jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

Buyer - $24.50 - $36.21 per hour

The purpose of this position is to perform responsible specialized work in procurement of assigned types of commodities at competitive prices in connection with the Central Procurement Operation of the City. Employees in this classification do detailed work involved in purchasing assigned commodity groups, including review of requisitions. Work involves the ability to communicate with vendors and City personnel in order to discern needs and ability to furnish needed materials. The employee exercises considerable judgment and initiative in the performance of work tasks. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Procurement Manager and Senior Buyer in accordance with established policies and is reviewed through observation and analysis of reports. Works with supervisor to prepare specifications for bidding and quoting purposes. Prepares bid packets, and quote packets, and public advertisement of tabulations.

Senior Buyer – $26.50 - $39.17 per hour 

The purpose of this position is to perform highly specialized work in the purchase of a variety of complex commodities for the City.  Employees in this classification function at senior professional level to perform detailed work in the preparation, research, writing, evaluating and administration of solicitations and contracts. The position consists of technical and professional work in the procurement of goods and services in compliance with federal, state and local policies and procedures. The Senior Buyer may act on behalf of the Procurement Manager in their absence. This position ensures proper administration of the solicitations, specifications, scopes of work and resulting agreements or contracts, purchase orders issued by the City in support of departmental activity.  Leads and participates in work of other staff within the division.

Essential Job Functions

Buyer 

  • Purchases assigned commodities, supplies, services and equipment.
  • Evaluates requisitions and confers with department representatives on specifications, quantity, quality and delivery requirements of merchandise.
  • Solicits and analyzes written and verbal quotations for materials, supplies, services and equipment.
  • Performs expediting and follow-up activities to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Interviews vendors and their representatives and maintains close contact by telephone and correspondence.
  • Contacts suppliers and vendors regarding condition of goods and errors in shipment, prices and extensions.
  • Assists in establishing schedules for purchases and term contracts for annual requirements.
  • Assists in preparation of manuals and procedures.
  • Assists with the administration of the procurement card program.
  • Remains familiar with the State of Florida Contracts system.
  • Exercises responsibility to assist Procurement Manager in administration of purchasing procedures for all City acquisitions.
  • Performs some general clerical functions, filing, answering telephone, taking messages, inventory functions and other support activities, as required.
  • Performs special assignments.
  • Works with supervisor to prepare specifications for bidding and quoting purposes.        Prepares bid packets, and quote packets, and public advertisement of tabulations.
  • Creates, monitors and recommends award of formal bids as directed by the Procurement Manager.
  • Creates, monitors and facilitates the evaluation of formal RFP’s as directed by the Procurement Manager. 
  • Maintains awareness of the material requirements of all City departments.
  • Candidate must be highly proficient in the use of a personal computer and associated general software such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.  Procurement staff are responsible for completing their own correspondence and all computer related data entry.
  • Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and business letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.  
  • Performs specialized technical and professional work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure.
  • Directs actions of others, making decisions almost constantly, affecting coworkers and City staff.
  • Performs related functions as required.

Senior Buyer 

  • Performs complex and specialized purchasing work according to generally accepted public procurement principles. Provides initial and ongoing support to the department staff assigned to all types of complex and simple procurement functions for all City Departments.
  • Serves as the liaison between City departments and the procurement division for all department needs related to procurement.
  • Prepares and reviews justifications, specifications, and scopes of work for high dollar and complex procurement; performs complex purchasing work according to, regulatory requirements applicable to the work, City Procurement Policy/Code, established policies and procedures, and departmental guidelines.
  • Monitors, reviews and processes departmental requisitions, specifications and procurement related to City Agreements and City Commission agenda items for accuracy and conformance with established policies and procedures; communicates with various department users to determine needs for contractual and consultant services, commodities, materials, supplies and equipment. 
  • Prepares specifications, legal advertisements, invitations and addendums to bid, Requests for Proposals, solicitation schedules, contracts, contract amendments and options of renewals; advertises formal bids and solicits quotations; assists with facilitating bid openings and tabulations; conducts pre-solicitation conferences; conducts solicitation evaluation process and price analysis; reviews post-award documents.
  • Prepares formal solicitations and works with departments to develop scope of services and/or specifications, conditions and requirements; works with department users to evaluate complex bids to ensure compliance and consistency with purchasing policies and regulations while fulfilling department needs; prepares and issues purchase orders; assists departments with vendor disputes.
  • Tracks purchase requisitions and purchase orders on computer; investigates any outstanding purchase orders, invoices or inquiries; works closely with requesting divisions/offices and the supplier to reconcile problems pertaining to delivery of goods, procurement process and/or receiving for the payment of goods.
  • Conducts meetings, interviews vendors, evaluates new products, and solicits user feedback for needed goods and services; coordinates and conducts meetings and training sessions with City staff.
  • Communicates with vendors on product pricing, specifications and availability; participates in solicitation reviews and debriefings with vendors; discusses results with department users.
  • Assists in the development, drafting, and review of new/revised procedures, and programs related to purchasing and contract administration.
  • Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and business letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.  
  • Performs supervisory work involving policy and guidelines, solving both people and work-related issues.
  • Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percentages.
  • Performs specialized technical and professional work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure.
  • Directs actions of others, making decisions almost constantly, affecting coworkers and City staff.
  • Performs related functions as required.

Minimum Requirements

Buyer 

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED.  Associates degree with major or minor course work in business administration, public administration, or related field or an equivalent combination of experience and education.  Work experience will be considered in lieu of college degree or credits.
  • A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in the following: procurement, supply activity, assisting with contract negotiations or contract management.  Experience in government or municipal procurement is highly desirable.   
  • Must be able to communicate clearly orally and in writing.
  • Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.  These programs are used on a daily basis in performing the duties of this position. Must be capable of using or learning to use on-line web hosted software applications for bid management, vendor notifications and contract administration/management. Must be capable of using or learning to use virtual meeting software applications to host online meetings related to Solicitations, presentations and City department training and collaboration.
  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 
  • Public procurement certification (such as CPPB, NIGP-CPP or CPP) is preferred, but not required.

 Senior Buyer 

  • Graduation from a four (4) year accredited college with major or minor course work in business administration or related field or an equivalent combination of experience and education.  A college degree is desirable but not required. Work experience will be considered in lieu of college degree or credits.
  • Four (4) or more years’ experience in one or more of the following: procurement, buying, supply activity, contract negotiation or contract management.  Experience in the government or municipal sector is highly desirable.
  • Must be able to communicate clearly orally and in writing. 
  • Must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel software programs. These programs are used on a daily basis in performing the duties of this position. Must be capable of using or learning to use on-line web hosted software applications for bid management, vendor notifications and contract administration/management. Must be capable of using or learning to use virtual meeting software applications to host online meetings related to Solicitations, presentations and City department training and collaboration.
  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 
  • Public procurement certification (such as CPPB, NIGP-CPP or CPP) is preferred, but not required.

jobs.title: Maintenance Worker I - Facilities
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to perform routine manual work. The class is responsible for the maintenance of City property using hand or power tools or equipment. Workers typically perform a variety of tasks, which may, include any combination of the following: light carpentry, digging, raking, sprinkler installation and repair, painting and power washing and completing logs or routine records. The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Operates vehicles such as trucks to haul people or material to job sites.
  • Loads and unloads materials such as gravel, dirt, timber, chemicals, or other materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Performs utility service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches, assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes and irrigation systems.
  • Performs maintenance functions such as repairing irrigation, greasing pumps, motors, and shafts, and replacing valves; performs light repairs and installations as directed.
  • Maintains indoor areas such as cleaning facilities and indoor areas, performing light maintenance such as painting and minor repairs.
  • Assists the public by answering questions and providing routine information.
  • Performs clerical tasks such as completing work orders or maintaining logs.
  • Compares or inspects items against a standard.
  • Follows instructions and orders of supervisor.
  • Makes a few decisions, affecting only the individual.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires two years or more of routine manual work experience.

  • Must possess a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment at time of hire.

summary.good_fit: you have two years of manual work experience and a valid Florida driver license with a satisfactory driving record.

jobs.title: Trades Technician
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to maintain City buildings, facilities, grounds, and irrigation systems. The class is responsible for installation, modification, maintenance, and repair of facilities including electrical, carpentry, mechanical, plumbing, painting, masonry, outdoors structures and fixtures, and completing logs, forms, and reports. Also responsible for the efficient maintenance of City parks. The class works according to some procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Inspects or monitors condition of buildings, structures, fixtures, equipment, and outside structures for needed maintenance or repairs
  • Initiates installation, modification, construction, maintenance or repair actions in response to inspections or work orders in regards to plumbing, HVAC, and electrical. 
  • Estimates materials and determines tools, support equipment, or other things needed for job; secures needed items and transports to job site.
  • Performs indoor maintenance including painting, carpentry, plumbing, electrical or mechanical repairs, fixture moving or repair, and other.
  • Performs outdoor maintenance including concrete work, painting, roof replacing or repairs, structure or fixture repair, and other.
  • Assists other departments or offices with maintenance tasks.
  • Maintains job-related forms such as logs, activity reports, material reports, and other.
  • Operate a wide variety of Maintenance equipment. 
  • Work in adverse weather conditions.
  • Work independently or with other staff.
  • Effectively communicate and deal with public.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED. Requires a minimum of four years of job-related experience.

  • Must have a good working knowledge of plumbing – repairs and maintenance, HVAC preventative maintenance, and electrical troubleshooting/minor repairs.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

jobs.title: Police Officer
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to protect life and property, enforce laws, and investigate crime. The class is responsible for surveillance, law enforcement, investigations, apprehension, and reporting. The class works according to procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Conducts routine patrols in residential and business areas; maintains contact with businesses and residents to establish good relations.
  • Responds to calls for police service and responds to crimes, domestic disputes, disturbances, disputes among neighbors, juveniles, or other incidents; apprehends law breakers as necessary; conducts follow-up investigations of crimes and other incidents, conducts surveillance of areas for suspected or potential criminal activity
  • Provides information and/or assistance to the public, informing citizens of services in the community, or providing referrals to other city, county, or state agencies.
  • Maintains the peace and safety of the community by quelling public disturbances and maintaining order at group functions.
  • Provides for the safe and convenient flow of traffic and pedestrians within the community, investigates traffic accidents, enforces traffic violations, promotes vehicular and pedestrian safety, reports unsafe road conditions, and conducts DUI or other investigations.
  • Issues civil or legal documents such as traffic citations; prepares written reports, forms, and other documents as required; may testifies in civil and criminal court proceedings or give depositions.
  • Provides specialized police service when trained and assigned such as K-9, Bicycle Patrol, Motorcycle Patrol, or other.  
  • May perform administrative or specialized functions when trained and assigned such as administrative support services, property and evidence, field and firearms training, public information, athletics, or other. 

Minimum Requirements

Requires a high school diploma or GED. Applicants currently serving in the military or currently employed as a certified law enforcement officer, seeking to relocate to this area and hold a valid driver's license, will be eligible to test and interview. Police Recruit opportunity also available to anyone interested in becoming a Police Officer with our agency. Prior or current attendance at a Law Enforcement academy is not required to be eligible to test and interview. However, if offered a recruit opportunity, the applicant will be required to enroll in a State of Florida approved Criminal Justice Training Center for Law Enforcement Certification Training or Comparative Compliance Course prior to commencing employment. All applicants must pass the State Exam prior to becoming a Police Officer. Reserve Police Officer opportunities may also be available, as needed, and applicants must meet the minimum requirements noted within this description.

An eligibility list will be established for future openings.  

Employee must live within a 20-mile radius of the Leesburg city limits within 15 months of employment. 

Marginal Job Functions

This position gathers, organizes, analyzes, examines, or evaluates data or information and may prescribe action based on such data or information.  Persuades or influences others in favor of a service, point of view, or course of action; may enforce laws, rules, regulations, or ordinances.  Handles or uses machines, tools, or equipment that requires moderate instruction and experience such as protective equipment, police vehicles, firearms, computers, and software programs such as word processing, spreadsheets or custom law enforcement applications.  Performs skilled work involving rules/systems but solves problems almost constantly.   Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percent. Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form. Performs technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure.  Guides others, making frequent decisions, affecting the individual, coworkers, and others that depend on the service or product.

jobs.title: Maintenance Worker I - Grounds
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to perform routine manual work.  This class is responsible for service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, valves, fittings, and manholes; landscape, road, sidewalk, driveway restoration and other outdoor work.  Completes logs or routine records.  The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision.   

Essential Job Functions

  • Operates vehicles such as trucks to transport people or material to job sites.
  • Loads and unloads materials such as gravel, dirt, timber, chemicals, or other materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintains outdoor areas by cutting grass, pruning trees and bushes, raking leaves and debris, installing landscape material, and other maintenance tasks.
  • Performs utility service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, manholes, and sewer lines.
  • Performs maintenance functions such as repairing irrigation, greasing pumps, motors, and shafts, and replacing valves; performs light repairs and installations as directed.
  • Maintains indoor areas such as cleaning facilities and indoor areas, performing light maintenance such as painting and minor repairs.
  • Assists the public by answering questions and providing routine information.
  • Performs clerical tasks such as completing work orders or maintaining logs.
  • Compares or inspects items against a standard.
  • Follows oral and written directions; communication effectively in both oral and written form of supervisor
  • Makes a few decisions, affecting only the individual.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work, including City and other government officials, community groups, and the general public; and applying safe work practices.

Minimum Requirements

Previous experience working in a ground’s maintenance position preferred, but not required. Employee will receive on the job training.


General knowledge of computer usage preferred.


Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 


May be required to acquire and maintain a specific applicators license.

Marginal Job Functions

  • Attends unit meetings, in-service training, workshops, etc. for the purpose of gathering information required to perform job functions.  
  • Performs other related duties as assigned for ensuring the efficient and effective functioning of the work unit.

jobs.title: Fleet Manager
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

Performs administrative and managerial work directing the City’s centralized fleet division. Work involves responsibility for planning and directing the fleet management program, contractors and city employees; to include the maintenance, servicing, modification and repair of municipal vehicles. Responsible also for replacement and disposal of a wide variety of automotive, vehicular, emergency and heavy construction equipment. Develops and submits bid specifications for vehicle and equipment purchases.  The class works within broad policy and organizational guidelines; independently plans and implements projects; reports progress of major activities through periodic conferences and meetings.

Essential Job Functions

  • Supervises staff including selecting or recommending selection, training, assigning and evaluating work, counseling, discipline, and recommending termination.
  • Coordinates operations with all City departments and the public; analyzes preventive maintenance and repair procedures, establishes and organizes repair priorities; evaluates replacement and expanding equipment needs for the City; declares equipment excess to City needs.
  • Develops policies and procedures for safety and daily operations in accordance with requirements and guidelines, promulgates, and evaluates to ensure compliance.
  • Operates and maintains vehicle and equipment fueling and cleaning stations.
  • Inspects or diagnoses vehicles or equipment with complex problems; advises and assists subordinates, or performs especially difficult or complex maintenance tasks.
  • Prepares and administers annual budget; establishes and or reviews and approves program goals and objectives; monitors and ensures adherence to include maintenance and repair cost on vehicles.
  • Attends or conducts staff meetings to exchange information; attends, and schedules others to attend, in-service training and technical classes, seminars, or conferences to improve skills.  
  • Develop and implement specific computer systems and software relative to operations of the Fleet Division of Public Works. Review of periodic analytical reports on performance; ensure attainment of desired goals and level of Service.
  • Formulates operating policies and procedures and establishes work standards and performance metrics; develops fiscal year work calendar relative to the maintenance management program.

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Automotive Engineering, Automotive Technology, Business Management or related discipline preferred. Eight or more years of experience in an automotive fleet environment with a minimum of four (4) years as a supervisor or manager in a fleet environment. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

  • Performs supervisory work involving policy and guidelines, solving both people and work related problems.

  • Uses basic algebra involving variables and formulas, basic geometry involving plane and solid figures such as circumferences, areas, or volumes; may compute ratios, rates, or percents.

  • Read technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

  • Performs specialized technical and administrative work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida Class B CDL and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.  
     
    Must obtain a valid State of Florida Class “A” Commercial Driver’s License within six (6) months of hire date. 

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

jobs.title: Senior ER Technician
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to maintain City motorized vehicles and equipment.  The class is responsible for preventive maintenance, major and minor repairs, vehicle modifications, maintenance documentation, and parts inventories.   The class works within a general outline of work to be performed, develops work methods and sequences under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Inspects vehicles and equipment and performs preventive maintenance.
  • Performs highly specialized diagnostic and repair to fire pumps, governor systems, control valves and plumbing on fire apparatus to include aerial and ARRF.
  • Installs and repairs emergency vehicle equipment for police and fire vehicles.
  • Inspects, sets-up, and otherwise prepares new vehicles and equipment to be placed in service.
  • Performs routine minor maintenance such as tire change, timing, adjusting, and lubricating.
  • Performs major repairs such as engine overhaul or transmission repair or replacement.
  • May perform vehicle modification such as installing or removing special equipment, or other modifications.
  • May perform State safety inspections as required.
  • Must have knowledge of NFPA standards.
  • May train or advise less experienced personnel.
  • Performs shop or area maintenance such as general clean up.
  • Prepares documentation for maintenance activities such as repairs, parts used, cost, and other information.
  • Provides advice and assistance to vehicle or equipment operators as necessary.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED. 

  • Requires a minimum of five (5) years of experience in fire apparatus, police vehicles, automobiles, heavy equipment maintenance and repairs. Must have experience with diagnostics scanning tools or a closely related field.

  • Performs skilled work involving rules/systems but solves problems almost constantly.

  • Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percents.

  • Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports and forms; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

  • Performs manual and technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. Must have a State of Florida Class A CDL within six (6) months of employment.   

  • Must have and maintain a minimum of five (5) EVT certifications in fire apparatus within eighteen (18) months of employment.  

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

This is a general description of duties and is not all-inclusive.  This is temporary, entry level work assisting with recreational activities, events and programs of the City of Leesburg’s Recreation Department

jobs.title: Electrician JM
jobs.description_html:
Journeyman Electrician

Location: Tampa Bay Area, FL
Pay Rate: $28.00–$35.00 per hour (Depending on Experience)
Employment Type: Temp-to-Perm
Openings: 2 Positions
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Job Description

Liberty Staffing USA is seeking experienced Journeyman Electricians for a busy and growing Commercial Building Maintenance company serving the Tampa Bay area. This is an excellent opportunity for skilled electricians looking for stable, full-time employment with the potential for permanent placement.

Most work will be performed at large hospitals and commercial facilities throughout the Tampa Bay area.

Responsibilities

  • Perform commercial electrical installations, repairs, and maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose electrical systems and equipment.
  • Complete electrical work while following safety standards and building codes.
  • Assist with commercial building maintenance projects.
  • Be willing to learn and assist with HVAC installations.
  • Participate in cross-training to develop additional building maintenance skills.
  • Maintain a professional attitude and provide quality service at job sites.

Requirements

  • 5–10 years of commercial electrical experience.
  • Journeyman Electrician experience and strong knowledge of commercial electrical systems.
  • Must be seeking long-term, full-time employment.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable personal transportation.
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check.
  • Must be able to pass a drug screening.
  • Willingness to learn HVAC installation and other building maintenance skills.
  • Dependable, professional, and committed to excellent attendance.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay: $28.00–$35.00 per hour, depending on experience.
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM.
  • Employment: Temp-to-Perm opportunity.
  • Openings: 2.

Apply through Liberty Staffing USA today!

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Vision insurance

Grind and Pack Machine Operator

Location: Eustis, FL
Pay Rate: $20.50 per hour
Shift: 2nd shift- 3pm till 11:30pm
Overtime: May be required and occasionally mandatory

The Grind & Pack Operator Lead is a vital member of our manufacturing team, responsible for overseeing grinding and packaging operations to ensure efficient production, quality control, and safety compliance. This leadership position coordinates daily team activities, troubleshoots operational challenges, and drives continuous improvements to optimize workflow and equipment performance. Acting as the bridge between management and staff, the Lead fosters a collaborative work environment and supports team development to meet and exceed company goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise and lead grind and pack operators to maintain smooth and efficient production processes
  • Monitor equipment performance, perform routine maintenance, and coordinate repairs to minimize downtime
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, quality standards, and regulatory requirements
  • Train, mentor, and evaluate team members to improve skills and performance
  • Collaborate with production planners and quality control teams to meet production deadlines and quickly resolve operational issues
  • Implement process improvements and maintain accurate production documentation

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably with grinding and packaging operations
  • Proven leadership or supervisory experience in production settings
  • Basic mechanical aptitude with familiarity in manufacturing equipment
  • Strong knowledge of workplace safety standards and quality control

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree or technical certification in manufacturing, industrial technology, or related fields
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies
  • Proficiency in manufacturing software and data tracking systems
  • Experience in training and staff development
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement and project management principles

Additional Requirements:

  • Proven machine operator experience

  • Stable work history preferred (frequent short-term roles may not be considered)

jobs.title: Construction Superintendent
jobs.description_html:
COMMERCIAL CONSTRUCTION SUPERINTENDENT

Direct Hire Opportunity | South Florida

Starting Annual Salary: $75,000
Schedule: 1st Shift
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Location: South Florida

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Construction Superintendent to independently oversee daily field operations and lead commercial construction projects from mobilization through final project turnover.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial construction, excellent leadership and communication skills, and the ability to coordinate subcontractors, manage project schedules, maintain safety standards, and ensure quality workmanship.

Projects typically range from $1 million to $5 million and include healthcare, retail, industrial, medical, and commercial interior build-outs, renovations, and ground-up construction.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced construction professional looking for a long-term career with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily jobsite operations, including subcontractor coordination, deliveries, site logistics, and inspections.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized jobsite while enforcing all safety requirements.
  • Review construction drawings, specifications, and subcontractor scopes to identify potential issues.
  • Coordinate with Project Managers to maintain project schedules and resolve field-related challenges.
  • Develop short-term look-ahead schedules and ensure subcontractors have the necessary manpower and materials.
  • Monitor construction progress and ensure quality standards are met.
  • Maintain daily reports, progress photos, inspection records, and project documentation using Procore.
  • Communicate professionally with clients, architects, engineers, inspectors, vendors, and subcontractors.
  • Identify potential scope changes, unforeseen conditions, and schedule or cost impacts.
  • Monitor field expenses, equipment needs, and material requirements.
  • Oversee punch-list completion, final inspections, and project turnover.
  • Provide hands-on support when necessary while maintaining overall responsibility for field supervision.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of commercial construction superintendent experience preferred.
  • Proven ability to independently manage commercial construction projects from start to finish.
  • Experience with commercial build-outs, renovations, and/or ground-up construction.
  • Experience managing projects valued between $1 million and $5 million is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, scheduling, and construction methods.
  • Experience coordinating multiple subcontractors and construction trades.
  • Proficiency with Procore and Bluebeam preferred.
  • OSHA 30 certification preferred.
  • First Aid/CPR certification preferred.
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel to local project sites.
  • Ability to work outdoors and accommodate occasional project-related schedule adjustments, including nights or weekends.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $75,000 annual base salary
  • Performance-based bonus eligibility.
  • Company-paid employee-only health insurance premium.
  • $1,000 monthly company contribution toward offered family health coverage.
  • 401(k) with company match up to 4%, subject to plan terms.
  • Two weeks of starting paid time off.
  • Paid holidays.
  • Mileage reimbursement with a monthly minimum.
  • Company-provided phone and iPad.

Work Location & Schedule

  • Location: South Florida.
  • Shift: 1st Shift.
  • Projects generally located within approximately 90 minutes of the designated local area.
  • Assignments outside the local area may be considered travel assignments and handled under applicable travel arrangements.
  • Occasional nights and weekends may be required depending on project needs.

Employment Opportunity

This is a Direct Hire position, meaning the selected candidate will be hired directly by the company.

If you have a strong background in commercial construction and are ready to take the lead on exciting projects, we would love to hear from you!

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Solderer
jobs.description_html:
PCB Soldering Technician – Experienced

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced PCB Soldering Technician to perform precision soldering and assembly of printed circuit boards (PCBs). This is not an entry-level position. Qualified candidates must have previous hands-on experience soldering electronic components and working with circuit board assemblies in a professional manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

Perform precision hand soldering of electronic components onto printed circuit boards.
Solder both surface-mount (SMT/SMD) and through-hole components.
Inspect solder joints for quality, accuracy, and defects.
Perform rework and repairs on PCB assemblies as needed.
Read and interpret assembly drawings, schematics, and work instructions.
Use soldering stations, microscopes, and other electronic assembly tools.
Follow established quality standards and production procedures.

Requirements

Minimum 2 years of professional PCB soldering experience required.
Previous experience soldering circuit boards is mandatory.
All qualified candidates will be required to complete a hands-on PCB soldering skills assessment during the interview to demonstrate their soldering proficiency, precision, and workmanship.
Strong knowledge of surface-mount and through-hole soldering techniques.
Experience with fine-pitch components and detailed soldering work.
Ability to identify and correct soldering defects.
Familiarity with IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 standards preferred.
Excellent hand-eye coordination and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently while maintaining quality and production standards.

Preferred Qualifications

IPC soldering certification.
Experience with PCB rework and component replacement.
Previous experience in electronics manufacturing or circuit board assembly.

Benefits

Health insurance


Background check and drug screening required.

jobs.title: Banquet Operations Attendant / Steward
jobs.description_html:
Job description:

We are seeking a dedicated Steward to join our dynamic culinary and hospitality team. The Steward plays a vital role in maintaining the cleanliness, organization, and safety standards of our kitchen and dining areas. This position ensures that all food handling, sanitation, and kitchen operations adhere to strict health and safety regulations. The ideal candidate will possess strong attention to detail, excellent manual handling skills, and a proactive approach to supporting our culinary staff. This paid position offers an opportunity to develop foundational skills in food safety management and kitchen operations within a fast-paced environment.

Duties

Assist with food preparation tasks, including basic ingredient handling and portioning under supervision
Maintain cleanliness of all kitchen areas by regularly sanitizing surfaces, equipment, and utensils following food safety sanitizing procedures
Support bussing activities by clearing tables promptly and efficiently to ensure a clean dining environment
Operate kitchen equipment safely, including dishwashers, ovens, and other small appliances
Handle food safely during storage, transportation, and service in accordance with food handling standards
Perform heavy lifting tasks such as moving supplies, equipment, or bulk ingredients safely and correctly
Follow all sanitation protocols to uphold kitchen health and safety standards
Assist with dishwashing duties ensuring dishes, cookware, and utensils are thoroughly cleaned and sanitized
Support the culinary team during banquet or special event setups with basic food handling tasks
Adhere to all food safety management practices to prevent contamination or spoilage
Experience

Previous experience in food service or restaurant environments preferred; prior kitchen experience is advantageous
Experience working in banquet settings or large-scale catering environments is a plus
Familiarity with food safety procedures, sanitation standards, and kitchen health regulations
Experience with dishwashing, cleaning routines, and manual handling tasks in a commercial setting
Knowledge of operating basic kitchen equipment such as ovens, dishwashers, and food prep tools
Strong understanding of food safety management principles and proper hygiene practices
This role is ideal for individuals eager to build their culinary experience while supporting a high-standard hospitality operation. We welcome applicants committed to maintaining a safe, clean, and efficient kitchen environment that upholds the highest standards of sanitation and food safety.

Salary

$17-$19 Hourly (Based on experience)
Background Check and Drug Screen required.

jobs.title: Design Drafter
jobs.description_html:
Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Design Drafter to create and update detailed 2D and 3D technical drawings using SolidWorks and AutoCAD. This position supports manufacturing and fabrication projects by developing accurate layouts, structural assemblies, and component drawings.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of mechanical design, metal fabrication, and manufacturing processes, along with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

Responsibilities

Create and modify detailed 2D and 3D technical drawings using SolidWorks and AutoCAD.
Develop layouts and structural assembly drawings based on project specifications and customer requirements.
Design and incorporate sheet metal, structural metal, equipment, and hardware components into project drawings.
Review project requirements and collaborate with production teams to ensure designs are accurate and practical for manufacturing.
Research components and materials to ensure proper fit, spacing, and mechanical functionality.
Identify and resolve design issues during the drafting and manufacturing process.
Maintain accurate drawing revisions and follow company documentation standards.
Perform additional drafting and design support duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Associate degree in Drafting, Engineering Technology, or related field, or CAD certification.
Minimum 3 years of professional experience using SolidWorks and AutoCAD (excluding classroom training).
Experience with metal fabrication or manufacturing processes.
Strong understanding of 2D and 3D mechanical drafting.
Familiarity with sheet metal design, structural assemblies, and fabrication drawings.
Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to interpret technical specifications and identify potential design issues.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.

Ideal Candidate

Takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality technical drawings.
Understands how designs translate into real-world manufacturing processes.
Comfortable working independently and collaborating with production personnel.
Strong mechanical aptitude with excellent spatial awareness.
Organized, dependable, and able to meet project deadlines.
Proactive in identifying problems and developing practical solutions.
Work Environment: Primarily on-site manufacturing environment with limited remote flexibility (one day per week and occasional additional remote work as approved).

Position Type: Full-Time

Background check and drug screening required.

jobs.title: CNC 2ND Shift Lead
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced CNC Machinist for our 2nd shift manufacturing operations. This position requires an advanced-level machinist who can independently program, set up, troubleshoot, and operate CNC milling machines with minimal supervision.

Due to limited management and supervisory oversight during the second shift, candidates must be self-sufficient, dependable, and capable of making technical decisions independently. This is not an entry-level or machine operator-only position.

Schedule:

Monday – Thursday: 4:15 PM – 2:45 AM
Optional Friday shifts available for overtime
4-day standard workweek

Responsibilities

Independently program, set up, and operate CNC milling machines.
Read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and machining specifications.
Develop and modify CNC programs, including G-code and M-code.
Select tooling, establish offsets, and configure machines for production.
Troubleshoot programming, tooling, and machining issues without direct supervision.
Perform precision measurements using calipers, micrometers, and other inspection equipment.
Ensure finished parts meet quality standards and tight tolerances.
Manage assigned production tasks efficiently with limited oversight.
Maintain equipment, troubleshoot issues, and follow safety procedures.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of hands-on CNC machining experience; 7+ years strongly preferred.
Advanced CNC milling programming, setup, and operating experience required.
Must be capable of independently programming and setting up machines from start to finish.
Strong knowledge of CNC controls, G-code, M-code, tooling, and machine offsets.
Ability to read complex blueprints and interpret GD&T specifications.
Proven ability to troubleshoot machining problems independently.
Proficiency with precision measuring instruments and quality inspections.
Strong mechanical aptitude, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently with minimal leadership or supervision.
Reliable attendance and strong work ethic.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with multi-axis CNC milling machines.
Familiarity with CAD/CAM programming software.
Experience with Haas, Fanuc, or similar CNC controls.
Previous experience working independently on second or overnight shifts.
Job Type: Full-time

Shift: 2nd Shift – Monday through Thursday, 4:15 PM – 2:45 AM

Overtime: Optional Friday shifts available.

Benefits:

Health insurance
4-day standard workweek
Optional overtime opportunities
Background check and drug screening required.

jobs.title: CAD Designer
jobs.description_html:
Job description
Job Summary
 Skilled CAD/CAM Designer. The ideal candidate will have experience in a manufacturing environment and proficiency in CAM programing and Alpha CAM is a plus.
In this role, your responsibilities will include completing CAD drawings and programs for CNC. Ordering CNC bits. Working with CNC operators to maintain bits, perform daily machine maintenance, ensure CNC systems produce according to CAD programs.
-Train CNC operators
-Troubleshoot errors from CNC machines.
-Make drawings/prints for use on the shop floor.
-Create basic work instructions for CNC operators.
-Generate programs for twin-spindle twin-table CNC routers.
-Manage tooling and inventory.
-Basic to mid-level understanding of G and M codes
-Basic understanding of work coordinates and work offsets
-Develop, test, and improve workflows on both the office side, and on the shop floor
Goals:
-Looking to expand the capabilities of the shop by taking on new projects and developing new processes(pre-hang, assembled doors)
-Basic knowledge of coding in any language, but VBA a big plus
-Use of/experience with right angle or fourth axis tooling
-Working with team on cosmetic designs and feasibility for manufacturing

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching

  • Vision insurance
Schedule:

Job description:

Housekeeper / Houseman
Location: Venus, FL
Pay Rate: $18 per hour

We’re looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Housekeeper/Houseman to support daily operations at a luxury property. This role plays an important part in creating a clean, organized, and welcoming environment for guests. A strong eye for detail, pride in your work, and a genuine commitment to hospitality are key to being successful in this position.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and set up designated areas, ensuring all spaces are clean, organized, and guest-ready.
  • Clean and maintain offices, breakrooms, hallways, restrooms, and select outdoor areas.
  • Dust, mop, vacuum, and disinfect surfaces; restock supplies in restrooms and common areas.
  • Conduct routine inspections of assigned spaces and address cleanliness or maintenance needs promptly.
  • Work with management and maintenance teams on special requests and general inquiries.
  • Report safety concerns or maintenance issues to the appropriate team members.
  • Maintain a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays when needed.

  • Previous experience in housekeeping, hospitality, private clubs, or luxury resort settings is preferred.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well within a team.
  • Must be able to stand for long periods and safely lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work in a range of temperatures, including high heat and cold conditions.
  • Comfortable reading, writing, and speaking English.
  • Clean background

Background check and drug screen is required.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate
jobs.description_html:
Role Overview:

The Warehouse Associate is responsible for maintaining all stock inventory and pulling orders for manufacturing according to designated work orders by performing the following duties. These duties may vary to include some or all of the following job responsibilities.


Duties/Responsibilities:

· Determines work assignments and material or equipment needs based on written work orders or oral instructions.

· Responsible for order-fulfillment including packaging and banding orders, labeling product, and stacking finished orders on skids.

· May be required to maintain all stock inventories for warehouse daily.

· Maneuvers heavy materials with the use of forklift, pallet and hand truck as required.

· Responsible for unskilled production work on assembly line.

· Loads and Unloads shipping trucks as required.

· Maintains and ensures all machines and equipment are functioning according to established work standards and follows all safety guidelines and regulations.

· Assists shipping area with package procedures, including label printing, as requested.

· Monitors products for quality and uniformity; reports any identified problems to Supervisor/Manager in timely manner.

· May be asked to stand in as a backup for Line Leads as needed.

· Complies with company policies and procedures giving special attention to safety regulations.

· Promotes self-improvement in assigned tasks and always maintains a clean and safe work environment by sweeping, cleaning, and removing trash.

· Performs other related duties as assigned.


Required Skills/Abilities:

· Ability to follow directions and work well in a team.

· Ability to handle materials and equipment in a responsible manner.

· Ability to work in a variety of roles

· Basic understanding of or ability to quickly learn company products and terminology.

· Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent customer service and time management skills.

· Ability to perform repetitive tasks.


Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

· Must be able to continuously lift and move up to 75 pounds.

· Must be able to perform physical activities that require considerable use of arms and legs and moving the entire body. This will include climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, carrying, bending, twisting, and stooping.

· Regularly exposed to fumes, allergens, or airborne particles, and outdoor weather conditions.

· May occasionally be exposed to mild chemicals.

· Occasionally exposed to electric powered equipment, conveyor belt and compressed air.

· The noise level in the work environment is moderate to high.

jobs.description_html:
Box Truck Driver

Job description

Overview
We are seeking a reliable and dedicated Truck Driver to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for transporting goods safely and efficiently to various locations while ensuring excellent customer service. This role requires a strong commitment to safety, adherence to traffic regulations, and the ability to handle heavy lifting and moving tasks.

Duties

  • Operate box trucks, vans, or other delivery vehicles to transport goods to designated locations.
  • Load and unload cargo using pallet jacks and other equipment as necessary.
  • Ensure that all deliveries are made in a timely manner while maintaining high standards of customer service.
  • Conduct pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the vehicle to ensure safety and compliance with regulations.
  • Maintain accurate delivery logs and documentation as required.
  • Communicate effectively with warehouse staff and customers regarding delivery schedules and any potential issues.
  • Assist in moving goods within the warehouse as needed, ensuring efficient organization of inventory.

Requirements

  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
  • Experience operating box trucks or vans preferred; experience as a courier or delivery driver is a plus.
  • Ability to perform heavy lifting and moving tasks (up to 50 pounds).
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to interact positively with clients.
  • Familiarity with warehouse operations and logistics is advantageous.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility in working hours, including potential overtime or weekend shifts when necessary.

Join our team today and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service while ensuring the safe transportation of goods!

The Appraiser is responsible for scheduling and writing estimates within Company guidelines at residences, shops or tow yards based on assignments received.

  • Inspecting, photographing and appraising damage to vehicles involved in an automobile accident or loss.

  • Review repair-cost estimates with automobile repair shop to secure agreement on cost of repairs.

With a nationally ranked reputation for outstanding customer service and a history that spans more than a century, NJM is a leading provider of worker’s compensation, automobile, and homeowner’s insurance in New Jersey. It is an exciting time to join NJM as we are expanding into other states. 
Become a member of our team and you’ll be part of company who operates for the benefit of its policyholders and is committed to maintaining the highest levels of service. Team members are offered a competitive compensation package and benefits including: a 401k plan, health coverage, a generous paid time off plan, and much more! 
 NJM is currently seeking a Staff Auto Damage Appraiser , Senior to inspect first and third party vehicle damage and then providing an estimate to repair damage. The Appraiser is responsible for scheduling and writing estimates within Company guidelines at residences, shops or tow yards based on assignments received.
 This role will be covering a Gloucester , Camden and part of Burlington county.
 NJM does not provide a company vehicle but we do reimburse for mileage and tolls. 
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.
 Contacting and arranging schedules with customers, autobody shops and tow yards
 Inspecting, photographing and appraising damage to vehicles involved in an automobile accident or loss.
 Estimate parts and labor to repair damage, using standard automotive labor and parts-cost software.
 Evaluate practicality of repair as opposed to payment of market value of vehicle before accident.
 Review repair-cost estimates with automobile repair shop to secure agreement on cost of repairs.
 Complete, review, and reconcile supplemental repair estimates
 Estimates are created and negotiated based on company guidelines and applicable law.
 Reinspect and review estimates for accuracy and conformity to Company guidelines.
 Complete required courses and training
 Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.
 Customer service skills and experience
 Multi-tasking, problem-solving, negotiation and decision-making abilities.
 Technical aptitude, including working knowledge with estimating systems,
 Own vehicle and have reliable transportation.
 Adequate space for a home office and ability to work in an unsupervised environment.
 3-5 years of Body Shop experience and/or related insurance experience required.
 High School Diploma or GED
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Familiar with CCC One Estimating platform
 PA Auto Appraiser License
 I-Car Certified

jobs.title: Property Damage Rep (I/II/Sr) – Parsippany, NJ
jobs.description_html:
Our General Claims department in Parsippany, NJ is looking for a Property Damage Representative candidate who has excellent communication skills as well as strong organizational and time management skills.  We are looking for talent with and without prior experience in the insurance industry.

Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:45 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with work from home opportunities after training is complete.

Salary: The level and salary is commensurate with direct experience and credentials.

  •  Level I - $51,120.55 - $67,542.80 annually based on experience

  •  Level II - $58,737.25 - $89,324.95 annually based on experience

  •  Sr. Level - $77,698.40 - $102,805.30 annually based on experience

Responsibilities

  • Appropriately handle, settle and close property damage (automobile) claims by bringing a prompt and amicable resolution

  • Verify coverage, open claims, contact parties involved

  • Verify and investigate information presented by first and third party claimants

  • Schedule appraisals or repair facilities, assess related damage

  • Contact witnesses, police departments, attorneys or other insurance companies

  • Claims are settled and negotiated based on company guidelines and applicable law

Requirements

  • Level I - Customer service experience or experience interacting with the public in a professional setting is required or Bachelor’s degree

  • Level II – Minimum 2 yrs. experience as a Property Damage/Auto Claims Adjuster

  • Sr Level - Minimum 4 yrs. experience as a Property Damage/Auto Claims Adjuster and completion of AIC/CPCU or licensed to adjust claims in Texas or Connecticut

  • High school diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s degree is a plus

  • Knowledge of Claims or Personal Lines area are a plus

  • Requires strong oral and written communication skills

  • Ability to deliver a high-quality customer service experience while showing empathy and kindness to customers in need

  • Multi-tasking, problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Technical aptitude, including a working knowledge with Microsoft Office

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to juggle multiple priorities and manage time effectively

  • Ability to think critically, use resources and seek answers

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $0-$0

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

jobs.title: Claims Insights Analyst, Associate
jobs.description_html:
Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.


NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.



NJM Insurance Group’s Claims Analytics group is seeking a Claims Insights Analyst. The Claims Insights Analyst applies a strong understanding of data sources and associated business processes to provide management with research, analysis and insights in support of departmental strategies and goals.


This position will perform analysis on large and diverse sets of data to tell compelling stories through presentations, dashboards and visualizations to drive strategic decision making. The Claims Insights Analyst is a highly motivated, creative self-thinker and has a good sense for interpreting and communicating the “why” behind the data and application to the business.


The Business Insights Analyst, Associate applies an understanding of data sources and associated business processes to provide management with research, analysis and insights in support of department strategies and goals. This position will run queries and perform basic analysis to assist in telling compelling stories through presentations, dashboards and visualizations to drive strategic decision-making. The Business Insights Analyst, Associate is a motivated, creative thinker and has a sense for interpreting and communicating the “why” behind the data and application to the business.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.


  • Assist in the development of intelligent insights from analysis of both quantitative and qualitative data, testing basic hypotheses, running exploratory analysis and identifying trends in support of business strategies and goals. Assists in translating results/findings into clear and concise presentations for management and develop plans for corrective action. Assist in the development and enhancement of department KPI dashboards, analytics and reports to monitor performance to create a comprehensive view of the business.

  • Assist in collaborating with cross-functional business teams and Data Engineers to fully understand the meaning, business rules and structure of required data and ensure alignment and consistency of data to support the end-to-end journey. Partner with the department Business Process Unit to identify, plan and prioritize source system improvements that facilitate data analytics.

  • Assist in expanding understanding/knowledge of business processes and competitive environments. Scan the market to understand key trends impacting markets, customers, products, services and operational processes.

  • Assist in complying with Data Governance standards and guidelines for data definition, quality, accuracy, completeness, availability and security to encourage data integrity and conformance.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • BS from a 4-year accredited college/university in related field (Statistics, Mathematics, Business Intelligence, Finance etc.) or equivalent experience.
  • Basic analytical aptitude with the ability to turn raw data into presentations containing insights and visualizations that are critical in making strategic business decisions.
  • Technical knowledge with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Ability to read and understand data models
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • 1+ years writing queries (T-SQL)
  • 1+ years using business intelligence tools (Power BI, SSRS, SAS, Excel)

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.


NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $70,444-$81,849

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: First Notice of Loss Associate - Hourly
jobs.description_html:
The First Notice of Loss Associate serves as the first point of contact for policyholders, claimants or other parties reporting claims. They are responsible for addressing customer inquiries concerning the claim process and collecting essential details about the incident, to accurately and efficiently establish new Auto, Property and Commercial claims.  


Schedule (working 4 days per week): Monday-Friday (5:00PM - 9:00PM) and 2 Saturdays a month (8:30AM-4:30PM)


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Receive initial reports of loss or damage from policyholders, claimants or other parties.
  • Accurately process information into the system for assignment to an adjuster.
  • Address customers’ questions and concerns related to the claims process and procedures and offer clear instructions on the next steps.
  • Determine appropriate coverage and complete necessary follow-ups in a timely manner.
  • Navigate systems with proficiency to access appropriate information to service callers.
  • Perform additional duties within the department, as needed.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to build rapport with customers and demonstrate empathy during what may be a stressful time
  • Excellent listening skills
  • Ability to navigate multiple programs simultaneously.
  • Accurate keyboarding and data entry skills
  • High School Diploma or GED

Starting Rate: $22

Part Time employees are eligible for Paid Sick Leave and PTO as well as state-mandated Leave policies.  Employees may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Subpoena Unit
jobs.description_html:
General Summary 

 

Reporting to the General Claims Legal Operations Division Administrator, the Subpoena Unit Supervisor is responsible for the daily management, oversight, and delivery of subpoena and document production in the General Claims Legal Department. The Subpoena Unit Supervisor will ensure the timely and accurate review, analysis, processing, and response to subpoenas and other document production requests directed to the Company by supervising three subpoena clerks, analyzing document requests, and applying and improving processes. The Subpoena Unit Supervisor is responsible for maintaining compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, safeguarding highly confidential information, and fostering collaboration across business units to ensure efficient document retrieval and production.

This is a hybrid position with three days a week required in the office and up to two days a week working remotely. This is a Monday through Friday, day shift opportunity based in our West Trenton, New Jersey corporate office.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job. 

  • Provide direct supervision and daily workflow management for subpoena staff, ensuring appropriate workload distribution and timely completion of assignments. 
  • Establish and maintain quality control standards, performance metrics and compliance with subpoena response procedures and document production standards.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex subpoena, discovery, and litigation-related issues. 
  • Coordinate closely with General Claims Legal attorneys regarding legal and regulatory requirements. 
  • Develop employee skills related to document review, litigation, and subpoena compliance through coaching and training. 
  • Develop, recommend, and implement departmental objectives, workflow enhancements, and operational process improvements. 
  • Analyze and report on workload, productivity, operational performance, and trends to Legal Operations Division Administrator and General Claims Legal leadership to support operational decision making and resource planning.
  • Special projects, audits, and other departmental initiatives as needed. 

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

 

  • Paralegal Certificate required.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively lead, coach, develop staff. 
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify issues and implement effective solutions compliant with applicable Rules of Court and law. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail and customer service orientation. 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple deadlines, and a high-volume workload. 
  • Demonstrated experience managing workflow, quality assurance processes, and performance metrics. 
  • Ability to interpret and apply legal, regulatory, and company policies related to subpoena responses and document production requests. 
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments. 
  • Associate’s degree.

Preferred Qualifications: 

 

  • Knowledge of subpoena response requirements, document retention practices, and legal document production processes. 
  • Minimum of 2-4 years of supervisory, leadership, or management experience, preferably in a legal, or insurance environment. 

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $84,610-$98,261

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: CL Small Business Sales Representative
jobs.description_html:
Small Business Sales Representative

General Summary: A brief description of the main purpose for this position.

For NJM Small Business in New Jersey, serves as a liaison and relationship manager between the company sales and underwriting departments, and our agency partners. Assess the strengths and weaknesses of agents and assist them in achieving a mutual goal of small business profitable growth in both volume and policy count. Ensures that agents are familiar with and use NJMs ProQuote platform, products, policies, procedures and services. Conducts agency training as required on our platform.  

Key Objectives


• Increased NJM Small Business submission flow, new business conversion, and written premium growth through disciplined agency engagement and execution
• Improved agent, and CSR clarity on appetite, workflows, and how to do small business with NJM.
• Strong connectivity between agencies and underwriting, resulting in fewer stalled opportunities, faster issue resolution, and improved partner experience.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

General Responsibilities

  • Promotes ease of doing business with NJM’s Small Business platform.
  • Demonstrates to Premier Agents our ProQuote platform and provides regular training sessions for our agents with small business capabilities in the field.  
  • Monitors agency small business results and follows up with agent as to small business growth.
  • Develop professional working relationships with agents, sales and underwriting teams. Conduct sales and information technology training for agents and their staff.
  • Keeps communication between agent and company continuously open and viable; and encourages agent usage of all NJM ProQuote systems.
  • Advise company of any industry information, new ideas, products or any changes in other carrier philosophies that could positively or adversely affect NJM Small Business.
  • Meet regularly with sales and underwriting to discuss agency results and opportunities for greater growth and profitability.


Specific Job Responsibilities

 

Daily Sales Activities 40%

  • Drive individual new submission flow into Small Business and manage local pipelines with New Jersey agent submitted small business.
  • Conduct regular in-person and virtual agent engagement with frontline producers and CSRs, including training, appetite refresh, workflow enablement, and quoting navigation
  • Create demand for NJM’s Small Business products by reinforcing appetite fit, speed-to-quote, and ease-of-doing-business advantages

 

Agency Engagement & Local Presence 20%

  • Establish credibility as a trusted advisor through NJM’s Small Business product knowledge, underwriting appetite clarity, and workflow guidance

Small Business Market and Competition Awareness 20%
