jobs.title: Maintenance Operator - 2nd or 3rd Shift
jobs.description_html:
There’s never been a better time to join NJM!  With a nationally ranked reputation for outstanding customer service and a history that spans more than a century, NJM is a leading provider of worker’s compensation, automobile, and homeowner’s insurance in New Jersey. It is an exciting time to join NJM as we are expanding into other states.      

                                                                                                                                            Become a member of our team and you’ll be part of company who operates for the benefit of its policyholders and is committed to maintaining the highest levels of service.  Team members are offered a competitive compensation package and benefits including: a 401k plan, health coverage, a generous paid time off plan, and much more!  


NJM is seeking a Maintenance Operator (depending on experience this has the flexibility to be filled at the Senior level). The Maintenance Operator will assist with the daily operation of all facility systems, consisting of HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire suppression, building automation, and backup power systems. Provides instruction and guidance to other staff. Performing routine preventive maintenance and repairs on all facility systems and equipment. Overseeing and working alongside outside contractors on various jobs and PM assignments. Performs minor work assignments as needed on their own or with other maintenance staff. Monitors facility systems by computer, visual inspections, and logged readings. On call as needed when issues or emergencies arise. Works closely with supervision keeping them advised of operations and unresolved situations. Maintains and repairs numerous varying types of equipment.


Hours:

2nd shift: Monday to Friday: 3PM to 11:30PM with a 10% shift differential.

or

3rd Shift: Sunday to Thursday: 11:00PM to 7:30AM with a 15% shift differential.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Maintain facility work flow through established work order system, and updating PM schedules and assignments.
  • Routinely monitor the computer-based work order program for service requests that are entered and report any upset conditions to Supervisor.
  • Demonstrate a high regard for timely response and clear communication in response to situations that could impact business operations.
  • Monitor conditions and make adjustments to building mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.
  • Perform visual inspections of mechanical and electrical rooms and mission critical equipment and communicate any concerns or problems to the shift supervisor.
  • Oversee the shift operators monitoring of conditions and establish practices and routines to confirm systems are operating normally.
  • Identify potential system problems or abnormalities which may impact mission critical systems or the workplace environment
  • Serve as a first responder to emergency conditions caused by utility failures or malfunctions of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.
  • Keep management informed in a timely manner of all situations which may impact business operations.
  • Organize and maintain all maintenance records and technical documentation related to NJM systems.
  • Keep current and accurate as-built drawings of systems, bills of materials, system maintenance and repair records, and equipment inventories.
  • Document any contractor onsite, operating conditions, equipment status, incidents and system changes made in daily log entries.
  • Supervise upkeep and housekeeping of equipment rooms and other areas under the control of the maintenance department.
  • Confirm that all service vendor contract obligations are being met.
  • Proactively study, review, and maintain a working knowledge and understanding of the mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems throughout the facility.
  • Ensure that the NJM Procedures for Service and Construction Contractors are understood and followed.
  • Serve as the Facility Operations lead or backup Maintenance Operator.
  • Work closely with supervision, other members of the group, and independently to develop job specific skills that are necessary to become proficient in operating procedures.
  • Work to develop specific skills required to appropriately operate and maintain electrical distribution, chilled water, hot water, air handling, fire protection, fuel oil, domestic water, sanitary, storm water and gas systems.
  • Communicate any unresolved situations to supervision
  • Monitor conditions and make adjustments to building mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.
  • Demonstrate a high regard for timely response and clear communication in response to situations that could impact business operations.
  • Serve as a first responder to emergency conditions caused by utility failures or malfunctions of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection systems.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification, and/or license requirements.


Experience:

  • 5+ years’ experience in a hands-on maintenance related role.

Minimum & Desired Education:

  • High School, GED or Trade School Diploma

Certifications & License Requirements:

  • New Jersey State – Low Pressure (or higher) Boiler License (Minimum requirement -obtain with-in 6months)

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong technical and problem-solving skills.
  • Basic HVAC
  • Air Handling
  • Ductwork
  • Pump Repair
  • Basic Plumbing
  • Basic Electrical
  • Lighting
  • Electric Motors
  • Basic Carpentry
  • Boiler Operation
  • Chiller Operation
  • Pneumatic Building Systems
  • Diesel Generator Operation
  • Hand Tool Proficient
  • Power Tool Proficient
  • Basic Computer Operation
  • Experience with Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, Adobe, Access
  • Blueprint Reading and Understanding
  • Small Appliance Repair
  • Ability to Interpret Equipment Manuals and Diagrams
  • Strong People Skills

Preferred Qualifications:


Experience:

  • Basic Refrigeration

Certifications & License Requirements:

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • CAD Based Software
  • Building Management System Controls (Siemens Auto)

This role has the flexibility to be filled at the Senior level, based on experience, skills and abilities.


The salary range is $58,219 - $88,400 and is commensurate based on years of experience and skills.


Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $66,914-$77,667

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Enterprise Agile Transformation Coach (SPC Required)
jobs.description_html:
The Enterprise Agile Transformation Coach supports the adoption, maturity, and sustainability of Agile ways of working across Property & Casualty insurance delivery teams. This role partners with business, technology, and operational leaders to improve delivery predictability, value flow, and outcomes across core insurance value streams, while ensuring alignment with regulatory, risk, and governance requirements. 


The Agile Coach acts as a change agent, guiding teams and leaders beyond mechanical Agile adoption toward a sustainable Agile mindset that balances speed, quality, and compliance in a regulated insurance environment. 


The official NJM job title is Agile Coach, Sr.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
 

Team & Role Coaching

  • Help teams and delivery leaders adopt an agile mindset through coaching
  • Coach multiple cross-functional delivery teams across key P&C domains (Policy, Billing, Claims, Data, Digital). 
  • Mentor Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and delivery leaders to improve team maturity, flow, and outcomes. 
  • Reinforce clear role boundaries while promoting shared accountability. 
  • Observe, facilitate, and continuously improve Agile ceremonies with a focus on outcomes over process compliance. 
     

Insurance Value Streams & Delivery Flow

  • Coach teams organize work around P&C value streams rather than projects. 
  • Improve flow across intake, prioritization, delivery, and release. 
  • Align delivery metrics to meaningful insurance outcomes (cycle time, predictability, quality, customer experience). 
  • Support dependency management across policy, billing, claims, data, and vendor platforms. 
     

Organizational & Leadership Agility 

  • Partner with delivery leaders to model Agile leadership behaviors. 
  • Coach leaders on decision-making and flow-based planning. 
  • Support organizational change initiatives by reinforcing adoption and sustainability of Agile practices. 
  • Balance speed to market with governance, compliance, and risk needs. 
     

Agile Practices, Enablement & Community 

  • Support Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery models. 
  • Support facilitates PI planning, quarterly planning, retrospectives, and workshops. 
  • Design and deliver Agile training, workshops, and role-based learning sessions for teams and key Agile roles and leaders.
  • Develop reusable training materials, coaching guides, and enablement content to support consistent Agile adoption across teams, roles, and value streams.
  • Support onboarding of new teams
  • Support the development and maturity of NJM’s Lean-Agile Center of Excellence.
  • Help define Agile coaching standards, playbooks, maturity models, and enablement plans.
  • Partner with leaders to scale consistent Agile practices across teams and value streams.
  • Facilitate Agile communities of practice and knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Track adoption progress and recommend continuous improvement actions based on team maturity, delivery metrics, and stakeholder feedback.

Required Qualifications:

  • SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC) certification required.
  • Bachelor’s degree and equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years working in Agile or Lean delivery teams as a contributor
  • 3+ years as an Agile Coach, Scrum Master, or similar role
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise delivery teams
  • Strong facilitation, coaching, and communication skills
  • Ability to provide practical coaching experience in a real-world technology delivery environment with support from theoretical agile principles

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Property & Casualty insurance or financial services
  • Exposure to core insurance platforms (Guidewire, Duck Creek, or equivalent)
  • Experience partnering with PMO or any governance groups. 
  • Agile certifications (ICP-ACC, ICP-ATF, CSM, CSP)
  • Experience with the following tools: Agile Place, Planview and JIRA
  • Prior hands-on software delivery or engineering experience is strongly preferred

Key Competencies:

  • Servant leadership and coaching mindset
  • Systems thinking
  • Change leadership
  • Collaboration across business and technology
  • Ability to balance agility with governance

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $144,643-$167,898

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Staff Attorney - Insurance Coverage & Claims Counsel
jobs.description_html:
The Staff Attorney I (official NJM job title) performs coverage analysis, drafts and reviews relevant communications, which may include reservation of rights letters and coverage position letters associated with claims under personal and commercial insurance policies. 


The Staff Attorney I also monitors outside insurance defense litigation, coverage litigation, and appellate work under the supervision of a more senior attorney.  The Staff Attorney I provides General Claims staff with legal advice regarding coverage and various claims questions, assists in responding to regulatory and consumer inquiries, and advises on legal developments in case law, statutes and regulations.  The Staff Attorney I also provides General Claims Legal perspective to NJM business units on various matters including fraud, policy language, marketing materials, and legislation.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provides in-house legal oversight, advice and strategy recommendations relating to insurance defense and coverage litigation in the trial and appellate courts.
  • Timely, accurately, and thoroughly analyzes legal issues and advises the General Claims department regarding complex personal and commercial auto, homeowners and commercial property and liability claims and coverage issues.
  • Drafts and reviews coverage position and reservation of rights letters and other correspondence.
  • Identifies legal issues and trends, analyzes industry impact and develops a strategy to respond.
  • Provides advice and legal insight from a claims perspective on policy language, corporate communications, fraud, marketing materials, legislation, and other issues with clear communication.
  • Prepares written responses to regulatory and consumer inquiries.

Required Qualifications:

  • B.A. or B.S. and J.D. from an accredited law school, NJ Bar Admission in good standing or Limited License for In-House Counsel pursuant to N.J.Ct.R. 1:27-2.
  • 1-5 years' experience providing legal advice regarding insurance coverage and insurance defense matters.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Decisive and well organized, ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and a commitment to customer service.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Admissions to practice in NY, PA, CT, MD or OH a plus.
  • Experience litigating insurance defense and insurance coverage cases.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $102,745-$116,255

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Sr. Workers Compensation Claims Specialist
jobs.description_html:
NJM’s WC Claims Department is seeking an experienced Sr. Workers Compensation Claims Specialist who lives in or near Connecticut to provide on-site service to our policyholders and agents in that state.  This is a 100% remote position which includes virtual claims handling for customers in any area of CT and possibly MD, DE or PA as needed.  


At NJM, our WC Claims Department empowers our employees to focus on delivering guidance and empathy to our customers.  As a department driven by service and customer advocacy, we are committed to providing transparent, empathetic support and collaborative engagement during the life of a claim. The WC Claims Department takes pride in being a key component in the growth and success of our policyholders’ business operations.


To meet these expectations, WC Claims Specialists are supported by a dedicated call center who can field calls for them and other specialized units who are responsible for setting reserves, making permanency payments, and following through on subrogation so they can dedicate the time needed to manage claims. Many of our staff are long-tenured with a focus on building relationships, not only with our customers, but with each other providing a positive and nurturing work environment.

Hours: Monday to Friday 8:00AM- 4:15PM (Hours can vary depending on start time). Training may be required at one of our NJM offices.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure quality management of claims in accordance with claims best practices and company guidelines, and timely, accurate documentation of claim activity

  • Provide a high level of customer service that promotes injured worker advocacy-based principles to improve outcomes for all parties 

  • Determine compensability and coverage issues by gathering medical and factual evidence

  • Administer the delivery of timely, appropriate, and accurate benefits

  • Evaluate the claim for potential fraud indicators and escalate the claim to SIU, as appropriate

  • Recognize and investigate subrogation opportunity and refer to NJM subrogation staff for recovery of third-party funds

  • Initiate and provide excellent communication with all stakeholders (injured workers, medical providers, attorneys, policyholders, agents, etc.) professionally and proactively with a customer-centric approach

  • Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and mitigate exposures, and establish and implement a proactive strategic plan of action

  • Assign and refer claim petitions to Counsel, and work to resolve the claim within given authority

  • Build rapport with policyholders and agents, conduct on-site investigations when necessary, and educate policyholders and agents on NJM procedures, policies, and claim practices

  • Prepare and attend Claim Reviews at policyholder or agent locations in CT or virtually for further locations.

  • Serve as a liaison between policyholders/agents and various departments in NJM.

  • Represent WC Claim in on-site capabilities meetings to onboard new policyholders in CT. 

  • Participate in training programs to keep current on relevant issues/topics

  • Recommend process improvement where applicable to best improve the department efficiency, work product, and service commitment to interested parties

  • Demonstrate a commitment to NJM’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and apply knowledge of compliance policies and procedures, standards, and laws applicable to job responsibilities in the performance of work

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Workers' Comp Claim Representative, or comparable knowledge and experience with various aspects of claims handling and/or process including advanced knowledge of medical terminology and WC regulations for CT claims.

  • Knowledge of and/or experience working with liens and Medicare Set-Asides to secure full and final settlements

  • Customer service oriented with strong written and oral communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work both in a team and independently

  • Demonstrated organizational skills, and use of sound decision-making capabilities

  • Working knowledge utilizing an automated claim processing system and Microsoft Office tools including Word and Outlook

  • Licensed in CT to adjust WC claims.

  • Ability to travel for business purposes, approximately 2 – 3 days a week meeting with policyholders and/or agents

Preferred:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree

  • AIC/CPCU or other applicable insurance designations

  • Experience using Guidewire Claim Center, OnBase and additional Microsoft Office tools including Teams, Excel and PowerPoint

  • Knowledge and experience in WC claims handling in various states including PA, MD and/or DE.

  • Licensed in other states including DE to adjust WC claims.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $81,124-$94,141

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: IT Workstation Support Intern
jobs.description_html:
Consider joining NJM’s 2027 Paid Summer Intern Program!

This robust program includes:

  • Lunch with leaders; featuring insights from an Executive Leadership Team member, and a former NJM intern. Opportunity to network with leaders and professionals across multiple departments.
  • Contribute to and collaborate on meaningful work within your department.
  • Team Intern Project: Research and present a business question to NJM leaders.
  • NJM Seminars designed to build essential professional skills and expand knowledge of the insurance industry.
  • Professional headshots to help enhance your personal brand.
  • Intern Fun:
    • Night at the Trenton Thunder Game
    • Volunteer activities to give back to the community in which we serve
    • Networking and social events with fellow interns, former interns, and leaders

Overview

The Workstation Support Intern will assist the IT team in providing technical support for workstation hardware, software, operating systems, and network connectivity issues. This role offers hands-on experience troubleshooting technology problems, supporting IT projects and documenting procedures while developing practical enterprise IT support skills.

Job Responsibilities

  • Respond directly to technical questions or issues, or refer them to the appropriate employee or group in a timely manner. Utilize in-house and Internet resources when researching solutions for job related issues. Keep current in technology and continuously expand knowledge through training and review of industry literature.
  • Assist the Senior Workstation Specialists during large-scale projects related to workstation hardware, applications, and/or workstation OS upgrades. Work in coordination with the IT Service Desk in the Field Analyst capacity when assigned.
  • Support Server and Network groups with regard to issues involving multiple workstations. Additionally, support all other IT disciplines as needed with regard to workstation issues.
  • Address assigned work as defined in current call tracking tool. Adhere to current Service Level Agreements with regard to priorities and defined timelines for solution delivery. Investigate and resolve workstation problems regarding PC client OS, applications, and/or hardware. Resolve workstation problems with respect to their interaction locally and their participation on the NJM network. For hardware problems, initiate troubleshooting steps to resolve. If outside service is required, determine responsible vendor and take appropriate action. Provide support and advice to end-users in relation to PC software and hardware.
  • Continuous Improvement efforts through Documenting Events & Procedures - Procedures for recurring activities need to be documented completely using existing templates and screen shots to create standard forms which are easily understood by co-workers. Work Orders, RFC's, Incident and Problem tickets need to be completely documented so that Management and co-workers gain a complete picture of what transpired by reading the tickets. Descriptions of problems and resolutions to the problems are completely documented so the knowledge can be reused by co-workers. Status information is recorded promptly on Work Orders and Assigned tickets so that accurate, complete status is always available by reading the assigned Ticket. Status indicators, all dates and other fields (e.g. impact, priority) on tickets are accurately and completely valued.

Requirements

  • Current Sophomore or Junior pursuing their Bachelors Degree
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Windows support
  • General knowledge and experience with Microsoft SCCM
  • Experience with Ivanti, Adobe, iOS, and other 3rd party migration and personalization tools
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Office products.
  • General knowledge of active directory and group policy
  • Experience with Dell Optiplex desktop line
  • Experience with IBM/Lenovo hardware line
  • Cumulative GPA 3.0 or greater
  • Commutable to our West Trenton, New Jersey office

The I.T. Workstation Support Intern position can pay $21-$25.

Starting Rate: $21

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM's Special Investigations Unit in West Trenton, NJ is seeking a Summer Intern for 2027!

Overview

The SIU Analyst Intern will support NJM's Special Investigations Unit by using data analytics, research, and reporting to help identify potential insurance fraud and support investigative teams. Interns will analyze predictive model results, identify trends and anomalies, and develop actionable insights that aid business and investigative decision-making. This role provides valuable exposure to fraud detection, data mining, and the insurance industry while developing strong analytical, technical, and communication skills.

Job Responsibilities

  • Triaging and analyzing scorecards and outputs from predictive models for General Claims, Personal Lines, Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims and Medical Providers.
  • Conduct data mining efforts to explore anomalies, conduct statistical analysis, and identify patterns and trends related to fraudulent Personal Lines and Commercial Lines policies and claims.
  • Conduct background research on available public databases to support the need for the escalation of the claim review. 
  • Review NJM databases, retrieve NJM recorded calls, and support the investigative teams.
  • Provide metrics and statistics, as well as actionable intelligence to aid in decision making.
  • Articulate and convey analyses into information that can be consumed by non-technical staff.
  • Share analytical findings with SIU Supervisory staff. 
  • Attend virtual industry meetings to broaden exposure to the insurance industry.

Qualifications and Required Skills

  • Current Sophomore or Junior pursuing their Bachelors Degree in Criminal Justice, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics and Economics.
  • Familiarity in data science tools and available systems (SQL, SAS, PowerBi).
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.
  • Organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal, written, technical and presentation communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Pro-active and self-motivated.
  • Ability to listen effectively and actively engage others.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative environment.
  • Ability to conduct online research and review results.
  • Commutable to our West Trenton, New Jersey office.

The SIU Intern position can pay $21-$25 hour.

Starting Rate: $21

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Commercial Claims
jobs.description_html:
​General Summary: A brief description of the main purpose for this position.
 

The Commercial Claims Supervisor is responsible for leading a team of Commercial Line adjusters and successfully interact with our internal and external business partners.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • The position requires excellent communication and time management skills as well as a strong organizational background. This individual must be a creative & proactive problem solver, analytical and an independent contributor who can also work as a member of the team. The successful candidate will also be a disciplined self-starter, decisive, “own” their decisions and the work they produce. Must be able to manage their own team and work successfully with internal and external business partners.
  • Maintains accurate and complete personnel records to include mentoring the ongoing progress and performance of Commercial Representatives and Commercial Specialists and oversee the day-to-day operations and workflows for Commercial Claims team.   Guides staff with coverage determinations when needed for our Commercial lines of business, CA, BOP, & CPP.  Provides oversight into managing claims and laws in multiple jurisdictions and will intercede as appropriate to handle individual claims.  Participate in Internal claim committee reviews.
  • Conduct file reviews for quality and accuracy to ensure commercial claims staff adhere to best practices and set adequate reserves on claim files. Ensures staff compliance with liability laws and mandated regulatory reporting requirements, as well as customer handling requests.
  • Instruct, counsel, and provide directions to Commercial Representatives and Commercial Specialists on established as well as new and altered procedures and responsibilities.  Review complex claim matters, emerging issues, and new policy forms with staff. Assures peak performance of the team through continued training and coaching, coupled with regular performance evaluations. Functions as liaison, suggesting and implementing final resolution for clients and employees regarding claim-specific, procedural or special requests.
  • Demonstrates exceptional critical thinking, problem solving, and innovation with a confident presence with exceptional communication skills (verbal, listening and written) and can provide both positive and difficult feedback. Demonstrates ability to work independently and remotely to achieve results with limited supervision and the ability to maintain a high level of productivity, confidentiality and customer service.


This is a hybrid position requiring three days in the office and up to two days a week working remotely. The hours of the position are 8:00 a.m. to 4:15 p.m.
 

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • AIC Designation
  • Relevant work experience in Commercial General Liability required
  • State licenses as required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous leadership experience
  • College degree

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $88,176-$111,218

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

Overview

NJM Insurance has a law clerk (summer) opportunity available on our General Claims legal team. Located at our West Trenton, NJ headquarters, this is a wonderful opportunity for a second-year law student to enjoy sharpening research and writing skills in this heavy research role, while collaborating with our fine legal team.

The law clerk will gain work experience while performing meaningful tasks and projects. This summer internship is part of a structured program that will provide the law clerk with challenging work assignments/projects, an overall view of the business and litigation, and networking opportunities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Assist with various legal research assignments and writing legal memoranda.

  • May assist with various research related tasks to maintain the General Claims Legal Index, a multi-state legal resource for property and casualty insurance related issues.

  • Assist the staff attorneys in other tasks.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Student must have completed the second year of law school by the start of summer 2027.

  • Commutable to our West Trenton, New Jersey office

  • Minimum 3.0 GPA overall - undergraduate

  • Some knowledge of insurance coverage and tort law

  • Previous legal work experience is a plus.

  • Ability to multitask.

  • Self-directed worker with the ability to learn quickly and pursue Internship with enthusiasm and focus.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills

  • Excellent research and communication skills, both written and oral

The General Claims Legal Intern can pay $21-$25.

Starting Rate: $21

jobs.title: Commercial Lines Pricing Actuary - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company (NJM) was founded in 1913 by a group of manufacturers seeking to provide cost-effective, safety conscious and financially secure workers' compensation insurance for their workers. From inception the Company has operated as a mutual, with a focus on the needs of its policyholders.


Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.

The Actuary (this role can be filled at the level, I, II , Senior or Associate level) will support NJM’s efforts to attract new policyholders, retain existing policyholders, and honor our commitment to pay claims by developing fair and competitive pricing, providing comprehensive product analysis, and ensuring that NJM maintains a strong financial position.

This role is hybrid working 3 days in the West Trenton, NJ office and 2 days from home.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Perform pricing studies to evaluate the profitability of our Auto, Workers’ Compensation, and Commercial Package insurance products. 

  • Analyze rating variables based on company data and competitor information and recommend changes.

  • Perform analysis of frequency, severity, and premium trends.

  • Perform analysis of loss and LAE reserves.

  • Assist with the annual loss and LAE ratio planning process.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop business insights and recommendations. 

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of actuarial tools and processes to enhance the department’s capabilities over time.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, or related field.

  • Property and casualty actuarial experience. 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SQL, SAS, or other programming languages a plus.  

  • ACAS or FCAS credential.

This role can be filled at the Analyst, Associate or Senior level and the salary is commensurate based on experience.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $116,749-$147,145

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Workforce Supervisor, Stock Services
jobs.description_html:
The Stock Services Workforce Supervisor oversees the daily operations of the Stock Services department, including receiving, inventory control, stock distribution, courier functions, fleet-vehicle support, and mail transport activities.  This position provides direct supervision and guidance to the Stock Services Courier/Driver-Stock Clerk staff, insuring accurate inventory management, timely deliveries across the NJM campus, safe driving practices and high-level customer service.  The Stock Services Workforce Supervisor ensures compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and departmental standards while driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

SCHEDULE: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am to 4:15 pm

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

Supervisor Responsibilities

  • Provide daily supervision, scheduling, and task assignments for Stock Services staff.
  • Oversee performance, provide coaching, conduct evaluations and support professional development.
  • Ensure team compliance with inventory procedures, safety protocols, and customer service standards.
  • Lead and participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new employees.
  • Monitor workload, prioritize department activities, and resolve operational issues promptly.
  • Maintain a positive, collaborative team environment and address performance or conduct issues as needed.

​Operational Oversight & Inventory Management

  • Supervise all receiving operations to ensure accurate inspection, counting, and documentation of deliveries.
  • Ensure that inventory items are properly transferred, stored, and tracked within the physical and system-based inventory locations.
  • Ensure stockroom inventory controls are in place and adhered to.
  • Communicate the delivery of stocked items with appropriate vendors to ensure adequate inventory levels.
  • Investigate vendor discrepancies, delivery issues, and product variances; communicate finding to appropriate departments.
  • Oversee timely fulfillment and delivery of stock orders to internal requestors while upholding customer service expectations.
  • Monitor and audit inventory management software (Workday) activity, including requisition approvals, receiving entries, serialized item logging, cycle counts, adjustments and required reporting.
  • Ensure safe and compliant operation of manual and electric pallet jacks and other equipment.
  • Support the development and maintenance of organized, efficient, and compliant stockroom areas.

Courier, Driver & Fleet Oversight

  • Oversee the daily courier/driver operations performed by staff, ensuring punctual and safe transport of cargo and/or passengers.
  • Ensure all vehicle loading, unloading, and delivery activities meet safety and company standards.

Departmental Support & Additional Duties

  • Develop and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and service delivery.
  • Generate and review departmental activity reports, inventory reports, and metrics as required.
  • Serve as the operational point of contact for internal departments requiring Stock Services support.
  • Function as a backup to Stock Services staff completing their assigned tasks as needed.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • 1-2 years of experience in a supervisory or leadership role.
  • 2-4 years of experience in inventory, warehouse, stock, or related operations.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize, adjust to changing demands, and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, perform repetitive movements, and stand or sit for long periods of time.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to maintain requirements for company fleet driving.
  • Ability to access all federal/government buildings.
  • Proficient with MS Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supervising stockroom, warehouse, inventory, or courier operations.
  • Prior inventory management system experience.
  • Knowledge of Workday Financials a plus.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $58,737-$74,031

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company (NJM) was founded in 1913 by a group of manufacturers seeking to provide cost-effective, safety conscious and financially secure workers' compensation insurance for their workers. From inception the Company has operated as a mutual, with a focus on the needs of its policyholders.


Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

The purpose of the Project Management Team is to serve as a strong advocate and partner within NJM dedicated to driving the facilitation, planning and successful execution of approved business initiatives so that NJM can achieve its annual objectives, strategic goals and long-term vision. 

The Project Manager is responsible for managing one or more projects from startup through closeout and ensuring customer satisfaction. Project Managers need to be very comfortable around technology, be inquisitive, have a problem-solving mindset, and be willing to adapt approach to successfully execute projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Manage one or more independent projects from startup to closeout with some input from senior PMO members.
  • Demonstrate accountability with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers towards project implementations and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate understanding and proficiency of Agile project management techniques and processes.  
  • Hold self and project team members accountable to deliverables and commitments.
  • Demonstrate awareness of project metrics and using metrics towards project discussions.
  • Work with Portfolio leadership to deal with dynamic situations and ambiguity.
  • Demonstrate the ability to adapt and perform in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
  • Collaborate with Technical Leads for Release and Sprint Planning, brainstorming, etc.
  • Demonstrate an analytical mindset and be comfortable working with data.
  • Take charge of situations, challenges, and leading the team towards resolution with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers.
  • Provide direction and day-to-day management of project teams.
  • Communicate transparently through status reporting and managing expectations of senior PMO leaders.
  • Understand project objectives and ensuring team member commitment towards achieving those objectives.
  • Engage in discussions with team members  to propose alternative solutions/approaches to address challenges.
  • Identifying challenges and risks (not just reporting status) and proactively seek resolution through support from PMO leadership.
  • Demonstrate awareness of various risk management strategies.
  • Prepare presentations regarding projects and their statuses to small audiences.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Minimum 4-year degree or equivalent experience; technical or business background preferred.
  • Minimum 5-year work experience in a team setting; willingness to continue working in a team setting.
  • Basic understanding of tooling such as Jira, Planview, etc. Very proficient in MS Office (Excel, MS Word) and essential to be able to learn and utilize tooling.
  • Excellent and effective verbal and written communication skills (verbal, written, presentation) and facilitation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Scaled Agile or Scrum Master experience / certifications preferred Experience with Project budget management preferred.
  • Experience and understanding of P&C insurance a big plus.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $104,686-$131,986

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Senior IVR & Contact Center Engineer (NICE CXone / Genesys)
jobs.description_html:
The Sr. Telecom Apps Software Engineer (official NJM job title) will have extensive knowledge of the NICE CX1 platform and is responsible for the design and development of voice/email/chat solutions on the NICE suite of applications used by contact center staff.  The person in this role will be the technical lead for IT and will be expected to translate software requirements into working solutions within the existing IVR application framework. The person serving this role will also be responsible for monitoring and troubleshooting systems for optimal performance.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Customer support and troubleshooting
    • Perform analysis and resolve telecom related issues and service requests in a timely manner.
    • Assist immediate team members, extended IT team members and vendors to resolve complex and cross product issues.
    • Interact with vendor support and provide adequate communication about problem resolution.
    • Proactively monitor systems and take corrective action when required.
    • Document process and procedures according to established IT standards.
    • On a periodic frequency, insure that all supporting telecom systems are adequately patched with the appropriate application and security related updates.
    • Have a thorough understanding of NICE CX1 and related technologies.
       
  • Subject matter expert on IVR development
    • Design and develop IVR voice, chat and email solutions leveraging API’s to communicate to backend systems on the CX1 platform.
    • Act as the liaison for the business unit and IT.
    • Support the various IT system integrations to the telecom architecture.
    • Identify and correlate business requirements to software configurations solutions within the telecom applications.
    • Influence technical staff in the design and operation of telecom systems.
    • Serve as the point of contact for issue resolution and problem analysis.
    • Coordinate and run testing efforts to validate application functionality upon deployment of a fix and or platform upgrades.
       
  • Quality and documentation
    • Insure that team and individual deliverables are of high quality.
    • Service requests are resolved to end user satisfaction with minimal rework.
    • Effectively use available tools to diagnose and remedy user reported issues.
    • Create and document procedures adhering to established IT processes.
    • Maintain library of documentation to be used as a reference by immediate team members.
       
  • Continuous improvement
    • Maintain and improve technical proficiency through continuous learning of telecom products, supporting hardware and software environments.
    • Actively seeks to learn from senior team members as appropriate.
    • Serve as a mentor to junior team members.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of related information technology experience.
  • 5+ years of supporting telecom applications.
  • 5+ years of programming experience.
  • 3+ years of supporting Linux based application.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (computer science, engineering) or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of telecom system architecture to support a contact center environment on NICE CX1 platform.
  • Working knowledge of database design and operation, web technologies.
  • Proficiency and experience with certain operating systems (Windows, Linux)

Certifications or Licenses:

  • NICE Certified System Administrator (preferred but not required)

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $91,021-$114,806

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: JAVA Developer (Hybrid)
jobs.description_html:
This role will be responsible for developing, configuring and customizing business applications under the guidance of the team lead or a senior JAVA developer. The JAVA Developer will work in a highly collaborative environment as part on an agile delivery team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Code, configure, develop, and debug functionality in core systems in accordance with architectural guidelines and defined best practices under the guidance of a senior developer, this includes: screens, data model, batches.
  • Plan, initiate, and conduct unit and integration testing of applications.
  • Provide accurate and reliable estimates.
  • Consistently deliver work on time and of high quality.
  • Understand and work from business requirements documentation (user stories, use cases, as well as traditional software requirements specifications).
  • As a part of an agile project team, share technical and product knowledge with other team members.
  • Support and troubleshoot production deployments
  • Seek mentoring from senior team members as necessary

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience with object-oriented technologies
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field required.
  • Some knowledge of object-oriented design patterns, software architecture concepts, and web application constructs.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming languages and object-oriented architectures.
  • Some understanding of relational database technologies and experience writing SQL queries.
  • Possesses good written, oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to learn how to support production systems
  • Experience working with integrations such as web services or messaging is a plus.
  • Experience working as part of a high pace agile development team is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Guidewire technologies; PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter; required.
  • Knowledge and experience of the Guidewire object model.
  • Experience with both configuration as well as integration within the Guidewire architecture.
  • GOSU development skills.
  • Knowledge and experience with Guidewire typelists, rule sets, plugins, activities and messaging framework.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL server
  • Certification or Licenses
  • Comparable object-oriented technology certification a plus.

The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.

The Commercial Lines Loss Prevention team is searching for a Senior Loss Prevention Representative. The goal of the Sr. Loss Prevention Representative is to assist our policyholders in the process of identifying, quantifying, eliminating, or reducing the risk of loss.  This is a senior level position that will entail training and mentoring of staff.

** This position does not provide a company vehicle but NJM does reimburse for mileage and tolls.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Conduct on-site loss control surveys and underwriting evaluations to assess potential hazards for our policyholders and agency partners

  • Conduct accident investigations

  • Prepares loss control reports and sends recommendations to policyholders to help them improve potential risk factors

  • A knowledge of workplace safety

  • An understanding of nationally recognized standards and codes

  • Develop, enhance and present training programs in the area of loss prevention

  • Communicate loss prevention services available to policyholders and agency partners

  • Will be responsible for mentoring loss prevention representatives in the department

  • May act on behalf of the loss prevention supervisor in their absence

  • May train other loss prevention representatives on conducting site evaluations, training, or other loss control services

Required Qualifications and Experience: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • 6+ years of experience in loss control including Industrial Hygiene

  • Air sampling and noise monitoring experience

  • High School Diploma/GED Required

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

  • Ability to work in a team environment or independently

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and be detail-oriented

  • Excellent analytical and decision making skills

  • Experience with laptop computers as well as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook

  • Safety experience is required 

  • Loss Control and Safety Experience in the Insurance Industry (Workers’ Comp, Commercial Auto, Property and/or General Liability)

  • This position is the field and requires regular travel throughout the Central NJ area.

Preferred Qualifications:                                                                          

  • Bachelor's Degree is preferred

  • Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP) preferred

  • OHST (Occupational Health and Safety) Certification Preferred

  • ARM (Associate in Risk Management) preferred

  • ASC (Advanced Safety Certification)

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $121,807-$141,453

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

jobs.title: Manager, PL Product Development
jobs.description_html:
The Product Development Manager is responsible for supporting the design, enhancement, and ongoing management of NJM’s personal auto, homeowners, and umbrella products across the company’s operating footprint. This newly created position is accountable for evaluating product performance, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to improve product competitiveness and profitability. The role is also responsible for conducting research, developing recommendations, and collaborating with actuarial, underwriting, claims, compliance, IT, and other business areas to implement product changes and strategic initiatives. In addition, the position ensures alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational objectives, contributing to product strategy and supporting NJM’s growth and performance goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

Lead the creation & recommendation of new & existing product enhancements for assigned lines of business. Develop short & long-term project roadmaps for each product assigned. Work with key stakeholders to ensure alignment of product goals & objectives. Present recommendation for approval to senior leadership, up to and potentially including the Executive Leadership Team.

Proactively identify, evaluate, and recommend new product opportunities for assigned lines of business. Conduct comprehensive competitor research and other market solutions. Apply the analytical rigor model to determine best solution to successfully solve consumer pain points.

Oversee the successful execution of assigned product enhancements. Work closely with the SOG and PMO teams ensuring a timely implementation. Collaborate and provide support & guidance across Personal Lines in communicating changes to policyholders and staff.

Hours:
Monday through Friday, day shift

Compensation:
The salary is commensurate with experience and credentials but is likely to fall in the $175,000 - $215,000 range. This full time position is based in our suburban West Trenton, New Jersey corporate office, which is easily commutable from central and southern New Jersey as well as Bucks and Philadelphia Counties in Pennsylvania.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Minimum 4‑year college degree or equivalent
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in insurance product development, product management, actuarial, or analytics, with increasing responsibilities
  • Strong analytical abilities and natural curiosity for solving complex business challenges
  • Advanced Excel and database skills; proficiency with MS Office suite
  • Commitment to continuous learning, including product best practices and emerging technologies
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization

Preferred Qualifications:

  • College degree in Business, Data Analytics, Economics, Insurance, or related field

jobs.title: Workers Compensation Claims Specialist, Sr
jobs.description_html:
NJM’s WC Claims Department is seeking an experienced Claims Specialist, Sr. who lives in Western or Central PA to provide on-site service to our policyholders and agents in that area.  This is a 100% remote position which includes virtual claims handling for customers in any area of PA and possibly MD, DE or CT as needed.  

At NJM, our WC Claims Department empowers our employees to focus on delivering guidance and empathy to our customers.  As a department driven by service and customer advocacy, we are committed to providing transparent, empathetic support and collaborative engagement during the life of a claim. The WC Claims Department takes pride in being a key component in the growth and success of our policyholders’ business operations.

To meet these expectations, WC Claims Specialists are supported by a dedicated call center who can field calls for them and other specialized units who are responsible for setting reserves, making permanency payments, and following through on subrogation so they can dedicate the time needed to manage claims. Many of our staff are long-tenured with a focus on building relationships, not only with our customers, but with each other providing a positive and nurturing work environment.

Hours:

Monday to Friday 8:00AM- 4:15PM (Hours can vary depending on start time).

Training is required at the NJM- West Trenton office.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure quality management of claims in accordance with claims best practices and company guidelines, and timely, accurate documentation of claim activity

  • Provide a high level of customer service that promotes injured worker advocacy-based principles to improve outcomes for all parties 

  • Determine compensability and coverage issues by gathering medical and factual evidence

  • Administer the delivery of timely, appropriate, and accurate benefits

  • Evaluate the claim for potential fraud indicators and escalate the claim to SIU, as appropriate

  • Recognize and investigate subrogation opportunity and refer to NJM subrogation staff for recovery of third-party funds

  • Initiate and provide excellent communication with all stakeholders (injured workers, medical providers, attorneys, policyholders, agents, etc.) professionally and proactively with a customer-centric approach

  • Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and mitigate exposures, and establish and implement a proactive strategic plan of action

  • Assign and refer claim petitions to Counsel, and work to resolve the claim within given authority

  • Build rapport with policyholders and agents, conduct on-site investigations when necessary, and educate policyholders and agents on NJM procedures, policies, and claim practices

  • Prepare and attend Claim Reviews at policyholder or agent locations in Western and/or Central PA or virtually for further locations.

  • Serve as a liaison between policyholders/agents and various departments in NJM.

  • Represent WC Claim in on-site capabilities meetings to onboard new policyholders in Western and/or Central PA. 

  • Participate in training programs to keep current on relevant issues/topics

  • Recommend process improvement where applicable to best improve the department efficiency, work product, and service commitment to interested parties

  • Demonstrate a commitment to NJM’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and apply knowledge of compliance policies and procedures, standards, and laws applicable to job responsibilities in the performance of work

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Workers' Comp Claim Representative, or comparable knowledge and experience with various aspects of claims handling and/or process including advanced knowledge of medical terminology and WC regulations for PA, MD and/or DE claims.

  • Knowledge of and/or experience working with liens and Medicare Set-Asides to secure full and final settlements

  • Customer service oriented with strong written and oral communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work both in a team and independently

  • Demonstrated organizational skills, and use of sound decision-making capabilities

  • Working knowledge utilizing an automated claim processing system and Microsoft Office tools including Word and Outlook

  • Licensed in DE and/or CT to adjust WC claims or have the ability to obtain these licenses within 90 days.

  • Ability to travel for business purposes, approximately 2 – 3 days a week meeting with policyholders and/or agents

Preferred:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree

  • AIC/CPCU or other applicable insurance designations

  • Experience using Guidewire Claim Center, OnBase and additional Microsoft Office tools including Teams, Excel and PowerPoint

  • Knowledge and experience in claims handling for other commercial line products in various states including PA, MD and/or DE.

Salary:

  • Sr Level starting rate is $79,129.05+ annually based on experience and credentials

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $79,129-$91,834

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant
jobs.description_html:
About the role:

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful professional to support the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer, North America and Head of Board Services. This role will provide executive support across a broad range of administrative, operational, and strategic activities while helping ensure the effective management of priorities, communications, and stakeholder engagement.

The Senior Executive Assistant will play an important role in enabling executive effectiveness by managing day-to-day operations, coordinating leadership activities, and supporting key initiatives across the North America Marketing & Communications organization.

The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, exercises sound judgment, maintains strict confidentiality, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.

Key responsibilities:

  • Manage a complex and dynamic executive calendar, including scheduling meetings across multiple stakeholders, business functions, and time zones.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements, including itineraries, logistics, expense reports, and travel-related communications.
  • Support the planning and coordination of leadership meetings, team events, town halls, and offsite sessions.
  • Serve as a liaison between the executive and internal and external stakeholders, helping facilitate effective communication and coordination.
  • Manage sensitive and confidential information with the highest degree of professionalism and discretion.
  • Assist with budget administration, invoice processing, purchase orders, and expense management activities.
  • Support special projects, team initiatives, and operational activities across the Marketing & Communications organization.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to improve processes, enhance team effectiveness, and drive operational excellence.

Job requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience supporting senior executives, preferably within a corporate, professional services, financial services, or insurance environment.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across all levels of an organization.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and Excel.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Experience coordinating executive travel, meetings, events, and communications.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Business, Communications, Marketing, Management, or related field) or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

For positions based in NYC, the base salary range is $75,000 - $95,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: :  2026 Benefits Overview Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications. 



#LI-CY1

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. jobs.description_html:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Senior Underwriter, AIG Risk Management (AIGRM) to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make you mark in Underwriting


AIG underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, Multinational Clients, and High Net Worth individuals. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model, and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG.


How you will create an impact


The Senior Underwriter will be responsible for underwriting the Workers’ Compensation, General Liability and Auto Liability primary Casualty product lines and typically manages accounts/clients that are most complex.


  • Develops and manages underwriting strategies for both renewals and prospects within his/her portfolio of accounts. This includes knowledge of the current market penetration of AIGRM products and the development of specific plans to increase portfolio share. 
  • Develops and implements negotiation strategies. Makes independent sales calls to market and cross-market products. Identifies target markets, designs, and implements strategies for lead development and builds prospect lists.
  • Provides technical direction to management, less senior specialists, producers, and claims adjusting personnel. Communicate risk appetite and AIGRM Value Proposition to brokers. 
  • Collaborate with Distribution, Territory Managers, and other line(s) of business underwriters to target desirable accounts and cross selling opportunities from brokers.
  • Rapidly evaluate, prioritize, and select submissions to be underwritten.
  • Recognize and create cross sell opportunities for other Commercial products.
  • Collaborate with broker to understand the deal structure, terms, and AIG Services that best meets clients’ needs. 
  • May review, evaluate and make recommendations to underwriting guidelines. 
  • May direct or conduct internal underwriting audits. 
  • Negotiate pricing, terms & conditions, and deal structure with brokers and clients.
  • Participate in special underwriting projects as needed. 

What you’ll need to succeed


  • 5+ years of Commercial Insurance Company, Agency, or Brokerage experience. 
  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university. 
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.
  • Advanced working knowledge of US Casualty lines of business (Workers’ Compensation, Auto Liability, and General Liability) including product features, forms, regulatory environments, and risks etc. 
  • Demonstrated sales, marketing, and relationship building experience. 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Highly motivated and results oriented. 
  • Ability to work in dynamic, rapidly changing environment, adapting to changing requirements and collaborating with a wide range of colleagues to quickly deliver solutions.
  • Expert with underwriting analytical tools and technology.

Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.


For positions based in Chicago, the base salary range is $104,600- $127,600. In addition, the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan.
