jobs.title: WC Claims Supervisor
jobs.description_html:
The Workers’ Compensation Claims Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of direct reports, ensuring all quality, productivity and customer service criteria are met while adhering to company policies and procedures. The WC Claims Supervisor position is integral to the success of the company and requires regular and consistent attendance, supporting the goals of the claims department and CorVel.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Supervises WC claims staff in their day-to-day operations
  • Assists Claims Manager with recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding new staff, ensuring proficiency in procedures and job functions
  • Ensures staff compliance with Workers’ Compensation laws and mandated regulatory reporting requirements
  • Ensures optimal team performance through ongoing training, coaching, and regular performance evaluations; recommends merit-based actions (subject to managerial approval)
  • Provides technical and jurisdictional guidance to claims staff regarding complex compensability, investigation, litigation issues and service account instructions
  • Acts as a liaison by recommending and executing final resolutions for clients and employees concerning claim-specific, procedural, or special requests
  • Participate in customer claim reviews and presentations
  • Ability to travel overnight and attend meetings if required
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Effective quantitative, analytical and interpretive skills
  • Strong leadership, management and motivational skills
  • Demonstrated, strong customer service skills
  • Ability to maintain composure under pressure and communicate diplomatically across various channels, including telephone, email, and written correspondence
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Demonstrated public speaking skills
  • Minimum of 5 years’ claims handling experience
  • Knowledge of Workers’ Compensation required
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation claims must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $73,345 - $113,247

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Supervisor
jobs.description_html:
The Regulatory Compliance Supervisor provides leadership and oversight for Nevada regulatory compliance activities, ensuring adherence to legal requirements, regulatory obligations, and internal standards. This role establishes compliance governance, drives accountability for high-risk matters, and partners closely with claims leadership and the Litigation & Resolution Specialist to mitigate exposure and support timely resolution of complex issues. The position serves as a key escalation point for regulatory, litigation, and compliance-related concerns while promoting consistent execution across the organization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the Nevada compliance framework and establish standards for regulatory oversight, escalation, and accountability
  • Provide governance and quality oversight for legal, hearing, excess-reporting, and other high-risk compliance matters
  • Determine priorities for complex regulatory issues and ensure appropriate ownership is assigned
  • Monitor critical deadlines and confirm timely completion of required actions
  • Partner with the Litigation & Resolution Specialist to support legal strategy and complex claim resolution efforts
  • Oversee excess carrier reporting processes and ensure timely identification, escalation, and follow-through
  • Review high-risk claims to identify potential compliance concerns and emerging exposure
  • Establish escalation protocols for significant legal, regulatory, and operational risks
  • Analyze litigation, hearing, benefit penalty, and regulatory trends to identify areas requiring corrective action
  • Collaborate with claims leadership to implement process improvements and risk mitigation strategies
  • Provide reporting and recommendations to leadership regarding unresolved exposure and compliance performance
  • Clarify accountability when responsibilities involve multiple stakeholders, including claims staff, leadership, clients, counsel, and compliance resources
  • Verify that legal decisions, negotiated resolutions, and hearing outcomes are accurately implemented within claim operations
  • Support training initiatives and operational guidance to strengthen regulatory compliance and reduce future exposure
  • Promote consistency in compliance practices across all Nevada operations
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong understanding of Nevada workers' compensation regulations and related compliance requirements
  • Demonstrated ability to assess regulatory risk and exercise sound judgment in complex situations
  • Ability to influence outcomes and build partnerships across operational and leadership teams
  • Strong analytical skills with experience identifying trends and developing corrective action plans
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex compliance issues clearly and effectively
  • Experience managing escalations and competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to regulatory excellence
  • Ability to balance risk management objectives with operational business needs

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Risk Management, Legal Studies, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • Five or more years of workers' compensation, claims compliance, litigation support, regulatory oversight, or related experience
  • Experience interpreting and applying state regulatory requirements and compliance standards
  • Supervisory or team leadership experience preferred

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $92,673 – $120,368

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.description_html:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Boise, ID.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

This is a remote position but candidates must reside in Idaho.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $63,739 – $95,264

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: Claims Manager
jobs.description_html:
The Claims Manager is responsible for the overall operation of a designated office.  The Claims Manager participates in formulating and administering company best practices as well as developing long-term goals and objectives, analyzing costs, activities and operations, supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel. 

 This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Represents the company in a professional manner to both internal and external customers and clients
  • Directs the performance and development of the employees in their department
  • Ensures staff compliance with Workers’ Compensation laws and mandated regulatory reporting requirements
  • Assures peak performance of the team through continued training and coaching, coupled with regular performance evaluations
  • Utilizes jurisdictional expertise and knowledge of regulatory rules, statutes and procedures governing these jurisdictions to ensure compliance
  • Monitors operational workflow and manages appropriate/adequate staffing levels and staff retention strategies
  • Develops and oversees the implementation of common claim practices and procedures
  • Directs and controls the review and settlement of high dollar or potential high dollar claims, as well as any claims that are beyond the authority of subordinate claims personnel
  • Promotes operational efficiency, quality, and consistency by continuously improving processes, people and systems
  • Ensures compliance with CorVel’s policies and procedures
  • Ability to travel overnight and attend meetings
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills necessary for customer contact, negotiation, presentations, project management and personnel management
  • Effective quantitative, analytical and interpretive skills
  • Excellent leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to motivate staff and obtain results through teamwork
  • Ability to function effectively under time constraints, consistently meet deadlines and handle multiple tasks in a demanding work environment
  • Ability to remain poised in stressful situations and communicate diplomatically via various communication channels
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize common computer applications
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, project management, and organizational skills
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and equivalent industry-related experience, with a record of steady advancement in Workers’ Compensation claims administration
  • Minimum of 6 years’ comprehensive workers’ compensation administration experience
  • Minimum of 2 years' recent supervisory or management experience
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel
  • Self-Insured Certificate preferred

PAY RANGE: 

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time. 

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process. 

Pay Range:  $87,190 – $134,613 

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management 

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers’ compensation, auto, health and disability management industries.   CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients.  We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities.  Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).  

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.

jobs.title: Network Relations II
jobs.description_html:
The Network Relations role supports the frontline of Network Development, responsible for providing excellent customer service while impacting and overseeing provider data integrity. This role must combine strong interpersonal skills with an aptitude in the medical provider market.

This is a remote position, must reside in the Central Virginia area.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist Developer with implementing medical providers, using written and verbal communication
  • Verify all provider signatures, contracts and documentation before submitting for internal processing
  • Review credentials of prospective providers to be considered for acceptance into network per national credentialing requirements and protocols
  • Provide orientation on managed care procedures and establish liaison(s) with all participating providers
  • Assist and communicate with provider orientation program in cooperation with Developer
  • Distribute and maintain provider manual and orientation materials per state guidelines
  • Receive and resolve all disputes involving provider contract and payment issues in accordance with contract Dispute Resolution Procedures
  • Provide assistance and respond to staff requests for information regarding the network, both locally and nationally
  • Oversee distribution of executed contracts and maintenance of database
  • Assist with network marketing, employer and payor relations and product development
  • Conduct and manage provider data audits that ensure data integrity for network and oversee all provider updates and changes with NDB
  • Coordinate and process provider roster updates at least annually or as otherwise required
  • Perform facility site surveys as needed per credentialing requirements or state guidelines
  • Identify specialties within network and generate a recruitment list for Developer
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong interpersonal skills and adaptive communication style
  • Complex problem solving skills and innovation
  • Ability to quickly adapt to process changes
  • Ability to prioritize and manage assignments, scheduled or unscheduled
  • Ability to embrace new tools and procedures per corporate guidelines and objectives
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Superb attention to detail and ability to deliver results in a fast paced and dynamic environment
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Associate’s degree or two or more years of equivalent work experience
  • Customer service education/training within the insurance industry, managed care or related field

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $19.24 - $31.04 per hour

jobs.title: Liability Claims Specialist
jobs.description_html:
The Liability Claims Specialist manages non-complex and non-problematic Liability claims under direct supervision of a senior claims professional. This role aims to achieve optimal outcomes for both CorVel and our clients. The Liability Claims Specialist handles litigated files and works with delegated limited authority, adhering to company best practices.

This is a remote position. 

 ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manages non-complex and non-problematic medical only claims and minor lost-time liability claims under close supervision
  • Receives claims, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgment of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Communicates claim status with the customer, claimant, and client
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Collaborates with team members on more complex or problematic claims as necessary
  • Additional duties as assigned

    KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS: 

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
    • Ability to learn rapidly to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
    • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
    • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
    • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
    • Ability to meet or exceed performance expectations
    • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 

    • Minimum of 3 years' experience with Auto and General/Premises Liability

    • Active Home State/Designated Home State adjuster license

    • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
    • Current Adjuster’s License in state of operation is required
    • Multi-State license is preferred

This is a remote role but requires residency in Arizona or Virginia. The work schedule for this role is Saturday - Wednesday, with the following shift available: 9:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST.

Remote positions require a quiet, designated work environment that adheres to our privacy and HIPAA standards.

This role has voluntary and mandatory overtime opportunities; Holidays are required on a rotating schedule. Holidays include New Years Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Thursday/Friday, and Christmas Day.

This role requires a wired access to a broadband internet network with a minimum bandwidth of at least 80Mbps.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Review medical notes, treatment referrals, work status notes, etc. to ensure all necessary referral orders were received
  • One of the primary tasks will be coordinating and scheduling X-ray appointments
  • Responsible for data entry and verification of details in the system for appropriate and timely order submission
  • Provide quality telephonic and email customer service including inbound and outbound messages
  • Receive and respond to daily emails and correspondence
  • Identify, analyze, and solve problems outside of standard processes
  • Participate in ongoing internal training and learning to obtain updated knowledge of industry and product changes
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Ability to work on several concurrent tasks in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Outlook and Excel
  • Strong attention to detail with a high commitment to accuracy
  • Bilingual language skills preferred

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • 2 years of experience in an office environment preferred
  • 1 year of similar, relevant experience preferred

  • Monitor staffing, workload, productivity, and capacity across service lines to ensure appropriate resource alignment and consistent service delivery
  • Manage several departments spanning multiple service lines
  • Implement and oversee workflow processes according to service level agreements and best practices to ensure product efficiency and accurate service delivery
  • Production and quality management to ensure that team performance metrics are established and met
  • Provide excellent internal and external customer support including issue resolution, product training, and service assistance
  • Lead operations efforts for hiring, training and team member development that builds staff engagement and retention
  • Assure optimal team performance through continued training, coaching and team-building
  • Review and monitor departmental service, quality, and administrative results; identify performance gaps and implement corrective action to ensure program expectations and service levels are met or exceeded
  • Ensure client specific processes are sustainable and implemented accurately
  • Collaborate with CareIQ leadership and cross-functional partners to ensure consistent service delivery and operational alignment
  • Maintain appropriate knowledge of jurisdictional regulations, regarding ancillary care, and ensures services are provided in accordance
  • Partner with sales staff on product proposals and presentations
  • Lead service operations discussions with corporate IT and Development for system maintenance and enhancements
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills
  • Demonstrated ability to provide superior service to internal and external stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and strong cross-functional relationships across an organization to achieve common goals
  • Proven project management and process improvement skills
  • Proven skill in prioritizing, problem solving and accelerating change
  • Sense of urgency and ability to multitask in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications is required
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare or related field with experience
  • Master’s degree in business, healthcare or related field with experience preferred
  • Prior managerial experience in Ancillary Benefit Management or Utilization Management preferred

jobs.title: SVP Liability Operational Strategy
jobs.description_html:
The Senior Vice President, Liability Operational Strategy provides executive leadership for CorVel's liability claims business, driving strategic direction, operational excellence, market growth, and financial performance. This position establishes and executes the vision for liability services while ensuring alignment among operational delivery, product development, sales initiatives, customer expectations, and corporate objectives.

Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Risk Management Services, this role partners closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, Information Technology, Human Resources, Legal, and executive leadership teams. The Senior Vice President has direct oversight of CorVel's Liability Claim Hubs and is accountable for operational performance, service quality, regulatory compliance, workforce strategy, customer satisfaction, and profit and loss results.

This position serves as a visible industry leader, representing CorVel with customers, prospects, industry organizations, and strategic partners while supporting sales growth, customer retention, and market expansion initiatives.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Establish and execute short- and long-term strategies for liability services that support CorVel's growth objectives and market position
  • Assess market conditions and emerging trends to identify opportunities that strengthen the liability business
  • Provide executive leadership for Liability Claim Hubs and ensure achievement of business objectives
  • Maintain accountability for revenue growth, profitability, workforce planning, and overall P&L performance
  • Establish performance expectations and operating standards that drive consistency and service excellence
  • Ensure organizational structure and staffing strategies support current business demands and future growth
  • Lead improvement initiatives when operational results fall short of expectations
  • Serve as executive sponsor for strategic customers and complex liability programs
  • Support business development through customer presentations, finalist meetings, and proposal activities
  • Build relationships with key customers, industry partners, and other stakeholders that support long-term growth
  • Partner with Product and Information Technology leadership to enhance liability capabilities and strengthen competitive differentiation
  • Ensure customer and operational needs are reflected in product priorities and service enhancements
  • Provide executive oversight of claims quality and regulatory compliance
  • Support the development of claims strategies and operating standards across liability operations
  • Promote technical development through training, coaching, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Lead and develop management teams while strengthening succession readiness across the organization
  • Represent CorVel at customer meetings and industry events as a recognized liability claims leader
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Extensive knowledge of liability claims administration and the regulatory environment governing claims operations
  • Strong understanding of the insurance carrier and third-party administration marketplace and the needs of insurance carriers, brokers, self-insured organizations, and loss-sensitive customers
  • Demonstrated success leading complex claims organizations and large-scale operational teams
  • Ability to develop strategy and translate business objectives into measurable results
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, and P&L management
  • Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to influence decisions and drive accountability across diverse functions
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive presentations and customer-facing interactions
  • Strong business development acumen with experience supporting sales growth and strategic customer relationships
  • Ability to analyze business performance and apply data-driven insights to decision-making
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change and large-scale business initiatives
  • Strong judgment with the ability to assess risk and respond effectively to complex business challenges
  • Ability to build trust and credibility with customers, business partners, and executive leadership
  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, discretion, and accountability
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and claims administration technologies
  • Ability to travel overnight up to 40% of the time

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, Insurance, Finance, or a related field required; equivalent combinations of education and executive-level experience may be considered
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience within an insurance carrier, third-party administrator, or complex claims organization
  • Significant experience leading liability claims operations with direct accountability for operational and financial performance
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale teams, multiple locations, or centralized claims operations
  • Experience with P&L management, operational budgeting, workforce planning, forecasting, and performance improvement initiatives
  • Experience supporting business development activities, executive-level client relationships, customer presentations, and requests for proposal
  • Demonstrated experience serving as an industry subject matter expert through conference presentations, customer events, publications, or professional forums
  • Professional insurance or claims designations preferred

The Workers’ Compensation Claims Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of direct reports, ensuring all quality, productivity and customer service criteria are met while adhering to company policies and procedures. The WC Claims Supervisor position is integral to the success of the company and requires regular and consistent attendance, supporting the goals of the claims department and CorVel.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Supervises WC claims staff in their day-to-day operations
  • Assists Claims Manager with recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding new staff, ensuring proficiency in procedures and job functions
  • Ensures staff compliance with Workers’ Compensation laws and mandated regulatory reporting requirements
  • Ensures optimal team performance through ongoing training, coaching, and regular performance evaluations; recommends merit-based actions (subject to managerial approval)
  • Provides technical and jurisdictional guidance to claims staff regarding complex compensability, investigation, litigation issues and service account instructions
  • Acts as a liaison by recommending and executing final resolutions for clients and employees concerning claim-specific, procedural, or special requests
  • Participate in customer claim reviews and presentations
  • Ability to travel overnight and attend meetings if required
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Effective quantitative, analytical and interpretive skills
  • Strong leadership, management and motivational skills
  • Demonstrated, strong customer service skills
  • Ability to maintain composure under pressure and communicate diplomatically across various channels, including telephone, email, and written correspondence
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • CT, MA, NH, RI license and/or experience required.  ME and VT license and experience preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Demonstrated public speaking skills
  • Minimum of 5 years’ claims handling experience
  • Knowledge of Workers’ Compensation required
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation claims must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster

PAY RANGE

jobs.description_html:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in the Pensacola, FL area. 

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

      KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

      • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
      • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
      • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
      • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
      • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
      • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

      EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

      • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
      • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
      • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
      • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
      • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

      PAY RANGE:

      CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

      For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

      Pay Range:  $63,739 - $95,264

      A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

jobs.title: CA Senior Claims Specialist
jobs.description_html:
The WC Senior Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards. This role works closely with case managers and attorneys, manages subrogation, and negotiates settlements. The Senior Claims Specialist ensures the best possible outcome for the claim, meeting customer service expectations, and supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel.

This is a remote position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives Workers’ Compensation claim, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgement of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim by investigating and gathering information regarding the claim and files necessary documentation with state agencies
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Develops and manages well documented action plans with the case manager and outcomes manager to reduce overall cost of the claim
  • Coordinates early return-to-work efforts with the appropriate parties
  • Manages subrogation and litigation of claim as it applies
  • Manages potential claim recoveries of all types
  • Reports claims to the excess carrier when applicable
  • Communicates claim status with the customer and claimant
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Develops and maintains professional customer relationships
  • Complies with rules and regulations of applicable state
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers’ Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years’ industry experience and claim handling
  • Self-Insured Certificate preferred
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster
  • Current license or certification in Workers’ Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $29.35 - $47.28 per hour

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: Medical Case Manager I
jobs.description_html:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Hawaii.  

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.  

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families.  Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others.  This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

This is a remote position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient’s progress
  • Evaluates patient’s treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney’s visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker’s injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month 
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required 

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $63,739 – $95,264

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: Vice President Sales Enablement
jobs.description_html:
The Vice President, Sales Enablement plays a critical leadership role in strengthening execution, leadership effectiveness, and consistency across CorVel’s national sales organization. This role reinforces and advances the consistent application of CorVel’s Sales Performance System, ensuring that strategy, methodology, and expectations are effectively applied in how the organization sells. Through close partnership with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams, this role improves how the organization executes, supporting stronger pipeline quality, more consistent selling practices, and overall sales performance.

This is a remote position.

Core Purpose:

Strengthen execution, leadership effectiveness, and consistency in how the organization sells.

This role enables leaders and sellers to operate with clarity, discipline, and alignment, supporting improved sales performance across the organization.

Role within the Sales Performance System:

The Vice President, Sales Enablement leads the Enablement and Field Leadership (ENABLE and LEAD) pillars of CorVel’s Sales Performance System, with direct responsibility for strengthening sales capability, leadership effectiveness, and execution consistency across the organization.

In this role, the Vice President partners with pillar owners to reinforce consistent execution across the broader system:

  • Positioning (POSITION) – in partnership with Marketing to support consistent use of messaging in the field
  • Sales Process Execution (SELL) – in partnership with Sales to reinforce consistent use of the sales process
  •  Commercial Execution (WIN) – in partnership with Sales and Marketing to support clear and consistent value articulation
  • Performance Optimization (OPTIMIZE) – in partnership with Finance and Sales to share field insight and support alignment

The role supports alignment of the overall sales strategy (ALIGN) and ensures the system is consistently applied across the organization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Performance & Capability Development:

  • Delivering training that builds core selling skills and improves confidence and effectiveness across the sales team
  • Support ongoing development of both sales leaders and sellers through simple, practical learning and reinforcement
  • Reinforce consistent skill development to improve overall sales performance

Sales Leadership Effectiveness & Coaching Excellence:

  • Partner with sales leaders to strengthen coaching capability and leadership effectiveness
  • Equip leaders with clear frameworks and tools for pipeline reviews and opportunity coaching
  • Support leaders in building consistent coaching habits and improving team effectiveness overall

Forecast Accuracy, Pipeline Health & Revenue Predictability:

  • Provide clear frameworks, training, and tools to support consistent pipeline and forecasting practices
  • Reinforce consistent use of pipeline and forecast approaches across the organization
  • Reinforce awareness of pipeline and forecast trends to support better decision making

Sales Methodology Adoption & Enablement Execution:

  • Reinforce adoption of CorVel’s sales methodology, including ASLAN principles and consultative selling practices, ensuring practical use in daily selling
  • Equip teams with simple tools, guidance, and training that improve consistency, productivity, and overall sales effectiveness
  • Partner with Sales Operations and cross-functional teams to support effective use of sales tools and workflows

Messaging Alignment & Market Consistency:

  • Partner with Marketing and Product to translate positioning into simple, usable sales tools and guidance
  • Reinforce consistent use of CorVel’s messaging in customer conversations
  • Share field feedback to help improve clarity and consistency of messaging

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

This role partners across the organization to support consistent execution, including

  • Sales – support coaching, consistency, and how teams operate
  • Sales Operations – support consistent use of sales tools and systems
  • Marketing – ensure messaging is clearly understood and used in the field
  • Product – support clear understanding of differentiation and solutions in market conversations
  • Finance – support alignment on forecasting, pricing, and incentives
  • Additional duties as assigned

IMPACT OF ROLE:

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Improved consistency in how the sales organization executes
  • Stronger adoption of sales methodology, process, tools, and messaging
  • Increased leadership effectiveness and coaching consistency
  • Greater clarity and alignment in pipeline and forecasting practices
  • Improved overall sales effectiveness and performance

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Consistency in sales execution
  • Coaching excellence and leadership development
  • Sales enablement and methodology reinforcement
  • Influence and alignment across teams
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Change leadership and adoption
  • Strong understanding of sales process, qualification, and consultative selling practices
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across teams

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise sales, sales leadership, or sales enablement roles
  • Demonstrated ability to improve execution consistency and effectiveness in complex B2B environments
  • High operational discipline combined with practical field-based sales experience
  • Experience in insurance, healthcare, workers’ compensation, or managed care strongly preferred

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $147,441 - $228,008

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: CA UR Case Manager II
jobs.description_html:
The Utilization Review Case Manager gathers demographic and clinical information on prospective, concurrent and retrospective in-patient admissions and out-patient treatment, certifies the medical necessity and assigns an appropriate length of stay while supporting the goals of the Case Management department and of CorVel.

This is a remote position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Identifies the necessity of the review process and communicates issues of concern to the appropriate claims staff/customer
  • Collects data and analyzes information to make decisions regarding certification or denial of treatment
  • Documents all work in the appropriate manner
  • Promotes utilization review services with stakeholders
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during work hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP)
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS: 

  • Must have thorough knowledge of both CPT and ICD coding
  • Ability to interface with claims staff, attorneys, physicians and their representatives, as well as advisors/clients and coworkers
  • Effective organization skills in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to meet designated deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Knowledge of the workers’ compensation claims process preferred
  • Knowledge of outpatient utilization review preferred

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 

  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing with an associate’s degree, Bachelor of Science degree or Bachelor of Science in Nursing
  • Current Nursing licensure in the state of operation required; RN is required unless local state regulations permit LVN/LPN
  • 4 or more years of recent clinical experience
  • Prospective, concurrent, and retrospective utilization review experience preferred
  • Experience in the clinical areas of OR, ICU, CCU, ER and/or orthopedics preferred

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

jobs.title: CERIS Director of Product
jobs.description_html:
The Director of Product is responsible for supporting the strategy, execution, and lifecycle management of CERIS’ Itemized Bill Review (IBR) and Hospital Bill Audit (HBA) product lines within medical cost containment. This role helps ensure alignment with CERIS’ annual strategic objectives while addressing evolving industry needs within the clinical audit space. The Director serves as a subject matter expert in IBR and HBA, bringing relational, tactical, and technical expertise in payment integrity. The leader in this role is accountable for supporting product growth across the IBR and HBA portfolio, with a focus on enhancing revenue generation and elevating client satisfaction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support development of next generation IBR and HBA services aligned with prepayment and post payment solution strategies
  • Build product relationships across CERIS/CorVel, including corporate marketing, IT, regional offices, external clients, and AE and AM staff within the IBR and HBA segment
  • Function as a subject matter expert (SME) in IBR and HBA product development processes, solution areas, competitor offerings, and customer needs
  • Plan, develop, define requirements, produce cost benefit analysis, and launch IBR and HBA projects within scheduled and committed time frames
  • Build external relationships with customers and industry experts to stay current on IBR and HBA industry information & trends
  • Contribute to the integration of complex business factors in support of long-term strategic LOB or market segment objectives for IBR and HBA; help shape products to enhance client value and experience
  • Support product integrity through collaboration with senior leadership and other CERIS departments
  • Collaborate with leadership and functional experts, providing insight and input on business process improvement approaches to strategic business challenges within IBR and HBA
  • Provide mentoring and coaching to team members; contribute to a “learn and do” culture of continuous improvement
  • Produce content for training AE and AM teams on IBR and HBA, including market differentiation, benchmarking, etc
  • Manage multiple projects, priority setting, and committed schedules
  • Available to travel up to 25% for customer onsite visits and events

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Background in Itemized Bill Review (IBR) and Hospital Bill Audit (HBA) audit types required
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Solid problem-solving skills with an innovative mindset
  • Verbally articulate with the ability to present product/topics at events
  • Skilled in supporting product business plans with forecasting and maturation planning
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver results in a fast paced, dynamic environment
  • Strong analytical and modeling skills, with the ability to distill data into actionable results
  • Comfortable working in a cross-functional role
  • Technology industry experience considered a plus but not required

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited college or university is preferred
  • 7+ years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • Demonstrated experience with Itemized Bill Review (IBR) and Hospital Bill Audit (HBA) clinical audit methodologies required

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $139,548 – $181,252

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: CareIQ Service Coordinator I
jobs.description_html:
The CareIQ Service Coordinator provides administrative customer service and file management assistance to claimants, providers, claims professionals, and case managers regarding new and ongoing ancillary healthcare services. Utilizing proprietary systems and knowledge from training, a CareIQ Service Coordinator will provide excellent telephonic and written customer service to both inbound and outbound customers. This role operates with a high focus on accuracy, urgency and communication to ensure that services are completed on schedule and without interruption.

This is a remote role. The shift for this position is Monday - Friday: 10:30 AM - 7:00 PM EST.

A wired connection to your modem from a broadband internet network with a minimum bandwidth of at least 3 Mbps is required for this position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide telephonic customer service in an inbound and outbound high-volume call-center environment
  • Complete accurate data review and entry
  • Able to learn and operate corporate proprietary systems
  • Request and review treatment and appointment documentation to verify completion and accuracy
  • Administrative review of claim referral orders, authorization, appointment notes and reports, ensuring alignment of pending and completed services
  • Update all case stakeholders on a regular basis
  • Type and proofread reports and correspondence via email and management systems
  • Transcribe correspondence/reports from dictation
  • Use problem solving and critical thinking skills to ensure daily scheduling challenges do not cause delays in securing appointments
  • Meet departmental production and quality performance expectations
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Process oriented and effective multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to meet designated deadlines
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office and Proprietary Systems
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to maintain a professional and courteous demeanor that sets tone for complex telephonic conversations
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • High School diploma
  • Prior work experience in a detail-oriented customer service environment

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

Pay Range:  $15.61 - $23.82 per hour

jobs.description_html:
The Utilization Review Case Manager gathers demographic and clinical information on prospective, concurrent and retrospective in-patient admissions and out-patient treatment, certifies the medical necessity and assigns an appropriate length of stay while supporting the goals of the Case Management department and of CorVel.

This is a remote position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Identifies the necessity of the review process and communicates issues of concern to the appropriate claims staff/customer
  • Collects data and analyzes information to make decisions regarding certification or denial of treatment
  • Documents all work in the appropriate manner
  • Promotes utilization review services with stakeholders
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS: 

  • Must have thorough knowledge of both CPT and ICD coding
  • Ability to interface with claims staff, attorneys, physicians and their representatives, as well as advisors/clients and coworkers
  • Effective organization skills in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to meet designated deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Knowledge of the workers’ compensation claims process preferred
  • Knowledge of outpatient utilization review preferred

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: 

  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing with an associate’s degree, Bachelor of Science degree or Bachelor of Science in Nursing
  • Current Nursing licensure in the state of operation required; RN is required unless local state regulations permit LVN/LPN
  • 4 or more years of recent clinical experience
  • Prospective, concurrent, and retrospective utilization review experience preferred
  • Experience in the clinical areas of OR, ICU, CCU, ER and/or orthopedics preferred

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $63,739 – $95,264

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

ABOUT CORVEL:

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers’ compensation, auto, health and disability management industries.   CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients.  We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities.  Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!). 

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.

CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

jobs.title: CA Senior Liability Claims Specialist
jobs.description_html:
The Senior Liability Claims Specialist manages mid to complex Auto and/or General Liability claims, including bodily injury and property damage. This role aims to achieve optimal outcomes for both CorVel and our clients. The Senior Liability Claims Specialist handles litigated files and works with delegated authority, adhering to company best practices.

This is a remote position, and occasional travel may be required up to 5%.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives claims, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgment of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim
  • Investigates claims and handles Auto and/or General Liability claims
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Communicates claim status with the customer, claimant, and client
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Collaborates with team members on more complex or problematic claims as necessary
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to learn rapidly to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to meet or exceed performance expectations
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Five (5) or more years’ experience handling General Liability claims, including high exposure and/or litigated claims
  • Two (2) or more years' experience handling Auto Liability claims
  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Current Adjuster’s License in state of operation is required
  • Multi-State license is preferred
  • Municipality experience is a plus

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $29.35- $47.28 per hour

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

jobs.title: Workers' Compensation Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
The Workers' Compensation Product Manager is a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness of our Enterprise Claims workers’ compensation product. This role requires a deep understanding of product knowledge, operational processes, workers’ compensation regulations, and the ability to provide business requirements to development. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to enhance our product offerings, streamline workflows, and drive product development.

This is a remote-first role with requirements for occasional travel and on-site office attendance as business needs dictate.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct comprehensive analyses of product, including feature performance, utilization trends, and user feedback; identify areas for improvement and recommend actionable solutions to enhance product functionality and user experience
  • Data Analysis: Utilize techniques to extract meaningful insights and identify patterns to inform product development and optimization efforts
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay abreast of evolving workers’ compensation regulations, regulatory compliance rules and regulations, and industry standards impacting workers’ compensation claim management practices
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product management, software development, quality assurance, and customer support teams to obtain requirements, prioritize enhancements, and facilitate the successful implementation of product improvements; act as a subject matter expert and provide guidance on technical and functional aspects of the Enterprise Claim workers’ compensation product
  • Quality Assurance: Participate in quality assurance activities to validate product enhancements, ensure accuracy and consistency in claim management, and verify compliance with predefined specifications and requirements; conduct thorough testing and troubleshooting to identify and resolve any issues or discrepancies
  • Documentation and Training: Assist the documentation and training team to develop comprehensive documentation, training materials, and user guides to support internal teams and external stakeholders in understanding and effectively utilizing the workers’ compensation claim product; provide training sessions and demonstrations as needed to ensure proper product adoption and utilization
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and efficiency gains within the claim management product lifecycle; drive initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce manual interventions, and improve overall product performance

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong understanding of claim management processes, reporting, and regulatory compliance
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets, identify trends, and draw actionable insights
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies, agile principles, and experience working in cross-functional teams
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills as well as verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across diverse teams
  • Experience with creating and leading presentations and/or conducting training with various levels of users
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, thoroughness, and continuous improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Aptitude for learning systems and technical processes
  • Adept at thriving in a fast-paced environment with firm deadlines with demonstrated ability to manage details and timelines for multiple simultaneous complex projects
  • Demonstrated ability to provide product requirements and drive innovation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field
  • Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., SCLA, ARM) preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare industry roles with a focus on Workers Compensation claim management
  • Proven leadership experience, especially in matrix or cross-functional settings, is highly desirable

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location.  Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors:  federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions.  Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.  The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range:  $99,250 - $166,777

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.
