jobs.title: Claims Coverage Attorney
jobs.description_html:
Claims Coverage Attorney

Hybrid Work Schedule

Buffalo, NY

Merchants Insurance Group is a leading Property and Casualty Insurer in the Northeast and is looking for an experienced Claims Coverage Attorney for our Corporate Claim Legal Team located in Buffalo, NY.

We are seeking individuals with at least 5 years of previous experience in insurance coverage analysis/determination/disposition.  

This position will be responsible for preparing coverage opinions and coverage position letters for claims involving complex coverage issues or disputes.  This role will also assist claims professionals in the evaluation of risk transfer opportunities, priority of coverage, and tender strategies.  The Claims Coverage Attorney is responsible for assessing and directing coverage litigation strategy in conjunction with outside counsel and the claims professional, including developing and executing a plan to manage the coverage litigation through final resolution. This individual may also provide legal support to underwriting, product development and regulatory compliance programs.

This position is responsible for both first- and third-party coverage review, analysis and decisions for all levels of claims, including those involved in litigation. In addition, the individual will provide claim, policy, regulatory and legal expertise, if or as appropriate, to all levels of management up to and including senior management.   The role will also review all policy forms for updates and revisions, ensuring compliance with state regulations, as well as applicable statutes and case law.  The position will also require training for all levels of claims staff in matters of policy interpretation, investigatory processes, regulatory compliance and good faith claims practices across multiple venues.

Merchants Insurance Group is rated A- (Excellent) with a stable outlook by A.M. Best and is consistently recognized as a top employer and high-performing organization. Recent honors include:

  • Best Places to Work in Western New York (Buffalo Business First, 2023–2026)

  • Fast Track Company (2019–2025) and Top Private Company (2019–2025)
  • Ward’s 50® top-performing property-casualty insurer (2021–2024)
  • Ivans Spark Award for Innovation (2024–2025)
  • Named to Newsweek and Statista’s America’s Most Reliable Companies list (2025), ranked among the top 300 of 1,500 B2B organizations evaluated

We offer a hybrid work schedule, requiring two full days per week in the office, with flexibility to work remotely or in office the remaining days. This model supports collaboration while providing flexibility and work-life balance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Prepares coverage communication consistent with internal quality standards and applicable state regulations.
  • Works collaboratively with front-line claims professionals and managers to provide coverage analysis and preparation or review of coverage position letters for claims involving complex coverage issues or disputes.
  • Provides legal or coverage guidance to claim professionals handling declaratory judgment actions in which Merchants is a named party.
  • Directs outside counsel on litigation strategy.
  • Leads claim staff in training involving legal or coverage matters.
  • Provides claim legal support to underwriting and product development teams. Also assists in regulatory compliance programs by providing supplementary research regarding statutes and regulations impacting our business.

 Qualifications & Skills:

  • Juris Doctor with license in good standing
  • Minimum 5 years of insurance coverage experience and/or practicing attorney experience
  • Proficiency with Westlaw or other legal research applications CPCU highly desirable
  • Minimum 10 years of technical experience in complex coverage analysis
  • Prior leadership experience is highly desired
  • High degree of competency in insurance coverage analysis, policy construction, and legal research with exemplary writing skills.
  • Ability to transfer knowledge through formal and informal training with demonstrated excellent written and oral presentation skills.
  • Advanced written and oral communication skills with influence, initiative, and ability to communicate effectively across all levels across an insurance organization to include cross-departmental relationships.
  • Experience with construction and labor law litigation coverage issues related to risk transfer.
  • Proven demonstration of creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to lead and work in a cooperative manner.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
Product Manager – Commercial Lines

Hybrid Work Schedule

Buffalo, NY 

At Merchants Insurance Group, we're looking for a strategic and results-oriented professional to help shape the future of our insurance product portfolio. As a Product Manager for commercial package and middle market, you will lead the performance, strategy, and growth of assigned product lines, driving initiatives that enhance profitability, improve loss outcomes, and strengthen our competitive position in the marketplace.

In this highly visible role, you'll collaborate across Underwriting, Actuarial, Claims, Distribution, and other key business areas to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and deliver meaningful business results. Success requires a strong blend of analytical thinking, business acumen, and influence—leveraging data, expertise, and relationships to align stakeholders and execute winning strategies.

The ideal candidate brings product management experience within the insurance industry, a passion for data-driven decision-making, and the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Candidates with underwriting and/or actuarial experience will be especially well-positioned to thrive in this role.

If you're looking for an opportunity to make a measurable impact, collaborate with talented professionals, and help drive the continued success of Merchants Insurance Group, we encourage you to apply.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Product Strategy, Portfolio Management & Performance 

  • Serve as the business owner for assigned product lines, accountable for profitability, growth, retention, and overall portfolio performance
  • Drive production goals for assigned product lines by monitoring performance, partnering with regional teams to identify opportunities and challenges, and implementing targeted actions to improve results.
  • Conduct competitive, market, and industry analysis to identify emerging trends, customer demands, and strategic opportunities.
  • Lead state rate and form filings in partnership with Actuarial Team.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.

Product Development & Innovation 

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned products, from strategy and prioritization through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversight of day-to-day management of assigned product lines, with hands-on involvement across all aspects of the product lifecycle.
  • Partner with technology and operational teams to improve product capabilities, streamline processes, and enhance customer and agent experience.
  • Analyzes performance across key dimensions and leverages insights to recommend and implement actions that improve results.
  • Identifies and develops new product opportunities, coverage enhancements, and endorsements to strengthen profitability and expand market presence.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Production Management 

  • Lead cross-functional product initiatives, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely execution across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Influence decision-making and drive outcomes without direct authority in a matrixed environment.
  • Partner with regional leadership and distribution teams to achieve production goals and optimize growth.
  • Identify production challenges and growth opportunities through ongoing performance monitoring and stakeholder engagement.
  • Support field teams through product education, performance insights and consultation on market opportunities and challenges.

Qualifications & Skills:

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field.
  • 5+ years of insurance product management, underwriting, or actuarial experience
  • Experience working across functions and influencing outcomes without direct authority; or
  • Combination of above education and experience

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE & ABILITIES

  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Product management, underwriting, and/or actuarial experience, ideally within the relevant insurance product line.

Merchants Insurance Group Benefits:

  • Welcoming and positive work environment.
  • Flexible work arrangements, including flex scheduling and summer hours.
  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Colleague Appreciation Events.
  • Competitive pay scale.
  • Generous paid time off package.
  • Full Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, 401(k) employer match amount is 100% up to 6% of your annual contributions. You are immediately 100% vested in the employer match dollars.
  • Outstanding company bonus programs.
  • Tuition Reimbursement.

And many more exciting company benefits!!  

Salary Range: $133,000 - $155,000

The compensation range listed for this position reflects the good-faith range Merchants Insurance Group expects to pay for the role at the time of posting. Individual compensation will be determined based on qualifications, experience, skills, and other job-related factors.
 
Merchants Insurance Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Buffalo, NY

Merchants Insurance Group, a leading Property and Casualty Insurer in the Northeast, is looking for a Reserving Actuarial Analyst for our Corporate Actuarial team based in our Corporate Headquarters in Buffalo, New York.  

The Reserving Actuarial Analyst will become part of a dedicated actuarial team focusing on estimating unpaid property and casualty insurance liabilities and providing reserving methodology and process improvements

Merchants Insurance Group is rated A- (Excellent) with a stable outlook by A.M. Best and is consistently recognized as a top employer and high-performing organization. Recent honors include:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Supports quarterly and annual reserve reviews using traditional property-casualty unpaid claim estimation techniques and methodologies and implements the results effectively.
  • Extracts, validates, and maintains transactional datasets for both internal use and transfer to the Appointed Actuary.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Employee Benefits - Mid Market
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

 

Responsible for providing customer service and overall service of assigned customers and/or policies, soliciting of new business on existing accounts and support of Producer-led new business efforts.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

 

Supports Producer in developing new business opportunities for existing clients and prospects;

Initiates renewal process for existing clients, and discusses and creates renewal strategy with Producer;

Analyzes and compares current exposures and develops renewal or new business specifications for marketing;

Conducts marketing, negotiates rates, reviews quotes and coverages for competitiveness and accuracy;

Reviews and summarizes marketing results and prepares proposals;

Finalizes proposals and presentations in coordination with Producer;

Binds insurance coverage and prepares binders and/or delegate certificates issuance;

Reviews policies for accuracy and review contracts;

Prepares summaries and/or schedules of coverage for clients;

Reviews client accounting history, responds to accounting inquiries, corrects discrepancies, and contacts client on receivable collections;

Participates in the claims process as directed by management, including claim submission, follow-up and overall communication;

Provides technical guidance to staff assisting with client needs or procedural issues;

Notifies brokers of pertinent information related to client retention;

Meets with clients as needed or directed by Producer;

Collection of fees, reconciliation and resolution of any outstanding balances within 90 days of invoicing date;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Commissions System Configuration & Reporting Analyst
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for working with technical and business unit members to understand the sales and commission process and then gather requirements, analyze, define, manage,  configure and implement commission system and reporting requirements.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Commission System Analysis Functions:  Analyze current operational procedures, identify problems, and identify and communicate system requirements, and implement appropriate configurations and/or changes. Act as a knowledgeable liaison between teams during the implementation phase, maintenance and general processing stages of the commission system.

Technical Configuration Functions:  Utilize SQL, Excel, and web-based customization tools including Logical Expressions, queries, field mappings, and system functions to configure and maintain commission system. Configure and maintain formulas, expressions, and data mappings; create and update screens, dashboards, views, filters, and approval rules; configuration of users, groups, and security permissions; customization of objects, fields, record types, page layouts and validation rules.  Ensure technology system and process standards are adhered to with regard to system updates.

Quality Assurance and Usability Testing: Test, Validate, and understands the impact of various configuration options and changes. Assist with resolving technical/system related inquiries.  Develop solutions to increase efficiency, accuracy and accessibility of data.

Commission System Reporting and Records:  Utilize Commission System and BI tools to create and maintain reports for internal and external distribution.  Establish and follow consistent process for system documentation and training, communicating enhancements, and reporting system discrepancies.

Special Projects:  Work collaboratively with fellow staff to advance the values and mission of Senior Market Sales by serving on relevant internal and external committees; Assists with special projects/assignments as requested by members of management.

Performs other duties as assigned by management.

These tasks do not meet the Americans with Disabilities Act definition of essential job functions and are usually less than 5% of time spent. However, these tasks still constitute important performance aspects of the job.

QUALIFICATIONS 

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 

Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems or related field or experience with a minimum of two (2) years in the system support field

SQL Excel experience

Experience with Callidus/SaaS commission systems a plus

Experience with Groovy, Java, Python, Ruby or other Object Oriented languages a plus.

Strong verbal and written proficiencies of the English language

Bilingual (Spanish and English)

SKILLS

Working knowledge of insurance services, industries, and product lines.

Knowledge of the general industry procedures, practices and terminology including data processing system and application design methods, techniques and standards.

Knowledge of accounting and commission principles and procedures.

Working knowledge of SQL and Excel; as well as languages such as Groovy, Java, Python, Ruby and/or other Object Oriented languages.

Working knowledge of Agile project management methodology.

Working knowledge and skill with comparing large data sets, organizing data and summarizing findings.

Working knowledge and skill with requirements gathering, analysis, implementation and support.

Knowledge of general office forms, processes and procedures.

Knowledge of program and project management including outcomes, quality assurance, and satisfaction measurement and interpretation.

Knowledge of accounting and budgeting principles and procedures.

Skill in negotiating and problem solving to resolve internal and external conflicts.

Skill in the use of time management and organizational skills.

Skill in maintaining effective working relationships with all vendors, employees and the general public.

Proficient working knowledge of common computer systems and computer software programs used by SMS.

Ability to approach and communicate with a wide range of personalities in a professional and courteous manner.

Ability to be patient under frustrating circumstances and demonstrate controlled emotional affect in difficult situations.

Ability to engage in effective interpersonal interaction, verbal communication and written communication.

Ability to maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail while remaining flexible and responsive when faced with multiple urgent requests.

Ability to read, write and communicate English effectively.

Ability to maintain all company policies, including all confidentiality and safety policies.

Ability to actively contribute to team effort.

Ability to work independently, exercise independent judgment, make and execute decisions.

Ability to demonstrate organizational leadership qualities and develop and foster trusting relationships.

jobs.title: Business Data Analyst
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for working with account team in processing renewals, conducting and analyzing marketing, preparing financial summaries and providing general technical support for assigned fully-insured and self-funded accounts. Performs a variety of analysis including provider network analysis and carrier utilization analysis. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Initiates recurring analyst renewal projects on assigned accounts (pre-renewal spreads, carrier renewal process initiation, information requests, etc.); Gathers, reviews and validates all information related to assigned clients for renewal analysis and marketing purposes, gaining comprehensive familiarity with client’s current details and history;

Evaluates carrier utilization reporting to identify key cost drivers and make recommendations for possible plan design changes;

Coordinates and assists in renewal challenges (underwriting);

Creates new financial reporting package from templates as needed;

Conducts provider network comparison analysis (access disruption analysis);

Coordinates with account team to understand strategy for client renewal and define roles and responsibilities.  Revisits throughout the renewal development process, outlining renewal project action items, including all deadlines;

Collaborates with all current insurance carriers and vendors to obtain preliminary and/or firm renewals and prepares initial financial summary and benefit highlights;

Presents preliminary renewal summaries and marketing results to account team to determine plan options and/or marketing strategy; works with account team to develop and execute negotiation strategy;

Presents all final results to account team; determines content and structure of renewal presentation and identifies analytical support materials (i.e.; utilization review, contribution strategy, benchmarking, financial reporting, etc.);

Executes all relevant plan option requests, marketing projects and necessary analysis to complete account strategy objectives;

Reviews all marketing and plan option responses, evaluates for accuracy and completeness, and requests clarifications and revisions as needed;

Handles ongoing (monthly/quarterly) client maintenance projects as determined by account team;

Reviews team members work for accuracy and completeness as needed;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Degree in Business or Mathematics preferred. 

One (1) or more years related work experience

Valid insurance license (or must be obtained within ninety (90) days of employment)

Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal

Basic knowledge of compliance topics (HIPAA, COBRA, ACA, Medicare).

Basic knowledge of programs (know of existence and how to get a quote).  

Salesforce experience preferred

Knowledge of all major fully-insured and self-funded lines of benefits insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability, EAP);

SKILLS

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite: Excel, Power Point, and Outlook 

Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel

Excellent verbal and written communication skills 

Excellent problem solving and time management skills

Good customer service skills, including telephone and listening skills

Excellent planning, organizational and prioritization skills

Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork 

Ability to work productively as an individual to accomplish assigned projects

Ability to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines

#LI-GS1

jobs.title: Senior Associate Counsel - P&C (Remote)
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for advising Alliant corporate departments and business groups on a broad range of legal issues and managing outside counsel when needed. Reviews, drafts, and negotiates a variety of contracts and other forms, in addition to other general corporate and compliance matters. Proactively contributes to the progress of the legal department and development of team processes, procedures, and practices, as well as policies, processes, and procedures for the company. Assists with supervising, mentoring, and training other associate attorneys and legal team members

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides guidance on complex legal matters and anticipates, mitigates, and advises on potential legal problems across corporate groups, client engagements, and third-party relationships.

At the direction of department leadership, leads and oversees discrete legal initiatives, projects, and/or functions, and elevates certain legal matters to leadership, as appropriate, for guidance and feedback on proposed solutions and next steps.

Reviews, drafts, negotiates, and advises on a wide range of contracts including account purchase agreements, independent contractor agreements, vendor agreements, data privacy agreements, client agreements, collaborative agreements, and confidentiality agreements.

Partners with multi-functional transactional teams, including corporate and business development, accounting, sales, and human resources, on company policy, process, and procedure development and legal compliance.

Works with external counsel and internal business teams to respond to subpoenas and litigation discovery requests.

Partners with other internal attorneys and legal operations to create, refine, and update contract templates and other forms.

Supports merger and acquisition activity by collecting, reviewing, and preparing information for due diligence, contributing to the integration process for newly acquired companies, and working with external counsel to review and draft employment agreements for transitioning employees.

Works with other internal attorneys and legal operations to develop, revise, and manage legal department

policies, processes, and procedures to increase efficiencies and support business objectives.

Works with other team members to develop and manage training protocols for new attorneys and other legal team members.

Assists with supervising, mentoring, and training other associate attorneys and legal team members.

Develops and gives presentations to various corporate groups and management on best practices with regard to contracting, legal compliance, and other legal matters.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Law School Juris Doctor degree from an ABA-accredited law school is required

Five (5) or more years of related work experience is required

Member in good standing of at least one State Bar or the District of Columbia Bar is required

Experience in effectively preparing, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts with minimum supervision.

 

SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Ability to give legal guidance in a practical, business-oriented manner to non-lawyer company representatives in order to help reach solutions

Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills

Demonstrated business acumen with ability to inspire trust and confidence with senior management

Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to adapt skills based on context and environment

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to establish good professional relationships with internal clients,

management, and legal colleagues

Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills, including ability to multitask on multiple high-priority projects

Good judgment, including good business judgment

Strong contract drafting and negotiation skills

Proficient in Microsoft Office products




#LI-DR2

#LI-REMOTE

Notifies brokers of pertinent information related to client retention;

jobs.title: Manager, Divisional Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for interacting with employees throughout all levels of the organization and provides broad, company-wide analytical support in support of business objectives.  Key responsibilities include management reporting and analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, partnering with IT on business intelligence (BI) projects, mentoring and supervising other FP&A team members, and completing special projects for management. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Provides analytical support to various functional units of the business; analyzes and interprets financial results.


Assists with the preparation of materials for monthly business reviews, investor calls, and other presentations.


Provides analytical insight based upon deep understanding of business objectives, issues, and root causes.


Sets best-in-class reporting standards.  Leads the development and preparation of ad hoc and standard management reports, tailoring the format and content to the specific needs of various internal customers.


Applies a wide range of analytical and statistical techniques to independently construct sophisticated financial models.  Uses results of modeling to provide decision support and recommendations to leadership.


Sets standards for planning templates and reports, develops sound global assumptions, constructs plans, identifies and analyzes variances and decision trade-offs, and makes recommendations on how to improve business results.


Integrates diverse sets of financial and operational data to generate business insight.


Develops clear and informative methods of presenting key findings to management.


Proactively drives continuous improvements and best practices within the FP&A and broader organization to reduce error rates and maximize productivity and efficiency.


Completes special projects as assigned to support corporate objectives.


Mentors and supervises other team members.


Comply with agency management system data standard and data integrity (enter and maintain complete and accurate information).


Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS 

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 


Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or related field equivalent
combination of education and experience


Graduate degree


Eight (8) or more years related work experience; specifically in a FP&A role


Certified Corporate FP&A Professional


Certified Public Accountant (CPA)


Certified Financial Planner-CFP Board


  

SKILLS


Strong understanding of financial computer systems and data systems


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite


Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and polished presentation skills


Excellent ability to interpret and analyze financial statements


Strong mathematical ability, including understanding of algebraic functions and statistical forecasting methods


Mastery of data management, financial systems, and other analytical tools


Strong ability to leverage various financial systems and BI tools to produce insightful reports and analyses


Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills


Highly proactive; actively seeks opportunities for process improvement


Project management experience successfully leading cross-functional teams


Ability to interact professionally with employees across all levels of the organization


Works well both independently and as a member of a team

jobs.title: Senior IT Business Analyst
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for leveraging expertise in business analysis, project coordination, and Agile delivery to support complex technology initiatives, drive process improvements, and mentor junior team members. Coordinate activities across SES, Alliant teams, external clients, vendors, and technology partners. Partner with business liaisons and stakeholders on requirements, backlog readiness, and release planning, while supporting Agile delivery. Work with designated business and technology leaders who retain overall delivery accountability.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Lead business analysis, stakeholder discovery, and documentation of business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process workflows.

Analyze and improve business processes, identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency, and better user adoption.

Partner with Business Liaisons, Product Owners, and stakeholders on request intake, backlog reviews, and business priority discussions.

Facilitate release prioritization and scope discussions using business priorities, engineering estimates, dependencies, and available capacity; support leadership decisions.

Coordinate requirements readiness with Business Analysts, Engineering, and QA before sprint planning and development.

Maintain project schedules, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items; proactively follow up and escalate impediments.

Coordinate concurrent technology initiatives across SES, Alliant, external clients, vendors, and implementation partners.

Facilitate cross-functional project meetings and communicate status, delivery expectations, and decisions to stakeholders and leadership.

Support Agile and Scrum delivery, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and Scrum Master coverage as needed.

Coordinate UAT, business validation, release planning, implementation readiness, and post-release follow-up with participating teams.

Collaborate with technical teams on system integrations, data exchanges, application modernization, and infrastructure initiatives.

Use SQL to query and validate data, investigate discrepancies, and support root cause analysis and business requirements.

Lead complex data analysis and deliver actionable insights for business decisions.

Develop or enhance Power BI dashboards and visualizations to support strategic and operational reporting needs.

Generate and improve recurring and ad hoc reports, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with stakeholder needs.

Ensure project, process, and requirements documentation is accurate, current, and accessible throughout delivery.

Mentor junior analysts and promote consistent requirements practices, documentation standards, and knowledge sharing.

Guide cross-functional teams, facilitate resolution of competing needs, and drive accountability without requiring direct reporting authority.

Support workload visibility and team development; demonstrate readiness for broader BA leadership responsibilities as organizational needs evolve.

Leverage approved AI tools to support research, requirements analysis, documentation, and process improvements, while ensuring accuracy and adherence to company policies.

Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE


Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience   

Seven (7) or more years business analysis,  project management, or related work experience

Experience with project management and Agile delivery tools to plan, track, and coordinate projects and releases 

Insurance industry experience    



SKILLS


Expertise in business analysis, requirements documentation, process modeling, and data analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and SQL.

Experience with Agile/Scrum, SDLC, backlog management, release planning, and project tracking tools.

Ability to coordinate multiple initiatives across internal organizations, external clients, and vendors; manage risks and dependencies.

Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to guide teams and influence without formal authority.

Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder facilitation, analytical problem-solving, and process improvement skills.

Demonstrates curiosity, resourcefulness, and a proactive, self-directed approach to problem solving, with the ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.




#LI-DK1
#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: General Sales Manager
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


The General Sales Manager is responsible for the overall recruiting and development of a designated sales unit within a branch office, and meeting personal and branch office production in support of the profitable growth and success of the branch office.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Performs regular, in person outside sales activity selling products within a specific line of business directly to clients to meet both personal production as well as branch office production requirements for consumer sales. 


Responsible for leadership of the unit to ensure the branch office achieves the goals and objectives as reflected in the Business Plan for the branch office including sourcing, recruiting, developing, supervising, supporting and retaining the agents/advisors. 


Train new agents with company's marketing systems, illustration and planning tools; as well as sales appointment training with an emphasis on working jointly with unit agents (resulting in split commissions) and the establishment and implementation of minimum sales requirements.


Monitor performance against goals and adhere to budget guidelines and approved annual marketing or business unit plans.


Establish, oversee and/or participate with annual goal setting, including revenue and recruiting goals based upon sales projections and annual marketing or business plans for the business unit.


Presentations at appropriate meetings to include ongoing initiatives as well as future plans to be implemented, accurate reporting, reviewing objectives, reviewing progress, identifying needs or areas for improvement and action plans for correction


Perform all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.


Performs other duties as assigned



QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 


Bachelor's Degree in financial services or marketing, or an equivalent combination of education, industry training, designations and experience.


Two (2) or more years of successful insurance sales and/or management at a field or home office level.


Must have a strong sense and knowledge of sales and marketing concepts that are beneficial to the sale of insurance products.


Securities Licensing preferred but not required (Series 6, 63, 7, 24, 26 or 65).



SKILLS


Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws as well as industry regulations.


Working knowledge of insurance services industries, concepts, and principles.


Knowledge of the general industry procedures, standards, systems, resources, practices and terminology.


Knowledge of supervisory techniques to accomplish instruction, motivation and training of personnel.


Excellent written, and verbal communication and collaboration skills, capable of effectively engaging with diverse teams and stakeholders.


Excellent analytical, problem solving, presentation skills, time management, organizational leadership and supervisory skills.


Skill in maintaining effective working relationships with all customers, employees and the general public.


Ability to work independently, exercise independent judgment, make and execute decisions.


Ability to maintain a flexible work schedule to include evening and weekend hours as needed.


Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provide a high-level of support for the annual merit and incentive process, and officer slate; including project planning, communication, and execution.

Work on a variety of complex projects involving analysis, job mapping, project planning, and testing.

Work with managers to develop and update job descriptions, ensuring job content is appropriately captured.

Perform evaluation of job responsibilities to determine appropriate FLSA classification.

Perform regular research and audit of incentive plan eligibility for new hires and job changes, report findings and recommend corrections.

Perform compensation analyses, market pricing, and audit of internal pay and job data to ensure compliance with state and federal laws.

Maintain job description tracking, ensure each job has an updated job description and job descriptions are documented in the company’s standardized format.

Review job and pay change requests, identify potential discrepancies, seek clarification, process approved changes, and prepare corresponding promotion or employment change letters.

Review and audit compensation reports such as ‘Employment Conditions Audit’ and ‘Upcoming Agreement  Dates’ report, ensuring future compensation commitments are documented and processed in a timely manner.

Perform regular research and audit of incentive plan eligibility for new hires and job changes, report findings and recommend corrections.

Provide analytical and administrative support for various compensation projects, including responsibilities related to documenting, monitoring, tracking, auditing and coordinating payments from the annual incentive bonus, merit, promotion.

Develop, maintain and audit job titles, job codes, and other job related attributes in the HRIS.

Provide overall project support with the compensation administration application; audit internal data, perform testing of configuration and data interface files to ensure data integrity and accuracy.

Provide training and cross-training in support of Compensation Function procedures and team support model.

Maintain job family and career path information by Operations group.

Stay abreast of and may report on compensation compliance updates, such as state minimum wage increases, and FLSA exemption regulations.

Compile data for compensation survey submissions.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience  


Two (2) or more years’ experience with administration of compensation programs

Four (4) or more years overall experience in Human Resources, Finance, or related area within a mid to large size organization

Experience working with leaders and recruiters to prepare and maintain job descriptions

Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or completion of some CCP course work



SKILLS

Knowledge of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

Knowledge of federal, state and local laws relating to Compensation and HR practices

Knowledge of salary planning tools and methods, job evaluation techniques, and market salary trends

Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.; with emphasis on Excel

Skill in writing and editing job descriptions

Strong time-management, problem-solving, and organizational skills

Skill in analyzing and organizing technical data

Skill in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail

Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with frequent interruptions, distractions, and a fluctuating workload

Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision

Ability to process and handle confidential information with discretion

Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form

Ability to understand and express opposing points of view while maintaining positive working relationships

Ability to maintain effective interpersonal relationships with employees at all levels of the organization

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for execution of all advanced pricing and analysis requests.  Leads in the development and management of assigned underwriting and analyst teams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Act as subject matter expert in all major areas of underwriting, including special pricing and marketing projects.

Meet with clients and Financial & Underwriting team to define and accomplish projects.

Assist in determining strategic goals of team(s), including but not limited to resource planning, education/training needs, policy development, and business growth.

Identify, coordinate, and manage all relevant external business partner relationships, including but not limited to insurance carriers, external consultants, and third party administrators and vendors.

Act as subject matter expert in understanding actuarial plan values and how they are used in various pricing and analysis projects. This includes ability to competently use software available for such types of plan analysis and pricing.

Understand underwriting models and reporting templates in order to fully modify and customize to meet customer needs.

Lead and manage all assigned client underwriting projects, and present analysis to clients directly in a confident and easy-to-understand manner.

Assist Producers in prospecting activities as needed, including but not limited to written RFP responses, finalist presentations, and related follow-up activities.

Maintain data tracking and reporting for financial management, underwriting models, client reports, and other analytical reporting deliverables.

Competent in multiple carrier data and reporting systems as needed to obtain claim data for reporting and analysis purposes.

Confidently analyze and challenge insurance company renewal calculations for fully-insured contracts (Health, Dental, and Vision).

Actively engage in educational opportunities to further underwriting knowledge, market trends, and regulatory environment.

Responsible for accuracy and timeliness of all work performed, including proper management of timelines and meeting deadlines as established.

Address incoming correspondence and respond as required in a timely manner.

Lead in training development and execution on all underwriting and analysis related topics.

Comply with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enter and maintain complete and accurate information).

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree Or equivalent combination of education and experience 

Eight (8) or more years of related work experience

One (1) or more years of management experience in leading a team of at least 3 individuals


Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal

SKILLS

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, advanced MS Excel skills required

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Excellent problem solving and time management skills

Good customer service skills, including telephone and listening skills

Excellent planning, organizational, and prioritization skills

Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork

Ability to completely manage mid-level and large projects as well as effectively manage and lead assigned teams to complete goals

Ability to work productively as an individual to accomplish assigned projects

Ability to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for providing analytical support to operating group leadership and team. Key responsibilities include management reporting and analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and process improvement.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Provides broad analytical support to assigned departments and acts as a liaison between departments.


Analyzes and interprets financial results, comparing actual performance to prior periods, budgets, and forecasts; then clearly articulates to management the narrative behind the numbers.


Designs and prepares ad hoc and standard management reporting.


Proactively seeks opportunities to provide increasingly insightful reports to management.


Independently constructs moderate to complex financial models to analyze the impact of current and proposed company initiatives.


Leads the forecasting and budgeting processes.


Creates and maintains planning templates and reports, helps to construct revenue and expense plans, identifies and analyzes variances, challenges and redirects business assumptions as needed.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Architect (Remote)
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for leading the design and delivery of transformational platform implementations. This role will partner directly with IT leadership, ServiceNow developer teams, and business stakeholders to translate organizational imperatives into scalable, value-driven ServiceNow solutions. This is a leadership-focused role that bridges technical excellence with strategic business outcomes and platform health/performance. You will also engage with implementation partners, participate in internal governance boards, and work across IT and business functions to drive platform adoption and sustainable value realization.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead end-to-end ServiceNow architecture, solution design, and implementation strategy; own the platform roadmap from discovery through go-live and optimization.

Direct delivery teams (developers, functional analysts, administrators, testers) on complex, multi-module implementations (ITSM, CSM, HRSD, GRC, FSO, etc.); ensure adherence to ServiceNow best practices and platform governance.

Engage C-suite (CIO, CTO, CFO, business unit leaders), IT leadership (Senior Directors, Directors, Release Train Engineers), and cross-functional business stakeholders to define strategic platform vision, business outcomes, and change management; serve as the trusted technical advisor on ServiceNow strategy and organizational impact.

Define scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions for ServiceNow modules, integrations, and custom applications.

Design platform architecture, data models, integration patterns, and data governance frameworks aligned with client regulatory and operational requirements in partnership with other IT teams.

Collaborate with IT project managers and business analysts to translate business requirements into ServiceNow solution designs and detailed user stories.

Ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture, business needs, and platform best practices.

Review technical design documents, data models, and integration patterns for quality and compliance.

Lead scope management, risk mitigation, and escalation resolution on complex implementations; drive accountability for schedule, technical quality, and business outcomes.

Partner with IT project managers, implementation partners, developers, and systems integrators; coordinate delivery across internal and external teams to ensure alignment, knowledge transfer, and sustainable handoffs.

Assess existing ServiceNow instances (e.g., CMDB/CSDM health, configuration debt, data model governance, upgrade readiness); recommend remediation and optimization strategies.

Participate in and/or lead governance boards, steering committees, and strategy forums; serve as the primary escalation point for technical strategy, business alignment, and change management decisions.

Develop proof-of-concept demonstrations, technical specifications, and detailed business cases quantifying platform value and organizational outcomes

Coach and mentor junior architects, functional leads, and delivery teams on ServiceNow best practices, design patterns, and implementation methodology


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in computer technology or equivalent combination of education and experience

Eight (8) or more years of experience in ServiceNow Platform Expertise (Primary Focus), preferably in ServiceNow solution architecture, implementation, and delivery.

Eight (8) or more years of hands-on experience designing and implementing ServiceNow solutions across multiple product lines (ITSM, CSM, HRSD, GRC, FSO, SAM, or equivalent)

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA)

Certified Master Architect (CMA)

Enterprise Architecture Certification


SKILLS

Strong experience with ServiceNow Financial Services Operations (FSO), Software Asset Management (SAM) modules, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), SPM, or AI.

Strong knowledge of core ServiceNow platform capabilities: application configuration, scripting (JavaScript, Glide), integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft), workflow design, and data modeling

Strong written communication; ability to develop compelling business cases, technical specifications, executive summaries, and board presentations

Ability to manage delivery teams (5-50 people across functional and technical disciplines); drive accountability for schedule, quality, and business outcomes

Ability to utilize ServiceNow capabilities: Now Intelligence, AI Search, Workflow Data Fabric, or Process Optimization

Skilled at leading 3+ complex, multi-year ServiceNow implementations from design through go-live and post-go-live optimization

Skilled at distilling complexity into clear narratives; ability to quantify platform value and organizational impact (operational efficiency, cost reduction, business process improvement)

Skilled with consulting or systems integrator background, advising clients on platform strategy

Experience with published thought leadership (blog posts, industry papers, conference presentations) on ServiceNow implementation or digital transformation

Knowledge of core commercial business functions and workflows that ServiceNow supports (finance, operations, IT service delivery, HR)

Knowledge of Bravium and the governance platform

Knowledge of multi-divisional or multi-geography operating models and how ServiceNow scales across complex organizational structures



#LI-DR2

#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Senior Auditor - Internal Audit (Remote)
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for evaluating and enhancing the efficacy of risk management practices, internal controls, and governance processes across the organization. This role will work closely with leadership to develop and implement a comprehensive risk-based audit plan.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Executes the enterprise-wide annual risk assessment process and assists in developing the annual audit plan incorporating management insights, emerging trends, and regulatory changes within the industry.


Leads the full audit lifecycle (planning, execution, reporting, and remediation status) for financial, compliance, and operational audits.


Prepares timely and comprehensive audit reports to communicate results and recommendations to management.


Develops recommendations to strengthen internal controls, improve business processes, and verify that proper internal control safeguards are in place.


Fosters collaboration among team members and business partners throughout the organization.


Participates in advisory reviews and special projects as needed.


Manages multiple demands to achieve optimal efficiency and productivity while ensuring business deadlines and requirements are met.


Performs Internal controls assessments of acquired companies and leads efforts to mitigate identified control deficiencies.


Participates in critical business and technology initiatives and projects, ensuring that audit’s perspective is effectively voiced and appropriate controls are designed and implemented.


Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state, and local laws, wherein the Company operates.


Performs other duties as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 


Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, in a relevant field, preferably Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration, required


Three (3) or more years of related experience in internal audit or external audit in the insurance industry, required


Understanding of the insurance industry, required


Certified Public Accountant (CPA), a plus


CIA - Certified Internal Auditor, a plus


Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), a plus



SKILLS


Must have a comprehensive understanding of the Global Internal Audit Standards, procedures, and methodology


Proven multitasking skills, ability to manage multiple audits and projects at the same time


Ability to work independently and effectively monitor own performance to ensure plans, schedules, and budgets are met


Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills are essential


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


Effective working knowledge of Excel, Microsoft Word and PowerPoint


Knowledge of audit data extraction and analysis (or interest to develop knowledge) is strongly preferred


Exhibits strong drive for results and success; conveys a sense of urgency to achieve outcomes and exceed expectations


Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills


Commitment to compliance and accountability

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Leads the end-to-end accounting and reporting function for producer commission activity. Oversees daily accounting operations, the preparation of financial information, and monthly close and reporting deadlines, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of Alliant's financial results. Working closely with Divisional Controllers, Producers, Sales leaders, and Legal, this role ensures contracts are interpreted and applied appropriately and commissions are calculated accurately. Ensures the team follows Alliant policies and procedures while adapting processes to support growth, and is responsible for staff supervision, performance reviews, development, and training.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Own the monthly (and any interim) producer commission calculation process from data intake through final payment file.

Prepare and distribute commission statements/calculations directly to producers, fielding and resolving questions.

Maintain and update commission calculation models, schedules, and tools to reflect current contract terms.

Review new, amended, and acquired producer contracts to ensure commission terms are accurately reflected in calculation logic and systems.

Work with Legal to resolve contract interpretation questions, disputes, and amendments affecting commissions.

Analyze commission expense trends and reasonableness, including production levels, rates, and payouts; investigate and resolve variances.

Develop and maintain review procedures and supporting documentation that meet audit and internal control requirements.

Reconcile commission accruals and payables each month.

Identify, develop, and implement process improvements and automation opportunities in commission workflows and accounting operations.

Oversee the maintenance and development of financial reporting and month-end close processes.

Support monthly financial statement close and maintain related schedules.

Prepare monthly commission reporting and analysis for the Divisional Controller and senior finance leaders, including variance commentary.

Lead commission integration activities related to acquisitions.

Review acquired producer contracts and payment schedules, along with legacy calculation methods while maintaining controls and payment continuity.

Support internal and external audit requests related to commission accounting.

Collaborate with internal partners to address accounting, reporting, and operational needs.

Manage the Accounting team’s daily activities and ensure deadlines are met.

Manage staff by motivating/mentoring staff, providing employee training and development, conducting performance reviews, and performing disciplinary action as appropriate.

Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE


Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance; or an equivalent combination of education and experience  


Seven (7) or more years of progressive accounting experience    

Insurance, financial services, or producer/broker-based industry experience 

Experience with commissions, incentive compensation, or sales compensation accounting    

Experience reviewing and interpreting contracts or commission agreements  

Experience working in a rapidly growing organization and improving processes to support scale and efficiency    



SKILLS


Solid understanding of GAAP

Proficient with Microsoft Office, especially Excel

Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem solving skills

Demonstrated team management and mentoring skills and the ability to keep staff focused, accountable, and on track

Excellent communication skills and able to communicate directly with leadership

Ability to manage competing monthly deadlines

Ability to explain calculations clearly to producers and outside brokers and collaborate with Legal and Controllership

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for providing a wide variety of support services, including the development of valuable leads for insurance and insurance related products, and to promote the company's product portfolio via the telephone and internet to support the organization to increase company revenue and profit.

Customer Service:  Place and receive outbound and inbound calls related to the development of insurance leads.  Promote the company’s product portfolio and provide service assistance to consumers; Respond to consumer inquiries through calls both inbound and outbound as well as internet inquiries.  Deliver prepared scripts to prospects and leads with the intent of delivering a qualified prospect or lead to a Licensed Agent.  Communicate with consumers regularly regarding rate changes, new product offerings, additional product information, and new policy issuance.   Monitor compliance with program reporting rules and service requirements.  Update and maintain proprietary Lead Advantage System in accordance with policies and procedures.  Document each and every consumer contact with detailed notes;

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Acts as a Consultant to assigned accounts, including servicing and/or business development.  Expert in all time-off benefit programs, with special emphasis in Absence and Disability program development, implementation and monitoring.  


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Develops, implements, and evaluates/adjusts absence management strategies, particularly in the areas of disability, occupational and non-occupational disability, FMLA, workers compensation, statutory and non-statutory leave management programs, return to work programs, and ADA;

Evaluates the performance of insured/self-funded disability programs for change options and best potential outcomes.  This includes evaluation of third party administrators and insurers by investigating and assessing program performance, conducting quality and control audits, reviewing claim data and claim handling practices;

Conducts detailed analysis of disability incidence and duration and develops specific initiatives to positively impact these metrics via the utilization of best practices;

Develops and implements strategies that integrate healthcare disability programs, and mitigates the impact of disabilities/absences on health benefits programs (insured or self-funded);

Manages all client required services and maintains client relationships; 

Participates in team selling process including finalist interviews and RFP responses; 

Understands, evaluates, coordinates, and optimizes external resources available from carriers, employer health departments, and other applicable vendors to effectively assist clients;

Promotes to clients other services offered by our firm including Individual Disability and Voluntary Benefit program strategies;

Provides analysis and recommendations concerning client's existing coverages;

Selects carriers for solicitation and negotiates with carriers for benefit and premium considerations;

Receives and responds to client inquiries including benefit and claim questions and issues;

Alliant is Hiring a Licensed Travel Insurance Agent out of our Travel Insurance Center office in Omaha, NE.

Travel Insurance Center® is a travel insurance aggregator for consumers to compare, shop for and buy travel insurance through its online Policy Picker® tool or with the help of licensed travel insurance agents over the phone. We are dedicated to helping travelers find the coverage they need to travel safe and protected, whether for a business trip or a dream vacation.

SUMMARY 

Responsible for providing a wide variety of support services to promote the company's product portfolio via the telephone and internet to support the Travel Insurance Center Department to increase company revenue and profit.          


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

•    Agent Support Functions:  Promote the company’s product portfolio and provide service assistance to consumers; Respond to consumer inquiries through inbound and outbound calls; email, and website Live Chat. Describe product features, benefits, and pricing; Respond to questions; Obtain customer information, process applications, assist with consumer online applications. Work with IT department to trouble shoot electronic application communication errors.

•    Department Support Functions:  Take the lead in maintenance of Web site copy owned by Travel Insurance Center. Manage day-to-day activities of our affiliate program. Monitor and expand company's presence on social media sites such as Facebook. Assist in maintenance of company marketing materials.

•    Special Projects:  Work collaboratively with fellow staff to advance the values and mission of Senior Market Sales by serving on relevant internal and external committees; Assists with special projects/assignments as requested by members of management.

•    Performs other duties as assigned by management.


QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 

High School Diploma or GED

Bachelor's Degree in marketing or a related field

Three (3) or more years general insurance industry or related field (financial services, marketing, web-based business, business-to-business customer service or call center) experience

Strong verbal and written proficiencies of the English language is required and bilingual (Spanish and English)


SKILLS

Working knowledge of insurance services industries and specific current knowledge of product lines assigned to the marketer.

Knowledge of the general industry procedures, practices and terminology.

Skill in working effectively with inbound and outbound callers/customers.

Skill in negotiating and problem solving to resolve internal and external conflicts.

Skill in the use of office equipment including computer, fax, printer, telephone system, etc.

Skill in the use of time management and organization skills.

Skill in maintaining effective working relationships with all customers, employees and the general public.

Skill in project management.

Proficient computer skills (Microsoft/Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, MS Outlook software preferred).

Ability to engage in effective interpersonal interaction, verbal communication and written communication.

Ability to work independently, exercise independent judgment, make and execute decisions.

Strong verbal and written proficiencies of the English language is required and bilingual (Spanish and English) preferred.

jobs.title: Account Manager - EB General Agency
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for serving as the primary operational liaison between company, independent insurance producers, employer groups, and carrier partners. Provides consultative support throughout the customer lifecycle including new business development, implementation, enrollment, ongoing service, renewals, and carrier administration. Acts as an extension of the General Agency and carrier service teams by delivering operational support, resolving service issues, coordinating implementations, educating producers, employers and employees, and supporting the growth and retention of General Agency business.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Builds and maintains trusted relationships with assigned brokers, agencies, carrier partners, and employer groups to promote retention, growth, and exceptional service.

Serves as the primary day-to-day General Agency contact for assigned producers and carrier partners.

Supports producer-led new business efforts including quoting, plan recommendations, proposal preparation, RFP responses, and quote-to-card coordination.

Reviews and scrubs new business submissions for completeness and accuracy prior to carrier submission.

Coordinates new group implementations, installation activities, enrollment timelines, and carrier onboarding requirements.

Conducts or participates in employer implementation meetings, employee education meetings, benefit presentations, and open enrollment meetings in partnership with producers and carrier representatives.

Facilitates renewal activities including proposal preparation, alternative plan options, plan design changes, and renewal strategy discussions.

Provides first-line operational support by researching and resolving eligibility, billing, claims, pharmacy, ID card, provider directory, plan change, member add/termination, reinstatement, ancillary product, and other service-related issues using carrier service platforms whenever possible.

Assists producers and employer groups with carrier portals, eServices, Employee Navigator, connectivity, and other enrollment or technology platforms.

Coordinates resolution of complex service issues and appropriately escalates matters that cannot be resolved through established carrier resources.

Maintains working knowledge of carrier products, underwriting guidelines, administrative procedures, technology platforms, and regulatory requirements affecting General Agency operations.

Supports producer education by delivering training on carrier products, processes, enrollment tools, and General Agency resources.

Collaborates with carrier sales and service teams to implement new products, initiatives, and strategic growth opportunities.

Maintains accurate documentation and utilizes agency management systems and other technology platforms to support operational excellence.

Exercises sound judgment in balancing producer advocacy with carrier requirements while ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Five (5) or more years related work experience  

Valid Insurance License

Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal


SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills

Ability to conduct producer, employer and employee meetings

Excellent customer service skills

Good analytical, problem solving and time management skills

Ability to be organized and to prioritize work for multiple projects and deadlines

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, agency management systems, carrier portals and enrollment technology



#LI-KK1

jobs.description_html:
*****NO RECRUITERS PLEASE*****

Assistant Controller (CPA Required) | Hybrid

Experienced Senior Accountants and Accounting Managers with an active CPA license are encouraged to apply. We are seeking professionals with expertise in budget preparation, leadership of month-end close processes, team management, and driving process improvement initiatives.

POSITION SUMMARY

Windward Risk Managers is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant Controller (CPA Required) to support the Controller in leading the organization's accounting and financial reporting functions. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for overseeing month-end close. financial reporting, budgeting, cost allocation, financial analysis, and accounting operations while providing guidance and mentorship to the accounting team.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in financial reporting, budgeting, and process improvement, along with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Hybrid Schedule: This position offers a hybrid schedule of four days in the office and one day remote following the initial training period. During training (up to six months), the position is fully onsite five days per week.
 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

General Ledger and Financial Reporting

  • Lead month-end closing and preparation of monthly internal financial statements and reporting packages.
  • Review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and reports.
  • Work closely with the Commissions team to develop, analyze, and reconcile reports and statements.
  • Support Accounts Payable and Claims Billing functions as needed.
  • Train and mentor junior staff.
  • Assist with annual audit preparations.
  • Assist with system reviews and process improvements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Budgeting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead the annual operating budget process in coordination with department heads.
  • Maintain department-level budgets and support models.
  • Prepare monthly budget-to-actual variance analyses.
  • Partner with department leaders to review variances and support corrective actions.
  • Ensure budgets align with organizational objectives and cost structures.

Cost Allocation & Expense Management

  • Develop, document, and maintain cost allocation methodologies across departments, entities, and cost centers.
  • Ensure cost allocations are applied consistently, accurately, and in accordance with internal policies.
  • Collaborate with Accounting to reconcile allocated costs to the general ledger and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assesses allocation methodologies periodically to ensure continued appropriateness and transparency.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune’s Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • Active CPA License (Required)
  • More than five years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in publicly traded and multi-entity environments
  • Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and cost allocation
  • Experience leading month-end close
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and meeting deadlines

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas and financial models
  • Solid understanding of general ledger accounting and expense structures
  • Ability to communicate financial concepts to non-financial audiences
  • Proven ability to collaborate across departments
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Work Authorization Requirement:

  • This role requires permanent U.S. work authorization and does not offer employer sponsorship now or in the future.
