jobs.title: Business Analyst I, II, III (Personal & Commercial Residential Insurance)
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with solid expertise in personal and/or commercial residential property insurance to support and enhance our Policy and/or Claims Administration systems. This role will partner with business stakeholders and technology teams to analyze workflows, define requirements, support system enhancements, and resolve production issues that impact critical insurance operations.

This position may be filled at the BA I, BA II, or BA III level, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to work independently, lead initiatives, and influence outcomes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, regulated environment with evolving priorities.

Essential Functions:

Business & Systems Analysis

  • Partner directly with Underwriting, Product, Operations, Compliance, Claims, and Technology teams to gather and document business requirements
  • Translate underwriting and/or claims guidelines, eligibility rules, rates, forms, endorsements, and workflows into functional system requirements
  • Support enhancements and configuration of online quote/bind applications and policy/claims administration systems
  • Create user stories, business process flows, requirement documentation, acceptance criteria, and traceability artifacts
  • Analyze impacts of product or regulatory changes to system functionality and business processes
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned to support business objectives.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Participate in or lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, and backlog refinement meetings.
  • Manage changing priorities and scope while ensuring requirements remain clear, documented, and approved.
  • Participate in testing validation, defect triage, and production implementation activities
  • Provide clear, timely communication and status updates to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Create and maintain documentation while ensuring Confluence is consistently updated and serves as the single source of truth for requirements including workflows, business rules, system behaviors, and configuration details.
  • Develop and execute test plans, track defects and coordinate fixes.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and compliance expectations.

Production Support & Issue Resolution

  • Troubleshoot system issues, identify root cause, and coordinate resolution with IT and development teams.
  • Support production incidents and escalated help desk tickets related to our systems.
  • Communicate issue status, risks, and resolution progress effectively to business partners.
  • Review escalated Service Desk tickets to identify opportunities for process improvement, knowledge base development, and training, facilitating the transition of repeatable support activities and issue resolution from higher support tiers to Level 1 Service Desk teams.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Professional experience in the Property & Casualty Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial insurance industry functioning in a Business Analyst capacity, including requirements elicitation, documentation, and collaboration with technical teams to implement changes to insurance or policy administration systems.
  • Proven experience analyzing business problems, troubleshooting issues, and applying logical, detail-oriented approaches to develop effective solutions with limited supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritizing work, managing scope, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical resources, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum or sprint-based delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst role within the Property & Casualty insurance industry.
  • Experience supporting Homeowners and/or Residential Commercial lines of business for Florida, Texas, and/or California risks, including familiarity with state-specific products, forms, rating, underwriting, or regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Duck Creek.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments such as Florida and/or Texas.
  • Insurance carrier or MGA background strongly preferred.
  • Business Analyst certification (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA) a plus.

Essential Skills:

  • Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate effectively with developers and system vendors.
  • Strong attention to detail especially when working with policy, forms, rating, claims, or billing system changes.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate business needs and translate them into clear, well-defined requirements.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for quality and timeliness of deliverables.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to research issues, recreate steps, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Ability to understand complex business processes, system workflows, and dependencies.
  • Proficiency with business analysis, documentation, and collaboration tools used to support project delivery.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Work Authorization Requirement:

  • This role requires permanent U.S. work authorization and does not offer employer sponsorship now or in the future.

​​​​WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

jobs.title: Claims Supervisor - Catastrophe
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our firm by driving industry leading best practices in front line claims adjusting. This role engages directly with partners in the oversight of Functional and Team Leads for maintaining best practices, response logistics, facilitation of ongoing training, quality assurance and operational management.

Essential Functions:

  • Claims Supervisor works closely with Claims leadership and supports the coordination of aspects of catastrophe responses such as CAT team mobilization, vendor staffing, process management, training, desk examiner adjusting, reserving, payment and approvals, claim reopens, reporting, metrics, and performance management.
  • Provides consistent high-quality training to partners, provides feedback for performance trends and metrics.
  • Participates in off-season training and logistical planning with external adjusting firms and vendors.
  • Supports catastrophe claims process design, testing and implementation.
  • Works within assigned limits of authority to manage and control the proper adjustment of catastrophe claims requiring a high degree of technical complexity and coordination.
  • Evaluates large and complex claims.
  • Addresses file escalations and complex claim situations.
  • Effectively manages loss costs and claim expenses.
  • Maintains and ensures partner firm’s compliance with the claim handling guidelines.
  • Participates in files reviews and supports the Quality Management program.
  • Conducts regular reviews of reserves, along with a routine reserve reconciliation as needed.
  • Travel may be a part of this role to support catastrophe response as well as to attend key internal and vendor meetings.
  • Extended hours and weekend support during catastrophe event may be required.
  • Support daily claims team when needed.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • HS Diploma or GED Required
  • 7 years of Daily/Catastrophe property claims experience, at least 5 of which are in Florida Property.
  • Knowledge of common residential building and construction methods and practices.
  • Must maintain a Florida licensed All-Lines adjuster (620/720) and yearly Continuing Education as required by licensing division of DFS. 
  • California adjusters license may be required in the future.

Competencies and Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree
  • Prior Insurance Carrier Experience
  • 3 years management experience
  • Deep expertise in Florida Homeowners Claims and Litigation
  • Commercial Claim experience a plus
  • Experience in strategy, process management and improvements and analytics related to P&C claims
  • Experience completing claim file reviews
  • Excellent analysis, communication, presentation, and project management skills
  • Works collaboratively to effectively implement claims handling and quality
  • Proven track record in supporting the development and implementation of claims strategies, best practices, handling processes, programs, and controls leading to increased productivity and quantifiable loss cost and expense savings
  • Ability to work in a team environment, and demonstrates a keen attention to detail  
  • Strong internal customer focus with ability to develop and manage relationships with claims personnel, and claims project team members
  • Strong interpersonal skills – team leadership, relationship building, communication
  • Strong performance management, financial awareness, and colleague development skills
  • Demonstrates personal qualities of sound planning, deep claims domain expertise, problem dissection and resolution, commitment to excellence, and decisiveness
  • Fluency in Microsoft Office applications-excel, ppt, MS word etc.
  • Fluency in Xactimate estimation program
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary: 

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment: 

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Switching and compute fabric: Cisco Catalyst campus switching and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) data-center switching; Cisco UCS X-Series (chassis, Fabric Interconnects, Intersight).
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals, including subnetting, routing, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Production experience with enterprise-class routers and switches, including Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), and Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnects.
  • Hands-on production experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, and VPN.
  • Working knowledge of at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF, EIGRP, or BGP).
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Azure networking (VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, NSGs, and routing).
  • Experience with NetApp (or comparable enterprise) storage and its supporting network connectivity.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools and alerting platforms.
  • Experience supporting network security applications.
  • Methodical troubleshooting skills using packet captures, logs, and device diagnostics.
  • Strong written documentation skills.
  • Works well in a collaborative team environment, with strong self-motivation to drive projects through to completion.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Palo Alto Networks Network Security Professional, the entry-level certification in the current role-based program. The legacy PCNSA also applies.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).
  • Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700) and / or Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
  • NetApp Certified Technology Associate (NCTA).
  • Experience with Cisco UCS X-Series and Intersight data-center compute fabric.
  • IPSec VPN design and troubleshooting experience.
  • Familiarity with server, virtualization, or storage environments.

Work Environment:

  • Reports to: Senior Network Engineer.
  • Scope: owns day-to-day network operations and project execution; partners with the Senior Network Engineer, who leads network architecture and standards.
  • Full-time position with participation in an on-call rotation.
  • Occasional travel between company sites may be required.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Manager to support the planning, execution, and delivery of projects in an Agile environment. This role is accountable for coordinating project activities, managing timelines and deliverables, tracking risks and dependencies, and communicating status to stakeholders. The Project Manager will lead Scrum-based delivery activities as part of the overall project execution, ensuring work is planned, monitored, and delivered in alignment with business objectives.

Essential Functions:

  • Project Planning & Execution:
    Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables. Track progress against plans and support on-time, on-scope delivery.
  • Individual Work & Progress Tracking:
    Actively track each team member’s planned and completed work, including commitments made during daily stand-ups and sprint planning. Retain and follow up on prior-day and sprint-level commitments to ensure transparency, accountability, and forward momentum.
  • Delivery Awareness & System Understanding:
    Develop a working understanding of the systems, applications, and business processes the team supports in order to effectively track progress, ask informed questions, and identify delivery risks or bottlenecks.
  • Scope, Schedule & Resource Coordination:
    Assist in defining project scope, managing changes, and coordinating resources across cross-functional teams to meet delivery commitments.
  • Agile & Scrum Delivery Oversight:
    Lead Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as part of the project execution framework. Ensure Agile practices are applied to support delivery predictability and transparency.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication:
    Serve as a primary point of contact for project communications. Provide regular status updates on progress, risks, issues, and dependencies to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Risk, Issue & Dependency Management:
    Identify, document, and track project risks, issues, and dependencies. Support mitigation plans and escalate concerns as needed to minimize delivery impacts.
  • Reporting & Documentation:
    Maintain project documentation, schedules, and status reports. Ensure project information is accurate, current, and accessible.
  • Delivery Governance & Controls:
    Support adherence to project management standards, processes, and governance requirements while ensuring alignment with Agile delivery practices.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    Capture lessons learned and contribute to process improvements to enhance project execution and delivery outcomes.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, or a related field.
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM)
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience managing projects within the homeowner’s insurance domain, including coordination of cross-functional teams and delivery of business or system initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in tools like JIRA, Trello, Miro, Smartsheet, or MS Project

Essential Skills:

  • Strong foundational understanding of project management principles (scope, schedule, cost, risk).
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery within a project-managed environment.
  • Clear and professional communication skills with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a structured, deadline-driven environment.
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: System Administrator
jobs.description_html:
Position Summary:

Windward Risk Managers is seeking a highly skilled System Administrator to serve as the primary administrator for backup, recovery, and cloud infrastructure across the company’s on-prem and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Veeam, vCenter, and Microsoft Azure, with a focus on continuously improving, optimizing, and validating data protection and high-availability architecture. This role leads disaster-recovery planning and testing in partnership with the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams to keep business-critical systems protected and recoverable.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Continuously improve and evolve the company’s disaster-recovery environment across our data centers and Azure; lead DR planning, runbooks, and failover testing, engaging the Systems, Network, Database, and Security teams; configure fault-tolerant features and maintain Recovery Time Objective and Recovery Point Objective documentation.
  • Design, implement, and optimize the Veeam Backup & Replication environment, including job architecture, repositories, replication, retention and immutability policies, and storage usage.
  • Administer the VMware vSphere / vCenter environment as it relates to data protection, including replication and recovery validation, along with the supporting SAN / NAS storage (NetApp, Tintri), deduplication appliances (ExaGrid), and immutable backup repositories.
  • Validate backup integrity through regular restore testing and automated verification; confirm all critical systems are covered, configurations follow best practices, and gaps are remediated.
  • Contribute to the company’s business continuity program, supporting business impact analysis, recovery strategies for critical business functions, and the ongoing maintenance and testing of business continuity plans as infrastructure and systems change.
  • Manage and expand the company’s Microsoft Azure footprint, building out cloud infrastructure to support business continuity, backup, and DR targets while maintaining storage, access control, and cost governance as adoption grows.
  • Monitor backup health, capacity, and SLA compliance; perform root cause analysis on failures and implement preventive measures.
  • Support compliance and audit requirements related to data protection, backup retention, and recoverability, including evidence gathering and remediation of audit findings.
  • Automate verification and reporting with PowerShell; maintain runbooks and documentation; serve as the escalation point for backup and recovery issues.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for data protection, storage management, and recovery operations.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companie
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 to 8 years of systems administration experience in a hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environment.
  • Hands-on production experience designing and managing Veeam Backup & Replication and VMware vSphere / vCenter environments.
  • Administrator-level experience with Microsoft Azure (resources, access control, storage, cost governance).
  • Solid understanding of backup and disaster-recovery concepts, including Recovery Point Objective and Recovery Time Objective, replication, snapshots, immutability, and DR testing.
  • Practical PowerShell scripting skills; working knowledge of Windows Server and enterprise storage (NetApp and / or Tintri preferred).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to prioritize effectively, and clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE)
  • VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
     

Due to current business and operational considerations, we currently hire employees residing in the following states at this time: AL, AR, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, MO, NC, NV, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future.

WRM is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We take affirmative action to ensure that all employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities.

Notice to Third Party Agencies: WRM does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting firms. Absent a signed Service Agreement by WRM’s Human Resources Department, WRM reserves the right to pursue and hire these candidates without financial obligation to recruiters or agencies.

The FPI Corporate Internship Program provides qualified students an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand business experience with a homeowners insurance carrier. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description_html:
Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Our vision of creating a future that’s safer and more secure drives everything we do.

Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success. 

At Marshall+Sterling, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

This role is based in our Poughkeepsie Office.

We’re looking for a people-focused Account Manager who can combine relationship-building with sharp benefits expertise to help create a future that’s safer and more secure for our clients. In this role, you’ll manage your own book of business, work closely with our producers and executives, and deliver the kind of client experience that inspires trust and long-term partnerships.

If you’re passionate about making complex benefits feel simple, supporting clients through every stage of their journey, and mentoring others to grow alongside you—you’ll thrive here.

  • Manage your own book of business—acting as the go-to contact, ensuring smooth operations, and delivering outstanding service.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Producers to design benefits strategies, prepare renewals, and grow client relationships.
  • Lead client meetings including open enrollments, benefit presentations, and planning sessions—both in person and online.
  • Build strong carrier relationships to secure the best solutions for each client.
  • Create and maintain client materials like benefits guides, presentations, and communication pieces using Microsoft Office and HRIS tools.
  • Stay ahead of industry changes by keeping up-to-date on regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
  • Mentor Assistant Account Managers, providing guidance to help them succeed.

Qualifications

 

  • A four-year college degree in business or related field
  • Proficiency in AI tools and Microsoft Office programs.
  • Must have own transportation or access to reliable transportation and maintain a valid driver's license throughout employment.
  • This position requires a NYS P+C brokers license.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $50,000 - $70,000, based on experience.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

Employee Stock Ownership Program

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here’s what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Collaborative & Engaged Culture: Employee ownership fosters a team-oriented environment where everyone has a stake in the company’s growth and success.
  • No Out-of-Pocket Costs: Unlike stock purchase plans, our ESOP is entirely company-funded, meaning you gain equity without any personal investment.

For more information on our culture and benefits, please visit us at : Careers - Marshall+Sterling

  • Lead and develop the region’s leadership team by recruiting, retaining, mentoring, and supporting high-performing Account Managers and Supervisors.
  • Oversee key client relationships and growth opportunities, taking a direct leadership role with the region or division’s largest accounts and supporting strategies that strengthen client retention.
  • Drive effective account management practices by ensuring consistent use of Service Timelines, Book Segmentation, and other tools that support proactive client service and retention.
  • Develop and execute regional business strategies that support growth, profitability, staffing needs, and long-term retention goals.
  • Monitor team performance and operational effectiveness, using key metrics and feedback to identify opportunities, improve processes, and ensure the region is delivering a high level of service.

  • Build a strong employee-owner culture and promote Marshall+Sterling, fostering collaboration across teams while representing the organization positively with employees, clients, and the community.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred; high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and required continuing education. Active P+C insurance license preferred
  • Five years of related insurance or business experience, including one to three years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance products and brokerage/consulting practices.
  • Strong business, leadership, and strategic decision-making skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and email; Vertafore experience a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $100,000 - $150,000, based on experience, education, and work location.

We’re seeking a skilled IT Systems Engineer to join our IT help desk. This role is the first point of contact for technical issues and plays a vital role in supporting our employees and technology infrastructure, including Microsoft O365, Intune, Azure Virtual Desktops, Salesforce, Vertafore, and other business-critical platforms.  This position is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values problem-solving, and is motivated by making an impact.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues to minimize disruption to business operations.
  • Daily checks of off-site spam, attachment, and content filters.
  • Troubleshoot access and performance issues with the cloud desktop environment.
  • Manage help desk tickets to ensure timely follow-up and resolution.
  • Participate in an after-hours on-call rotation to respond to urgent employee support issues.
  • Support technology rollouts, upgrades, and testing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field — or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in IT support, systems engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a focus on customer service.
  • Flexibility to work overnight, and weekends as required.
  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.
  • Travel to Marshall+Sterling offices as needed to provide on-site support for technology upgrades and rollouts.

Preferred:

  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft 365 Fundamentals.
  • Experience with Vertafore (AMS360, ImageRight) or Salesforce.

  • Lead and develop the region’s leadership team by recruiting, retaining, mentoring, and supporting high-performing Account Managers and Supervisors.

Qualifications

  • College degree preferred; high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Appropriate state insurance licenses and required continuing education. Active P+C insurance license preferred
  • Five years of related insurance or business experience, including one to three years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance products and brokerage/consulting practices.
  • Strong business, leadership, and strategic decision-making skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and email; Vertafore experience a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $100,000 - $150,000, based on experience, education, and work location.

  • Underwrite individual risk situations to ensure that they meet our agency standards and those of the insurance companies we represent
  • Make individual policy placement decisions based on the needs of the customer, our Agency and the Companies we represent
  • Manage all account transactions including but not limited to endorsements, binders, cancellations & correspondence.

  • Timely follow up on company/clients suspense/diaries
  • Keep abreast of change in the insurance industry
  • Maintain professional accreditation
  • Build favorable work relationships
  • Maintain confidentiality

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Personal Lines Experience
  • Active Florida 4-40 License required (2-20 preferred)
  • High level of organizational ability with attention to detail
  • Ability to be part of a team
  • Experience w/rating, underwriting and procedural skills
  • Experience with AMS360 / Image Right

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Compensation: $47,500 - $80,000 based on experience, education, and work location.

Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Our vision of creating a future that’s safer and more secure drives everything we do.

Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success.

At Marshall+Sterling, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

We’re looking for a people-focused Account Manager who can combine relationship-building with strong commercial insurance expertise to help create a future that’s safer and more secure for our clients. In this role, you’ll manage your own book of business, collaborate with our producers and executives, and deliver the kind of client experience that builds trust and long-term partnerships.

This position can be based out of either Marshall+Sterling’s Middletown office.

If you’re passionate about helping businesses protect what matters, guiding clients through every stage of their risk management journey, and mentoring others to grow alongside you—you’ll thrive here.

  • Manage your own book of business- serving as the main point of contact to ensure smooth account management and exceptional client service.
  • Partner with Sales Executives and Producers to design risk management strategies, prepare renewals, and strengthen client relationships.
  • Lead client meetings including policy reviews, renewal discussions, and coverage planning—both in person and online.
  • Build strong carrier relationships to secure competitive coverage options and resolve client service needs.
  • Review and prepare applications, policies, endorsements, audits, and proposals for accuracy using Microsoft Office and agency systems.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends, regulations, carrier guidelines, and coverage changes to provide clients with informed recommendations.
  • Mentor Assistant Account Managers, offering guidance and support to help them succeed.

Qualifications

  • This position requires a P+C brokers license.
  • A four-year college degree in business or related field
  • Experience with basic office automation software, such as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Must have own transportation or access to reliable transportation and maintain a valid driver's license throughout employment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

The salary range for this position is $80,000 to $100,000, depending on experience and based on commission.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more! 

Employee Stock Ownership Program

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here’s what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company’s success.

jobs.title: Sales Executive- Employee Benefits
jobs.description_html:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Group Benefits Sales Executive with exceptional communication skills and in-depth knowledge in the commercial insurance industry. This role is ideal for a highly motivated professional who excels at building relationships, identifying opportunities, and closing deals. You will be responsible for driving new business growth, expanding existing commercial lines accounts, and maintaining a strong book of business. 

This position can be based out of any of Marshall+Sterling's Group Benefits offices.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive new business growth while maintaining and expanding your book of business.
  • Proactively build and manage a pipeline of prospects to achieve sales and retention goals.
  • Craft a compelling value proposition, leveraging your expertise and the powerful tools provided by Marshall+Sterling.
  • Gather and analyze detailed risk and underwriting information to tailor insurance solutions.
  • Create and present professional, customized insurance proposals using Marshall+Sterling’s advanced online system.
  • Follow structured renewal workflows to ensure strong client retention and long-term partnerships.
  • Identify opportunities to refer clients and prospects to other divisions within Marshall+Sterling to meet their broader needs.
  • Partner with internal teams, delegating client service tasks effectively for seamless support.
  • Foster strong, professional relationships with colleagues, contributing to a positive and collaborative work environment.

Qualifications

  • Active state insurance license is required, with a commitment to maintaining compliance through ongoing continuing education.
  • Demonstrated success in pursuing and closing sales, with a strong track record of meeting and exceeding goals.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to connect with diverse individuals and teams.
  • Valid driver’s license
  • College degree preferred, high school diploma or equivalent required.

Compensation 

  • Compensation: $100,000 - $175,000, based on demonstrated insurance sales experience and measurable achievements.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, medical paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more!

Why Join Marshall+Sterling? Our ESOP Sets Us Apart!

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here’s what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Ownership & Wealth-Building: Every eligible employee earns shares in the company at no cost, creating a meaningful path to financial security.
  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company’s success.
  • Retirement Security: Our ESOP is a powerful supplement to your retirement savings, helping you plan for the future with confidence.
  • Collaborative & Engaged Culture: Employee ownership fosters a team-oriented environment where everyone has a stake in the company’s growth and success.
  • No Out-of-Pocket Costs: Unlike stock purchase plans, our ESOP is entirely company-funded, meaning you gain equity without any personal investment.
  • Stability & Legacy: With over 150 years of success, our ESOP ensures that Marshall+Sterling remains strong, independent, and employee-driven for generations to come.

Join us and experience the benefits of true employee ownership!

jobs.title: Contract Administrator
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Tyndall Air Force Base, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Tyndall Air Force Base, FL  area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Contract Administrators support a busy leadership team with administration, documentation, scheduling, financial expense support, meeting coordination, minute-taking, and special projects. The Contract Administrator’s attention to detail and great skills in communication keep our busy team operating successfully.


As a Contract Administrator, you will:  

  • Work with legal team to manage contracts: route contracts for signatures, run reports to track contracts’ status, maintain non-disclosure agreements, improve associated processes when opportunities arise
  • Manage Certificate of Insurance requests
  • Schedule and organize activities such as meetings, travel, conferences, and department events for the members of the leadership team
  • Create visual presentations for the leadership team
  • Organize and prioritize large volumes of information and communication
  • Field and answer all business-related questions, seeking assistance from subject matter experts from within and outside of our branch as necessary
  • Order stationery, office materials, and office hardware
  • Organize and maintain shared drives to assure efficiency and coordination of data
  • Prepare and design charts, tables, graphs, business plans, etc. Proofread copy for spelling, grammar, and layout, making appropriate changes so that that the final copy is accurate and clear
  • Support the leadership team with the proficient use of software, including MS Office, SRM (indirect purchase orders), EZ-X (Expenses), aspects of SAP (ERP system), recruitment software, SharePoint etc.
  • Demonstrate excellent project- and time-management/organizational skills to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail
  • Work flexible hours as needed to accomplish tasks
  • Work well in a highly matrixed organization, and with managers and employees of all levels to advise on, gather, prepare and vet material in a poised and tactful manner


You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • High School degree or state-recognized GED
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Experience using the MS Office suite
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience providing team support as either an administrative assistant or team assistant
  • Aptitude to quickly master additional software programs related to administrative support

#LI-TAG #Southeast-EREF #VeteranCareers #TransitioningServiceMember #MilitarySpouse

 

Ready to create your own journey? Join us today!


About Siemens

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.  


Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.


You’ll Benefit From

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

The pay range for this position is $40,375 - $69,214 annually. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: OEM/Machine Builder - Account Manager
jobs.description_html:
OEM/Machine Builder - Account Manager

The OEM Sales Professional is responsible for development, exploitation and maximization of account penetration and profitable growth of assigned OEMs / Machine Builders for the Digital Industries portfolio of products and solutions. He/she represents Digital Industries in all sales/strategic activities and acts as an interface between the OEM and Siemens. This includes the objective to Enter, Expand, and Defend accounts and will be responsible for the achievement of the account business targets (KPIs) in the respective customer base to include specification, account development, competitive conversions, and revenue generation leading to market share growth. The role is intended to be self-sufficient in terms of product, technology, and solution knowledge at an executive level and first level engineering discussion/conversations.

We are looking for an OEM/Machine Builder Account Manager. This role is remote and candidates must reside in central Florida.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Leading strategic OEM conversions to drive market growth and expand our customer base.
  • Developing and implementing cutting-edge automation and digitalization solutions that create measurable competitive advantages for our customers.
  • Elevating Siemens' brand presence and market position in the US through strategic initiatives and relationship building.
  • Creating and maintaining transparent pipeline reporting systems that provide real-time visibility to global Digital Industries leadership.
  • Spearheading the adoption of innovative technologies and solutions within the greater northeast markets, setting new industry standards
  • Utilizes Digital Thread, Challenger approach and Industrial Metaverse in selling process at most customers including in Customer Business Plans, Opportunity Plans and Successful Meeting Plans. 

You will win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or equivalent GED
  • 2+ years of Technical Sales in one or more of the relevant product/solution sets: Factory Automation, Motion Control, Services, Networking and Power, Digitalization Software.
  • Prior experience or working knowledge of multi-channel go-to-market strategies, including both Distribution channels and Direct selling.
  • Experience engaging and selling to C-level customers.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company required sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the OEM Machinery market
  • A Bachelors Degree with a preferred major in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or Computer Science.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Global Deal Enablement Architect
jobs.description_html:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Position Overview:

Siemens is a global technology powerhouse focusing on the areas of intelligent infrastructure, automation, and digitalization. Within Global Sales Excellence (GSE) HQ, our mission is to empower our sales and commercial teams with world-class operational frameworks, deal enablement structures, and streamlined processes. We champion operational excellence, ensuring that complex commercial strategies translate into clear, scalable, and frictionless execution for our teams and customers.

We are currently seeking a Deal Enablement Architect for the commercial and operational frameworks that enable products, business models and cross-business opportunities to be sold consistently, efficiently and at scale. The GSE HQ Deal Enablement Architect owns the design and evolution of the business-facing elements of the Global Deal Enablement Operating Model.

The role connects Product, Strategy, Pricing, Finance, Sales and operational stakeholders to translate commercial strategy into clear and practical guidance for the field. Its purpose is to ensure that Deal Guidelines, new products, new business models and cross-business propositions are designed for execution, with clear parameters, watch-outs and escalation pathways. The role challenges complexity at source and ensures lessons from execution are continuously fed back into better guidance and commercial design.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Deal Guidelines Architecture

  • Own providing Finance Enablement and Governance perspectives into the global architecture and lifecycle of Deal Guidelines.
  • Define the framework, structure and governance for global Deal Guidelines.
  • Translate commercial, financial, contractual and operational requirements into simple, actionable seller guidance.
  • Drive continuous simplification and rationalization of guidelines.
  • Define mechanisms to measure adoption, effectiveness and usability.
  • Analyze recurring questions, exceptions and escalations to identify remediation opportunities.
  • Convert repeatable expert judgement into clear rules and guidance.
  • Ensure changes in strategy, products or business models are reflected in Deal Guidelines.
  • Drive the principle that standard business should not require expert interpretation

2. Product Introduction Alignment

  • Establish Deal Enablement readiness as an integral component of product introduction.
  • Work across Product Segments, Strategy, Pricing, Finance and Operations to define:
  • How the product should be sold
  • Standard commercial parameters
  • Pricing and packaging considerations
  • Contracting and quoting implications
  • Permitted and non-standard scenarios
  • Known watch-outs
  • Required guidance
  • Exception and escalation routes
  • Challenge upstream product or commercial design where unnecessary complexity will create downstream seller friction or manual intervention.

3. New Business Model Readiness

  • Own Deal Enablement readiness for new and evolving commercial models.
  • Assess the impact of new business models on deal execution.
  • Identify gaps across commercial policy, pricing, processes, contracting, finance and operations.
  • Develop practical guidelines for new commercial structures.
  • Define boundaries between standard, guided and exception business.
  • Support initial transactions and capture lessons from early adoption.
  • Convert early-stage learning into repeatable guidance.
  • Avoid temporary workarounds becoming permanent complexity.

4. Cross-Business Collaboration

  • Develop scalable Deal Enablement concepts for opportunities spanning multiple businesses, portfolios or organizational structures, for example OneTech / OpsSW-type collaboration.
  • Define clear execution principles for cross-business opportunities.
  • Clarify commercial interfaces, responsibilities and decision points.
  • Identify conflicting policies or operating assumptions.
  • Develop reusable cross-business frameworks rather than deal-specific workarounds.
  • Simplify how sellers navigate organizational boundaries.
  • Partner with relevant business organizations to identify common models that can be standardized.
  • Organizational complexity should not become seller or customer complexity.

Key Deliverables:

Global Deal Guideline framework

  • Deal Guideline lifecycle and governance
  • Guideline adoption and effectiveness framework
  • Guideline simplification/remediation backlog
  • Product Introduction Deal Readiness framework
  • New Business Model readiness framework
  • Cross-business Deal Enablement frameworks
  • Commercial parameter / watch-out frameworks
  • Standard vs exception decision principles

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations, Engineering, or a related field (MBA or advanced degree preferred).
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in commercial operations, deal desk leadership, sales operations, pricing strategy, commercial/contract management, or product go-to-market within a complex B2B enterprise software or technology environment.
  • Proven track record of designing, scaling, and governing global deal guidelines, quoting frameworks, and commercial operating models.
  • Exceptional ability to bridge product, strategy, pricing, finance, legal, and sales stakeholders to translate complex corporate requirements into simple, actionable field guidance.
  • Direct experience driving operational readiness for complex technology offerings, including SaaS, subscriptions, usage-based models, and multi-product/cross-business bundled solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS 15 software revenue accounting and revenue recognition requirements for software, SaaS, and related service offerings.
  • Demonstrated methodology for identifying and eliminating upstream operational complexity, reducing manual exceptions, and ensuring standard business requires no expert interpretation.
  • Experience defining frameworks to measure guideline adoption, analyzing recurring escalation patterns, and using feedback loops to continuously improve commercial design.
  • Highly structured thinker capable of breaking down ambiguous commercial challenges into clear parameters, watch-outs, and escalation pathways.
  • Outstanding ability to influence senior cross-functional leaders and drive consensus across diverse organizational silos.
  • Experience navigating matrixed, multinational enterprise structures and coordinating cross-business initiatives across international boundaries.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms and digital technologies, including Salesforce, SAP, and AI-powered bots/agents, with the ability to leverage these tools to improve business processes, data insights, and operational efficiency.


Why us? 
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. 

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! 


Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

#LI-REMOTE
#LI-PLM

You’ll Benefit From
Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html
The pay range for this position is $171,200 - $308,200 annually with a target incentive of 15-25% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

jobs.title: Branch Administrative / Team Assistant
jobs.description_html:
This onsite role supports our Richmond branch, serving customers throughout the greater Richmond area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!

Our Branch Administrative / Team Assistant, you will provide consistent, high-quality administrative and onsite operational support to branch leadership, employees, customers, and visitors. You will help ensure seamless office operations, effective communication, a positive employee experience, and strong customer relationships across the Southeast Region. This position requires professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, collaboration, meticulous organization, and a responsive customer-service mindset.

WORK ARRANGEMENT SCHEDULE OPTIONS REPORTING / SUPPORT

Onsite

Supports branch leadership, employees, customers, and regional initiatives

As a Branch Administrative / Team Assistant, you will:

Administrative & Leadership Support

  • Create, proofread, and edit reports, presentations, correspondence, proposals, and other business documents for clarity, accuracy, and professional presentation.
  • Organize and support branch leadership activities, meetings, presentations, training sessions, Town Halls, and events, including materials, catering, room setup, and follow-up.
  • Manage calendars, appointments, meeting logistics, incoming calls, correspondence, and confidential materials; screen and route inquiries appropriately.
  • Maintain organized records and documentation in accordance with company policies and exercise discretion when handling information requests.

Employee Support & Experience

  • Coordinate new-hire onboarding and first-day readiness, including technology, workspace, access, equipment, and local orientation needs.
  • Coordinate cell phones, upgrades, computer equipment, IT service requests, and employee support intake.
  • Support fleet vehicle processes, including coordination, accident reporting, and other fleet-related incidents.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employee questions and guidance, and coordinate offboarding activities.

Front-Line, Mail & Shipping Support

  • Provide professional front-door, guest, delivery, and direct phone-system support; help callers identify the appropriate contact and route inquiries efficiently.
  • Pick up, sort, and distribute onsite mail and correspondence.
  • Coordinate UPS, FedEx, courier, and package services, ensuring timely handling of sensitive and priority materials.

Office Operations, Facilities & Vendors

  • Monitor office and departmental supplies, initiate purchase orders as needed, and help optimize branch operating costs.
  • Support vendor relationships and service contracts, including coffee, pest control, janitorial, shredding, first-aid supplies, and parking permits.
  • Coordinate renewals, service requests, issue resolution, business licenses, and tax receipts.
  • Lead or support office renewals, remodels, facilities projects, adjacent spaces, and warehouse-related needs.

Engagement, Safety & Customer Advocacy

  • Coordinate annual employee appreciation activities and support quarterly community and charitable events such as Toys for Tots and food or clothing drives.
  • Support safety activities, including PPE ordering, Grainger vending-machine inventory, Safety Coordinator needs, and Safety Day activities.
  • Support Branch Customer Advocate and NPS-related activities by documenting customer-experience insights, sharing feedback, and contributing to continuous improvement.

Technology, Collaboration & Special Initiatives

  • Learn and adapt to Siemens systems, Microsoft 365 tools, digital displays, and other business applications.
  • Provide initial technology troubleshooting using approved manuals and training resources before opening a MyIT ticket.
  • Collaborate across offices and functions to support standardization, regional initiatives, and evolving local business needs.
  • Exercise independent judgment, manage competing priorities, and follow through on commitments in a fast-paced environment.

You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED.
  • At least 3 years of administrative support experience.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams, with the ability to learn Copilot and Siemens business systems.
  • Ability to work onsite in the assigned branch during an approved schedule.
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience supporting branch leadership, a sales team, or a multi-office operation.
  • Experience coordinating onboarding, facilities, fleet, vendors, events, or customer-experience activities.

Ready to create your own journey? Join us today!

About Siemens

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. jobs.title: Building Automation Solutions Account Executive (Mid / Senior)
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Pensacola, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the Gulf Coast and greater Pensacola, FL area.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Solutions Account Executive is committed to supporting our new construction business within our commercial Smart Buildings Automation Controls Solutions team. Our Solutions Sales team will achieve booking and profit goals by developing and implementing plans to grow, develop, and manage contractor, consultant, developer, and end-user relationships; capitalize on sales opportunities within the territory; and effectively execute sophisticated deals independently within our established guidelines. Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services, and your expertise and regular interaction with the customers will help them optimize and facilitate a safe, emergency-ready workplace.


As a Solutions Account Executive, you will:

  • Achieve new order/booking and profit goals based on your assigned quota.
  • Develop and maintain a qualified funnel of opportunities including forecasting expected order intake. Deliver on forecasted results consistently.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the marketplace, competitor offerings, customers, and decision influencers across the region, segments, and verticals within the region. Keep current on automation market business and product trends.
  • Develop a vertical market and account management plan that focuses on strategic growth. Identify new business opportunities to grow in new markets or adjacent segments and develop “go to market” strategies to drive business to the end user customer and the standard construction channel.
  • Act as a consultant to multiple levels of the customer’s organization by understanding their challenges and recommending services to ensure their building systems perform as required to achieve business goals.
  • Attend industry-specific networking events; actively participate in professional organizations such as ASHRAE, AEE or USGBC to build a network of contacts and to represent Siemens in the market.
  • Consult with the customer and determine budgeting and investment requirements.
  • Position Siemens as an industry leader among service providers, leveraging Siemens world-class digital service delivery as a key differentiator.
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams to deliver excellent customer outcomes.
  • Work with your internal sales support to enable you to spend more time with your customers.
  • Collaborate with sales estimators to prepare cost estimates and customer bid packages.
  • Partner with other sales business teams to plan, target, and acquire new projects and accounts.
  • Set pricing based on identified value of the services offered to the customer.
  • Work with operations, finance, legal and other inside and outside resources to obtain the sale.
  • Actively participate in sales department meetings, workshops, and seminars to stay knowledgeable on current market, business, and product trends.
  • Expected to spend minimum 50% of time in customer facing activities, performed in person and on customer site. 
  • Work with existing customers supporting their needs and act as a hunter to bring new customers to the business. 
  • Travel overnight ~10% for training and business development as required based on your assigned territory. 


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • High School Diploma or state-recognized GED
  • 8+ years of Sales Experience in building automation or a related field (Senior Level) | 4+ years of Sales Experience in building automation or a related field (Mid-Level)
  • Must be able to demonstrate:
  • Financial expertise to estimate and sell technical solutions and service offerings effectively and independently 
  • Account development and strategic sales skills 
  • Organizational, presentation, and negotiation skills 
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite 
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or Engineering
  • Salesforce CRM

jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role supports our Miramar, FL branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Miami, FL and Fort Lauderdale, FL area. This is a hybrid position but can be remote for the right candidate.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

 

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.  

Transform the everyday with us!


Our Service Coordinator / Dispatchers coordinate the delivery of onsite and remote service activities for our customers from the initial demand creation through delivery and close-out. As a Service Coordinator, you ensure customer expectations and commitments are met for all services by scheduling and dispatching resources.


As a Service Coordinator / Dispatcher, you will:  

  • Support, inform, prioritize, and coordinate activities and resources across branch offices and the Digital Service Center
  • Act as primary point of contact for service customers to ensure expectations are met
  • Handle incoming service requests via phone or email, resulting in a service work order and scheduled or dispatched personnel
  • Schedule resources to support standard service agreements
  • Handle decisions regarding the scheduling and movement of resources and material based on the nature of service calls, urgency, contractual obligation, and availability
  • Order and track parts and subcontractors in support of maintenance plans and service calls using the service platform
  • Evaluate time-and-material (T&M) service orders for completed costs and scope of work; process invoices in accordance with standard billing practices
  • Proactively follow up with customers after completion of service to ensure a high level of satisfaction with the quality of work
 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications:  

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED 
  • Must have the ability to demonstrate:
    • Organizational and interpersonal skills
    • The ability to read and understand customer service contracts
    • Experience with Microsoft Office and business software systems (e.g., SAP)
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Associate degree 
  • Experience dispatching/scheduling field personnel/technicians
  • Familiarity or experience with Fire Alarms/Sprinklers, Security Systems, HVAC, or a similar industry is a plus

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer - Electrical Services
jobs.description_html:
Position Location: This role is remote.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first.
