jobs.title: Bed Management & Staffing Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Bed Management and Staffing Specialist

This is NOT a recruiter position

Schedule: 24 hours a week, 3 8-hour days

Weekends Rotate

Pay Rate: $16.80

Job Purpose: As a Bed Management / Staffing Specialist at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose is to provide bed availability based on the staff coordination per the guidelines/acuity and safety.

Job Functions

  • Coordinate unit staff to ensure unit coverage on a 24/7 basis for all acute care programs.
  • Maintain an accurate daily staffing schedule for all inpatient units.
  • Monitor time and attendance regularly, and refers to the appropriate Nurse Manager.
  • Maintain a master schedule for each acute care unit through on-Shift, assisting with filling daily staffing needs due to call outs, census fluctuations and other variables.
  • Monitoring employees in number and availability for each position to assure that designated casual staff is able to meet staffing needs without overtime.
  • Maintain an accurate contact information for all staff.
  • Collaborates in a professional manner with each department to ensure patients are placed in the correct bed the first time, based on their funding source/ gender and legal status.
  • Manages census for all inpatient acute care, substance abuse units and residentials.
  • Completes routine census reports and sends to necessary AHP management as indicated.
  • Assist Centralized Navigation Manager in collecting and reviewing data analysis.
  • Most importantly, all functions must be completed while maintaining high standards of ethical and professional conduct while adhering to agency policies and procedures.

Position qualifications: Ability to receive and maintain a(n)

  • Level II Background clearance
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire insurance company as described in the AHP Corporate Transportation Policy 3.9.1
  • High School Diploma
  • College degree preferred
  • Must be competent in using Microsoft Office suite
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Integrated Medical Services Charge Nurse
jobs.description_html:
Integrated Medical Services Charge Nurse

Pay: $31.00 - $34.00 per hour

As an Integrated Medical Services Charge Nurse at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide a multitude of essential functions to assess, implement and evaluate the nursing care of psychiatric and substance abuse clients in the Inpatient Program. The Charge RN will be responsible for managing all aspects of nursing responsibilities during each shift, from processing patients in and out to delegating nursing rounds and drug administration. Charge RN will also focus on providing the best care possible while ensuring patient satisfaction in every interaction.

Job Functions:

  • Coordinates patient admissions/discharges. Transfer arrangements. Coordinating continuing services and maintaining a therapeutic milieu.
  • Participates in direct patient care and works as an interdisciplinary team in order to promote the highest standard care.
  • Participates fully in-patient rounds and triages patient conditions as necessary and maintains patient condition amongst nursing and support staff.
  • Complete and exchange of information between the oncoming and off-going staff by communicating patient care needs and concerns.
  • Direct support staff as appropriate in the provision of care of the patient providing supervision as necessary.
  • Assign and coordinates patient care and related duties, including following unit schedule.
  • Maintain patient records accurately and promptly in accordance with documentation Policy and Procedures.
  • Facilitates the orientation to the program for new nursing staff and students. Acts as preceptor/mentor/trainer in order to support and development of new nursing staff and students. Coordinate and co-operate with colleagues of the unit and other related programs for smooth transition operations.
  • Assist in developing protocol, identifying and reporting accidents and incidents in accordance to Policy and Procedures.
  • Ensures Treatment Plan are complete and coordinated insurance documentation for concurrent reviews and continued authorization.
  • Conducts/assist with Peer Reviews and quality improvement plans (QIP’s)
  • Delegate the shift’s tasks to all of the nurses on the unit and coordinate with physicians who might need assistance
  • Supervise and guide other nurses in their work
  • Supervise Behavioral Heath Tech as they complete their assigned tasks and point out any changes or improvements that need to be made
  • Encouraging a culture that promotes staff productivity
  • Detect any issues that could result in injuries or other difficulties for patients or staff members
  • Inform physicians of any changes in patients’ progress, condition or medicinal needs
  • Ensuring that the unit runs efficiently and as per standards and regulations
  • Demonstrating leadership while performing nursing care to potentially agitated or combative clients, identifying and assessing client psychosocial, cultural, ethnic and religious needs, administering client medications and providing knowledge of medications and side effects, documenting client treatment details, assisting physicians with transcriptions and implementation of orders and maintaining compliance by completing necessary training.
  • Most importantly, all functions must be completed while maintaining high standards of ethical and professional conduct while adhering to agency policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Integrate Medical Services Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)
jobs.description_html:
Integrate Medical Services Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)

Aspire Health Partners is a leading Integrated behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care organization committed to providing comprehensive healthcare services to individuals and families. We strive to deliver high-quality, compassionate, comprehensive, and cost-effective care within an integrated, patient-centered, and supportive environment.

As a Integrated Medical Services APRN, you will play a vital role in our integrated care continuum, providing exceptional medical services to patients with a focus on behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care. This is an exciting opportunity to work with our multidisciplinary team to deliver exceptional care and ensure our patients receive comprehensive treatment for their mental health, addiction, and primary care needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric and medical assessments, including health histories, physical examinations, mental status evaluations, and risk assessments.
  • Evaluate and diagnose mental health, substance use, and medical conditions, including acute and chronic illnesses, withdrawal, intoxication, and psychiatric crises.
  • Develop and implement individualized, recovery-oriented treatment plans in collaboration with clients and interdisciplinary care teams.
  • Prescribe, monitor, adjust, and discontinue medications in accordance with clinical guidelines, organizational policies, and applicable state regulations.
  • Order, interpret, and review laboratory tests, diagnostic studies, and other clinical assessments to support treatment decisions.
  • Monitor treatment effectiveness, medication adherence, side effects, safety concerns, and barriers to care.
  • Provide education regarding diagnoses, medications, treatment options, wellness strategies, and recovery goals.
  • Coordinate care with physicians, psychiatrists, therapists, nurses, pharmacists, case managers, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Identify patients requiring specialty referrals, emergency intervention, hospitalization, or higher levels of care.
  • Participate in treatment team meetings, discharge planning, case reviews, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation in accordance with organizational, professional, and regulatory standards.

Qualifications

  • Current Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) license in the State of Florida.
  • Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or other applicable APRN specialty.
  • DEA registration and prescriptive authority as required.
  • Experience in behavioral health, psychiatry, primary care, substance use treatment, crisis stabilization, or integrated healthcare settings preferred.
  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, treatment planning, communication, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills.

Qualifications:

  • Valid APRN license in Florida.
  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit https://info.flclearinghouse.c.om to learn more.
  • Master's degree in Nursing or Post MS Certificate from an accredited University/College.
  • Board Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or Adult Gerontological Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPC).
  • 2 years of experience as a Nurse Practitioner (preferred). Willing to work with motivated new graduates.
  • Excellent clinical assessment, diagnostic, and treatment skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a patient-centered approach.
  • Proficient in using electronic medical record (EMR) systems and other relevant healthcare software.

Benefits: We offer a competitive salary package and are an approved employer for Federal loan forgiveness programs. In addition, we provide a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and more. We value work-life balance and prioritize the well-being of our employees.

If you are a passionate and dedicated Nurse Practitioner who thrives in an integrated care environment and is committed to making a positive impact in the lives of others, we encourage you to apply.

Aspire Health Partners is a drug-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are treated without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or veteran status. For more information, see Aspire’s Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

jobs.title: Quality Data Analyst (On-Site Only – Orlando, FL)
jobs.description_html:
Quality Data Analyst (On-Site Only – Orlando, FL)

Pay Rate: $22.00 per hour
Location: Orlando, FL 32804
Work Arrangement: 100% On-Site

Important Information for Applicants

->This position is NOT remote.
->Hybrid work is not available.
->Relocation assistance is not offered.

Applicants should be local to the Orlando area or able to reliably commute to our Orlando office. Candidates requiring relocation support or a remote work arrangement will not be considered.

Join Aspire Health Partners as a Quality Data Analyst

Are you passionate about using data to improve healthcare outcomes? Aspire Health Partners is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Data Analyst to support our mission of delivering high-quality behavioral health services. This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys uncovering insights, improving processes, ensuring compliance, and leveraging technology to drive organizational excellence.

As a Quality Data Analyst, you will work closely with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams to evaluate performance, support quality initiatives, and ensure data integrity across the organization.

What You'll Do

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze healthcare and quality performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
  • Provide actionable insights that support informed decision-making and operational excellence.
  • Utilize data analytics to measure outcomes and track organizational performance.

Internal Auditing & Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits across clinical and administrative departments.
  • Monitor compliance with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend data-driven corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to implement and monitor audit findings and resolutions.

Quality Improvement

  • Assist in designing and executing quality improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and help develop sustainable corrective action plans.
  • Monitor progress, measure results, and report findings to leadership.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence.

Technology & Systems Support

  • Support the integration, optimization, and ongoing use of quality and compliance-related IT systems.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and security.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for data systems, reporting tools, and quality processes.
  • Train staff on audit procedures, data reporting practices, and compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, IT systems, internal auditing, or quality management within a healthcare environment.
  • Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools.
  • Experience working with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
  • Understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and quality standards.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and confidentiality.
  • Power BI experience strongly preferred.
  • Certification in Healthcare Quality, Auditing, or related discipline.

Additional Requirements

Successful candidates must be able to obtain and maintain:

  • Level II Background Clearance
    All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Click https://info.flclearinghouse.c... to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)
    In accordance with Aspire Health Partners' transportation and insurance requirements.

 As a Quality Data Analyst, you will work closely with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams to evaluate performance, support quality initiatives, and ensure data integrity across the organization.
 What You'll Do 
 Data Analysis & Reporting 
 Analyze healthcare and quality performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
 Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
 Provide actionable insights that support informed decision-making and operational excellence.
 Utilize data analytics to measure outcomes and track organizational performance.
 Internal Auditing & Compliance 
 Conduct internal audits across clinical and administrative departments.
 Monitor compliance with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
 Identify process gaps and recommend data-driven corrective actions.
 Collaborate with stakeholders to implement and monitor audit findings and resolutions.
 Quality Improvement 
 Assist in designing and executing quality improvement initiatives.
 Conduct root cause analyses and help develop sustainable corrective action plans.
 Monitor progress, measure results, and report findings to leadership.
 Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence.
 Technology & Systems Support 
 Support the integration, optimization, and ongoing use of quality and compliance-related IT systems.
 Ensure data accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and security.
 Serve as a subject matter resource for data systems, reporting tools, and quality processes.
 Train staff on audit procedures, data reporting practices, and compliance requirements.
 What We're Looking For 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.
 Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, IT systems, internal auditing, or quality management within a healthcare environment.
 Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools.
 Experience working with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
 Understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and quality standards.
 Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
 Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and confidentiality.
 Power BI experience strongly preferred.
 Certification in Healthcare Quality, Auditing, or related discipline.
 Additional Requirements 
 Successful candidates must be able to obtain and maintain:
 Level II Background Clearance 
All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Click https://info.flclearinghouse.c... to learn more.
 Acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) 
In accordance with Aspire Health Partners' transportation and insurance requirements.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician - ONE DAYTONA
jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


ONE DAYTONA is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to:

  • Help shape a welcoming, well-maintained environment for tenants, guests, and visitors.
  • Drive operational excellence through proactive facility maintenance, property upkeep, and attention to detail.
  • Support the successful execution of community events, activations, and day-to-day property operations.
  • Create a clean, safe, and visually appealing destination experience across the property.
  • Advance the long-term quality, functionality, and reputation of one of the region's premier mixed-use destinations.

...based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You’ll Do

  • Conduct routine inspections to identify maintenance, cleanliness, and safety concerns throughout the property.
  • Maintain the appearance of public spaces through litter removal, pressure washing, grounds maintenance, and general property upkeep.
  • Complete maintenance work orders, including painting, drywall, plumbing, carpentry, door repairs, and basic electrical work.
  • Support the setup and teardown of furniture, signage, displays, and equipment for events, activations, and community gatherings.
  • Operate maintenance equipment, utility vehicles, pressure washers, and aerial lifts to complete assigned projects safely and efficiently.
  • Assist with contractor coordination, housekeeping oversight, and multi-person maintenance projects.
  • Maintain maintenance equipment, tools, inventory, traffic control devices, and support vehicles.
  • Identify, document, and communicate property deficiencies, tenant concerns, and safety hazards.
  • Respond to emergency maintenance situations and support operational needs during evenings, weekends, holidays, special events, and severe weather events.
  • Maintain an organized and safe work environment while supporting the overall goals of the Property Operations team.

What You’ll Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Two or more years of building maintenance, facilities maintenance, or related experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of painting, drywall repair, plumbing, electrical systems, carpentry, and general building maintenance.
  • Experience operating commercial maintenance equipment, including pressure washers; scissor lift experience or willingness to obtain certification preferred.
  • Ability to safely operate a truck with an attached trailer.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in delivering high-quality work.
  • A proactive, service-oriented mindset and willingness to support a variety of operational needs.
  • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events, as business needs require.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to help shape the daily experience of everyone who visits, works, and does business at ONE DAYTONA.

From maintaining the appearance and functionality of the property to supporting special events and responding to operational needs, your work will have a direct impact on creating a safe, welcoming, and first-class destination. As a member of the Property Operations team, you'll play an important role in preserving the quality and reputation of ONE DAYTONA while helping deliver the exceptional experiences that keep guests, tenants, and visitors coming back.


Behind every race weekend are talented people helping shape the future of sports and entertainment. If you are ready to make an impact alongside passionate teammates, we encourage you to apply.


Explore this opportunity and apply at www.careers.nascar.com.


Our people are the key to our success. That is why we offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package focused on wellness, and opportunities to grow and develop both personally and professionally.


NASCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to conducting recruitment and hiring activities in a fair, ethical, and legally compliant manner. In support of this commitment, all employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, skills, experience, and performance, and are made without discrimination based on any legally protected characteristic, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including socioeconomic, marital, parental, or caregiving status.


Follow us on LinkedIn and X for future opportunities and company news.


We are looking for your voice, your ideas, and your perspective. To help us get to know you accurately and keep the process fair for everyone, we ask that interviews and assessments be completed without the support of AI-generated content or automated assistance.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Track Maintenance
jobs.description_html:
HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Homestead-Miami Speedway is seeking an experienced Track Maintenance Supervisor to:

  • Help shape a safe, race-ready environment for competitors, employees, and event partners.
  • Lead a skilled maintenance team responsible for the upkeep of critical track and facility infrastructure.
  • Drive operational excellence through proactive planning, problem-solving, and execution of maintenance projects and event activities.
  • Create efficient processes that support seamless event operations and year-round facility readiness.
  • Advance the speedway's ability to host world-class racing and entertainment events through strong leadership and hands-on expertise.

...based in Homestead, Florida.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a working supervisor, leading and participating in maintenance and repair activities involving the track surface, safety barriers, fencing, and facility structures.
  • Plan, prioritize, and coordinate maintenance projects while identifying and implementing practical solutions to operational challenges.
  • Schedule, train, develop, and supervise track maintenance personnel, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and to high standards.
  • Coordinate equipment, staffing, and logistical needs to support race weekends, special events, and daily operations.
  • Operate and oversee the use of maintenance equipment required for facility upkeep and event execution.
  • Train on-track crews and support race operations by ensuring personnel understand procedures, responsibilities, and safety expectations.
  • Partner with racing series, internal teams, and event stakeholders to support successful event preparation, execution, and post-event activities.
  • Maintain schedules, support racing activities, and ensure the facility remains event-ready year-round.

What You’ll Bring

  • High school diploma or GED required; equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
  • Two to four years of maintenance, facility operations, construction, or related experience.
  • Experience operating equipment used in maintenance, facility operations, or event support environments.
  • Proven ability to lead, train, and develop teams while managing schedules and competing priorities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Ability to read and interpret safety regulations, operating procedures, maintenance instructions, and technical documentation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Basic math skills, including measurements, percentages, area, circumference, volume, and practical applications of algebra and geometry.
  • Valid Florida driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.
  • Bilingual skills are a plus.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as business needs require.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to play a direct role in maintaining one of NASCAR's premier racing venues and ensuring it is safe, operational, and ready to host world-class events.

Your work will have a visible impact on every event held at Homestead-Miami Speedway. By leading maintenance operations, overseeing critical safety infrastructure, and coordinating teams and resources, you'll help create the foundation that allows races and events to run successfully. This role combines hands-on leadership with operational responsibility, offering the chance to influence the performance, safety, and long-term success of a facility that brings people together through unforgettable motorsports and entertainment experiences.


Behind every race weekend are talented people helping shape the future of sports and entertainment. If you are ready to make an impact alongside passionate teammates, we encourage you to apply.


Explore this opportunity and apply at www.careers.nascar.com.


Our people are the key to our success. That is why we offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package focused on wellness, and opportunities to grow and develop both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Guest Services
jobs.description_html:
DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

Daytona International Speedway seeks a talented professional to join our team as Coordinator, Guest Services. This position supports an exceptional guest experience by coordinating nonprofit organization volunteers, event staffing, equipment, transportation, vendor services, and administrative activities for Guest Services and other departments.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the Nonprofit Organization (NPO) Supervisor, recruiting and maintaining relationships with volunteer groups and coordinating required documentation, contracts, credentials, and post-event payments.
  • Assist with preparing training materials for Guest Services Fan Crew members and NPO volunteers.
  • Coordinate social media and radio advertising for hiring events and NPO recruitment.
  • Use ABI MasterMind to replicate events, schedule staff, track labor costs, and process payroll for event employees.
  • Provide supervision for Tours staff, Crew Chiefs, Tram Maintenance, and Support personnel.
  • Assist at the Guest Services Desk in the Daytona International Speedway Ticket and Tours Lobby.
  • Prepare post-event summaries for management following major events.
  • Coordinate radios, golf carts, apparel, and other event equipment and supplies.
  • Support vehicle operations by coordinating vendor pricing, contracts, certificates of insurance, vehicle trade valuations, ticket trades, and vehicle pickup and return schedules.
  • Track vehicle registrations, license plates, service, and repairs; coordinate with Transportation and the DMV to maintain current registrations.
  • Maintain the toll authority account and monitor available funds.
  • Prepare vendor contracts, statements of work, invoices, and payment requests, coordinating legal review as needed.
  • Prepare and submit expenses and outstanding invoice information for monthly accruals.
  • Assist with hiring-event paperwork and HR documentation and processing for full-time and part-time employees.
  • Request permits for ADA carts and help ensure event operations follow established Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) guidelines.
  • Serve as the workers’ compensation liaison.
  • Coordinate show car appearances and special vehicle and transportation moves.
  • Assist the Director with the annual operating budget and prepare supporting documentation for smaller-event billbacks.
  • Partner with the Tours Manager to develop the annual modified tour schedule.
  • Participate in employee training sessions and travel regionally as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in sport management, event management, or a related field.
  • One to two years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Event management experience, preferably within the sports industry.
  • Demonstrated employee supervision experience, preferably with event-day staff.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft applications and web-based programs.
  • Strong verbal, written, and listening skills, including the ability to prepare reports and correspondence, interpret operating procedures, and communicate effectively with guests, vendors, volunteers, and employees.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Basic mathematical skills to support payroll, expense tracking, invoices, and budget activities.
  • A commitment to customer service, professional conduct, and representing Daytona International Speedway positively.

Schedule and Physical Requirements

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional extended shifts.
  • Ability to travel regionally as needed.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions and stand and walk for extended periods during events.
  • Ability to perform duties involving sitting, reaching, handling equipment, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling.
  • Ability to frequently lift and/or move more than 50 pounds.
  • Vision sufficient to perform assigned duties, including close and distance vision, color and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in creating the world-class guest experiences that make Daytona International Speedway a premier destination for motorsports fans. You'll work across multiple areas of the business, coordinating volunteers, event staffing, transportation, equipment, and operational logistics that directly support major racing events and year-round activities. From planning and preparation to event execution, you'll gain broad exposure to venue operations while building valuable experience in sports, events, guest services, and leadership.


Behind every race weekend are talented people helping shape the future of sports and entertainment. If you are ready to make an impact alongside passionate teammates, we encourage you to apply.


Explore this opportunity and apply at www.careers.nascar.com.

jobs.description_text:
DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY
 Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing." Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training. 
 Daytona International Speedway seeks a talented professional to join our team as Coordinator, Guest Services . This position supports an exceptional guest experience by coordinating nonprofit organization volunteers, event staffing, equipment, transportation, vendor services, and administrative activities for Guest Services and other departments.
 What You’ll Do 
 Serve as the Nonprofit Organization (NPO) Supervisor, recruiting and maintaining relationships with volunteer groups and coordinating required documentation, contracts, credentials, and post-event payments.
 Assist with preparing training materials for Guest Services Fan Crew members and NPO volunteers.
 Coordinate social media and radio advertising for hiring events and NPO recruitment.
 Use ABI MasterMind to replicate events, schedule staff, track labor costs, and process payroll for event employees.
 Provide supervision for Tours staff, Crew Chiefs, Tram Maintenance, and Support personnel.
 Assist at the Guest Services Desk in the Daytona International Speedway Ticket and Tours Lobby.
 Prepare post-event summaries for management following major events.
 Coordinate radios, golf carts, apparel, and other event equipment and supplies.
 Support vehicle operations by coordinating vendor pricing, contracts, certificates of insurance, vehicle trade valuations, ticket trades, and vehicle pickup and return schedules.
 Track vehicle registrations, license plates, service, and repairs; coordinate with Transportation and the DMV to maintain current registrations.
 Maintain the toll authority account and monitor available funds.
 Prepare vendor contracts, statements of work, invoices, and payment requests, coordinating legal review as needed.
 Prepare and submit expenses and outstanding invoice information for monthly accruals.
 Assist with hiring-event paperwork and HR documentation and processing for full-time and part-time employees.
 Request permits for ADA carts and help ensure event operations follow established Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) guidelines.
 Serve as the workers’ compensation liaison.
 Coordinate show car appearances and special vehicle and transportation moves.
 Assist the Director with the annual operating budget and prepare supporting documentation for smaller-event billbacks.
 Partner with the Tours Manager to develop the annual modified tour schedule.
 Participate in employee training sessions and travel regionally as needed.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
 What You’ll Bring 
 A bachelor’s degree in sport management, event management, or a related field.
 One to two years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
 Event management experience, preferably within the sports industry.
 Demonstrated employee supervision experience, preferably with event-day staff.
 Proficiency with Microsoft applications and web-based programs.
 Strong verbal, written, and listening skills, including the ability to prepare reports and correspondence, interpret operating procedures, and communicate effectively with guests, vendors, volunteers, and employees.
 Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Sound judgment, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
 Basic mathematical skills to support payroll, expense tracking, invoices, and budget activities.
 A commitment to customer service, professional conduct, and representing Daytona International Speedway positively.
 Schedule and Physical Requirements 
 Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional extended shifts.
 Ability to travel regionally as needed.
 Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions and stand and walk for extended periods during events.
 Ability to perform duties involving sitting, reaching, handling equipment, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling.
 Ability to frequently lift and/or move more than 50 pounds.
 Vision sufficient to perform assigned duties, including close and distance vision, color and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

 This is an opportunity to play a key role in creating the world-class guest experiences that make Daytona International Speedway a premier destination for motorsports fans. You'll work across multiple areas of the business, coordinating volunteers, event staffing, transportation, equipment, and operational logistics that directly support major racing events and year-round activities. From planning and preparation to event execution, you'll gain broad exposure to venue operations while building valuable experience in sports, events, guest services, and leadership.

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR is seeking a Junior Data Scientist based in Daytona Beach, Florida, to help transform data into actionable insights and intelligent solutions that drive business decisions across the organization. In this role, you'll analyze data, support predictive modeling initiatives, enhance AI-enabled analytics tools, and collaborate with stakeholders to solve real-world business challenges. This opportunity offers hands-on exposure to modern analytics, generative AI, and emerging technologies while helping shape the future of data-driven decision-making at NASCAR.

What You Will Do:


  • Prepare, combine, and analyze data using SQL and Python, investigating data quality issues and documenting business definitions.
  • Apply statistical methods and support predictive modeling to understand fan behavior, identify trends, forecast outcomes, and evaluate business performance.
  • Help develop, maintain, and enhance AI-enabled analytics tools, including Python-based tools and MCP integrations.
  • Test analytical tools and AI-generated answers against trusted SQL queries and reports; investigate errors and improve underlying logic, instructions, and tool descriptions.
  • Collaborate with business partners to translate questions and feedback into analyses, visualizations, and practical tools, communicating findings and limitations clearly.
  • Work with data engineering and business intelligence colleagues to create repeatable workflows, maintain documentation, and follow established data access and governance practices.
  • Support user adoption, ongoing analytical needs, and additional projects as assigned..
  • Up to 10% travel throughout race season.

What You Will Bring:


  • Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
  • Foundational SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, and common table expressions, and experience using Python for data preparation and analysis.
  • Understanding of core statistical concepts and familiarity with basic machine learning methods and model evaluation.
  • Foundational understanding of generative AI’s capabilities and limitations, an interest in learning MCP and tool calling, and a commitment to validating AI-generated results.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with attention to accuracy and the ability to explain technical findings in business terms.
  • A collaborative, curious mindset and willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and manage competing priorities.

Why This Role?


This is an opportunity to help shape how NASCAR leverages data, analytics, and emerging AI technologies to support business strategy and decision-making. You'll partner with teams across the organization to uncover insights, develop practical analytical solutions, and improve how employees access and interact with data. Whether you're building predictive models, validating AI-generated outputs, or helping create new analytics capabilities, you'll see your work make a visible impact while continuing to grow your expertise in analytics, machine learning, and generative AI.

NASCAR is seeking a Data Engineer based in Daytona Beach, Florida, to help shape the foundation of our data ecosystem. You'll build scalable data solutions, improve data quality, and create trusted datasets that empower teams across the organization to make informed decisions. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern data technologies, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and make a meaningful impact on the future of NASCAR through data-driven innovation.


What You Will Do:


  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data needs.
  • Translate defined business requirements into data solutions.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines using SQL and Python.
  • Build integrations across data platforms, including API-based sources.
  • Apply data modeling principles to prepare datasets for reporting, analytics, and business operations.
  • Write clear, maintainable code that follows team development standards.
  • Implement data quality checks and investigate discrepancies to improve accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Test changes, participate in code reviews, and support established deployment procedures.
  • Follow established data governance, privacy, and security standards.
  • Document data workflows, transformations, and business rules.

What You Will Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Up to two years of relevant experience.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and foundational Python skills.
  • Understanding of relational databases, data modeling, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality principles.
  • Familiarity with Git or another version control system.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Exposure to Snowflake, Apache Airflow, or comparable data platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS services, such as Amazon S3.
  • Experience working with APIs and structured or semi-structured data.
  • Familiarity with automated testing or GitHub Actions.
  • Interest in or experience within sports, entertainment, or media.

  • Enthusiasm for working with data and building practical solutions.

jobs.title: Representative, Ticket Operations
jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


Daytona International Speedway is seeking a motivated team player to play an integral role on its Ticket Operations team. The Representative, Ticket Operations delivers an exceptional guest experience while driving sales of track tours and experiences.


This position builds relationships with guests by understanding their needs, providing knowledgeable and helpful information, processing accurate transactions, and creating an engaging experience from the initial interaction through the completion of their visit. The role plays an important part in creating positive, lasting impressions that strengthen guest satisfaction and encourage repeat visits.

 

What You'll Do

  • Support the sales and service of daily track tours and experiences, providing knowledgeable and engaging customer service.
  • Apply consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs, educate guests, and maximize the overall customer experience.
  • Create, sell, and process track experiences using ticketing software and ensure accurate transaction processing.
  • Maintain current knowledge of events, promotions, sales initiatives, facility operations, and tour offerings through ongoing communication with leaders and internal departments.
  • Assist with offsite ticket sales, promotions, and special events as needed.
  • Utilize ticketing systems, computers, phones, and other office equipment to support daily operations.
  • Maintain a professional, positive, and customer-focused environment.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

What You'll Bring

  • High school diploma or GED required; equivalent education and experience considered.
  • One to two years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service.
  • Previous cash and/or credit card handling experience.
  • Positive, professional attitude and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • General knowledge of the facility and racing is preferred.
  • Ticketing software experience, such as Ticketmaster, preferred.
  • One to two years of customer service experience preferred.

 

Work Schedule

This position requires a flexible schedule based on business and event needs. Hours will include evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during race weekends and special events. Candidates must be willing to work the non-traditional schedules common within the sports and entertainment industry.

jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR seeks a detail-oriented and collaborative professional to join our Finance team as a Staff Accountant, Accounts Receivable & Revenue.

This position supports revenue and accounts receivable operations, including billing, invoicing, customer contracts, variable revenue transactions, and month-end accounting. The ideal candidate brings strong accounting knowledge, advanced Excel skills, and a commitment to accuracy while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Support customer contract activities in Workday, including contract setup, maintenance, and appropriate revenue recognition treatment within assigned responsibilities.
  • Prepare recurring and non-recurring month-end journal entries and account reconciliations.
  • Reconcile source systems, settlements, and supporting data to Workday and the general ledger; research and resolve discrepancies promptly.
  • Record and process variable revenue transactions and support related billing and invoicing.
  • Create and maintain customer invoices, follow up on payment status, and initiate invoice adjustments and write-offs with appropriate documentation and coding.
  • Create, update, and monitor billing schedules to ensure billing terms, amounts, and dates are accurately reflected in Workday.
  • Use Workday import files and other approved tools to upload and process billing and revenue transactions.
  • Create and maintain accurate customer records in Workday.
  • Gather supporting information and documentation for internal and external audits.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to improve efficiency in Workday and related accounting processes.
  • Assist with special projects and other accounting or operational responsibilities as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and one to three years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong accounting knowledge and the ability to identify issues, research discrepancies, and develop practical solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Workday Financials experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain accounting policies, provide clear instructions, and respond to customers, business partners, and management.
  • Ability to apply mathematical concepts, including discounts, interest, percentages, ratios, and proportions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to work occasional overtime to meet department needs.

Why This Role?

Behind every partnership, agreement, and revenue stream is accurate financial reporting that helps keep NASCAR moving forward. In this role, you'll play a key part in ensuring revenue is recorded accurately, customer transactions are managed seamlessly, and financial data supports informed business decisions across one of the most recognized brands in sports and entertainment. Your attention to detail and process improvement mindset will help strengthen the financial foundation that enables NASCAR to grow, innovate, and deliver world-class experiences.

jobs.title: Part Time Coordinator, Medical Liaison
jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR is seeking an experienced Part-Time Coordinator, Medical Liaison to:

  • Help shape a safe and well-supported environment for NASCAR participants and team members.
  • Lead communication and coordination efforts during medical events and critical situations.
  • Drive continuity of care by connecting medical providers, tracks, and NASCAR stakeholders.
  • Create trusted relationships that support timely decision-making and effective medical response.
  • Advance NASCAR's commitment to health, safety, and operational excellence across event operations.

...based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary liaison between NASCAR, tracks, hospitals, and medical providers, ensuring timely and accurate communication during medical events while maintaining HIPAA compliance.
  • Monitor compliance with NASCAR Event Medical Standards and support tracks in meeting medical requirements outlined in sanction agreements.
  • Record, track, and coordinate medical care, follow-up activities, accident reporting, and workers' compensation documentation through resolution.
  • Act as a medical resource and advocate for NASCAR members, identifying and communicating concerns that may impact participant, worker, or driver safety.
  • Maintain accurate reports, databases, and medical records in accordance with applicable policies and procedures.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with NASCAR staff, participants, tracks, medical providers, and other key stakeholders.
  • Support event preparation, office communications, data entry, health fairs, NASCAR Summit activities, and other departmental initiatives.
  • Participate in meetings, conference calls, and operational discussions throughout the season.

What You'll Bring

  • Associate Degree in Nursing required; Bachelor's Degree in Nursing or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of recent experience as a Registered Nurse in Emergency Medicine and/or Critical Care Transport.
  • Current, active, and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license.
  • Leadership experience preferred; case management experience is a plus.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to develop cross-functional partnerships and influence outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively in sensitive or high-pressure situations.
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and remain calm during emergencies and crisis situations.
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and data management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to utilize company-provided technology and systems effectively.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and customer service.
  • Ability to travel up to 90%, including weekends and holidays, as business needs require.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to help protect and support the people who power NASCAR. As a Medical Liaison, you'll serve as a critical link between NASCAR, medical providers, and event operations, helping ensure participants and team members receive timely care, clear communication, and appropriate support when it matters most. Your expertise, judgment, and advocacy will directly contribute to a safe, prepared, and high-performing environment across NASCAR events, helping the sport operate with confidence both on and off the track.

jobs.title: Hospitality Event Staff - Homestead-Miami Speedway
jobs.description_html:
HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

JOB SUMMARY: The Seasonal Hospitality General Staff Team Member will work under the direction of the Event Experience team. The General Hospitality position is responsible for greeting guests, checking admissions and answering questions our guests may have in our various hospitality locations on race day.  This job entails friendly, outgoing and positive people who are willing to work as part of a team.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability and willingness to take direction and follow through with assigned responsibilities, multi-task and exercise good judgement

  • Must be able to attend and participate in all pre-event training sessions and all assigned event days

  • Must be flexible to work extended hours due to business requirements including early mornings, late nights, weekends and indoor/outdoor environments when required

  • Must be punctual, dependable, able to stand for periods of time, walk long distances, ability to lift up to 25lbs.

  • Ability to work and thrive in a team environment

  • Exude positive attitude and place the guest experience at a premium

  • Some positions may require work for 1 hour past the checkered flag

Must be available to work Championship Race Weekend, November 6-8.

jobs.title: General Maintenance, Homestead - Miami Speedway
jobs.description_html:
HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Homestead-Miami Speedway is seeking a dependable and motivated General Maintenance team member to help maintain one of NASCAR's premier racing facilities. In this role, you'll help keep our buildings, grounds, and event spaces safe, clean, and race-ready while supporting the operations that deliver exceptional experiences for fans, competitors, and guests.

What You'll Do

  • Perform general maintenance, repairs, and cleaning of buildings, grounds, and facility equipment.
  • Complete minor electrical, plumbing, painting, and wall repair projects.
  • Maintain walkways, grounds, and common areas using hand and power tools.
  • Set up and tear down tables, chairs, furniture, and equipment for events and facility needs.
  • Support race weekends, track rentals, and special events by assisting with facility preparation and operational needs.
  • Help maintain the overall appearance, cleanliness, and functionality of the Speedway.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring

  • High school diploma or GED, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • One or more years of maintenance, facilities, construction, or related experience preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of general building maintenance, including minor electrical, plumbing, painting, and repair work.
  • Ability to safely operate hand and power tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining a safe work environment.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Valid Florida driver's license.
  • Ability to regularly lift up to 25 pounds, frequently lift up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift up to 100 pounds.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Availability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as business needs require.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to help create the environment where NASCAR events come to life. Your work ensures Homestead-Miami Speedway is safe, well-maintained, and ready to welcome thousands of fans, competitors, and guests throughout the year. jobs.title: IMSA Senior Coordinator, Partnership Marketing
jobs.description_html:
INTERNATIONAL MOTOR SPORTS ASSOCIATION (IMSA)

IMSA was originally founded in 1969 and owns a long and rich history in sports car racing. Today, IMSA is the sanctioning body of the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship, the premier sports car racing series in North America. IMSA also sanctions the IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge, IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge and Historic Sportscar Racing, as well as five one-make series: Ferrari Challenge North America, Lamborghini Super Trofeo North America, Whelen Mazda MX-5 Cup presented by Michelin, Mustang Challenge and Porsche Carrera Cup North America. IMSA – a company within the NASCAR family – is the exclusive strategic partner in North America with the Automobile Club de l’Ouest (ACO) which operates the 24 Hours of Le Mans as a part of the FIA World Endurance Championship. The partnership enables selected IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship competitors to earn automatic entries into the prestigious 24 Hours of Le Mans. For more information, please visit www.IMSA.com, https://x.com/IMSA, www.facebook.com/IMSA or www.instagram.com/imsa_racing.

IMSA is seeking an experienced Senior Coordinator, Partnership Marketing to:

  • Help shape the success of strategic corporate partnerships that support the growth of IMSA.
  • Drive impactful partner activations and sponsorship programs that deliver measurable value.
  • Create exceptional partner and VIP experiences both at the track and throughout the racing season.
  • Advance key business relationships through strong communication, collaboration, and flawless execution.

...based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day execution of assigned partnerships, ensuring contractual obligations, activation programs, and deliverables are fulfilled accurately and on time.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partner contacts while identifying opportunities to maximize the value of their IMSA investment.
  • Coordinate partnership communications, reporting, research insights, event logistics, executive briefings, and guest management.
  • Plan and execute at-track activations, hospitality programs, VIP experiences, suite operations, and other partner engagement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, tracks, agencies, and external stakeholders to deliver seamless partnership execution.
  • Manage the distribution and tracking of credentials, parking passes, suite access, VIP experiences, and Victory Lane celebrations.
  • Develop and maintain partnership collateral, presentations, activation materials, and event resources.
  • Serve as the at-track manager of the IMSA Business Center and support partnership initiatives at race weekends and partner events.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in partnership marketing, sponsorship activation, event marketing, sports marketing, hospitality, client services, or a related field.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build relationships with partners, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating events, hospitality programs, sponsorship activations, or client-facing initiatives.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with Adobe Photoshop is a plus.
  • Ability to leverage technology and AI tools to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and deliverables.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and execute with professionalism.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and effectively represent IMSA with partners and guests.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, including weekends, as business needs require.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to help grow and strengthen the partnerships that fuel IMSA's continued success. Through relationship management, partnership activation, and race weekend execution, you'll play a direct role in delivering value to world-class brands while creating meaningful experiences that support long-term partner investment. Your work will influence how partners engage with IMSA both at the track and throughout the season, helping advance the growth, visibility, and future of the sport.


Behind every race weekend are talented people helping shape the future of sports and entertainment. If you are ready to make an impact alongside passionate teammates, we encourage you to apply.


Explore this opportunity and apply at www.careers.nascar.com.

Our people are the key to our success. That is why we offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package focused on wellness, and opportunities to grow and develop both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Admissions Pricing & Promotions
jobs.description_html:
At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


The Admissions Pricing & Promotions Coordinator supports the execution of pricing, promotional, inventory, and revenue strategies across track events. This role ensures pricing accuracy, monitors sales and inventory performance, supports promotional and secondary market initiatives, and provides reporting and analysis to inform ticketing decisions.


The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, with the ability to work effectively with data, reporting tools, ticketing systems, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of event pricing, fee structures, and approved pricing changes within ticketing systems.
  • Monitor ticket inventory, sales performance, sell-through, and pricing trends to identify opportunities for optimization and revenue growth.
  • Prepare and distribute pricing, sales, inventory, revenue, and promotional performance reports and analyses.
  • Support promotional campaigns, dynamic pricing initiatives, resale activity, and inventory allocations for promotions, waitlists, relocations, and other ticketing programs.
  • Conduct market and competitive pricing research to support pricing recommendations and revenue strategies.
  • Maintain accurate pricing documentation and communicate pricing updates and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Ticket Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Track personnel, and Quality Assurance to ensure pricing and inventory accuracy.
  • Support the Director with data analysis, presentations, pricing recommendations, and special projects.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Sports Management, Marketing, Economics, or related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • 2–4 years of experience in ticketing, pricing analysis, revenue management, sales operations, or business analytics.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficient in using SQL to perform data joins, aggregations, and subqueries for business operations.
  • Capabilities in data manipulation and visualization using BI tools like Tableau are highly preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel and data reporting.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and CRM platforms preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A data-driven and detail-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Curiosity about market trends and consumer behavior.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented mindset.
  • A commitment to supporting revenue growth and operational excellence.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in sports, entertainment, or live event ticketing.
  • Knowledge of dynamic pricing principles and ticket inventory management.
  • Experience preparing business reports and analyzing sales trends.
  • Familiarity with secondary ticket marketplaces and promotional campaigns.

Work Schedule

This position requires flexibility to support race weekends, special events, and business needs. Evening, weekend, and holiday work is required, along with occasional travel as needed.

jobs.title: Corner Marshal
jobs.description_html:
SEBRING INTERNATIONAL RACEWAY

This racetrack located in Sebring, Florida, is America’s oldest road racing track, with over six decades of storied history. It hosts the historic Twelve Hours of Sebring each year on the third Saturday of March on the 3.74-mile road course. The Twelve Hours of Sebring is one of the five endurance races on the IMSA schedule.


Sebring International Raceway seeks a talented professional to join us in the position of Corner Marshal. This position will report at the Sebring, Florida location.

Summary 
Corner Workers are stationed at various points of danger around the race track and are responsible for observing and monitoring track conditions and communicating with drivers by using flags to warn of track conditions and provide assistance in case of any collisions, accidents or track problems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Observe, monitor and assess track surface conditions.

Provide consistent information to drivers using racing flags and signals.

Observe competitors for driving behavior and their cars mechanical condition.

Help drivers and others in an incident.

Communicate information to radio tower, stewards, and emergency medical responders.

0% travel

Supervisory Responsibilities                               
This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience                               
High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Language Skills                               
Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos.  Ability to write simple correspondence.  Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.

Mathematical Skills                               
Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.  Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability                               
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions.  Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
                     
Other Qualifications                               
Must be willing to work weekdays and weekends, and some evenings. Ability to work in all types of weather.

This position is a safety sensitive position and participates in the Substance Abuse Program (SAP).

Physical Demands 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand. The employee is frequently required to walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

jobs.title: Facility Operations Event Staff - Daytona Intl Speedway
jobs.description_html:
DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

The Daytona International Speedway seeks motivated individuals to join the Facility Operations team in the positions of Maintenance_Event based in Daytona Beach, Florida.

This position is a seasonal / event based position to assist the team in the areas of Maintenance Mechanic, Painter, Irrigation and Track Maintenance. Basic office systems knowledge including but not limited to computer system and programs, cellular phone and 2-way radios.

This position will perform routine preventative maintenance and repair procedures on race track and related infrastructures. Operate equipment and use tools as directed.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in executing DIS events – major races, track rentals, other events.

  • Assemble and disassemble track equipment such as track gates, barricades, portable bleachers, etc.

  • Use all types of power tools and large equipment including forklift, front end loader, backhoe, bucket truck.

  • Perform preventive building maintenance duties.

  • Clean, repair, lubricate and maintain equipment, tools and machinery used for construction jobs.

  • Use saws, hammer, nails and bolts for framing.

  • Dig ditches or trenches, backfill excavations, compact and level earth to grade specifications using equipment, picks, or shovels

  • Perform light electrical, plumbing, drywall and carpentry repairs. Participate in general cleaning, painting, and repair work.

  • Other duties as assigned

SEBRING INTERNATIONAL RACEWAY

This racetrack located in Sebring, Florida, is America’s oldest road racing track, with over six decades of storied history. It hosts the historic Twelve Hours of Sebring each year on the third Saturday of March on the 3.74-mile road course. The Twelve Hours of Sebring is one of the five endurance races on the IMSA schedule.


Sebring International Raceway seeks a talented professional to join in the position of Fire Rescue. This position will report to our Sebring, Florida location.

Summary

The primary role of every firefighter employed is to provide immediate response to any emergency situation encountered at Sebring International Raceway.  Support events that takes place on course or in spectator areas and mitigate each situation with professionalism.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

The Primary responsibilities for a firefighter include the following:

  • Scene safety
  • Fire suppression
  • Incident stabilization
  • Patient assessment and or patient care
  • Track cleanup and insuring the track is reopened as quickly and safely as possible.

0% travel

Supervisory Responsibilities                                                    

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience                                                   

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Language Skills                                                

Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos.  Ability to write simple correspondence.  Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.

Mathematical Skills                                                     

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.  Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability                                             

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions.  Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

Other Qualifications                                                    

Must be willing to work weekdays and weekends, and some evenings.

Position is safety sensitive and participates in the corporate Substance Abuse Program (SAP).

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit and use hands to finger, handle, or feel;. The employee is frequently required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance; The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds; frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move more than 100 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.
