jobs.title: Faculty - Music Business (Course Director)
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Music Business program provides a well-rounded and in-depth study of the fundamentals of business and management, focusing on how those skills can be applied in the entertainment and music industry. Throughout the degree programs, students work in a professional, project-based environment, designed to recreate the challenges and opportunities they’ll encounter in the world of entertainment business.  Foundational business topics include studies in management, marketing, accounting, finance, communications, and law, laying the groundwork for more advanced industry studies, including business models, concert management, digital marketing, intellectual property, entrepreneurship, data analysis, and more.

 Course Directors may be required to teach both on-campus and online. All positions are full time, on-campus in Winter Park, FL.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment of learning through effective teaching skills, maintain student-centered focus, and update curriculum to keep current and relevant to industry standards.
  • Utilize a variety of teaching strategies and encourage active learning.
  • Create learning activities, including assignments, tests, quizzes and labs, and assess student outcomes in a timely manner through effective assessment and constructive feedback to students to support the learning process.
  • Perform lectures for campus courses, and hold scheduled virtual course meetings for online courses. Teaching will be conducted through on-campus and online delivery.
  • Interact positively with diverse student populations; provide all students with equal opportunities for learning.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the industry, maintain knowledge and skill relevancy through continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:  Oversee associate course directors and lab specialists to ensure the integrity of curriculum and degree learning outcomes.

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including proofreading and editing for grammar and punctuation
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently and collaboratively with other teachers and university staff
  • Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in an immersive, fast paced environment

Education and/or Experience:

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of four (4) years related and verifiable work experience and required to hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Design, Communications, Entertainment, Music or related discipline from an accredited college or university. 


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  • None

Skills:

  • Minimum of 4 years of significant professional experience in the concert, touring, or live event production industry.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in a variety of multimedia and design skills as described above, evidenced by a professional portfolio.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for effective classroom delivery.
  • Ability to translate complex industry practices into an accessible and engaging curriculum for students.
  • Proficiency using software programs such as MS Word, Excel, Keynote/PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Basic business computer skills, including iLife
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

Work is performed in an office, classroom or recording studio environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active student and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system. May be subject to; bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

In the Film Production Master of Fine Arts degree program, students learn the artistic, technical, professional, and academic aspects of filmmaking. jobs.title: Adjunct Faculty - Public Relations (Remote-FL)
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The ability to measure and evaluate the impact of public relations efforts is critical to ensuring the success of any marketing and/or public relations campaign. In the Social Media Metrics and ROI course, students will learn how to track, report, and analyze a variety of metrics that describe audience behavior and attitudes. In the course, students will learn how to use numeric information to describe and explain performance in relation to campaign goals and objectives. Students will examine quantitative and qualitative measurements to help provide context for audience search trends, website traffic, and social behavior such as sharing content. In addition to exploring these metrics, students will also learn how to integrate these measures into their professional planning. The course will provide students with an understanding of both traditional and contemporary metrics and reporting tools for analyzing data. Ultimately, students will learn how to develop and create reports, which will develop a stakeholder's understanding and confidence in the public relations process.

jobs.title: Writer/Internal Communications Specialist
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Internal Communications Specialist reports to the Strategic Projects Manager and serves as Staff & Cultural Development's (SCD) dedicated communications lead, keeping Full Sail employees informed, connected, and engaged through clear, timely messaging and compelling storytelling. This position drives internal communications across Full Sail One and employee email. They also support Full Sail's employer brand and employee advocacy efforts on platforms such as Glassdoor, Indeed, and LinkedIn. Exceptional writing and editing skills, strong relationship-building skills, and meticulous attention to detail are critical to success in this role.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Plan, write, edit, and publish content for internal communications channels, including Full Sail One (intranet), email, Slack, and text messaging, ensuring all messaging is consistent across mediums and reflects the Full Sail voice and brand standards.
  • Support Full Sail's employer brand on Glassdoor.com and Indeed.com, curating and posting content that showcases the faculty and staff experience and monitoring reviews and activity to share insights with SCD leadership.
  • Develop and support employee advocacy initiatives on LinkedIn and other external platforms in coordination with Marketing, creating shareable content, toolkits, and guidance that empower faculty and staff to amplify Full Sail's culture, stories, and opportunities through their own networks.
  • Serve as SCD's primary liaison to the Marketing team, bridging internal and external communications to ensure messaging, branding, and storytelling are aligned; collaborate on shared content, campaigns, and creative needs, and keep both teams informed of upcoming initiatives.
  • Curate, build, and distribute On the Radar, Full Sail's weekly employee email newsletter, coordinating content submissions from departments across the university.
  • Research, interview, and write spotlight features on faculty, staff, and teams, as well as recap stories from on- and off-campus events.
  • Draft, build, and deliver employee emails and emergency/priority communications using Eloqua, Outlook, and other enterprise communication systems, following established review and approval protocols; occasionally support communications on behalf of other departments as needed.
  • Maintain the SCD email inbox, monitoring, triaging, and responding to inquiries in a timely manner and routing requests to the appropriate team members.
  • Partner with the Strategic Projects Manager to develop and execute communications plans for SCD programs and initiatives, including but not limited to New Employee Orientation (NEO), Navigator School, Hall of Fame staff programming, leadership trainings, recognition ceremonies, and The President's Message.
  • Maintain the internal communications calendar, coordinating the timing of messages across channels and departments; track communications deliverables in Monday.com in alignment with SCD's master project tracker.
  • Attend and support SCD events and programs, both in person and online, capturing notes, interviews, and content for follow-up communications.
  • Submit and manage production requests for graphics and creative assets that support written communications (email banners, thumbnails, etc.), maintaining branding consistent with organizational standards.
  • Partner with SCD's Data & Reporting Analyst to collect data and report on internal communications, employer brand, and employee advocacy reach and engagement; use results to recommend data-informed improvements that increase employee engagement.
  • Research external best practices and emerging trends in internal communications to continually evolve SCD's approach, identifying opportunities to innovate and integrate new technologies and tools that improve how employees receive and engage with information.
  • Respond to feedback from staff and stakeholders and adjust communications content and approach accordingly.
  • Design and deliver presentations related to internal communications as needed.
  • Research external best practices in project management, organizational development, and strategic planning to inform SCD's approach.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Attend meetings to receive leadership development and updates on strategic initiatives
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of company and personnel information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adhere to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:   NO


Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, marketing, English, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
  • 2+ years of professional writing, copywriting, editing, or communications experience; internal communications or higher education experience preferred.
  • Experience with employer branding, employee advocacy, or social media content strategy a plus.
  • Bilingual – fluency in Spanish preferred, both spoken and written.

Competencies

  • A love of storytelling and a passion for the Full Sail brand and voice.
  • Exceptional grasp of English grammar and writing mechanics, with strong editing and proofreading skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to adapt writing style and work across a variety of platforms and audiences.
  • Highly flexible and responsive to emergency/priority communications.
  • Excellent organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate comfortably with all levels of the organization, including senior leadership.
  • An openness and willingness to receive and act on feedback.
  • Analytical and critical thinking skills, specifically regarding qualitative and engagement data.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential communications with sound judgment.

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Office 365 (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, and other social and employer-brand platforms
  • Experience with Eloqua or a comparable email marketing platform preferred, with the ability to learn quickly
  • Ability to learn and utilize internal project management platforms (e.g., Monday.com)
  • Proficiency with Grammarly and other digital tools that support the writing process

Familiarity with Full Sail One and Workday, with a willingness to learn increased functionality


Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in a professional office environment. Occasional physical activities may be required, including bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping, and lifting or moving items weighing up to 30 pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Academic Advisor
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Academic Advisor reports to the Academic Advising Manager and supports students throughout their academic journey by providing guidance on academic policies, monitoring academic progress, and connecting students with resources to promote success. This role combines academic advising with proactive student support to foster engagement, retention, and achievement.


The position is located on campus in Winter Park; FL. Shifts may include nights and weekends.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Advise students on academic policies and procedures, including withdrawals, interruptions of training, changes in enrollment, and satisfactory academic progress.
  • Perform all job functions on-campus in Winter Park, FL, shifts may include nights and weekends.
  • Serve as a source of motivation and support to assigned cohorts by frequently reconnecting the student with their dreams and career aspirations.
  • Monitor student performance and proactively reach out to those with low GPAs, poor attendance, or minimal class involvement.
  • Mentor and advise students through scheduled in-person or virtual appointments and walk-in sessions.
  • Initiate and process academic paperwork such as Withdrawal Forms and Interruption of Training documentation.
  • Meet with students and/or parents in person and virtually provide academic and personal support.
  • Collaborate with Course Directors, Academic Coordinators, Academic Success teams, and Registrars to ensure coordinated student support.
  • Maintain and update referral resources for academic, personal, and career support.
  • Address student complaints, concerns, or suggestions in a professional, constructive, and timely manner.
  • Encourage student engagement and persistence through outreach and support initiatives.
  • Empower students to establish goals and develop skills for personal and professional growth.
  • Assist students in navigating university systems, accessing available resources and finding creative solutions to their challenges.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to Full Sail University’s mission and values.
  • Adhere to Full Sail University’s policies and procedures.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of students and institutional information.
  • Comply with company attendance standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:   NO

Competencies:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to multitask and work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Passion to encourage learning.
  • Crisis handling skills.
  • Effective listening skills, assertiveness, and enthusiasm.
  • Service-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to helping others.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree is strongly preferred, with emphasis in Social Work, Education, Psychology, Counseling, or a related field.
  • Minimum of one year of experience in student support, academic advising, admissions, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in a university or higher education setting preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  • N/A

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Comfortability navigating cloud-based systems and learning new software programs.
  • Familiarity with digital communication tools and CRM platforms
  • Ability to research situations using all available university databases and resources.

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in an office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active customer and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system; enter alphanumeric data into a computerized system often while listening on the telephone. (May be subject to bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping, and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.)

jobs.title: Student Loan Management Advisor
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The primary responsibility of the Student Loan Management Advisor is to contact active, graduate, and withdrawn students and explain available repayment options to assist with avoiding default on Federal Loans. This is an entry-level customer service position.

***Positions are located on and worked from campus in Winter Park, Florida.***

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Be a Full Sail University ambassador embracing our unique educational model, while maintaining the highest level of integrity, professionalism, and customer service
  • Contact graduate and withdrawn students in danger of defaulting and explain available repayment options to assist with avoiding default
  • Counsel students on use of National Student Loan Database System to track loan history, lenders and services
  • Complete In-School Deferment Requests
  • Interacts with other University departments such as the Financial Aid Team, Registrar’s Office, Student Services, and Career Development to resolve issues to achieve daily goals
  • Support the preparation of student records for annual audit
  • Provide recommendations to Management regarding policy and procedures
  • Make best use of debt management tools and reporting
  • Complete special projects as assigned
  • Serve as a lifelong resource to students needing assistance with loan repayment
  • Other tasks as required

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adhere to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of company and personnel information
  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adhere to company attendance standards
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:   

  •  No

Competencies:

  • Detailed-oriented
  • Ability to interact with students and staff in fast-paced environment
  • A friendly, professional demeanor, verbal and written communication skills, as well as proven excellence in customer service are essential
  • Ability to multitask and communicate effectively, using critical thinking and analysis skills


Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience preferred, but not required
  • Customer service experience preferred

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Proficient in Windows and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint) and comfortable with technology


Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in an office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active customer and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system; enter alpha-numeric data into a computerized system often while listening on the telephone. May be subject to bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds. This position is based on Full Sail University’s campus in Winter Park, Florida and can be performed on a hybrid basis to work from home and from campus. Full Sail management reserves the right to end hybrid positions at any time and require employees to work from campus permanently.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

  • Ability to work independently and efficiently

jobs.title: Adjunct Faculty - Digital Marketing
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

Students in the Digital Marketing Master of Science degree program explore the full range of digital marketing strategies and tactics that organizations use to reach their specific target audiences. The emphasis of the program is on practical application of marketing theories to develop campaigns that successfully achieve organizational objectives. The curriculum covers the tools that companies and non-profits use to market in the digital space, and utilizes course content that is continually updated to reflect the dynamic nature of the industry.

This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, on-campus OR online and must be resident in the state of Florida.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment of learning through effective teaching skills, maintain student-centered focus, and stay current with relevant industry standards.
  • Utilize a variety of teaching strategies and encourage active learning.
  • Perform lectures for campus courses, and hold scheduled virtual course meetings for online courses. Teaching will be conducted through on-campus and online delivery.
  • Interact positively with diverse student populations; provide all students with equal opportunities for learning.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the industry, maintain knowledge and skill relevancy through continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:  None

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including proofreading and editing for grammar and punctuation
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently and collaboratively with other teachers and university staff
  • Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in an immersive, fast-paced environment

Education and/or Experience: 

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of four (4) years related and verifiable work experience and is required to hold a Ph.D. in Marketing, Business Administration or a terminal degree with 18 graduate semester hours in an appropriate combination of the following subject areas: Business Administration, Business Management, E-commerce, Entrepreneurship, International Marketing, Marketing, Marketing Research, or Marketing Management from an accredited college or university. 

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  • None

Skills:

  • Proficiency using operating systems such as Office365 and applications such as MS Word, Excel, Keynote/PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Solid understanding of all areas of digital marketing
  • Solid understanding of the landscape of new media as it relates to marketing
  • Experience with virtual and live presentation creation and delivery


Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

May be subject to; bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

Full Sail University is seeking faculty with expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), OR Data Science. Topics covered will include Fuzzy Logic, Expert Systems, Neural Networks, Cognitive Sciences, Supervised Learning, Unsupervised Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Clustering, Regression, and Classification. Additional focus will be placed on HCI principles such as user-centered design, usability testing, interaction design, and accessibility, as well as Data Science topics including data preprocessing, statistical analysis, data visualization, feature engineering, and big data tools. Students will apply these techniques to create knowledge-based AI agents, machine learning solutions, interactive intelligent systems, and data-driven applications. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

In the Film Production Master of Fine Arts degree program, students learn the artistic, technical, professional, and academic aspects of filmmaking. The program provides aspiring filmmakers with the advanced creative, technical, and aesthetic knowledge and skills required to produce, crew, and package a professional feature-length or short film. This comprehensive program integrates the study of numerous filmmaking disciplines, including screenwriting, visual storytelling, directing, editing, and producing. Students master these concepts through project-based learning in a program that mirrors the real-world, professional filmmaking environment. Students will also be trained on current filmmaking technologies and will learn how to utilize academic research methodologies in their work. Graduates of the Film Production master of fine arts degree program leave prepared for the professional film industry and are equipped with a range of technical and creative skills needed for career success. This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, on-campus OR online and must be resident in the state of Florida.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer (Ruby)
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

Join a collaborative engineering team improving education for thousands of students.

We're looking for a Senior Software Developer who wants more than just tickets to close. We want someone who thinks deeply about technical solutions, drives meaningful improvements, and takes ownership of their work. You'll have real influence in architectural and product decisions as we modernize our learning platform, tackling challenges in performance, scalability, and usability that affect thousands of students and instructors daily.

This isn't abstract product work. We are surrounded on campus by those who trust our platform for daily instruction, feedback, and collaboration. The features you build will help learners complete degrees, stay engaged, and succeed academically.

You'll work alongside a small but mighty team that values code quality, shares knowledge, and enjoys solving problems together. We believe the best software comes from teams where engineering voices matter, product vision is shared, and everyone is invested in both the craft and the mission.

If you care about elegant solutions, meaningful impact, and making education better then we'd love to talk.

The Senior Software Developer is responsible for independently designing, developing, and maintaining robust software applications that support Full Sail University’s business needs. They provide mentorship and technical leadership to more junior developers.

*** This position is located and worked on campus in Winter Park, Florida ***

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Design and Development

  • Lead Software Development: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex software systems and applications.
  • Architect, Write and Optimize Code: Define and implement coding standards and best practices, ensuring high-quality, scalable code. Write and optimize clean, efficient, and maintainable code, adhering to industry best practices.
  • Design Complex Systems: Architect and design robust, scalable software solutions, making high-level decisions on technical direction.
  • Explore and Adopt Improvements: Continuously explore and evaluate new tools, frameworks, and best practices to enhance the development process and maintain up-to-date technical knowledge
  • Oversee Troubleshooting: Manage and resolve critical issues and complex bugs, guiding the team through troubleshooting processes.
  • Collaborate Effectively: Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver software solutions that meet project goals.
  • Follow Security Best Practices: Ensure that applications appropriately control access to sensitive resources.
  • Ensure System Performance: Identify and implement performance improvements to ensure optimal user experience and system efficiency

• Software Development Lifecycle

  • Responsible for Documentation: Ensure comprehensive and high-quality documentation is created and maintained for complex systems and processes.
  • Lead Code Reviews: Drive the code review process, providing in-depth feedback and ensuring adherence to best practices across the team.

jobs.title: Drone Innovation Center Manager
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Drone Innovation Center Manager is responsible for leading the operations, programming, and strategic development of Full Sail University's Drone Innovation Center. This position sits within the Emerging Technologies team, reports to the Executive Director of Emerging Technologies, and collaborates closely with faculty, academic leadership, industry partners, and cross-functional student teams to deliver an exceptional, hands-on learning environment. The Manager will oversee all aspects of facility operations, curriculum related projects, team leadership, and technology integration, ensuring the Center remains at the forefront of drone innovation in higher education.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily operations of the Drone Innovation Center, including the following spaces: Advanced Airspace, Engineering & Manufacturing, Simulation & Programming, Communications, Remote Operations, and the Situation Room.
  • Collaborate with faculty and academic leadership across degree programs, including Simulation Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Live Event Production, and other programs, to develop and implement drone-focused projects and experiences that align with program curriculum and learning outcomes.
  • Develop concepts, strategies, and project plans with clearly defined objectives, milestones, and deliverables for drone programming, competitions, demonstrations, and research initiatives.
  • Manage a multidisciplinary team that may include engineers, student assistants, and third-party contractors to design and execute high-quality drone projects and educational experiences.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging drone technologies, tools, software platforms, and workflows to keep the Center's capabilities current and cutting-edge.
  • Plan and manage drone events, races, tournaments, live demonstrations, and other public-facing activities hosted at or in partnership with the Center.
  • Support and advise the Full Sail Drone Club, fostering student engagement and cross-disciplinary collaboration.
  • Maintain and enforce safety protocols, FAA regulations, and university policies governing drone operation within the facility.
  • Manage inventory, maintenance schedules, and procurement of drones, components, and facility equipment.
  • Maintain and expand professional knowledge through ongoing training, certifications, and participation in industry events related to unmanned aerial systems (UAS), autonomous navigation, and drone technology.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive environment that encourages experimentation and creative problem-solving.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information.
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization.
  • Adheres to company attendance standards.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities: ☒YES

If YES, then the below applies in addition to those listed in Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • May oversee Federal Work Study students associated with the Spatial Computing Innovation Lab.
  • Recruits, interviews, hires, and trains staff in their department.
  • Oversees the schedules and responsibilities of staff in their department.
  • Provides constructive and timely staff performance evaluations.
  • Follows established guidelines for employee disciplinary action as determined by Full Sail policies and procedures.

Competencies

  • Proven track record of managing technical facilities, programs, or cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, interpersonal, and leadership skills with an ability to mentor both staff and students.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with experience engaging students, faculty, executives, industry partners, and the public.
  • Creative thinker with a passion for technology-driven innovation in education.
  • Comfortable operating, troubleshooting, and teaching with a wide range of drone hardware and software platforms.
  • Agile and adaptable in a fast-evolving technology landscape.
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and events.
  • Professional demeanor with a focus on service, safety, reliability, and excellence.
  • Commitment to maintaining a collaborative and inclusive facility culture.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong safety mindset.
  • Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Education and/or Experience

The ideal candidate is an organized, technically skilled professional with hands-on experience in unmanned aerial systems (UAS), drone engineering or operations, project management, and team coordination. They bring a balance of operational rigor, creative vision, and a genuine enthusiasm for immersive, technology-driven education. A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Simulation Engineering, Game Development, Digital Media, or a related field is required. Equivalent professional experience in drone operations, UAS program management, or a related discipline will be considered.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

· FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate (required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire)

· Additional UAS certifications or advanced FAA credentials a plus

Computer/Equipment Skills

· Strong understanding of drone hardware platforms, flight controllers, and autonomous navigation systems.

· Proficiency with drone simulation software (e.g., VelociDrone or similar platforms).

· Experience with 3D printing, electronics assembly, or drone frame manufacturing preferred.

· Familiarity with AI, computer vision, and programming as applied to drone systems.

· Comfortable with live streaming, AV systems, and multimedia production tools as relevant to the Communications and Situation Room spaces.

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands

Work is performed in both an office and active facility environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may regularly interact with drone hardware, flight zones, manufacturing equipment, and AV systems. The employee must have the ability to maintain active communication with students, staff, and partners; access, input, and retrieve information from computer systems; and respond quickly in a dynamic lab setting. Subject to bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping, and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Public Relations Manager
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Public Relations Manager will work to develop strategic communication efforts that enhance the reputation, visibility, and credibility of Full Sail University. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive public relations strategies, managing media relationships, with a key focus on producing high-quality written content that supports institutional goals. The Public Relations Manager is a strong storyteller, skilled writer, strategic thinker, and a proactive relationship-builder with experience in higher education or mission-driven organizations. Must have a proven ability to manage the development, implementation, and execution of successful public relations strategy and campaigns.

***Positions are located on and worked from campus in Winter Park, Florida.***

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Strategic Communications & Media Relations

  • Develop and implement public relations strategies that align with institutional priorities and brand positioning
  • Serve as one of the primary media contacts for the institution, building and maintaining strong relationships with local, regional, and national media outlets
  • Manage media requests in a timely and professional manner
  • Pitch stories, respond to media inquiries, and coordinate interviews with faculty, staff, alumni, and leadership
  • Proven track record of ability to garner press/media coverage 
  • Support crisis communications in coordination with director & senior leadership as needed
  • Manage and organize large scale events including ribbon cuttings, grand openings, degree program launches, etc. 
  • Oversee measurement of PR impact through regular reporting 

Writing & Content Development

  • Demonstrate ability to create strong written content for advertorials, op-eds, byline articles, and keynote presentations 
  • Demonstrate ability to draft, edit, and distribute compelling and newsworthy press releases, media advisories, talking points, and statements
  • Ensure messaging is accurate, compelling, and aligned with institutional voice and standards
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify newsworthy stories and achievements
  • Maintain editorial standards and ensure consistency across all external communications
  • Collaborate with partners on strategic joint announcements, case studies, white papers etc. 

Advertising & Budget Management

  • Plan, execute, and manage paid advertising buys across print, digital, broadcast, and other media channels
  • Manage the public relations advertising budget, including vendor negotiations and performance tracking
  • Monitor campaign effectiveness and adjust strategies to maximize reach and return on investment

Awards, Rankings & Reputation Building

  • A primary function of this role is the overall management of strategic rankings, awards and accolades efforts on behalf of the university including seeking out new/relevant awards/rankings opportunities, managing completion of surveys/submissions, tracking results and amplifying positive results to internal and external stakeholders and audiences.
  • Identify, pursue, and manage submissions for institutional awards, rankings, and accolades
  • Manage and execute the gathering of data, narratives, and supporting materials to strengthen award applications
  • Track and report earned recognition and leverage them in external communications

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner with marketing, internal teams including but not limited to Full Sail’s creative agency and academic departments to support institutional initiatives
  • Collaborate with Full Sail’s Partners to execute strategic communications initiatives
  • Manage external vendors as needed
  • Stay current on higher education trends, media landscapes, and best practices in public relations

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of company and personnel information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:   No

Competencies:

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively with ability to manage multiple priorities under deadlines
  • Professional presence and discretion when working with senior leadership and media
  • Collaborative, proactive, and detail-oriented approach
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills with a demonstrated ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences
  • Familiarity with higher education governance, culture, and academic environments
  • Self-starter
  • Possess a deep understanding of public relations, digital reputation management, and project/campaign management skills

Education and/or Experience:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 to 7 years of progressively responsible experience in public relations, or corporate communications, preferably in higher education or a complex organization
  • Proven experience with media relations, press release distribution, and advertising buys
  • Experience managing budgets and measuring campaign effectiveness
  • Experience working with rankings organizations, award programs, or accolades-related communications

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  n/a

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Proficient in Microsoft 356 (Word, Outlook, OneDrive, Excel) Keynote, Zoom
  • Exceptional working knowledge of a variety of public relations / project management programs: (ex. CisionOne, PR Newswire, Monday, Workfront, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of a variety of AI Platforms

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in an office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active customer and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system; enter alphanumeric data into a computerized system often while listening on the telephone. (May be subject to bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.) Ability to work nights and weekends as needed. 

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Security Officer is responsible for ensuring a safe and secure campus that fosters an optimal learning environment.

***Positions are located on and worked from campus in Winter Park, Florida.***

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Acts as a deterrent to unsafe or poor behavior by patrolling the campus, monitoring student behavior, enforcing University policies, intervening in physical encounters, monitoring security cameras, monitoring visitors, reporting unsafe or unhealthy conditions, and assisting administrators and/or public officials with emergency or investigative situations
  • Responds to alarms and dispatched calls
  • Completes appropriate incident reports when necessary


Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of company and personnel information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned


Competencies:

  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to deal with all levels of personnel and the general public in a  professional manner
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations
  • Ability to understand, follow, and enforce safety codes, regulations, and procedures


Education and/or Experience:

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • One year of security experience or any equivalent combination of experience and/or education


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Must possess a valid Florida Security D license
  • and a valid Florida Class D drivers license and maintain both during employment
  • Must be able to pass a background check including criminal, credit, and driving history
  • Certification in CPR & First Aid preferred


Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Familiarity using software programs such as MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook
  • Familiarity with camera and access control software such as WinPak is a plus

Work is performed in various environments including adverse outdoor conditions; involves some exposure to hazards, physical risks, and unusual elements such as: extreme temperatures, dirt, dust, fumes, smoke, unpleasant odors, and/or loud noises. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to move about campus; ascend/descend stairs, ramps, and occasionally ladders; run as needed; lift or carry up to 40 pounds; read, observe, and inspect security monitors; communicate with public and co-workers; and operate a motor vehicle. Employee must be able to work a flexible schedule including days, nights, weekends, holidays, rotating shifts, mandatory overtime, and extended hours when requested by management.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Adjunct Faculty - Recording Arts BS (REMOTE-FL)
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The goal of the Recording Arts Bachelor of Science degree program is to provide students with the focused skills and knowledge of audio engineering needed to qualify for entry-level industry positions as recording engineers, mix engineers, postproduction and game audio engineers, digital audio workstation operators and programmers, music/effects/dialogue editors, live-production engineers, and a variety of other positions in the audio industry. In addition to technical proficiency and creative development, the education provided through this program will help students develop critical-thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills that contribute to lifelong learning, providing them with tools to help sustain a long and productive professional career in the entertainment and media industries. This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, on-campus or online and must be resident in the state of Florida.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment of learning through effective teaching skills, maintain student-centered focus, and update curriculum to keep current and relevant to industry standards.
  • Utilize a variety of teaching strategies and encourage active learning.
  • Create learning activities, including assignments, tests, quizzes and labs, and assess student outcomes in a timely manner through effective assessment and constructive feedback to students to support the learning process.
  • Perform lectures for campus courses, and hold scheduled virtual course meetings for online courses. Teaching will be conducted through on-campus and online delivery.
  • Interact positively with diverse student populations; provide all students with equal opportunities for learning.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the industry, maintain knowledge and skill relevancy through continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:  None

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including proofreading and editing for grammar and punctuation
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently and collaboratively with other teachers and university staff
  • Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in an immersive, fast paced environment

Education and/or Experience:

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of four (4) years related and verifiable work experience and are required to hold a Bachelor’s degree in Recording Arts, Audio Production, Audio Engineering, Music Technology, Studio Music, Commercial Music, Media Writing and Production, Music Studio Composition, or related discipline from an accredited college or university required.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  • na

Skills:

  • Proficiency using software programs such as MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Expertise in studio recording, mixing and/or audio production.
  • Professional studio experience strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with music technology software including Logic Pro and Pro Tools is strongly preferred

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in a recording studio, project studio, computer lab environment, or live event production facility. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to communicate effectively with students, instructors, and support staff, and interact appropriately with computer systems, and audio, video, and lighting production equipment as necessary. May be subject to; bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Game Business and Esports BS program is seeking faculty to teach courses in game business. Topics range from the study of business monetization and operations, digital engagement, events, and community interactions. Students will learn to connect consumers to brands, generate revenue for businesses, and host events for various audiences. This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, online, and must be resident in the state of Florida

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment of learning through effective teaching skills, maintain student-centered focus, and update curriculum to keep current and relevant to industry standards.
  • Utilize a variety of teaching strategies and encourage active learning.
  • Create learning activities, including assignments, tests, quizzes and labs, and assess student outcomes in a timely manner through effective assessment and constructive feedback to students to support the learning process.
  • Perform lectures for campus courses, and hold scheduled virtual course meetings for online courses. Teaching will be conducted through on-campus and online delivery.
  • Interact positively with diverse student populations; provide all students with equal opportunities for learning.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the industry, maintain knowledge and skill relevancy through continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:  n/a

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to explain complex concepts in simple terms
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills, including proofreading and editing for grammar and punctuation
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently or collaboratively with other teachers and university staff
  • Ability to interact with students and staff at all levels in a fast paced environment

Education and/or Experience:

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of four (4) years related and verifiable work experience and required to hold a Bachelor's or Master's (preferred), in digital media, marketing, business, broadcast production, management, etc. from an accredited college or university. 


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  •  n/a

Skills:

  • Experience in game business and operations
  • Knowledge of game product lifecycle
  • Experience with gaming cultures
  • Proficiency in event production
  • Proficiency using software programs such as MS Word, Excel, Keynote/PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Project Management
  • Proficiency in online learning, specifically ability to navigate, populate, manage, and assess materials in a learning management system
  • Ability to provide useful feedback

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in an office and classroom environment.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active student and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system. May be subject to; bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

Full Sail University currently has openings for Adjunct Faculty in the Computer Animation and Game Arts programs. Adjunct Faculty ensure excellence in teaching skills and classroom content and deliver the same excellence in the labs, ensure personal service to students, maintain continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan. This position requires 3D industry experience as well as strong practical and formal knowledge of production pipeline. Experience in surface flow, anatomical models, and production modeling techniques is necessary, traditional art skills preferred.

This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, on-campus or online and must be resident in the state of Florida.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment of learning through effective teaching skills, maintain student-centered focus, and stay current with relevant industry standards.
  • Utilize a variety of teaching strategies and encourage active learning.
  • Perform lectures for campus courses, and hold scheduled virtual course meetings for online courses. Teaching will be conducted through on-campus and online delivery.
  • Interact positively with diverse student populations; provide all students with equal opportunities for learning.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the industry, maintain knowledge and skill relevancy through continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:  None

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including proofreading and editing for grammar and punctuation
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently and collaboratively with other teachers and university staff
  • Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in an immersive, fast-paced environment

Education and/or Experience:

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of four (4) years related and verifiable work experience and is required to hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Animation, Interactive Design, Game Art, or related discipline from an accredited college or university. 

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  •  N/A

Skills:

  • Proficiency using software programs such as Autodesk Maya, Pixologic zBrush, Adobe Photoshop, Substance Painter
  • There also needs to be demonstrated expert skills in modeling vehicles and environments
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

Work is performed in an office and classroom environment.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active student and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system. May be subject to; bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Camp Facilitator
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Full Sail Labs Camp Facilitator works with K-12 youth on a daily part-time basis (Monday-Friday) facilitating enriched, educational programs focused on technology, entertainment, art, and media. Part-time hours can range from 25-50 hours per week. This is a temporary (May - August) position.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate different types of technology-art related curriculum
  • Know, enforce, and follow all safety guidelines associated with the organization
  • Responsible for the safety and security of children on a daily basis
  • Ensure children are aware of rules, routines, and daily schedules
  • Ensure proper procedures are followed for sign-in/out of children
  • Establish a relationship with each child and know his/her/their present level of understanding and productivity
  • Consider the needs of all children and treat each child with respect and dignity
  • Interact with parents to establish rapport and articulate how child is performing
  • Assist in daily maintenance of facility, equipment, and supplies inventory
  • Maintain positive staff/colleague/peer relations
  • Problem-solve through situations and seek assistance when necessary
  • Communicate regularly with Supervisor regarding concerns, updates, and challenges
  • Assist with routine parent/guardian communications and updates
  • Remain up-to-date on emergency procedures and facility resources
  • Assist with research, development, implementation and revision of program curriculum where needed


Other Responsibilities:

  • Participate in extensive training
  • Attend scheduled team meetings
  • Maintain proper and timely correspondence with team and management
  • Adhere to the policies and procedures of Full Sail Labs and Full Sail University
  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adhere to Full Sail Labs standards, including attendance and wearing uniform
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Management

Competencies:

  • Teach, lead and manage groups of children with a variety of age and skill levels
  • •Interpersonal Skills – teamwork, motivation, flexibility, patience, empathy
  • •Organizational Skills – time management, communication, goal setting
  • •Excellent Character, Integrity and Personal Accountability
  • •Enthusiasm and a Sense of Humor

Education/Experience:

  • Minimum of two years completed in education (art-technology education preferred), related field
  • Previous work with children preferred, but not required

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • CPR certified (provided by the University, if not already certified upon hire)
  • Background Check/Fingerprinting (provided by the University, for more information visit - https://info.flclearinghouse.com)

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Knowledge of iPad and Apple technologies

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

  • Need to have the stamina to work with K-12 age range part-time, daily
  • Need to be comfortable working on your feet for long hours
  • Comfortable sitting on the floor and picking items up from floor
  • Comfortable hauling equipment between locations (laptops, iPads, robots, cameras, costumes, etc.)

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Accountant/Bookkeeper
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

Accountant/Bookkeeper job duties include working closely with our accounting team to create and analyze financial reports and ensure legal requirements compliance, process accounts payable and receivable and manage invoices and tax payments. Our ideal candidate holds a Finance degree and is familiar with accounting software packages.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Mail/Inter-Office Runner Coordination – daily mail sorting/routing to team members

  • Oversee AP, AR, cash flow management, and account reconciliation

  • Process check runs and manage payment schedules efficiently

  • Prepare/Process/Post Wire Transfers

  • Manage employee expense reimbursement and monthly employee credit card reconciliation.

  • Capability to analyze financial reports and records

  • Reconcile, review, and report daily cash activity and positions

  • Reconcile company balance sheet accounts

  • Participate in month end close procedures

  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts

  • Reconcile sub-ledger to general ledger account balances

  • Responsible for preparing sales tax work papers and submissions monthly

  • Post Adjusting Journal Entries

  • Support any financial and tax audits performed

  • Create ad hoc reports based on the accounting software as requested

  • Assist in special projects as requested

  • Ability to handle all confidential or proprietary information with proper consideration of ethical and legal ramifications

  • Contribute to the transition from paper-based filing systems to digital platforms, showcasing a tech-forward approach.

Competencies:

  • Handling multiple entities and maintaining a consolidated general ledger

  • Ability to prioritize workload to achieve effective results in a fast-paced and growing environment

  • Ability to work independently, in partnership with others, and in a collaborative role

  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills and the ability to multi-task

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Can safeguard company information by observing company security regulations

  • Be a catalyst for continuous improvement by making recommendations based on empirical data and business experience.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

  • 5+ years of senior level accounting experience

  • Familiarity with accounting and finance principles and procedures

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Strong knowledge and proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Adobe

  • QuickBooks Premier Accountant, Pro Advisor is a plus

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Work is performed in an office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to have ordinary ambulatory skills and the ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and manipulate (lift, carry, move) light to medium weights of 10-30 pounds. Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm, hand and finger dexterity, including ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard. The employee frequently is required to sit, reach with hands and arms, talk and hear.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Adjunct Faculty - Creative Presentation (Multiple Openings)
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

In the Creative Presentation course, students will learn the foundations of oral communication by building and delivering presentations of their own. Through this guided process, students will learn to effectively utilize visual storytelling techniques, create meaningful content, and apply lessons from myths and movies to shape the audience's journey. Multiple learning activities will allow students to creatively develop and analyze the core aspects of presentation, including audience, delivery, message, and the visual story. This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, on-campus or online and must be resident in the state of Florida.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create an environment of learning through effective teaching skills, maintain student-centered focus, and stay current with relevant industry standards.
  • Utilize a variety of teaching strategies and encourage active learning.
  • Perform lectures for campus courses, and hold scheduled virtual course meetings for online courses. Teaching will be conducted through on-campus and online delivery.
  • Interact positively with diverse student populations; provide all students with equal opportunities for learning.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the industry, maintain knowledge and skill relevancy through continuing education as defined in the faculty development plan.

Other Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to the policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of student and company information
  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adheres to company attendance standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:  None

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including proofreading and editing for grammar and punctuation
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to multi-task while working independently and collaboratively with other teachers and university staff
  • Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in an immersive, fast-paced environment

Education and/or Experience: 


The ideal candidate must have a minimum of four (4) years related and verifiable work experience and is required to hold a Master’s degree in Communications, Organizational Communications or a Master’s degree in a different subject with at least 18 graduate hours in an appropriate combination of the following subject areas: Business Communications, Communications, Mass Communications, Management Communications, Organizational Communications, or related discipline from an accredited college or university.  

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  


• N/A

Skills:


• Proficiency using software programs such as MS Word, Excel, Keynote/PowerPoint and Outlook
• Experience with public speaking and giving presentations as well as designing presentations
• Ability to interact professionally and constructively with students and staff at all levels in an immersive, fast-paced environment
• Teaching experience online and experience teaching on a campus
• Experience using Screen-capture web tools or software that allows for recording voice and screen


Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:


Work is performed in an office and classroom environment.  While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to have the ability to maintain active student and employee communication; access, input and retrieve information from the computer system. May be subject to; bending, reaching, kneeling, stooping and lifting up to thirty (30) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Veterans Affairs File Administrator
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

Administer all financial aid for veteran students from becoming active through to graduation; ensure compliance with all Title IV regulations; and create a positive and stress-free experience for all students.

Positions are on campus, in Winter Park, Florida.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Process Reports with timeliness and accuracy

  • Repackage Subsequent Academic Year Financial Aid and VA Benefits

  • Process Verifications on new ISIRs

  • Package Private, SFCA and Plus loans as needed

  • Process Audit Corrections

  • Respond to Student Advisor Requests

  • Adjust students’ packaging for Credits for Previous Training

Competencies:

  • Highly developed sense of integrity and commitment to student satisfaction.

  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both orally and in writing.

  • Strong decision making and analytical abilities.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Demonstrated time management and organizational skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple, competing tasks and deliver accurate and courteous service in a fast-paced and time sensitive environment with the ability to adapt to changing and competing priorities.

  • Ability to work within the scope of Title IV regulations.   

  • Proficiency with all Microsoft Office Suite software.

  • Demonstrate initiative and adaptability to change.

  • Ability to work independently and efficiently.

  • Ability to maintain highly sensitive, confidential academic and financial information in accordance with FERPA guidelines.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree plus two years of experience in an administrative position or equivalent combination of experience and education.

  • Must be in good standing in all Federal Title IV programs and remain current with federal, state, and institutional financial aid regulations.

Computer/Equipment Skills:

  • Microsoft Office Suite proficiency.

Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:

Physical requirements include remaining seated for potentially more than 8 hours per day, computer operation/data entry and minor lifting.
Must be flexible and able to work a 40 hour work week. May include some overtime, nights and weekends.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Floor Tech
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Floor Tech cleans floors with chemicals, tools and machines.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
•  Clean floors as trained, using a variety of methods.
•  Clean and maintain tools and equipment in working order.
•  Fill out daily work logs.
•  Once trained, able to train co-workers.
•  Verbal and written communication
•  Work schedule may include Saturday or Sunday, as well as overtime.

Other Responsibilities:
•  Adhere to policies and procedures of Full Sail University.
•  Maintain strict confidentiality of company and personnel information.
•  Demonstrate a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization.
•  Adhere to company attendance standards.
•  Learn and perform other tasks as assigned.
Competencies:
•  Able to speak, read and write in English or Spanish
•  Able to follow instructions (written and verbal)
•  Able to adapt to sudden changes in assignments
•  Good analytical and interpersonal skills
•  Able to work independently and in groups
•  Able to walk and stand for long periods of time
•  Able to work with cleaning chemicals
•  Able to work with tools and equipment
•  Able to wear and work with the safety equipment provided
Education and/or Experiences:
•  Minimal formal education required
•  Relevant work experience preferred

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:
•  Licensed drivers preferred

Computer/Equipment Skills:
•  Some computer knowledge a plus
Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk for long periods of time. The employee will frequently be subject to noise, repetitive motions, bending, stooping, kneeling, squatting, reaching, pushing and pulling up to forty (40) pounds, as well as lifting and carrying up to forty (40) pounds.

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Student Tour Guide
jobs.description_html:
If you're looking for the chance to learn, grow, and make a contribution to the community, look at employment opportunities with Full Sail University. You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The Student Tour Guide acts as an ambassador for prospective students and guests attending Full Sail University’s Behind the Scenes Tour and any related Touring Department events.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide world-class customer service while interacting and engaging with potential students and visiting guests
  • Follow a pre-guided route to ensure guests arrive and depart appropriately
  • Assist with set-up and closing procedures on each event day
  • Answer general questions about Full Sail University and have knowledge of its facilities
  • Remain up to date on relevant information related to Full Sail University, the entertainment media industry, and Admissions Compliance standards
  • Assist with additional department related events as schedule permits


Other Responsibilities:

  • Adhere to policies and procedures of Full Sail University
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of company and personnel information
  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to the mission and values of the organization
  • Adhere to company attendance standards
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

You must be an active Full Sail student with a 3.0 GPA and 90% attendance or higher to apply for this position.

Competencies:

  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills
  • Strong “stage presence” with the ability to captivate diverse audiences while articulating general University information
  • Ability to interact with guests and staff at all levels in a fast-paced environment


Education and/or Experience:

  • Customer service experience is strongly recommended


Environmental Factors/Physical Demands:
Work is performed in various environments including outdoor weather conditions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to move about campus, communicate with public and co-workers, and occasionally lift or carry 30 pounds or more. 
 

Full Sail is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Transportation Deputy Director
jobs.description_html:
Salary Range

$67.87-$89.10

Job Posting End Date - Applications will no longer be accepted starting

11-28-2026

Job Summary

Performs professional, administrative, and supervisory work assisting the Director of the Transportation Department. Work includes the strategic oversight of and policy direction to the Transportation Planning, Engineering, Parking, Policy, and Special Events divisions that have financial, operational, environmental, and safety impacts. Work is performed under the direction of the Director of Transportation. Performance is reviewed through conferences, reports submitted, evaluation of accomplishments, and the efficiency and effectiveness of results obtained.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree in Planning, Public Policy, Transportation Engineering, or related field and four (4) years progressively responsible experience in transportation or related engineering, planning, or transportation policy required, to include at least three (3) years experience in a major administrative and supervisory capacity required; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

  • Rock Lake Neighborhood Center (Must pass DCF background check)
