jobs.company: Embassy Suites Orlando - Lake Buena Vista South
jobs.title: Assistant Food and Beverage Manager - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The Assistant Food & Beverage Manager is primarily responsible for planning and running the day –to-day operations of the department in the absence of the Food & Beverage Manager. Adherence to establish policies, standards and procedures are required at all times in order to achieve high levels of guest satisfaction, quality service, compliance with corporate policies and procedures and local regulations while meeting/exceeding financial goals.

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a resort environment.
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in a leadership role in a food and beverage environment
  • Constant interactions and fulfilling the requests of guests.
  • Must be able to handle a multitude of tasks in an ever-changing environment with a sense of alertness.
  • Must possess outstanding guest services and communication skills.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle.

Responsibilities

  • Understands expectations and parameters for the Food and Beverage activities.
  • Manages and communicates details both verbally and in writing to the guest and hotel operations.
  • Manage beverage purchasing, beverage menu designing, marketing of new products and VIP guest requests.
  • Strong food/wine and liquor knowledge.
  • Excellent customer service skills.                                                      
  • Manage all Front of House positions, including scheduling, developing and coaching associates, motivating the team and continuing to drive sales.
  • Must have excellent organizational, interpersonal, and administrative skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, work under pressure and work independently.
  • Ability to deal with internal and external customers, some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact, and diplomacy accurately to resolve conflicts.
  • Maintain safety by adhering to stated safety policies and handling guest and associate accidents.
  • Spot-check guest checks to ensure proper check handling procedures are being adhered to.
  • Be aware of the budget and continuously work towards achieving budgeted goals.
  • Keep storerooms in a state of readiness, cleanliness and tidiness.
  • Schedule dining room associates with forecasted business ensuring that staffing is adequate.
  • Promote and maintain good associate relations between service kitchen and dining room.
  • Lead efforts in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring of associates.
  • Attention to detail and strong sense of urgency.
  • Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs or special projects in the Food and Beverage department.

Education

  • Two-year degree from an accredited college or university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration or related major.
  • Minimum two years’ experience in a Food and Beverage position.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language. Second language is a plus.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician 3 - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The Engineer III will perform hotel for general repairs, preventative maintenance, and other routine work in and around the hotel as needed. Cooperate and assist Engineering management in the achievement of hotel and department goals.

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a AAA 4+ Diamond Resort.
  • A minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in a hotel or directly related industry.
  • Knowledge of carpentry, plumbing, and electrical, is required.
  • Knowledge of hotel fire standards and procedures.
  • Able to work independently and exercise judgment to resolve personnel and production issues that arise, with minimal supervision.
  • Perform rigorous tasks including working from ladders, under equipment, and handling awkward materials or apparatus required of tasks assigned.
  • This position will require the operation of a motor vehicle.


Responsibilities

  • Perform repairs of physical property, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical equipment - ensuring methods, materials, practices meet company standards, and Local and National codes.  
  • Repair hotel guest rooms as assigned under the Preventative Maintenance program.
  • Report broken or misused equipment to Engineering Manager or Director
  • Ensure that safety systems are operable.
  • Follow Occupational Health & Safety regulations.
  • Assist in the maintenance of the department’s inventory by reporting needed supplies.
  • Knowledge of Safety Data Sheet, product labeling, proper storing, and handling of materials.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.


Education

  • High school diploma
  • Experience in a large hotel environment preferred.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language; Second language is a plus.
  • Knowledge of proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques, and use of equipment/ machinery.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends, including overnight shifts.
  • Able to perform multiple tasks.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be physically fit to lift, pull, and push items up to 50 pounds.
  • Also requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift (up to 8 hours).
  • Must be able to work in extreme temperatures like freezers (-10°F) and kitchens (+110°F).

jobs.company: Embassy Suites Orlando - Lake Buena Vista South
jobs.title: Chocolatier - Pastry - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The primary function of the Chocolatier is processing cocoa beans, tempering chocolate, molding chocolate, and storing chocolate properly. The Chocolatier is devoted to providing the best customer service and the highest quality product.

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a resort environment.
  • Experience as a chocolatier or equivalent experience required.
  • Able to handle a multitude of tasks in an ever-changing environment.
  • Possess outstanding guest services skills, professional presentation, and sophisticated communication skills.
  • A food handling certification must be completed within the first 90 days of employment.

Responsibilities

  • Produce all chocolates for the complex, logo amenities, chocolate showpieces and large seasonal displays, mise en place, molding, assembly, chocolate airbrushing, and addition of final details.
  • Assist in the daily operation of the Pastry Department.
  • Accurately follow proper techniques of tempering: time, temperature, and crystallization. Scale, make ganache’s, cut, age and dry for preservation, enrobing of ganache’s and other specialty pastries.
  • Ensure proper inventory, rotation and storage for chocolate truffles and boxes while maintaining appropriate par levels to prevent spoilage.
  • Responsible for purchasing ingredients including nuts, flavorings, and specialty chocolate.
  • Follow Occupational Health & Safety regulations.
  • Ensure equipment and kitchen cleanliness.
  • Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients according to recipes, using various kitchen utensils and equipment.
  • Mix icings, frosting, and glazes to decorate pastry items using icing bags, cutters, and miscellaneous hand tools.
  • Strong knowledge of food safety with critical control temperatures, danger zones, cross contamination, sanitization, food borne illness, toxins, and chemical poisoning.
  • Ensure the team leader is aware of any special products needed for upcoming functions.
  • Must stay current and up to date with trends.
  • Perform any other reasonable requests made by your manager or supervisor.

Education

  • High School diploma and/ or experience in a resort hotel or a related field preferred.
  • Culinary certification or degree preferred.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language (Second language is a plus); Must be a team player.
  • Knowledge of proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques and use of equipment & machinery.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends.

Physical Requirements

  • Physical agility and ability to move quickly in confined spaces.
  • Also requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.
  • Ability to push / pull 50 lbs.
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs.
  • Stand or walk for extended periods of time.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Front Desk Agent - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The Front Desk Agent is responsible for a professional, yet personal and efficient check-in and check-out for each guest of the resort. He/she will process all payments according to established resort requirements and provide information to guests, as well as visitor inquiries in person or via telephone. In addition, the Front Desk Agent is expected to complete daily checklists and always demonstrate professional courtesy.

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a AAA 4-Diamond Resort.
  • One (1) year experience in a Hotel or Resort Front Desk position.
  • Outstanding guest service skills.
  • Able to handle a multitude of tasks in an ever-changing environment.
  • Effective at listening to, understanding, clarifying, and responding to the concerns and issues raised by guests and members.
  • Experience with cash handling, including but not limited to guidelines set forth regarding PCI Compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Approach all encounters with guests, employees, and members in a professional and personalized manner.
  • Responsible for providing prompt yet personal service at times of check-in & check-out.
  • Assist management in applying credit and guest billing policies.
  • Resolve all guest concerns to conclusion including working with other departments to ensure guest satisfaction.
  • Always maintain a professional and high-quality service-oriented environment.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of all guest and member information and pertinent resort data, as well as the security of high-profile guests or members in accordance with the Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel standards.
  • Understand and communicate promotions and enhancements effectively with Associates and guests.
  • Build rapport with VIPs and distinguished visitors, follow up calls, encourage feedback throughout guests’ stay.
  • Offer to handle special arrangements during guest stays; coordinate future visits.
  • Maintain database of guest preferences and special dates.
  • Actively participate in training and continuing education related to the Front Desk.
  • Complete projects in a timely manner as required by the Front Desk Manager, and Supervisors.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management.

Education

  • High school diploma or GED or degree in Hospitality related major.

Skills and Abilities

  • Able to communicate in the English language. Second language is a plus.
  • Able to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends and able to perform multiple tasks.
  • Experience using software programs such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
  • Proficient in Opera, Nuvola, Runtriz (or similar programs).

Physical Requirements

  • On a continuous basis, stand at a desk for long periods of time in front of a computer screen.
  • Also requires walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.
  • Must be physically fit to lift, pull, and push items up to 50 pounds.

jobs.title: Laundry Supervisor - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of position

The Laundry Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the hotel’s laundry department, ensuring the efficient processing, cleanliness, quality, and timely availability of linens, towels, uniforms, and other laundered items. This position leads and supports the laundry team, maintains department standards, monitors equipment and supplies, and ensures compliance with hotel safety and sanitation procedures.

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a resort environment.
  • Effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying concerns and issues raised by team members and hotel guests.
  • Knowledge of proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques and use of equipment/ machinery.
  • Previous housekeeping experience in a large hotel environment preferred.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise, train, schedule, and support laundry department team members to ensure efficient daily operations.
  • Oversee the collection, sorting, washing, drying, folding, pressing, and distribution of hotel linens, towels, uniforms, and other laundry items.
  • Ensure all laundered items meet established cleanliness, quality, and presentation standards.
  • Monitor daily laundry volume and prioritize workloads based on hotel occupancy and operational needs.
  • Inspect linens and other items for stains, damage, excessive wear, or quality concerns and remove items that do not meet standards.
  • Maintain appropriate par levels of clean linens and communicate shortages or operational concerns to Housekeeping leadership.
  • Operate and monitor commercial laundry equipment safely and efficiently, including washers, dryers, presses, folders, and related equipment.
  • Perform routine inspections of laundry equipment and report maintenance or repair needs promptly.
  • Ensure proper use and storage of laundry chemicals and supplies in accordance with manufacturer instructions and safety standards.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary laundry facility at all times.
  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, OSHA requirements, safety procedures, and applicable health and sanitation standards.
  • Maintain accurate records related to laundry production, inventory, equipment issues, and other departmental activities.
  • Communicate effectively with Housekeeping, Rooms Division, Maintenance, and other departments regarding linen needs and operational priorities.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, and a positive work environment.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management.

Education

  • High school diploma.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language (Second language is a plus).
  • Ability to perform assigned duties with attention to detail, speed, and accuracy.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends.
  • Able to perform multiple tasks.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be physically fit to lift, pull, and push items up to 50 pounds.
  • Also requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift (up to 8 hours).

Qualifications

jobs.title: Cook 3 - The Venetian Chop House - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The Venetian Chop House Cook 3 position requires a highly professional and dependable individual with well-rounded culinary experience and a strong commitment to quality. The ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of food safety and sanitation standards, proper food presentation, and the ability to accurately follow recipes and established procedures while consistently maintaining quality.

Position Requirements

  • Must possess outstanding guest services skills, professional presentation, and sophisticated communication skills.
  • Ability to handle a multitude of tasks in an intense, ever-changing environment.
  • Ability to maintain composure and objectivity while under pressure.
  • Effective at handling problems in the workplace, including anticipating, preventing, identifying, and solving problems as necessary.
  • Effectively listen to, understand, and clarify any concerns and/or issues raised by coworkers and guests.
  • Flexible in terms of working hours.
  • Able to assimilate complex information, including data from disparate sources and consider, adjust, or modify to meet the constraints of a particular need.
  • A food handling certification must be completed within the first 90 days of employment.

Responsibilities

  • Knowledge of meat identification and cookery for various cuts of beef, pork, veal, lamb, poultry, and corresponding cooking techniques.
  • Knowledge of fresh and saltwater fish, crustaceans, mollusks, and various mixed cooking techniques. Poaching, simmering, deep-frying, baking, broiling, sautéing, and pan-frying.
  • Knowledge of vegetable preparation. e.g., various cutting techniques such as brunoise, paysanne, dice, allumette, battonet, mince, julienne, Parisian, noissette. A solid knowledge of proper cooking preparations, boiling, blanching, steaming, grilling, pan frying, baking, and deep-frying.
  • Knowledge and ability to prepare different methods of starch cookery. e.g., risotto, rice, potatoes (croquettes, berny, marcaire, pont- neuf, dauphinoise, dauphine, château, duchesse) polenta, and pasta.
  • Knowledge of identification, classification, and preparation of mother sauces e.g., hollandaise, béchamel, tomato, Espanola, and velouté.
  • Knowledge and ability to identify and prepare secondary sauces such as Mornay, chasseur, choron, beurre blance, marchand de vin, curry and normande.
  • Knowledge of pantry positions products i.e., lettuce identification, classical salad presentation and preparations. 
  • Knowledge in identification and preparation of basic soups such as consommé, clear, cream, puree, bisques, and chowders as well as speciality and national soups using the various and proper thickening agents.
  • Must stay current and up to date with trends.
  • Approach all interactions with guests and employees in a friendly, service-oriented manner.
  • Maintain refrigerators and kitchen in clean, organized manner with all food items labeled and dated to facilitate the necessary production to achieve company goals.
  • Knowledge of Cook 1 and 2 performance objectives, as well as technical skills.
  • Must stay current and up to date with trends.
  • Follow Occupational Health & Safety Administration (OSHA) Regulations including thorough knowledge of food safety with critical control temperatures, danger zones, cross contamination, sanitation, food borne illness, toxins, and chemical poisoning.
  • Has basic knowledge and timely skills of various knife-cutting techniques, such as cutting, dicing, and slicing.
  • Must supply their own basic tools of the trade, i.e., Chef’s knife, paring knife, peeler, etc.
  • Refined skill set in the knowledge and preparation of garnishes.
  • Ensure equipment and kitchen cleanliness.
  • Keep production of food at an adequate level to prevent excess leftovers and waste.
  • Maintain regular attendance in compliance with the Hotel’s Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the Hotel.
  • Perform any other reasonable requests made by your manager or supervisor.

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Culinary certification or degree preferred and/or a minimum of 3 – 4 years of culinary experience.

  Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language (second language is a plus).
  • Knowledge of proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques and use of equipment and machinery.
  • Willing to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends.
  • Ability to multi-task and think clearly in high stress and intense situations.

Physical Requirements

  • Physical agility and ability to move quickly in confined spaces.
  • Requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.
  • Ability to push/pull 100 lbs.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Stand or walk for extended periods of time.
  • Work in areas of high heat and humidity.

jobs.title: Group Housing Coordinator - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The Group Housing Coordinator position represents Caribe Royale Orlando and Buena Vista Suites to meeting planners and multiple internal departments. The position is responsible for meeting planners and internal departmental communication, managing group blocks, understanding group contracts, providing internal and external reporting, and entering rooming lists among other things. This position must be able to communicate efficiently and professionally with guests, meeting planners, and other departments via email or phone while answering any questions and/or concerns with positive customer service.

Position Requirements

  • Must possess outstanding guest service skills, professional presentation, and sophisticated communication skills.
  • Must be able to handle a multitude of tasks in an intense, ever-changing environment.
  • Must be flexible in terms of working hours.
  • Must work well in high-pressure situations.
  • Must maintain composure and objectivity under pressure.
  • Must be effective at handling problems in the workplace, including anticipating, preventing, identifying, and solving problems as necessary.
  • Must be effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying the concerns and issues raised by coworkers and guests.

Responsibilities

  • Assist hotel group guests to ensure a successful event by being the housing and billing contact from the signing of the contract through departure.
  • Maintain professionalism through all communication mediums and interdepartmental collaborations.
  • Process all reservation requests, changes, and cancellations received by phone, email, or in person.
  • Identify meeting planner’s reservation needs, determine appropriate room type, and verify availability of room type and rate.
  • Use the hotel’s group contract for the meeting to ensure the special rate, hotel policies, all concessions, and contracted items are addressed and taken care of regarding guestrooms.
  • Accommodate and document special requests/ changes.
  • Set-up proper billing accounts
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures.
  • Ensure uniform and personal appearances are clean and professional.
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets.
  • Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
  • Ensure information entered into the Hotel’s Sales System downloads into the Hotel’s property management system correctly and matches the contract.
  • Create blocks in Passkey for downloading rooming lists and / or creating booking links.
  • Responsible for monitoring blocks in Passkey and the property management system.
  • Responsible for sending meeting planner reports pertaining to their blocks. This includes, but is not restricted to pick up, VIP assignments, audits, and any other requested information.
  • Responsible for sending an introduction to group contact once the group has been assigned.
  • Attend weekly meetings with the revenue team to give pertinent group information.
  • Attend formal meetings pertaining to the group that is assigned (Resume meetings, pre-plannings, Pre-convention meetings, etc.).
  • Effectively manage time without compromising service.
  • Demonstrates and adheres to company values.
  • Perform any other duties as requested by management.

Education

  • High School diploma and/or experience in a hotel or a related field preferred.

Skills and Abilities

  • Able to communicate in the English language; Second language is a plus.
  • Willing to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends.
  • Proficient in performing multiple tasks and assigning/delegating tasks to associates.
  • Experience using software programs such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
  • Previous knowledge of PMS system preferred, including Opera or similar programs.

Physical Requirements

  • On a continuous basis, sit at a desk for long periods of time in front of a computer screen.
  • Intermittently twist to reach equipment or supplies surrounding desk.
  • Use telephone and computer keyboard on a daily basis.
  • Must be physically fit in order to lift, pull and push items up to 50 pounds.
  • Also requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.

jobs.title: Purchasing & Receiving Clerk - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The Purchasing & Receiving Clerk is responsible for assisting with the procurement of goods and services, receiving and inspecting deliveries, and maintaining accurate inventory records. This position ensures that all items are ordered, received, and stored in accordance with company standards regulations.

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a resort environment.
  • Minimum of 1 -2 years’ experience in a similar position or equivalent.
  • Previous warehouse experience preferred.
  • Fort Lift Certification is a plus.
  • General knowledge of Excel/Word/Outlook.
  • General knowledge of food & beverage items.
  • Excellent mathematical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in sourcing and ordering food, beverage, housekeeping, maintenance, and other supplies.
  • Obtain quotes from suppliers and compare prices and quality to ensure best value.
  • Prepare purchase orders and submit them to suppliers after management approval.
  • Maintain and update vendor database.
  • Monitor inventory levels and place replenishment orders in a timely manner.
  • Receive, inspect, and verify the quantity and quality of incoming goods.
  • Check deliveries against purchase orders and delivery notes.
  • Tag and store goods properly in designated storage areas, following FIFO (First-In, First-Out) practices.
  • Coordinate with department heads to ensure timely delivery of goods to the appropriate locations.
  • Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.
  • Remove empty pallets, cardboard, and trash and place them in proper storage areas.
  • Protect company tools, equipment, machines, or other assets in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Assist department supervisor with special projects as needed.
  • Perform any other duties required by management.

Education

  • High school diploma, additional education in accounting a plus.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate in the English language. Second language is a plus. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to perform proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques, and use of equipment/machinery.  
  • Ability to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends and able to perform multiple tasks.

Physical Requirements

  • On a continuous basis, sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time.
  • Intermittently twist to reach equipment or supplies.
  • Use the telephone and computer keyboard daily.
  • Must be physically fit in to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 100lbs and push carts ranging from 200lbs – 500lbs.

jobs.title: Housekeeping Supervisor (PM Shift) - Caribe Royale Orlando Hotel
jobs.description_html:
Scope of Position

The Housekeeping Supervisor will inspect guest rooms, etc. after being cleaned by a Suite Attendant to ensure quality standards. He/she will maintain superior standards of presentation and cleanliness in all areas of the resort while ensuring the safety and confidentiality of all guests. The Housekeeping Supervisor will act as a leader to all housekeeping personnel and assist with guest/Associate issues.  

Position Requirements

  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a resort environment.
  • At least 1 year of Housekeeping Supervisor experience in a hotel or equivalent.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with guests, Associates, and housekeeping staff.
  • Ability to handle a multitude of tasks in an ever-changing environment.
  • Effective at listening to, understanding, clarifying and responding to the concerns and issues raised by guests.
  • Must be able to perform assigned duties with attention to detail, speed, accuracy, follow-through, courtesy, cooperativeness and work well with limited supervision.

Responsibilities

  • Approach all encounters with guests and Associates in a professional, service-oriented manner.
  • Verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms.
  • Conduct daily inspections of guest rooms and floors assigned to room attendants, and house attendants.
  • Notify Suite Attendant/House Attendant of any deficiencies found and return to correct when applicable.
  • Inspect show rooms.
  • Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. 
  • Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, and Front Office.
  • Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. 
  • Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes on assignment sheets/work boards.
  • Handle guest complaints and react quickly, logging and notifying proper areas to service guests.
  • Assist with and lead room attendant, turndown attendant, and house attendant with daily duties.
  • Communicate concerns/opportunities to the next shift. 
  • Must be able to perform all Room Attendant and House Attendant duties.
  • Confirm that all daily duties are completed to standard by: Room Attendants, and House Attendant.
  • Train and coach Associates on expected standards of service and conduct.
  • Report and follow up with engineering issues.
  • Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries. 
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management. 

Education

  • High school diploma or GED

Skills and Abilities

  • Able to communicate in the English language. Second language is a plus.
  • Able to work flexible schedules including holidays and weekends and able to perform multiple tasks.
  • Knowledge of proper chemical handling, cleaning techniques and use of equipment, machinery.
  • Experience using software programs such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).

Physical Requirements

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be physically fit in order to lift, pull and push items up to 50 pounds.
  • Also requires standing/walking/reaching and bending throughout shift.

jobs.title: Seasonal Golf Starter / Player Assistant
jobs.description_html:
Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort—the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Our Team Members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for each guest. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore is Orlando’s ultimate game changer. In a city known for its theme parks and endless lines, Evermore is the paradise guests crave on their days between park visits. Imagine endless relaxation around Orlando’s first and only beach paradise, Evermore Bay. Our stunning 8-acre crystal-clear lagoon is framed by zero-entry swim zones, beach bars, private cabanas, cozy firepits, and 20-acres of white sand. From beachside bars to a vibrant food hall and rooftop dining with views of the fireworks, we’ve crafted unforgettable experiences. Guests can challenge themselves on 2 Jack Nicklaus championship golf courses, enjoy water sports including kayaks and paddleboards, a family water slide, rope swing, and activities that fill their days including pickleball, bocce ball, and volleyball.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities: 

  • The starter will provide a warm and welcoming greeting to the start of our guests’ round of golf.
  • Observe the pace of play on the course and take proactive steps to ensure groups maintain a reasonable pace to prevent bottlenecks and delays.
  • Communicate with golfers to encourage adherence to course policies, maintaining a positive and respectful tone throughout interactions.
  • Offer exceptional customer service, addressing golfer inquiries, concerns, and requests professionally and courteously.
  • Provide assistance and guidance to golfers on matters such as course layout, distances, and local rules.
  • Maintain effective communication with the golf shop and other staff to manage player flow and address any issues promptly.
  • Coordinate with the golf shop to ensure a smooth transition of golfers from the Golf Shop to the first tee.
  • Provide the necessary information for guests to enjoy the golf experience.
  • Be prepared with the necessary supplies (tees, pencils, scorecards, ballmarks, etc..) for our guests.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education, Skills, and Experience 

  • Must have Golf Knowledge and be familiar with most golf terminology.
  • Attention to detail is a must.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must be highly organized and able to perform multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Problem solving and critical thinking.
  • Inspired to always represent Evermore brand values and standards.
  • Proficient in reading safety procedures and operating guidelines/ instructions in English.
  • Sees the extra mile as their starting point in each interaction.
  • Ability to foster relationships with teammates, potential clients, and resort guests.
  • Comfortable with starting and maintaining conversations with guests and Team Members.
  • Maintain the resort’s integrity and prestige by complying with all golf, sales and operational standards, policies, procedures, manuals, memos and instructions.
  • Must be able to work weekends, rotating schedule and holidays.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate with guests to enhance the scope of their experience and diffuse and resolve guests' concerns.

Physical Requirements:  

  • Must be able to safely and effectively navigate a 1100-acre resort in order to facilitate and host events and guests as required.
  • Must be able to lift 25lbs.
  • Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and reach periodically.
  • Must be able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including exposure to sun, wind, rain, and other elements.

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together.

We offer our Team Members competitive pay, along with a range of benefits including  FREE Life Insurance, FREE Short-Term Disability, FREE Long-Term Disability. Additionally, we provide affordable health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for your dependents. Furthermore, we offer a 401K with employer match, a robust paid time off policy, parental and grandparent leave, as well as family and pet bereavement leave. We also have unique policies in support of our team and significant relationships in their lives.

EOE/M/F/D/V

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Extend a warm welcome to guests/visitors, answer questions and provide directions.
  • Address guest’s issues promptly and professionally, escalating matters to the appropriate department if needed.
  • Must strive to provide exceptional customer service and create a positive first impression.
  • Process Evermore guest check-ins, check-outs, accommodation assignments, and accommodation change/late check-out requests.
  • Secure payment and verify identification; activate/reissue accommodation access credentials.
  • Ensure rates match market codes and document exceptions.
  • Verify/adjust billing for guests as needed.
  • Enter and locate guest or work-related information using computers, mobile devices and/or other electronic systems.
  • Coordinate with Housekeeping to track accommodation status and guest concerns.
  • Run and check daily reports, contingency lists, and credit card authorization reports. File guest paperwork or documentation.
  • Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns; follow up to ensure each has been met to guests’ satisfaction.
  • Arrange transportation for guests/visitors.
  • During peak arrival or departure times, must manage queues and maintain order to ensure an efficient flow of guests. Coordinate with other staff members to streamline the process and reduce wait times.
  • Must handle emergency situations and may be responsible for providing initial assistance or alerting the appropriate emergency services if required. They should be knowledgeable about resort emergency protocols.
  • Process operational needs, address guest requests, and complete reports.
  • Sharing highlights of the local area, the Gate Agent makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
  • Thorough knowledge of the layout of the resort, its offerings, and some knowledge of the city and surrounding areas.
  • Ability to effectively deal with internal and external customers. Some of whom will require high levels of patience, tact, and diplomacy to defuse tense situations.
  • Assist guests/visitors and Team members during emergency situations.
  • Handle all interruptions and complaints; escalate to the Manager on Duty as needed.
  • Call for assistance using proper code responses.
  • Complete a shift summary/daily activity or incident report.
  • Follow up with guests, Team Members, and operational partners to ensure their requests or problems have been satisfactorily resolved.
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets.
  • Report work-related accidents, or other injuries immediately upon occurrence to manager/supervisor.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with others; support the team to reach common goals.
  • Support the resort safety program to promote and ensure a safe working environment.
  • Build strong relationships with key leaders, vendors, contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Support other departments through direct and indirect action.
  • Flexible to work at various assigned locations based on operations demand.
  • Perform other related duties as

Education, Skills and Experience

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of 1 year experience in security, guest service or related professional area.
  • Valid Florida Driver’s License with acceptable driving record preferred.
  • Knowledge of security protocols.
  • Knowledge of company safety policies and applicable Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Able to communicate in other languages, preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.
  • Excellent communication, people person; ability to interact with a wide range of people.
  • Excels at customer service and relationship building.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Provide recommendations on beverage selections and answer any questions about the menu.

Education, Skills and Experience

  • Knowledge of alcoholic beverages and upselling.

  • Physical ability to carry trays, navigate outdoor environments, and stand for extended periods.
  • Organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene.
  • Familiarity with POS (Point of Sale) systems and basic math skills for handling payments.
  • Food, alcohol, and safety certifications under FL requirements. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to interact with a wide range of people.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Inspired always to lead Evermore brand and Team Member values.
  • Capable of performing the role in a busy work environment.
  • Proficient in reading safety procedures and operating guidelines.

 

Physical Requirements

  • Able to safely lift, pull and push up to 25 pounds.
  • Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and reach.
  • Subject to environmental conditions, work activities can occur inside and outside.

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together.

jobs.description_html:
Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Evermore resort redefining what it means to vacation together. Just steps from Walt Disney World®, Evermore spans 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel.

Our team members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for every guest. Here, guests create their own adventure — enjoying the best of both worlds: the comfort and privacy of multigenerational space, paired with the amenities and service of a world-class resort. Our eight-acre Evermore Bay, two championship golf courses, water sports facilities, pickleball courts, event spaces, and dining venues round out Evermore's luxurious, sophisticated offerings.

Key Responsibilities: 

  1. Supervise, train, and mentor Pressure Washing Technicians, leading by example and working hands-on alongside the team
  2. Partner with the Director of Landscape Exteriors to build and manage daily, weekly, and bi-weekly work schedules, coordinating with other departments on occupancy and guest arrivals so work is planned around guest stays
  3. Pressure wash and soft wash resort surfaces, including building exteriors, driveways, sidewalks, pavers, pool decks, fencing, signage, and resort vehicles, removing dirt, grime, mold, mildew, algae, and other stains
  4. Select and mix the proper cleaning solutions and techniques for each surface to treat stains without damaging buildings, finishes, landscaping, or nearby water features
  5. Inspect, troubleshoot, and perform routine maintenance on pressure washing equipment; report malfunctions and needed repairs to the Director
  6. Manage equipment, chemical, and supply inventory and place purchase orders as needed
  7. Monitor weather conditions and make timely decisions to adjust or reschedule work during inclement weather
  8. Ensure safety standards are met, including use of personal protective equipment (PPE), safe chemical handling and storage per Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and clearly marked work zones in guest areas
  9. Inspect completed work to ensure surfaces are clean, complete, and meet Evermore’s luxury standard
  10. Interact with guests warmly and professionally, answer questions or concerns about pressure washing activity, and escalate to leadership when needed
  11. Keep accurate records of areas completed, schedule progress, and any safety or equipment issues
  12. Perform other duties as assigned

Education, Skills, and Experience: 

  1. High School Diploma or equivalent
  2. 1 to 3 years in exterior cleaning, janitorial work, or power washing operations, including previous experience as a pressure washing technician or in a similar role
  3. Prior lead or supervisory experience preferred
  4. Working knowledge of different types of pressure washing and soft wash equipment and their proper, safe, and efficient use
  5. Familiarity with cleaning solutions and chemicals used in pressure washing, including safe mixing, handling, and storage
  6. Hands-on mechanical knowledge to troubleshoot and fix equipment malfunctions
  7. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality results
  8. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  9. Ability to remain calm and make quick decisions in stressful situations.
  10. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  11. Capable of performing role in a busy work environment
  12. Capable of working flexible scheduled hours, including weekdays, weekends, nights, holidays and rotating schedules.
  13. Proficient in reading safety procedures and operating guidelines / instructions in English
  14. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Google business or similar software.
  15. Proficient in standard computer programs and work order system.
  16. Clear communication skills and a guest-focused, team-first approach
  17. Valid driver’s license preferred

Physical Requirements: 

  1. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds
  2. Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and climb for extended periods
  3. Ability to work outdoors in Florida heat, humidity, and various weather conditions
  4. Ability to wear required PPE, such as safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, and non-slip footwear
  5. Flexibility to work overnight shifts, early mornings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require

Evermore Culture

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort—the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore is Orlando’s ultimate game changer. In a city known for its theme parks and endless lines, Evermore is the paradise guests crave on their days between park visits. Imagine endless relaxation around Orlando’s first and only beach paradise, Evermore Bay. Our stunning 8-acre crystal-clear lagoon is framed by zero-entry swim zones, beach bars, private cabanas, cozy firepits, and 20-acres of white sand. From beachside bars to a vibrant food hall and rooftop dining with views of the fireworks, we’ve crafted unforgettable experiences. Guests can challenge themselves on 2 Jack Nicklaus championship golf courses, enjoy water sports including kayaks and paddleboards, a family water slide, rope swing, and activities that fill their days including pickleball, bocce ball, and volleyball.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

 Key Responsibilities:  

  • Provide a warm and welcoming greeting to guests of the resort.
  • Responsible for serving customers, arranging merchandise and processing sales transactions.
  • Designing and setting up product displays.
  • Assisting other departments with uniform needs as needed with our existing vendors.
  • Monitor inventory levels and notify retail coordinator.
  • Engage guests in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Able to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Ensure products are presentable and clean.
  • Uphold accurate monthly records regarding stock transfers and sales adjustments.
  • Responsible for month-end inventory as needed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education, Skills, and Experience 

  • College degree and/or equivalent work experience preferred
  • Experience in retail operations
  • Good numerical and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to facilitate merchandise movement, packing, pricing, and replenishment.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate with guests to enhance the scope of their experience and diffuse and resolve guests' concerns.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must be highly organized and able to perform multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Problem solving and critical thinking.
  • Inspired to always represent Evermore brand values and standards.
  • Proficient in reading safety procedures and operating guidelines/ instructions in English.
  • Sees the extra mile as their starting point in every interaction.
  • Ability to foster relationships with Team Members, potential clients, and resort guests.
  • Comfortable with starting and maintaining conversations with guests and Team Members.

Physical Requirements 

  • Able to visually look at a computer for extended periods of time while using repetitive hand motions, such as typing.
  • Able to sit and operate a computer for extended periods of time
  • Able to stand, walk long distances, stoop, kneel, bend, and or reach periodically

The resort integrates resort-owned vacation rental homes, large-scale water features, and extensive recreational infrastructure. The eight-acre Evermore Bay lagoon includes advanced water treatment, circulation, and safety systems that require continuous monitoring. Two championship golf courses, numerous pools, water sports facilities, and a wide range of amenities, including pickleball courts, event spaces, and dining venues, further enhance the offerings. This diverse environment demands sophisticated engineering oversight to ensure optimal performance, safety, and reliability across all systems.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities:

  • To be a visible and helpful presence for golfers upon arrival and departure.
  • Help golfers prepare for their round by loading their bags onto golf carts and giving them proper directions to the golf shop and practice facility.
  • Attendants will greet guests as they return from golf and help them unload clubs from carts and assist with their departure.
  • Organize and manage golf bags, clubs, and other equipment in the bagroom.
  • Ensure golf carts are cleaned, charged, and ready for use at the start of each day.
  • Monitor and organize the golf cart fleet, ensuring they are properly stored and maintained.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe environment for golfers and staff.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Education, Skills, and Experience

  • Strong Golf knowledge preferred.
  • Attention to detail is a must.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Must be highly organized and able to perform multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Problem solving and critical thinking.
  • Inspired to always represent Evermore brand values and standards.
  • Proficient in reading safety procedures and operating guidelines/ instructions in English.
  • Sees the extra mile as their starting point in every interaction.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with other staff members to achieve common goals.
  • Ability to foster relationships with teammates, potential clients, and resort guests.
  • Comfortable with starting and maintaining conversations with guests and teammates.
  • Maintain the resort’s integrity and prestige by complying with all golf, sales and operational standards, policies, procedures, manuals, memos and instructions.

Physical Requirements: 

  • Must be able to work weekends, holidays and rotating schedule.
  • Must be able to safely and effectively navigate a 1100-acre resort in order to facilitate and host events and guests as required.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate with guests to enhance the scope of their experience and diffuse and resolve guests' concerns.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together.

We offer our Team Members competitive pay, along with a range of benefits including  FREE Life Insurance, FREE Short-Term Disability, FREE Long-Term Disability. Additionally, we provide affordable health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for your dependents. Furthermore, we offer a 401K with employer match, a robust paid time off policy, parental and grandparent leave, as well as family and pet bereavement leave. We also have unique policies in support of our team and significant relationships in their lives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Complete knowledge of hot and cold line stations.
  • Prep food items and prepare cold food items utilizing knives, slicers and other kitchen equipment.
  • Skillfully prepare and cook a diverse range of dishes in adherence to menu specifications, maintaining a superior standard of culinary excellence
  • Employ various cooking techniques and utilize kitchen equipment effectively to achieve desired flavors and textures.
  • Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion size for all food items, upholding the resort's high culinary standards.
  • Conduct rigorous quality checks on ingredients to ensure they meet the resort's exacting quality criteria.
  • Maintain a clean and organized workstation, strictly adhering to sanitation and safety guidelines.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior kitchen staff, contributing to a positive and productive work environment.
  • Utilize knives, slicers and other kitchen equipment safely and responsibly.
  • Cook and plate food according to recipes and menus utilizing a variety of equipment, including broilers, outdoor grills, stoves, fryers, ovens, steamers and kettles.
  • Operate kitchen equipment safely and responsibly.
  • Rotate food in walking coolers and freezers to minimize waste and spoilage.
  • Adhere to all food safety and sanitation standards.
  • Set up hot and cold line stations and food trams for transport.
  • Serve food in culinary stations while interacting with guests.
  • Stock and maintain designated food stations.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of work area.
  • Complete safety training and certifications
  • Coordinate and communicate effectively with fellow kitchen staff to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 Education, Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of two years of experience as a culinary cook in a restaurant and / or banquet environment
  • Ability to read and understand recipes, instructions and safety information in English.
  • Ability to obtain a food safety card.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Proficient in using knives and other kitchen tools for cutting, chopping, and slicing ingredients accurately and efficiently.
  • Capable of performing role in a busy work environment
  • Effective time management skills to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and efficiently handle high-pressure situations while maintaining precision and quality.
  • Strong communication abilities to liaise with team members and convey information accurately and efficiently.
  • Capacity to thrive in a collaborative team environment, actively contributing to the shared objectives of the kitchen.
  • Willingness to embrace new opportunities for learning and growth within a dynamic culinary setting.
  • Capable of working scheduled hours, including weekdays, weekends, holidays and rotating schedule.

Physical Requirements

  •  Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and / or reach repeatedly.
  •  Able to safely lift up to 50 pounds and carry, pull, and push heavy objects and materials.
  •  Able to be on feet and moving around for entire shift.
  •  Manual dexterity of hand to use all kitchen equipment.
  •  Ability to perform duties with varying temperature ranges.
  •  Sense of smell

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Safely operate company owned vehicles in accordance with all applicable state, federal and company rules, while adhering to all traffic laws, safety policies, and procedures.
  • Interact with guests and golfers, answer questions and provide directions.
  • Greet guests/Team Members and provide on boarding assistance.
  • Create memorable experiences during transportation service.
  • Maintain knowledge of all amenities and services offered at the resort and local area.
  • Apply knowledge of commercial driving and skills in maneuvering vehicle at varying speeds in difficult situations, such as inclement weather and confined areas.
  • Inspect vehicle daily and report any damage or safety concerns immediately to your leader.
  • Maintain accurate log of hours driven, vehicle maintenance and service requests.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance checks, fueling of vehicles and keep accurate logs.
  • Report maintenance defects to your leader.
  • Ensure cleanliness of vehicles, including interior and exterior.
  • Keep storage area clean, organized and stocked.
  • Report any accidents or incidents that may occur while operating the vehicle to your leader.
  • Be conversational with guests, remembering that the Driver will be a lasting impression for the guests.
  • Abide to required mandates by FMSCA and DOT requirements through FOLEY (tracking contractor).
  • Must maintain a good driving record and report any violations to your leader.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education, Skills and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL) Class A or B driver’s license with passenger endorsement and good driving record is required.
  • Must meet Evermore Orlando Resort’s MVR guidelines.
  • Previous driving experience.
  • Ability to read maps.
  • Knowledge of emergency procedures on the road.
  • Ability to interact with guests utilizing conversational English.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Capable of performing role in a busy work environment.
  • Capable of working scheduled hours, including weekdays, weekends, nights and holidays.
  • Proficient in reading and understanding safety procedures and operating guidelines / instructions in English.

Department of Transportation (DOT) & Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) Requirements:

The Department of Transportation (DOT) and the Federal Motor Safety Carrier Safety Administration (FMSCA) have stringent requirements for Commercial Driver's License (CDL) drivers to ensure safety on the roads. These requirements encompass various aspects, including qualifications, medical standards, testing, and ongoing compliance. DOT and FMSCA require CDL drivers to undergo mandatory drug and alcohol testing as per regulations, including pre-employment, random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion testing. This process can be facilitated through the Human Resources Team or an appropriate third-party provider. These requirements may include, but are not limited to:

  • Shuttle Drivers may be required to obtain a CDL, especially if the shuttle vehicle has a seating capacity exceeding a certain threshold.
  • DOT regulations may require shuttle drivers to pass a DOT medical examination to ensure they are physically fit to operate commercial vehicles.
  • Compliance with DOT regulations regarding the maximum number of hours a driver can drive a commercial vehicle, as well as mandatory rest breaks.
  • Pre-employment, random or post-accident drug and alcohol testing is required.

It's important for resort management to ensure that shuttle drivers are aware of and compliant with all relevant DOT and FMCSA regulations to maintain safety and legal compliance. Specific requirements may vary depending on the location and type of shuttle operations.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and / or reach.
  • Able to safely lift up to 70 pounds.
  • Able to sit entire shift.
  • Manual dexterity of hand to use all equipment.
  • Ability to hear.
  • Random alcohol & drug testing mandated by DOT requirements.
  • Ability to have color recognition.
  • Subject to environmental conditions, work activities can occur inside and outside.

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. jobs.description_html:
About Evermore

Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Evermore resort redefining what it means to vacation together. Just steps from Walt Disney World®, Evermore spans 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel.

Our team members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for every guest. Our eight-acre Evermore Bay, two championship golf courses, water sports facilities, pickleball courts, event spaces, and dining venues round out Evermore's luxurious, sophisticated offerings.

Position Summary:  The Total Rewards Manager plays a critical role in supporting the daily execution of benefits, compensation, and Team Member functions across the resort. This position oversees benefits administration, compensation processes, compliance, workers compensation and wellness programs while ensuring alignment with Evermore’s culture and People First philosophy and operational excellence. This role ensures mandatory audits, compliance, accuracy, are met and a seamless team member experience that ultimately supports our guest service delivery. Will report to the Director of People Operations on enforcing statutory requirements, operating policies, quality standards, people relations, data services, and technology systems administration.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all benefits functions including enrollment, qualifying life events, reporting, open enrollment and billing coordination with vendors (including Dart Container).
  • Audit monthly benefits invoices and internal program billing to ensure accuracy and timely payment including internal events.
  • Assist in the development, implementation, and communication of team member benefits programs.
  • Monitor and track payroll-related items including benefits deductions, special payroll time-off requests to ensure timely and accurate processing.

jobs.description_html:
Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort, the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Our Team Members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for each guest. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore Orlando Resort is an expansive and technically complex property spanning 1,100 acres with multiple operational components. The resort integrates resort-owned vacation rental homes, large-scale water features, and extensive recreational infrastructure. The eight-acre Evermore Bay lagoon includes advanced water treatment, circulation, and safety systems that require continuous monitoring. Two championship golf courses, numerous pools, water sports facilities, and a wide range of amenities, including pickleball courts, event spaces, and dining venues, further enhance the offerings. This diverse environment demands sophisticated engineering oversight to ensure optimal performance, safety, and reliability across all systems.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Interact with golfers, answer questions, and provide directions with particular attention to great guest service.
  • Assist in the daily upkeep of the golf course grounds and landscaping, including mowing, edging, trimming, and maintaining sand traps and bunkers.
  • Maintain golf courses by mowing, trimming, edging, and treating turf as directed by supervision.
  • Operates fly mowers to mow bunkers and lake bank roughs.
  • Operates motorized trimmers to prune bushes, shrubs, and hedges.
  • Perform routine maintenance on power equipment and maintains hand tools in good working condition.
  • Operate and maintain basic groundskeeping equipment, such as fly mowers, trimmers, and utility vehicles.
  • Support landscaping efforts by planting, weeding, and pruning to enhance the visual appeal of the golf course.
  • Repair divots and course clean up.
  • Grade and prepare soil, plant beds, lay sod, and plant vegetative material.
  • Rake and maintain sand bunkers to ensure they are in excellent playing condition.
  • Keep course edged and pruned, edge cart paths, yardage markers, and drainage catch basins.
  • Repairs washouts on golf course.
  • Participate as support staff on any special projects.
  • Maintain ball washers, course signage, course roping, and tee marker placement.
  • Safely utilize various carts for transportation.
  • Keep storage area clean, organized and stocked.
  • Keep assigned tool locker clean, organized, and items in good condition.
  • Follow all company, departmental, safety and security policies and procedures.
  • Identify and report any course hazards or areas requiring repair to the management team.
  • Work closely with experienced maintenance personnel to acquire knowledge and skills related to golf course maintenance.
  • Report maintenance needs to supervision on a timely basis.
  • Follow the work schedule and complete job assignments as directed by supervision.
  • Request materials and/or tools needed to perform work activities to supervision on a timely basis.
  • Maintain fuel and fluid levels for all types of equipment daily.
  • Reports equipment problems or failures to supervision as encountered.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • May learn and operate higher level equipment occasionally until proficiency is acquired.
  • May perform repairs to the irrigation system.
  • May participate as support staff on any special projects.
  • May apply fertilizer, pesticides, and herbicides as directed by supervision if GIBMP Limited Fertilizer Application certificate is obtained.
  • May assist in providing support for golf tournaments.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. 

Experience

  • Experience as a greenskeeper preferred, work history performing manual labor required.

Skills

  • Basic knowledge of ground maintenance and landscaping techniques.
  • Basic knowledge of hand and power tools used for lawn care such as rakes, shovels, mowers, hedgers, edgers, trimmers, blowers, etc.
  • Ability to learn and adapt to new tasks.
  • Ability to problem solve issues with power tools and other assigned equipment.
  • Attention to detail to ensure the golf course is maintained to the highest standards.
  • Ability to understand the basic principles of golf.
  • Ability to understand and follow instructions provided in English.
  • Ability to follow verbal and written instructions independently.
  • Ability to understand immediate safety commands without hesitation.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Capable of performing role in a busy work environment.
  • Capable of working scheduled hours, including weekdays, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to adhere to safety protocols and procedures.
  • Ability to operate various types of power equipment including lawnmowers, string trimmers, hedge trimmers, leaf blowers, and other landscaping equipment in a safe manner.
  • Ability to use hand tools required for landscaping in a safe manner.
  • Ability to follow instructions and complete assignments.
  • Basic knowledge of landscaping techniques and processes.
  • Strong time management skills.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  •  Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and / or reach repeatedly.
  •  Able to safely lift and carry up to 50 pounds, carry, pull, and push heavy objects and materials.
  •  Able to be on feet and moving around for entire shift.
  •  Physical stamina and the ability to perform outdoor, physically demanding work.
  •  Subject to environmental conditions, work activities can occur inside and outside.
  •  Ability to see, hear, smell, and have manual dexterity to use all equipment.

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together.

We offer our Team Members competitive pay, along with a range of benefits including  FREE Life Insurance, FREE Short-Term Disability, FREE Long-Term Disability. Additionally, we provide affordable health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for your dependents. Furthermore, we offer a 401K with employer match, a robust paid time off policy, parental and grandparent leave, as well as family and pet bereavement leave. We also have unique policies in support of our team and significant relationships in their lives.

EOE/M/F/D/V

From beachside bars to a vibrant food hall and rooftop dining with views of the fireworks, we’ve crafted unforgettable experiences. Guests can challenge themselves on 2 Jack Nicklaus championship golf courses, enjoy water sports including kayaks and paddleboards, a family water slide, rope swing, and activities that fill their days including pickleball, bocce ball, and volleyball.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Welcome and assist guests with enthusiasm, providing information, guidance, and recommendations related to resort activities and amenities.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to guests, welcoming them, addressing their inquiries, and ensuring their needs are met as it relates to Evermore core values: Easy on Purpose, Unexpected Delight, Service Savvy, and Insightful Innovations.
  • Enforce safety rules and guidelines for all recreation activities including swimming, paddleboarding, use of fitness equipment, kayaking, slide, rope swing, and cliff jump.
  • Monitor beach and water slide areas for potential hazards and take action to prevent accidents by properly reporting and following up with respective departments.
  • Exhibit proper speaking and phone etiquette with the ability to communicate effectively, politely, graciously, and professionally with both guests and colleagues as it aligns to luxury service standards.
  • Willingness to be trained in and execute First Aid, CPR, AED, and EAP response.
  • Maintain and organize watersports equipment, including paddleboards, kayaks, life jackets, and other safety gear.
  • Daily set up and break down of activities, beach furniture arrangements, rental operations, cabana set-ups, and other recreational equipment
  • Oversee and assist participants in water activities, ensuring they have the necessary equipment and follow safety protocols.
  • Provide instruction and guidance to beginners or those in need of assistance with paddleboarding, kayaking, and other activities.
  • Assist fitness center users with equipment set up and general use while you ensure a safe and clean workout environment.
  • Maintain cleanliness and orderliness of the beach area, fitness centers, and other recreational facilities.
  • Manage inventory of rental equipment, keeping track of usage, and coordinating rentals and returns. This includes reporting inventory shortages regarding equipment, activity supplies, or general use items that are necessary for the success of your role as a recreation attendant.
  • Ensuring accurate billing and compliance regarding room charges, credit card payments, and cash/tip handling.
  • Work cooperatively with other recreation attendants and staff members to ensure a cohesive and enjoyable experience for guests.
  • Attend staff meetings and training sessions as required.
  • Facilitating, organizing, and running daily activity programs such as (but not limited to): crafts, nature walks, family games, pool parties, holiday events, scavenger hunts, kid’s camps, snack service, and many more.
  • Promote recreational activities and services to guests, encouraging participation and upselling rental equipment or additional services when appropriate.
  • Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations related to beach and water activities, safety standards and environmental protection.
  • Collect towels & trash in work area to maintain a clean and presentable guest environment.
  • All other duties as required.

 Education, Skills, and Experience:

  • Must be a minimum of 18 years of age or older with current or completed high school education.
  • Experience working/volunteering in an outdoor environment or with outdoor sporting activities.
  • Must be able to swim. The recreation team works on and around the water which in areas can be up to 12’ deep.
  • Experience with paddle craft and/or willingness to learn.
  • Lifeguard and or First Aid and CPR certification (or willingness to obtain) required.
  • Food Safety or RAMP certification (or willingness to obtain).
  • Flexibility to work weekdays, weekends, nights, early mornings, and holidays.
  • Ability to speak, read, write, and comprehend the English language at a level sufficient to communicate effectively with guests directly and on a microphone.
  • Ability to handle guest requests in a calm, professional, and empathetic manner.
  • Adhere to property and company policies and procedures.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment and prioritize job duties.

 Physical Requirements:

  • Able to safely lift, pull and push up to 50 pounds.
  • Excellent physical and temperature endurance to stand, walk, and remain active for extended periods of time, and participate in physical activities.
  • Ability to swim in deep water and potentially perform water rescues.
  • Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and reach periodically.
  • Tolerance for hot and humid Florida weather conditions, especially when working outdoors.
  • Ability to move swiftly and efficiently around the facility, including beach areas, pool decks, and gym facilities.
  • Effective verbal and non-verbal communication skills to interact with guests and colleagues.
  • Ability to clearly communicate in an emergency to direct guests and ensure their safety.
  • Willingness to adhere to strict regulations and enforce those regulations as necessary.

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together.

We offer our Team Members competitive pay, along with a range of benefits including  FREE Life Insurance, FREE Short-Term Disability, FREE Long-Term Disability. Additionally, we provide affordable health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for your dependents. Furthermore, we offer a 401K with employer match, a robust paid time off policy, parental and grandparent leave, as well as family and pet bereavement leave. We also have unique policies in support of our team and significant relationships in their lives.

EOE/M/F/D/V
