As an Executive Assistant within EA SPORTS, you will support members of the leadership team in their day-to-day operations. Working at the intersection of leadership support and studio operations, you will anticipate needs, ensure seamless execution, and maintain an organized, highly productive environment for the team.

This position is based at our Orlando office with a hybrid work model (expected in-office a minimum of 3 days a week - Tue/Wed/Thurs. Flexibility for up to 5 days and occasional travel as needed)

What You'll Do

  • Manage complex, dynamic calendars for senior leaders with high attention to detail and shifting priorities across multiple time zones. Follow up on action items.
  • Serve as point of contact for internal and external partners on behalf of supported leaders.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, expenses, and logistical support.
  • Plan team events, offsites, and partner meetings, managing end-to-end logistics, catering, setup, and teardown.
  • Provide on-site operational support for studio initiatives and special projects.
  • Support onboarding, vendor coordination, I-Procurement, corporate purchasing card (PCARD) management and software license management.
  • Handle confidential information with absolute discretion and professionalism.
  • Collaborate closely with other Executive Assistant and Production Coordinator team members to drive operational efficiency.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in executive administration, production coordination, workplace operations, or hybrid operational support for senior leadership.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex priorities, maintain calm control under pressure, and rapidly adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with impeccable discretion regarding confidential matters.
  • Customer-focused mindset dedicated to creating a high-quality employee and studio experience.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, collaboration tools (Slack/Teams), Oracle and Chrome River expense management systems.

  • Proficiency in UI implementation, prototyping, and modular interface workflows.
  • Familiarity with graphics tools, asset preparation, and UI motion.
  • Experience collaborating across design, art, and engineering teams.

jobs.description_html:

Role ID

216215

Worker Type

Temporary Employee

Studio/Department

EA Studios - SPORTS

Work Model

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Important Note: This role requires a hybrid onsite presence in either Victoria, BC or Orlando, FL. Applicants are required to work onsite 3 days every week. This is a 12-month contract with the possibility of longer term employment. 

American Football games (Madden, College Football, and our new project) are developed at EA's Tiburon Studios in Orlando, FL, Madrid, Spain, and Victoria, BC, Canada by a team that prides itself on innovation and creative collaboration. We're looking for top technical talent passionate about automation, scalability, and reliability to help redefine how we build, deploy, and operate large-scale connected game experiences within Unreal Engine for a new title that connects with football fans around the world.

Reporting to a Software Engineering Manager, as a Generalist Platform Software Engineer, you will build developer tooling, optimizing engine performance, and maintaining scalable CI/CD automation across multiple environments. Your work directly impacts developer velocity, workflow stability, and the performance of world-class sports entertainment experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain core internal tooling and workflows to boost developer productivity across Unreal Engine.

  • Analyze, profile, and optimize engine performance, memory usage, and build times.

  • Design, implement, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and infrastructure-as-code for game clients and backend services.

  • Collaborate closely with gameplay, tools, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical bottlenecks and improve service reliability.

  • Promote engineering best practices in testing, automated releases, and monitoring across the studio.

Qualifications:


  • 7+ years of professional C++ software engineering experience, ideally in games or real-time systems.

  • Experience with Unreal Engine architecture, build systems (UBT/UAT), and profiling/optimization tools.

  • Solid background in developer tooling, automation, or CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

  • Scripting capabilities in Python, C#, or Bash.

  • Familiarity with cloud environments, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), or version control (Perforce, Git).


Pay Transparency - North America


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). 

PAY RANGES * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$122,300 - $170,700 CAD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.
 In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance.

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Electronic Arts is looking for students to join our world-class internship experience. Summer 2027 will be better than ever as we bring all interns together on-site for orientation week and prep students for the future ways of work by offering remote and hybrid opportunities depending on your location. For more information about our Early in Career programs, visit https://www.ea.com/careers/early-careers

Our teams build meaningful relationships with hundreds of millions of players around the world who love our games. We aim to be the best at meeting players where they are and supporting them throughout their journey with EA. Our teams develop the strategic vision of our products, run outstanding multi-channel campaigns, build global engagement across all touch points, develop global insights, and propel sales and global publishing. We understand the dynamic global landscape so we can bring relevant content, promotions, and help to players anywhere.

What You’ll Do:

You will report to Producers, Development Directors and Technical Leads to lead the development of bug fixes, game changes, and new features into our games.

Qualifications:

  • You are pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in a related field with a graduation date of December 2027 or after.
  • You have working knowledge of Java Or C++, and SQL, Python
  • You have knowledge of object-oriented design and implementation
  • You must be available for a full-time paid internship in the Summer of 2027

We are only considering students who will be enrolled in an accredited degree program in the Summer of 2027, slated to graduate no earlier than December 2027. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis during the 12-week internship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

EA Studios - Respawn

Work Model

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Founded in 2010 by the original creators of the Call of Duty Franchise, Respawn was created with the philosophy that when talented people have creative freedom, they’ll make extraordinary games that achieve the unexpected. From our roots as an indie studio to joining the expansive roster of studios at Electronic Arts, this remains our guiding principle. We truly love what we do and want to share our passion with players worldwide.

Our shipped titles include critically acclaimed multi-platform games Apex Legends, Titanfall, Titanfall 2, Star Wars™ Jedi: Fallen Order,  Star Wars™ Jedi: Survivor, and Medal of Honor: Above and Beyond.

Join us for the opportunity to create groundbreaking games with some of the best developer talent in the industry.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Jedi team in creating a best-in-class experience for our players. On the Jedi Engineering team, we believe in individual ownership of features, close collaboration with other departments, and prioritizing the player experience.

What you’ll do...

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, modular UI systems, in-game HUDs, menus, and front-end features.

  • Drive PC-specific UI/UX features,owning the holistic experience from the engineering side. This can  include everything from mouse-and-keyboard navigation, dynamic cursor behaviors, comprehensive key remapping, detailed settings menus, and beyond.

  • Be able to proactively identify, diagnose, and solve issues as they arise. This includes both bugs and areas where the player experience can be improved.

  • Collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders - engineers,UI/UX designers, technical artists, technical designers, producers, QA.

  • Contribute to healthy team morale and culture

  • Share and receive opinions about the game as a whole

Ideally, you'll have...

  • 4+ years’ experience in the games industry working as an engineer, with experience in UI/UX.

  • Proficiency in C++.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues.

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and adapt to changing project requirements.

  • Familiarity with PC gaming and player expectations on that platform.

  • Familiarity with UX best practices.

  • Passion for making a great player experience.

  • Unreal Engine experience is a major plus, but not required.

If this opportunity sounds like a great fit for you, please submit your resume and we will get back to you once we have reviewed it.

In addition to opportunities for creative impact and professional growth which come with being a member of our team, working at Respawn has many other perks and benefits! Learn more at respawn.com/perks.


Pay Transparency - North America


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). 

PAY RANGES * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$122,300 - $170,700 CAD * California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$143,800 - $217,200 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.
In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to temporary employees scheduled to work full time. 
 In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance.

jobs.description_html:
Locations: Orlando, Florida, United States of America 

Role ID

216500

Worker Type

Regular Employee

Studio/Department

EA Studios - SPORTS

Work Model

Hybrid Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this role is on-site hybrid (3x per week) in Orlando, FL. Relocation assistance is not provided for this role.

EA SPORTS is one of the leading sports entertainment brands in the world, with top-selling videogame franchises, award-winning interactive technology, fan programs, and cross-platform digital experiences. EA SPORTS creates connected experiences that ignite the emotion of sport through industry-leading sports video games, including Madden NFL football,  EA SPORTS FC soccer, NHL® hockey, and EA SPORTS UFC.

As a Technical Game Designer on EA SPORTS Madden NFL Football, you’ll be a hands-on creator who builds new presentation features and complex systems. You’ll partner closely with design, engineering, and content teams to prototype, implement, iterate, and polish—from early concept through live tuning. If you're passionate about game design and thrive working with a collaborative team, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with designers, engineers and other creatives to develop the vision and innovate on compelling gameplay systems.
  • Implement and drive gameplay systems and/or modes from concept to ship quality.
  • Align and collaborate with multiple disciplines and communicate the vision of gameplay features.
  • Ensure a high-quality release by bug fixing, balancing, and creating a fun gameplay experience.
  • Pitch ideas, provide feedback and rapid iteration with the team
  • Build all-new innovative Madden experiences (mechanics, modes, progression, meta systems, tuning frameworks, etc.) that integrate cleanly into the core game.
  • Quick prototype building of new features
  • Create robust scripting-driven implementations (logic, state machines, event flows, data setup) that are scalable and maintainable.

Requirements:

  • Experience with scripting languages (such as Lua, Python, Javascript, and/or other scripting languages).
  • Worked on multiple shipped titles as a Technical Designer
  • Passion for crafting gameplay systems, mechanics and game modes.
  • Familiarity, passion and knowledge of American Football and football products.
  • Expertise in comprehending the game design process, specifically with game mechanics and design theory.
  • Experience with content-driven game engines (Unreal, Frostbite, Unity, GtkRadiant).
  • Ability to read and understand C++
  • Experience developing and in a multiplayer live service environment

jobs.title: Concurrent Review Nurse, Re-Admissions RN
jobs.description_html:
All of our team members and contributors are expected to deliver results with accountability while collaborating seamlessly across boundaries. They embrace change with resilience, staying curious and learning continuously in a rapidly evolving landscape. Grounded in business understanding and comfortable with AI and digital tools, they solve problems with critical thinking and creativity. Above all, they are driven to serve—ensuring their work creates meaningful impact for members and the community we support.

For leadership roles, we seek individuals who think critically, embrace a future-focused mindset, and bring intentional perspective to their work —whether managing people, leading projects, or guiding teams. Our ideal candidates operate across matrix environments, applying systems thinking and evidence-based decision-making to drive sustainable results with economic discipline. We value those who lead change with courage and conviction, building trust across teams, and orchestrating both human and AI capabilities to amplify impact. Across all roles - managing direct reports, leading projects, or advancing individual expertise - they cultivate resources, strengthen capabilities, and create conditions for people and work to thrive. Above all, they are committed to building durable value—decisions and actions today that compound organizational strength tomorrow.

 

Job Summary:
The CRN is responsible for performing medical reviews using established criteria to ensure the member is receiving care at the most appropriate level. The CRN builds relationships with facility case managers to facilitate appropriate care and discharge planning. The CRN is responsible for identifying appropriate care programs for members to ensure a smooth transition from facility to home and to decrease frequency of readmission.


Essential Functions:

  • The essential functions listed represent the major duties of this role, additional duties may be assigned.
  • Serve as a point of contact for providers to assist in navigating members them through the continuum, educate regarding benefits, identify candidates for Care Programs and provide information pertaining to the network and network access  
  • Evaluate members in the Hospital, Skilled Nursing Facility, LTAC, Acute Inpatient Rehab for benefit determination, medical necessity and appropriate level of care utilizing member benefits and InterQual or other medical necessity criteria. 
  • Participate in weekly case review 
  • Determine member's discharge status and identify and coordinate any additional needs and services that require ongoing Care Coordination services 
  • Collaborate with Medical Directors, Managers, Co-workers and other departments including Case Management and Care Partners 
  • Other duties as assigned 


Required Experience: 
2+ years related work experience. Experience Details: Recent (within the past 3-5 years) clinical experience in a hospital, LTAC, Rehab, SNF setting evaluating hospital benefit determination, medical necessity and appropriate level of care 
Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience Nursing 
RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure And/Or Compact State Licensure Florida 
Experience in one or more of the following: home health care, rehab, SNF, utilization review, discharge planning or case management Referrals for possible Case Management activities that focus on acute and non-acute services, outpatient services and/or community resources Experience with the Healthcare industry and Managed Care Experience in MS Word and Excel Moderate to heavy keying required Occasional travel within the State of Florida

Preferred Experience: 
Bachelor’s degree Nursing, Healthcare or Business 
Unrestricted US RN license 
 

General Physical Demands: 
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally. 


What We Offer: 
As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell’s vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living. 

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to: 
 

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program


Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases. 

Annualized Salary Range: $71,200 - $115,700

Typical Annualized Hiring Range: $71,200 - $89,000

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: VP Corporate Services
jobs.description_html:
The Vice President of Corporate Services is a strategic enterprise leader and trusted advisor to the executive leadership team, and business-unit leaders with accountability for enterprise facilities operations, hospitality, workplace infrastructure and experience, safety and security, executive protection and conference center operations and event services. This executive reflects strong business acumen with a service-oriented, experience driven mindset and is the single accountable owner of the end-to-end employee experience delivered through the workplace and corporate services.


The Vice President leads a complex, geographically dispersed organization across the United States (including Puerto Rico) and supplier ecosystem and is accountable for optimizing the company's physical footprint, infrastructure investments, workplace experience, operational resilience, executive safety, and service performance, and is answerable to the CHRO, CEO, and Board for the overall employee experience the function delivers.


The successful candidate will balance long-term portfolio strategy and capital allocation with the daily precision required to operate a complex Fortune 150 environment. This leader will optimize cost, risk, service quality, workplace effectiveness, and business continuity while maintaining an uncompromising standard of operational and service excellence.

Key Responsibilities:
Real Estate Strategy
•    Develop and execute long-term enterprise real estate portfolio strategy aligned with 3–5 year business plans, workforce planning, growth strategies, workplace requirements, and capital allocation priorities
•    Lead portfolio optimization across all owned, leased, and managed properties to maximize flexibility, utilization, financial performance, employee experience, and asset value
•    Direct major capital programs, renovations, relocations, construction projects, and workplace transformations from strategy through execution
•    Lead large-scale real estate transactions including acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, lease negotiations, restructurings, and renewals
•    Identify opportunities to reduce costs, improve productivity, mitigate risk, enhance asset value, and create enterprise value
•    Partner with Finance and executive leadership to evaluate portfolio economics, capital allocation, operating expenses, investment alternatives, and risk-adjusted returns
•    Monitor real estate market and economic trends, competitive positioning, and emerging workplace models (hybrid, flexible, sustainability) and translate insights into portfolio strategies
•    Partner with business unit leaders to forecast space needs and align real estate decisions with organizational strategy
•    Establish portfolio KPIs, financial dashboards, utilization metrics, employee experience scores, investment governance processes, and executive / Board reporting
Facilities & Workplace Operations
•    Provide enterprise leadership for all facilities operations, including engineering and maintenance, capital projects, environmental services, and regulatory compliance across a geographically dispersed portfolio
•    Oversee multi-site facility teams and third-party service providers; establish service level agreements, operating standards, governance processes, and accountability measures
•    Develop and manage annual and multi-year capital budgets; prioritize projects based on business value, risk, asset conditions, employee experience, and return on investment
•    Ensure facilities meet or exceed applicable safety, accessibility, building, environmental, sustainability, and regulatory requirements
•    Ensure facility-level readiness for business continuity by maintaining backup power, redundant systems, and physical infrastructure resilience plans
•    Map and continuously improve the end-to-end employee journey across the workplace (arrival, dining, meetings, events, support, and incident response), and develop and execute workplace strategies that optimize space utilization, employee experience, collaboration, productivity, well-being, and organizational culture in a hybrid work era.
•    Lead modernization and adoption of smart-building systems, workplace analytics, energy-management technologies, space-management tools, and digital workplace solutions
•    Establish preventive maintenance programs and asset lifecycle management protocols, infrastructure-renewal plans, and facilities-resilience programs
•    Report facility performance metrics, employee experience results, and capital/operating budget performance to executive leadership on a regular cadence, and own corrective action plans where results fall short
Corporate Services
•    Provide strategic oversight for enterprise workplace and corporate-service operations including food and hospitality services, event services and conference-center operations, print and mail services, shipping and receiving, and related workplace-support functions
•    Determine corporate event strategy to include conference-center operations, hospitality services, audiovisual coordination, space utilization, customer experience, staffing, and operating budgets and ensure events reflect company brand and culture while meeting operational and compliance requirements
•    Establish and execute enterprise event strategy for Board meetings, executive meetings, town halls, conferences, client events, leadership programs, and other high-profile engagements
•    Establish strategic and operational priorities for food service and hospitality programs including cafeterias, catering, pantry services, vendor management, service standards, food safety, and cost management
•    Direct end-to-end event planning and execution, including venue selection, hospitality, catering, audiovisual production, transportation, logistics, security coordination, and service quality.
•    Build strategic relationships with events, hospitality, travel, and production vendors and negotiate contracts and service agreements.
•    Partner with Marketing, Communications, Human Resources, Security, Finance, Procurement, and business leaders to deliver exceptional experiences and business outcomes and establish service-recovery processes so employee concerns are resolved quickly and visibly.
•    Drive continuous improvement across corporate-service functions through regular vendor performance reviews, service-quality audits, and employee feedback (such as satisfaction surveys and service-request data), and answer for the resulting service outcomes
Property Safety & Security
•    Establish and oversee enterprise physical-security, property-safety, and life-safety programs that protect employees, visitors, facilities, assets, and business operations and ensure employees feel safe and secure at work
•    Conduct enterprise-wide physical security and operational-risk assessments and implement risk-based mitigation strategies
•    Establish emergency preparedness, incident-response, evacuation, shelter-in-place, recovery, business continuity, and crisis management protocols
•    Ensure full compliance with OSHA, local building and fire codes, ADA requirements, environmental regulations, and other applicable standards
•    Direct security incident investigations, corrective actions, trend analysis, and post-incident reviews
•    Maintain strategic relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, landlords, and public-safety partners
•    Oversee physical-security technologies including access control, surveillance, visitor management, alarm systems, and emergency communications
•    Conduct regular audits of physical-security program effectiveness against established performance measures
Executive Protection & Security
•    Provide strategic leadership for executive-protection and executive-security programs supporting the CEO, Board members, executive leadership team, and other designated leaders
•    Establish a risk-based executive-security framework incorporating threat assessment, protective intelligence, executive travel security, event security, residential security, and emergency response
•    Conduct or oversee threat assessments and establish individualized security protocols based on risk exposure and business requirements
•    Coordinate with specialized security firms, law enforcement, intelligence organizations, and other external partners as needed
•    Establish domestic and international executive-travel security procedures and protective measures
•    Manage executive-security budgets, staffing models, contracts, technologies, and vendor relationships
•    Brief executive leadership and the Board regarding emerging threats, risk exposure, and recommended mitigation strategies
•    Ensure seamless execution of highly confidential, time-sensitive, and high-visibility executive-security, travel, logistics, and special-assignment activities
Team Leadership & Organizational Development
•    Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing, multidisciplinary organization spanning real estate, facilities, workplace operations, corporate services, security, travel, and event functions, while staying visible on-site and regularly listening to employees and front-line teams
•    Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, innovation, and exceptional service, and take personal accountability for the overall employee experience delivered across every function in the organization
•    Build organizational capability through succession planning, leadership development, workforce planning, talent management, strategic hiring, and service-excellence training and recognition for front-line teams and supplier partners
•    Manage organizational budgets, resource allocation, workforce strategy, and organizational design
•    Represent the function in executive forums and serve as a trusted partner to the CEO, Board, C-suite leaders, and business-unit executives
•    Serve as the enterprise executive advisor on real estate, workplace, facilities, security, travel, event, and corporate-service matters
•    Drive continuous improvement, technology adoption, organizational transformation, and operating-model effectiveness while maintaining operational continuity and service excellence
•    Establish and communicate enterprise strategy, standards, policies, governance, service-level expectations, employee experience commitments, and performance metrics to Board and C-suite.

Key Requirements:
•    10+ years' related Serving in senior operations, corporate real estate, facilities management, or related executive leadership roles; hospitality industry experience highly desirable.
•    5+ years leading large, multidisciplinary teams and managing complex, global organizational structures
•    Bachelor’s degree in business administration, real estate, finance, or a related field or additional related work experience
•    Proven track record managing P&Ls of $10M+ and multi-site or multi-country operations
•    Strategic and operational experience in geographically dispersed real estate portfolio management and leading large-scale capital programs, construction, renovations, relocations, lease negotiations, and portfolio optimization
•    Deep knowledge of physical security, executive protection, crisis management, business continuity, emergency preparedness, and risk mitigation
•    Experience with workplace strategy, sustainability, and emerging workplace trends, and with defining and measuring service standards in a hospitality or other guest-experience-driven environment
•    Experience using data, technology, workplace analytics, and market intelligence to improve portfolio decisions, operational efficiency, and employee experience
•    Track record of building governance frameworks that hold multidisciplinary teams accountable to service-level, employee experience, and performance expectations
•    Demonstrated success balancing competing priorities — cost, risk, experience, and growth — when setting enterprise-wide strategy
•    Strong track record of vendor management, strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, and third-party service oversight
•    Experience operating in complex, highly matrixed organizations with multiple business units and functions
•    Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams across multiple disciplines
•    Strong financial acumen, budget management, business-case development, capital-allocation experience, and ROI analysis capability
•    Excellent executive communication and Board-level presentation skills with proven ability to build trusted relationships with CEOs, Board members, C-suite executives, business unit leaders, vendors, and external partners

Preferred:
•    MBA or advanced degree in business, real estate, or related field
•    CCIM, CPM, or other real estate professional certification
•    Experience in corporate real estate for a Fortune 500 or similarly scaled organization
•    Experience overseeing executive protection, protective intelligence, or enterprise security functions
•    Experience implementing technology-enabled facilities management, workplace analytics, smart-building solutions, physical-security technologies, and portfolio-management platforms
•    Experience developing sustainability, energy-management, carbon-reduction, and environmental-performance programs
•    Experience in hospitality industry

General Physical Demands
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally. 
 

What We Offer: 
As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell’s vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living. 

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to: 
 

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program


Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases. 

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Senior IT Database Administrator (Senior Snowflake DBA)
jobs.description_html:
All of our team members and contributors are expected to deliver results with accountability while collaborating seamlessly across boundaries. They embrace change with resilience, staying curious and learning continuously in a rapidly evolving landscape. Grounded in business understanding and comfortable with AI and digital tools, they solve problems with critical thinking and creativity. Above all, they are driven to serve—ensuring their work creates meaningful impact for members and the community we support.

For leadership roles, we seek individuals who think critically, embrace a future-focused mindset, and bring intentional perspective to their work —whether managing people, leading projects, or guiding teams. Our ideal candidates operate across matrix environments, applying systems thinking and evidence-based decision-making to drive sustainable results with economic discipline. We value those who lead change with courage and conviction, building trust across teams, and orchestrating both human and AI capabilities to amplify impact. Across all roles - managing direct reports, leading projects, or advancing individual expertise - they cultivate resources, strengthen capabilities, and create conditions for people and work to thrive. Above all, they are committed to building durable value—decisions and actions today that compound organizational strength tomorrow.


The Senior IT Database Administrator (Senior DBA) provides consultation related to database management and administration. The Senior DBA's perform detailed data flow analysis ensuring the highest levels of efficiency in database and query design in distributed data flows. Senior DBA's administer database systems to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data. The Senior DBA is responsible for maintenance, control and testing of complex databases which provide orderly methods of data storage and controlled access to data. Senior DBA's also maintain complex query language for established database systems, design and execute backup and recovery schemes and implement disaster recovery procedures. The Senior DBA serves as a subject matter expert providing consultation to end-users and project team members on database management, query development, system requirements and database change management initiatives and providing technical guidance to other DBAs.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain Snowflake instances across development, staging, and production environments
  • Consults on database, architecture and related infrastructure technologies to all areas and levels within IT. 
  • Consults on exploiting opportunities involving multiple hardware and software systems, issue resolution, providing innovative business solutions, etc. to both internal and external customers and partners. 
  • Provides technical leadership on the implementation of leading-edge database technologies and the design and implementation of large-scale technical solutions based on business requirements. 
  • Develops and ensures compliance with all system, disaster recovery and security audit policies. 
  • Writes complex programming/scripts. 
  • Participate in disaster recovery design, testing and execution 
  • Manage databases, schemas, warehouses, users, roles, and resource monitors. 
  • Manage compute resources, storage, and cluster configurations with a focus on performance optimization
  • Make highly complex physical changes to current databases, often this requires working after hours 

The Successful Candidate Will

  • Have advanced SQL and Snowflake platform expertise 
  • Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and automation frameworks 
  • Data backup strategies, replication across geographic zones, and disaster recovery mechanisms 
  • Data encryption, RBAC models, access control policies, and least-privilege principles 
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving abilities 
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders 
  • Attention to detail in configuration management and compliance verification


What We Require

  • 7+ years related work experience Snowflake Administrator in AWS or in a similar cloud data platform administration role
  • Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience IT related field
  • Advanced SQL proficiency for database optimization and performance tuning and strong experience with Python. 
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, specifically working knowledge of Azure Entra 
  • Exceptional leadership skills demonstrated through project or technical leadership experience 
  • Leading edge proficiency in large database environments for decision support, parallel database environments for scalability and high availability and integrating business applications with integrated database technologies 
  • Advanced proficiency in multi-dimensional modeling 
  • In-depth knowledge of IT industry database technologies and processes and business applications integrated with database technologies 
  • Extensive experience designing and executing backup and recovery concepts and procedures 
  • Knowledge of Project Management Methodologies 
  • Proven leadership abilities including effective knowledge sharing, conflict resolution, facilitation of open discussions, fairness and displaying appropriate levels of assertiveness
  • Experience with enterprise security standards, compliance frameworks, and audit processes 
  • Document all administrative procedures and maintain current runbooks
  • Must be able to work on Eastern Standard Time Zone

What We Prefer

  • Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification 
  • Snowflake SnowPro Advanced Administrator 
  • HIPAA/SOC2 compliance certification or healthcare IT security training 
  • AWS, Azure  cloud platform certifications 
  • Complete user access provisioning/deprovisioning within 24 business hours 
  • Achieve compliance audit pass rates on security standards assessments 
  • Reduce query execution times and optimize warehouse utilization by 10–15% annually 
  • Maintain comprehensive audit logs with zero gaps in access tracking
     

General Physical Demands

  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects.
  • Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally. 
  • This position offers a hybrid work arrantement which combines flexibility with in office engagement. Team schedules are determined based on role requirements and business needs.
  • Travel to and from our corporate office may be required


What We Offer

As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell’s vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living. 

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to: 

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and a comprehensive wellness program


Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Annualized Salary Range: $109,300 - $177,600

The Senior Network Engineer to design, implement, and operate the enterprise network infrastructure that powers our business. This role combines deep technical expertise with architectural thinking you will be a hands-on engineer who also influences strategy, mentors junior team members, and partners with security, cloud, and application teams to deliver a resilient, high-performance network across our campus, data center, cloud, and remote-user environments.  Hybrid role with in-office presence required three days per week. 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provides expert level consulting services to both internal and external customers and partners. Resolves issues or maximize capabilities involving multiple facilities, high transaction volume or costs, and or a high impact level.
  • Manage cloud network architecture including Transit Gateway / hub-and-spoke designs, Direct Connect / Express Route circuits, VPC/VNet design, and centralized inspection patterns
  • Build and maintain network observability using tools such as Datadog, ThousandEyes, SolarWinds, or equivalent — including dashboards, alerting, and capacity planning
  • Develop automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (Python, Ansible, Terraform) to streamline configuration management, compliance, and change deployment
  • Provide leadership in the design and implementation of large scale networking solutions based on business requirements. 
  • Author and maintain high-quality network documentation including diagrams, runbooks, standards, and as-built records
    Participate in an on-call rotation and lead major incident response when network issues impact the business
  • Responsible for leading technical teams tasked with resolving complex network and system problems (e.g., protocol analysis, system errors, interoperability problems, security incidents and disaster recovery events) and in the development of technical strategies and architectures. 
  • Leads research, evaluation and selection of vendor solutions. 
  • Design systems and develop processes and procedures for operation and maintenance. 
  • Work in conjunction with Architects to develop network strategies and architectures. 
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to the design and maintenance of infrastructure, hardware and software. Consult with senior management on technical issues. 
  • Monitors and performs maintenance of network systems. 
  • Prepares reports and analyzes trends, issues and metrics related to network performance and recommends courses of action.
  • Responsible for implementation and deployment of technology design including troubleshooting and resolving issues, developing procedures and documentation. 
  • Participates in monthly releases and disaster recovery exercises. 
  • Develops and maintains procedures. 

What We Require

  • 5+ years related work experience in Network infrastructure design and administration 

  •  Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience IT related field 

  • Must have extensive network operations knowledge and experience. 

  • Ability to manage tasks independently and take ownership of responsibilities 

  • Ability to learn from mistakes and apply constructive feedback to improve performance. 

  • Ability to communicate highly complex technical information clearly and articulately to all levels and audiences. 

  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment. 

  • High critical thinking skills to evaluate alternatives and present solutions that are consistent with business objectives and strategy. 

  • Have broad, expert knowledge of many tools or products (breadth) and have deep knowledge in at least one particular tool or product (depth). 

  • Proven leadership abilities including effective knowledge sharing, conflict resolution, facilitation of open discussions, fairness and displaying appropriate levels of assertiveness.

What We Prefer

  • CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent certifications; cloud certifications (AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, Azure Network Engineer)
  • Experience with SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela/Catalyst SD-WAN, Versa, Fortinet, Palo)
  • Experience supporting regulated environments (HIPAA, PCI, SOC 2, FedRAMP)
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, ThousandEyes, or NetBrain
  • Hands on automation and scripting experience (Postman or Ansible)
  • Experience using Agile methodology
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field
  • Jacksonville area residency or be willing to relocate prior to start date

Across all roles - managing direct reports, leading projects, or advancing individual expertise - they cultivate resources, strengthen capabilities, and create conditions for people and work to thrive. Above all, they are committed to building durable value—decisions and actions today that compound organizational strength tomorrow.
 

General Physical Demands

  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects.

  • Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally. 

  • This position offers a hybrid work arrangement which combines flexibility with in office engagement. Team schedules are determined based on role requirements and business needs. 

  • Travel to and from our corporate offices may be required.

What We Offer
As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell’s vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living. 

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to: 
 

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days

  • Participates in the strategy and development of network architecture. 
  • Prepares documentation for audits. 
  • Participates in monthly releases and disaster recovery exercises. 
  • Develops and maintains procedures. 
  • Responsible for interfacing with other IT teams and business units to troubleshoot and resolve issues related network infrastructure.

  • Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience IT related field 

  • Must have extensive network operations knowledge and experience. 

  • Ability to manage tasks independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

  • Ability to learn from mistakes and apply constructive feedback to improve performance. 

  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly and articulately. 

  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment. 

  • High critical thinking skills to evaluate alternatives and present solutions that are consistent with business objectives and strategy.

jobs.description_html:
All of our team members and contributors are expected to deliver results with accountability while collaborating seamlessly across boundaries. They embrace change with resilience, staying curious and learning continuously in a rapidly evolving landscape. Grounded in business understanding and comfortable with AI and digital tools, they solve problems with critical thinking and creativity. Above all, they are driven to serve—ensuring their work creates meaningful impact for members and the community we support.
 

We are looking for a Associate Network Engineer who will be responsible for maintaining and administering our company's computer networks. Your primary duties will include maintenance of computer networks, hardware, software, and other related systems, performing disaster recovery operations, protecting data, software, and hardware from attacks, and replacing faulty network hardware components when necessary. You will also be working closely with the users of our network in order to identify potential issues and fix existing problems.

What You Will Be Doing
 

Monitor & Track

  • Ensure plan components are populated.

  • Coordinate and facilitate requests for change to plan dates and tasks.

  • Adjust plans/schedules and/or resources as directed by appropriate stakeholders.

  • Assist department users with all project management tools. 
  • Facilitate planning and execution by providing support in coordination of master schedule. 
  • Monitor status and scheduling on weekly basis. 
  • Perform analysis of historical data trend analysis and re-projection
  • Notify appropriate stakeholders of tasks that are behind schedule.
  • Alert appropriate stakeholders to issues raised by team members.

Provide Administrative Support

  • Prepare cost estimates, status reports and other related reports.
  • Execute planning and reporting processes.
  • Provide support in the development and maintenance of processes and templates.
  • Coordinate management process meetings and prepare presentations.
  • Participate in preparation of multiple status reporting.
  • Monitor and coordinate activities of technology /work initiative with team(s) to ensure that tasks and interdependencies are communicated, tracked, and met. (30%)

What We Require

  • 1+ years related work experience

  • High school diploma or GED 

  • Working knowledge of the Project Management methodology, Strong research and analytical skills; basic project planning skills 

  • Strong proficiency in current version of MS Project, MS Word, MS Excel or other equivalent tracking and documentation tools as appropriate. 

  • Basic proficiency using database tools. 

  • Demonstrated time-management skills Demonstrated ability to learn from mistakes and apply constructive feedback to improve performance. 

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information in laymen's terms, both orally and in writing. 

  • Experience working in a rapidly changing environment.

What We Prefer

  • Associate’s degree in information technology or a related field of study with a network engineering focus or relevant work experience.

  • CCNA or higher (CCNP highly valued)

  • Understanding of network architecture

  • Solid understanding of the OSI or TCP/IP model

  • Knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols.

  • Ability to think through problems and visualize solutions.

  • Ability to create accurate network diagrams and documentation for design and planning network communication systems.

For leadership roles, we seek individuals who think critically, embrace a future-focused mindset, and bring intentional perspective to their work —whether managing people, leading projects, or guiding teams. We value those who lead change with courage and conviction, building trust across teams, and orchestrating both human and AI capabilities to amplify impact. Across all roles - managing direct reports, leading projects, or advancing individual expertise - they cultivate resources, strengthen capabilities, and create conditions for people and work to thrive. Above all, they are committed to building durable value—decisions and actions today that compound organizational strength tomorrow.
 

General Physical Demands
 

  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. 

  • Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally. 

  • This position offers hybrid work arrangement which combines flexibility with in office engagement. Team schedules are determined based on role requirements and business needs.

  • Travel to and from our corporate office may be required.

Must be able to travel to multiple locations for work (i.e. travel to attend meetings, events, conferences). Occasionally

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance

jobs.title: Analyst III - Business Support Clinical
jobs.description_html:
The work of Analysts is guided by precedents, well-defined policy and supervisory review. Incumbents determine their own priorities and may deviate from established procedures and practices as long as the end results meet standards of acceptability.

Job duties include but are not limited to:
•    Research, analyze, maintain, modify, validate and prepare data, information and content used in making business decisions. Output is used for forecasting, costing, planning, positioning, trending, measuring, controlling risk, contracting and administration. Present findings and articulate results
•    Monitor, maintain and test the Company’s systems that manage business and work processes
•    Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of solutions, policies, practices and processes to ensure continuous improvement, good client relations, compliance and adherence to business and system requirements. Recommend improvements to achieve and deliver high quality, value-added services
•    Produce, edit and distribute a variety of business documents such as reports, system and process documentation, etc. 
•    Create, present and/or facilitate meetings, webinars, conference calls, training programs, education sessions, certifications, etc. for primarily internal audiences
•    Participate on or lead smaller departmental projects or components of projects. May plan, organize, monitor and control projects to ensure the effective use of resources and adherence to project management standards and reporting requirements
•    Participate on and/or lead department/divisional workgroups and initiatives
•    Develop and build internal partnerships to improve communication, coordination, collaboration and effective working relationships within own department

Job Requirements:
•    3+ years related work experience
•    Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience 

Preferred:
•    Demonstrates understanding of healthcare regulations (e.g. CMS, NCQA)
•    Knowledge of utilization management processes, prior authorization workflows, and regulatory reporting standards
•    CMS-0057F Prior Auth Metrics 
•    NCQA Reporting & Preparation
•    Familiarity with quality metrics and value-based care initiatives
•    Experience with Clinical systems (e.g., UM Prior Authorizations, Grievance & Appeals, Care Management, EMR) - MCG, MC400, and MHK
•    Experience with data analytics tools and visualization software
•    Ability to learn and adapt to new healthcare technologies and software applications
•    Serves as a clinical data resource expert and trusted advisor to UM leadership and stakeholders
•    Educates interdisciplinary teams on clinical data reporting, information extraction, and system workflows
•    Translates clinical needs into technical solutions
•    Healthcare domain expertise and understanding of clinical work and processes
•    Ability to combine clinical knowledge and analytical skills to bridge communication between technical teams and clinical stakeholders
 

General Physical Demands
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement which combines flexibility with in-office engagement. Team schedules are determined based on role requirements and business needs. Travel to and from our corporate or regional offices may be required.

jobs.title: VP Pharmacy Services
jobs.description_html:
The VP Pharmacy Services is the senior-most pharmacy executive for the enterprise and reports to the Chief Operating Officer, Health Services. This transformational leader articulates a clear and compelling vision for pharmacy, drives innovation, inspires others, and sets high expectations for achievement within and beyond the pharmacy organization. The role serves as the trusted pharmacy advisor to the executive leadership team and the Board.


This position holds strategic, operational, and financial accountability for all Commercial and Medicare pharmacy and specialty pharmacy programs at a Blue plan with approximately $30 billion in annual revenue. Accountabilities include enterprise pharmacy cost of care and multi-year trend, benefit and formulary strategy, Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) performance, Medicare Part D and Commercial regulatory compliance, and clinical quality outcomes. The role is accountable for achieving and sustaining Part D Star Ratings of 4.5 stars or higher across the organization’s Medicare Advantage prescription drug and stand-alone Part D contracts; for delivering pharmacy savings as a core contributor to total cost of care and affordability goals, with specialty and medical-benefit drug trend as a primary focus; and for leading the renegotiation and restructuring of PBM and specialty pharmacy arrangements while building a strong pharmacy operations organization that manages vendors and clinical programs.

Integrating pharmacy and medical strategy is essential to improving quality and controlling total cost of care. The VP Pharmacy Services leads the integration of clinical and operational solutions across the pharmacy and medical benefits to deliver innovative, cross-functional, and compliant programs.
This executive aligns team operational and budget goals with organizational directives, acts as a change leader within and beyond Pharmacy and Health Services, and provides organization-wide direction for project and functional resources inside and outside the reporting structure. Additional responsibilities include applying rigorous controls and oversight to the PBM and other strategic vendors across Pharmacy and Health Services to ensure compliance with all contractual terms and all State and Federal regulations.

Key Responsibilities: 
Pharmacy Strategy and Operations:
•    Build, develop, and lead a diverse, high-performing pharmacy leadership team and organization that applies individual expertise to collectively achieve organizational goals and objectives
•    Set the enterprise pharmacy vision and multi-year strategy for Commercial (individual, small group, large group, and ASO) and Medicare lines of business, delivering a coordinated, comprehensive pharmacy program that supports member care and aligns with the company’s vision and strategic imperatives
•    Own pharmacy cost of care for the enterprise, including multi-year pharmacy trend forecasting, budget accountability for multi-billion-dollar pharmacy spend, and delivery of net-cost and rebate targets, and accountable for annual pharmacy savings targets as a core contributor to enterprise total cost of care and affordability goals, with savings validated using enterprise methodology and reported separately as realized versus avoided
•    Lead the annual goal, budget, and financial planning process, ensuring goals are timely, measurable, and executed
•    Monitor pharmacy cost and trend continuously to identify operational improvement and savings opportunities
•    Direct PBM strategy and governance, including RFP and market-check activities, contract negotiation, pricing, rebate and performance guarantee terms, transparency and audit rights, and ongoing performance management to secure best-in-market net cost and member experience, with specific accountability to lead the renegotiation of PBM agreements informed by independent market-check results and the design and execution of restructured specialty pharmacy arrangements, including carve-out and multi-vendor models, ensuring seamless member transition, data integration, and protection of rebate and performance guarantees
•    Oversee the PBM and other pharmacy vendors across Commercial and Medicare to ensure contractual performance and achievement of the organization’s strategic imperatives, using scorecards and governance that cover performance guarantees, claims pricing accuracy, audit findings closure, rebate guarantee attainment and collection, and service levels, and pursuing financial remedies for non-performance
•    Lead pharmacy operations across the full operating cycle, including formulary and clinical policy administration, pharmacy coverage determinations and appeals, medical-benefit drug management (prior authorization, dose optimization, wastage, and infusion site of care), dispensing channel and network strategy, claims pricing and payment accuracy, and rebate invoicing, collection, and reconciliation
•    Lead pharmacy clinical programs, including adherence, Medication Therapy Management, medication safety, and prescriber engagement, and the outreach vendors that support them, ensuring each program has defined objectives and measured ROI
•    Set formulary, benefit design, and clinical pharmacy program strategy, including oversight of the Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) process, to balance clinical outcomes, affordability, and member access
•    Lead specialty drug strategy across the pharmacy and medical benefits, including site-of-care, biosimilar adoption, specialty network and vendor strategy, and management of emerging high-cost therapies such as GLP‑1s and cell and gene therapies, with accountability for specialty and medical-benefit drug trend, including exclusive specialty network utilization, infusion site of care, dose optimization and wastage reduction, and rebate capture
•    Direct Medicare Part D strategy and operations in partnership with Actuary and Medicare leadership, including annual bid development, formulary and network adequacy, Medication Therapy Management, and readiness for Inflation Reduction Act requirements, including the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan and Maximum Fair Price
•    Own Part D Star Ratings performance, with a goal of 4.5 stars or higher for each Medicare Advantage prescription drug (HMO and PPO) contract and stand-alone Part D contract, including medication adherence, statin use in persons with diabetes, Medication Therapy Management comprehensive medication reviews, and medication safety measures, in partnership with Quality and Medicare leadership
•    Integrate Commercial and Medicare pharmacy programs with medical strategy to reduce total cost of care while achieving quality outcomes
•    Build and deliver a pipeline of pharmacy affordability initiatives (for example, formulary and tiering, alternative sourcing, site of care, and manufacturer agreements), partnering with Healthcare Economics, Analytics, and Finance to quantify and validate savings
•    Lead pharmacy innovation, including manufacturer value-based agreements, digital and point-of-care pharmacy solutions, and alternative sourcing and pricing models, and evaluate their impact on total cost of care and member experience
•    Partner with Product and Actuary to deliver competitive, innovative Commercial and Medicare pharmacy product offerings in the marketplace
•    Support targeted ASO efforts to ensure competitiveness, growth, and financially positive outcomes
•    Lead the design and implementation of targeted interventions to improve pharmacy trend and support membership growth while minimizing disenrollment
•    Partner with Analytics and Healthcare Economics to build pharmacy performance reporting, forecasting, and drug trend analytics that inform executive decision-making
•    Establish and own pharmacy operations and clinical KPI scorecards, with leading and lagging indicators reported through the Health Services management rhythm
•    Apply data, automation, and AI (such as electronic prior authorization and predictive adherence and cost-risk modeling) to improve turnaround, outcomes, and efficiency
•    Lead the transformation of Commercial, Medicare, and specialty pharmacy to support future and changing health care models
Executive Leadership and Enterprise Representation:
•    Serve as the enterprise pharmacy executive, advising the executive leadership team and Board on pharmacy strategy, drug trend, and regulatory developments, and partnering with BCBSA, peer Blue plans, manufacturers, and industry coalitions
•    Represent Florida Blue and Health Care Services, both internally and externally, on pharmacy and related regulatory matters, including BCBSA activity and proposed State and Federal legislation, leveraging key relationships and professional organizations to influence policy and industry peers
•    Lead team operational efforts to minimize risk and ensure compliance with all Commercial and Medicare pharmacy State and Federal regulations, including coverage determination and appeal turnaround, CMS program audit readiness, Part C and Part D reporting requirements, and evolving federal PBM transparency requirements
•    Continuously evaluate internal and external factors that pose pharmacy-related risk to Florida Blue, and develop and implement controls and operational processes to mitigate that risk
•    Provide ongoing support, input, and oversight to Health Care Services (HCS) strategic partnerships
•    Lead the development and implementation of Healthcare Solutions through key initiatives, including High-Value initiatives pursued with Network and through IMM Governance
•    Develop effective partnerships with key leaders in Sales/Marketing, Compliance, Medical Operations, Care Management, Service Organization, Network, Product, and Legal
•    Remain current on issues affecting the pharmacy industry and integrate best practices to manage them effectively
•    Lead diverse, multi-disciplinary, cross-functional teams to support organizational goals and directives, providing direct and indirect leadership to GuideWell Health Solutions by leveraging individual and team expertise
Clinical Support and Oversight:
•    Oversee pharmacy-related committees, including Pharmacy and Therapeutics and pharmacy policy, and ensure alignment with medical policy for drugs covered under the medical benefit
•    Oversee the review and implementation of selected enabling technologies, tools, and initiatives, using organizational SMEs and support staff, that promote quality, administrative efficiency, and medical cost goals
•    Provide clinical oversight of pharmacy and drug-related medical policies to ensure clinical integration and alignment, and provide leadership and direction to achieve effective clinical programs and operational excellence, with a focus on member outcomes

Key Requirements: 
•    Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or related PhD or additional equivalent senior executive experience considered
•    15+ years’ of progressive related work experience in health care, health plan, or PBM leadership
•    Health Plan/PBM senior leadership Executive leadership of enterprise pharmacy operations
•    10+ years of progressive management experience, including leading managers and senior leaders
•    Pharmacist License - current Florida pharmacy license or able to obtain
•    Deep knowledge of the health care and insurance industry and of managed care products, benefits, and programs, including Commercial and Medicare
•    Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including executive and Board-level presentation
•    Proven record of delivering measurable pharmacy cost, quality, and member experience results at enterprise scale
•    Demonstrated ability to build productive, collaborative working relationships with key internal and external stakeholders
•    Demonstrated knowledge and application of the Florida Blue Management System
•    Demonstrated knowledge and application of the profession of pharmacy, including clinical pharmacy, Florida pharmacy law, and the process flow for prescription drug services in Florida
•    Demonstrated success improving Medicare Part D Star Ratings, including medication adherence, Medication Therapy Management, and medication safety measures
•    Experience leading PBM RFPs and negotiating PBM and specialty pharmacy contracts, including pricing, guarantees, and rebates
•    Experience managing specialty drug trends and specialty pharmacy models, including carve-out or multi-vendor arrangements
•    Experience overseeing pharmacy operations and vendor performance at scale, including prior authorization, claims accuracy, and rebate management

Preferred:
•    MBA, MHA, or comparable advanced degree
•    Prior experience leading pharmacy at a Blue plan or health plan of comparable size and complexity.
•    Direct experience with Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage pharmacy, including bid development
•    Experience leading a PBM transition or specialty pharmacy carve-out, and negotiating manufacturer value-based agreements
•    Demonstrated executive presence and experience presenting to senior executives and Board
