jobs.title: Small Business Senior/Lead Underwriter (Western Zone)
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

The Small Business Senior/Lead Underwriter owns their territory and partners with the Territory Manager to execute strategic priorities, drive profitable growth, and support retention. They apply our Underwriting Philosophy by balancing individual risk characteristics, agency performance, and portfolio health to make informed underwriting decisions. As trusted advisors to their agency partners, they provide guidance and solutions that strengthen relationships, support mutual success, and deliver consistent value to customers and the business.

The role leverages strong underwriting expertise, critical thinking, problem-solving acumen, portfolio management skills, data and analytics, and creativity to make informed risk decisions, optimize territory performance, and improve business outcomes. The Senior/Lead Underwriter is expected to demonstrate strong workload management, agency partnership, and support continuous improvement while serving as a resource and mentor to peers within the underwriting organization. The role makes responsible decisions regarding risk acceptability and pricing, escalates issues as needed, and provides leadership with insights on market trends, agency opportunities, and operational improvements. The Senior/Lead Underwriter embraces change, demonstrates adaptability, and serves as a champion for new processes, technologies, and ways of working to support the evolving needs of the organization and our agency partners.

Job Responsibilities

  • Manages an assigned portfolio of business consistent with underwriting strategies, profitability objectives, growth targets, retention goals, and customer experience expectations.
  • Effectively prioritizes and manages a high-volume workload across multiple agencies, balancing production, the agency experience, underwriting integrity, responsiveness, and business objectives.
  • Collects, analyzes, and evaluates underwriting information to make sound risk selection, pricing, and coverage decisions consistent with company appetite and strategy.
  • Operates as a Trusted Advisor by developing strong relationships with agencies, producers, and other distribution partners to understand business objectives, identify opportunities, and drive profitable outcomes.
  • Leverages portfolio underwriting principles, analytics, business intelligence, and market insights to identify trends, opportunities, and actions that optimize territory performance.
  • Owns their territory by collaborating with Sales, Product, Operations and key business partners to align strategies, address challenges, and achieve profitable growth, retention, and territory objectives.
  • Leverages underwriting expertise, business acumen, and creative problem-solving to deliver solutions that balance agency needs with company objectives. Partners and negotiates with agents to achieve profitable outcomes, strengthens agency relationships, and contributes to agency business planning and growth strategies.
  • Provides leadership with feedback and recommendations on market conditions, competitor activity, agency performance, product opportunities, pricing trends, and emerging business needs.
  • Identifies and implements opportunities to improve operational efficiency, streamline underwriting processes, and enhance agency and customer experiences.
  • Actively embraces and leverages technology, digital capabilities, automation tools, and innovation initiatives to improve underwriting effectiveness and business results.
  • Builds and maintains effective communication internally and externally regarding underwriting practices, agency strategies, growth objectives, and service expectations.
  • Collaborates with corporate and shared service partners to execute business strategies and deliver a seamless customer and agency experience.
  • Champions organizational change by adopting new processes, technologies, and ways of working while helping agency partners and teammates successfully navigate change in a growing and evolving organization.
  • Serves as a resource for peers by sharing knowledge, promoting best practices, supporting onboarding efforts, and contributing to the development of underwriting excellence across the team.

Job Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Commercial Underwriting experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field and/or commensurate work experience.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) (Preferred)
  • Property And Casualty Insurance License (PCIL) (Preferred)

Location

Hybrid- defined as working three or more days per week in the office if the employee's residence is within 50 miles of Westfield Center, OH; OR Remote-if the employee resides more than 50 miles from Westfield Center, OH.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Nimble Learning
  • Ability to Influence
  • Builds Effective Relationships
  • Adaptability

Technical Skills

  • Commercial Lines Underwriting
  • Underwriting Strategy
  • Risk Management
  • Portfolio & Territory Management
  • Data Analysis & Business Insights
  • Critical Thinking & Problem Solving

jobs.title: Treasury Operations Senior Analyst
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

The Treasury Operations Senior Analyst, working under minimal supervision, is responsible for ensuring the efficient and effective management of the company's cash and investments. This role supports the Treasury Operations department by performing the following: managing the execution of transactional processes, collecting, and reviewing data, posting general journal entries, reconciling accounts, reporting, and administering financial institutional relationships and various ongoing financing and treasury programs. The Senior Analyst partners with Accounting, Tax, Legal, and other internal departments to ensure the timely and accurate execution of treasury activities, appropriate accounting treatment and reporting of financial transactions, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal controls.

The role also serves as a peer mentor to less experienced staff and subject matter expert in the department.

Job Responsibilities

  • Supports the development, implementation, and maintenance of the company's cash management strategies and policies to optimize cash flow, minimize borrowing costs, and maximize investment returns.

  • Leads daily cash management, treasury operations, and related accounting functions, ensuring accurate transaction processing, reconciliation, financial reporting, and compliance with established policies and controls.

  • Serves as the lead contact for treasury and accounting matters, providing support and issue resolution, facilitating treasury service changes with banking partners and other internal departments and offering guidance on the accounting, reporting and control requirements of treasury activities.

  • Supports month-end cash reconciliation activities and variance resolution. Investigates discrepancies, updates financial records, and communicates with business partners to resolve issues.

  • Oversees the daily investment trading settlement activity of multiple legal entities and employee benefit programs; developing, implementing, and performing procedures to calculate and execute various transactions, within limits of authority and/or investment portfolio guidelines.

  • Verifies and maintains all purchase, sale, and income information of companies’ investment portfolios to ensure the integrity of the portfolio records and financial reporting.

  • Drives improvements to treasury-related systems and procedures by documenting requirements, leading testing efforts, resolving escalated user or data issues, and ensuring alignment with accounting practices, internal controls, and treasury objectives.

  • Collaborates with Leader and assists with development and monitoring all processes and controls in the treasury area. Recommends changes and provides continuous improvements to ensure operating and financial controls are of industry best practice standard.

  • Enhances cash management policy and process improvements to support efficient treasury operations and regulatory compliance.

  • Develops and implements treasury risk management strategies and policies to identify, mitigate, and manage financial risks.

  • Stays up to date on changes in financial markets and regulatory requirements that may impact treasury operations and proactively adjust strategies and policies to ensure compliance and optimize performance.

Job Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Treasury or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related field and/or commensurate experience.

Location 

Hybrid - defined as working three or more days per week in the office 

Licenses and Certifications 

  • Certified Treasury Professionals (CTP) (Preferred)

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Nimble Learning

Technical Skills

  • Cash Management

  • Treasury Management

  • Treasury Controllership Standard Procedures

  • Treasury Controllership Tools

  • Investment analysis

  • Accounting and Financial Reporting

  • Market Research

  • Compliance Management

  • Stakeholder Management

jobs.title: Sales Senior Territory Manager (AZ/NM)
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary:

The Sales Senior Territory Manager working under limited supervision, is responsible for implementing the Business territory strategy in their assigned distribution channel territory. The responsibilities include driving profitable business growth and sales, meeting annual growth targets, overseeing marketing and production of insurance products within their territory. The role serves as the representative of the Company in specified territory, actively engaging with agencies, networking, and participating in the local community to raise brand awareness. The role also manages agency relationships, leverages knowledge of the territory as a competitive advantage, gets involved in strategic territory planning, analyzing performance, gaining a deep understanding of the risks faced, staying updated on industry trends affecting the insurance business, and developing expertise in insurance products. This role collaborates closely with underwriting (UW) and product management teams to ensure profitability targets are met at both agency and territory levels, intervening to redirect agency behavior when required.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Executes the Business territory strategy in their designated territory and handles marketing, business development, and achieving annual growth targets for insurance products in the assigned territory.
  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets sales data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities, including examining sales reports, customer data, market research, and other relevant information to gain insights into sales performance.
  • Represents and promotes the company within the territory through agency visits, networking, and community involvement. Identifies specific opportunities within each agency and connects them with appropriate company resources.
  • Provides necessary support (e.g., underwriting, training, troubleshooting) to agencies to foster trust, comfort, and brand loyalty to the company. 
  • Collaborates with Distribution Management team in agency planning and customized compensation. Assists in identifying the need for new agencies in the territory and contributes to the agency selection process.
  • Uses their territory knowledge as a competitive advantage, focusing on territory planning, performance analysis, understanding risks, identifying industry trends, and building expertise in insurance products.
  • Gathers competitive and market intelligence through agency engagements and networking, sharing insights with Business Territory Leader and other stakeholders.
  • Stays up to date on industry topics, trends, competitors, and best practices through research, industry events, and networking, sharing knowledge within the business segment team.
  • Collaborates with corporate shared services functions to implement the competitive strategy and achieve desired results, while aligning with corporate governance and prioritizing the customer.
  • Develops and leverages strong partnerships to drive alignment and mutual benefits for business segments and the organization.
  • Prepares and presents regular sales reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate sales performance, trends, and analysis to relevant stakeholders. Summarizes findings and provides actionable recommendations.
  • For field roles, only: Expected to drive/travel at least 50% of working time to perform essential functions. This may involve traveling on short notice or other daily driving duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales, Distribution Management, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales or a related field and/or commensurate work experience. 
  • For field roles, only: Valid driver’s license and a driving record that conforms to company standards.

Licenses and Certifications: 

  • Certified Sales Professional (CSP) (Preferred)

Location: 

Arizona/New Mexico Territory

Behavioral Competencies:

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Nimble Learning

Technical Skills:

  • Sales Support 
  • Sales Data Analysis
  • Compensation Policies and Processes
  • Field Sales
  • Market Development
  • Sales Account Management
  • Data Analysis and Reporting
  • Insurance Operations
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • Direct Sales

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Head of Distribution, DACH (Location: GERMANY)
jobs.description_html:
The role holder will be responsible for establishing and strengthening relationships with key focus brokers, specialist brokers, corporate in-house brokers, and selected Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the German-speaking markets. The role will drive market engagement, enhance brand presence, and contribute to profitable business growth by promoting Westfield’s underwriting capabilities, risk appetite, and specialist product offering.

The Head of Distribution, DACH will act as a trusted market representative, working closely with underwriting and leadership teams to develop sustainable distribution opportunities and support the execution within the German specialty insurance market.  

The job holder is responsible for developing and maintaining broker and market relationships and identifying business opportunities. The role does not include authority to underwrite risks, bind insurance contracts, or enter into, execute or conclude agreements on behalf of Westfield Specialty Insurance Europe S.A. (“WSIE”). Such decisions and approvals remain subject to WSIE's delegated authority and governance arrangements.

Contractual terms discussed or developed by the role holder with brokers, MGAs, clients or other third parties are, in the ordinary course, subject to further review and formal approval and execution by the Company's authorised signatories at the Company's registered office in Luxembourg, in accordance with the Company's internal signature and authority policies in force from time to time.

Key Accountabilities & Role Requirements: 

  • Develop, maintain, and strengthen strategic relationships with key brokers, clients, MGAs, and distribution partners across the German market. 

  • Identify and secure new distribution opportunities aligned with Westfield’s specialty insurance strategy and risk appetite. 

  • Promote awareness and understanding of Westfield’s underwriting capabilities, line of business, and market proposition. 

  • Support profitable growth by developing strong commercial relationships with focus brokers, specialist brokers, and corporate in-house brokers. 

  • Collaborate closely with underwriting teams to ensure alignment between market opportunities and underwriting strategy. 

  • Maintain a strong understanding of local market dynamics, the competitive landscape, broker structures, and emerging opportunities within the German-speaking insurance markets. 

  • Provide market intelligence, broker feedback, and distribution insights to internal stakeholders to support strategic decision-making. 

  • Deliver high standards of professionalism, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement while acting as an ambassador for the Westfield brand. 

  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with regulatory requirements, internal governance standards, and company policies. 

  • Contribute to the successful execution of regional business plans and strategic growth initiatives.

Skills & Competencies Required:

  • Strong insurance distribution and relationship management capability within the German-speaking insurance markets. 

  • Proven ability to develop, influence, and maintain trusted long-term business relationships. 

  • Excellent commercial awareness and understanding of specialty insurance markets and distribution models. 

  • Strong networking, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. 

  • Ability to identify and convert business development opportunities into sustainable growth. 

  • Deep understanding of specialty insurance products, underwriting principles, and risk appetite frameworks. 

  • High levels of resilience, credibility, professionalism, and personal integrity. 

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across international teams. 

  • Fluent German and English language skills are essential.  

  • Adaptability and willingness to travel within the DACH region and internationally as required.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Significant experience within the insurance industry, preferably within specialty insurance or commercial lines. 

  • Proven track record in broker management, client engagement, distribution development, or business development roles. 

  • Established network and strong market relationships within the German-speaking insurance markets would be highly advantageous. 

  • Demonstrated success in developing profitable broker and/or MGA partnerships. 

  • Strong understanding of specialty insurance products and market practices. 

  • Experience working within an international insurance environment would be beneficial. 

  • Relevant professional insurance qualifications are desirable. 

  • Degree educated or equivalent professional experience preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Actuarial Analyst, Standard Lines Pricing
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

The Senior Actuarial Analyst in Standard Lines Pricing, working with limited supervision, conducts complex analyses, provides recommendations, and leads special actuarial projects. The role applies highly technical actuarial acumen and skill set in completing assignments and works to improve processes in the actuarial department. The role researches and develops best practices pricing techniques to be implemented across the business, serves as a mentor to less experienced professionals, provides general expertise on market trends and product performance and adheres to internal and external compliance requirements/standards.

Job Responsibilities

  • Directs actuarial projects while applying actuarial skills and knowledge of the Company's insurance products and operations.
  • Completes research, ensures accuracy of calculations and analyses, and meets project deadlines.
  • Completes all complex actuarial assignments by following standard processes in area of Standard Lines Pricing
  • Provides input on the pricing of new and existing products, collaborates with the Underwriting, IT, and Product teams.
  • Assists in developing management reports that are used to monitor performance, behavior, and results of company goals and objectives.
  • Develops and maintains adequate knowledge and awareness of industry activities through attendance at seminars, reading trade journals and magazines, and through personal contact with other insurance companies, state regulatory bodies, and professional affiliations.
  • Gathers information, prepares reports, and creates datasets following already documented processes in support of the Actuarial Department.
  • Prepares supporting exhibits for defending state filing materials, and partners with the IT team to implement rate and rule changes in rating.
  • Provides ongoing review and improvements of pricing and processes for greater automation, accuracy, and rate adequacy.
  • Supports peers and less experienced professionals, analysts, and associates in their respective activities on pricing.

Job Qualifications

  • 5+ years of insurance and/or business experience.
  • 4+ years of actuarial experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, or a related field and/or commensurate work experience.
  • Credit for completion of the following Casualty Actuarial Society work: passing the "Basic techniques for rate making and estimating claims liability" exam and completion all CAS preliminary requirements (e.g. exams, VEEs, online courses) prior to this exam.

Location 

Hybrid – defined as working three or more days per week in the office if the employee’s residence is within 50 miles of Westfield Center, OH; or Remote – if the employee resides more than 50 miles from Westfield Center, OH.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Customer focus
  • Communicates effectively
  • Decision quality
  • Nimble learning

Technical Skills

  • Financial Acumen
  • Knowledge of Programming Languages
  • Statistical Modelling Software
  • Pricing Modeling
  • Statistical Analysis
  • Predictive Analytics
  • Corporate Reserving
  • Data Analysis and Reporting
  • Actuarial Analytics
  • Insurance Industry Knowledge

jobs.title: WSP Actuarial Intern, Chicago
jobs.description_html:
The Westfield Specialty Intern Program is a paid, ten-week program that offers students the opportunity to obtain firsthand insight into the insurance business.  Every day you'll learn and develop your skills but you'll also have a clear and supportive path ahead of you. You'll gain the confidence to take on real projects, build your network and learn from senior leaders across our business.  The 2027 Summer Intern Program will run from June 7th to August 13th. 

We are seeking Intern candidates to work with our Actuary team in our Chicago, IL office.   

Program Elements Include:

  • Classroom and On The Job Training 
  • Weekly Lunch and Learn Series with Senior Leaders
  • Formal Mentor Program 
  • Presentations from Major Brokerage Partners 
  • Teambuilding and Social Activities; including Community Service Event
  • Industry based Group Project 

Participants in the Westfield Specialty Summer Intern Program are immersed in the day-to-day operations of a fast-moving, growing insurance company. You will gain valuable, hands-on experience and insurance industry knowledge during the 10-week program. As a summer intern you will work side-by-side with industry leaders on dynamic projects that provide ample opportunity for challenges, learning and achievement.  At Westfield Specialty, we are proud to emphasize the education and development for the future leaders of the insurance industry. 

2027 Summer Intern Program Openings:

  • Alpharetta, GA: Underwriting
  • Berkeley Heights, NJ: Claims, IT, Operations 
  • Chicago, IL:, IT, Underwriting, Actuary
  • New York, NY: Actuary, Marketing, Underwriting

For those who excel in the program, we would welcome the opportunity to discuss full-time employment opportunities at Westfield Specialty after graduation as part of our Trainee Program. 

As part of our internship program you will receive: 

  • Targeted business training designed to help you refine your professional skills and acumen critical to the success of Westfield professionals; 
  • Technical training to deepen your skill level within your chosen discipline; and an understanding of the broader insurance industry; 
  • Access to additional training to compliment your professional development. 
  • Opportunity to expand your professional network with talented insurance professionals 

Responsibilities 

An Actuary Intern at Westfield Specialty works on a variety of projects to gain hands-on experience in the insurance industry and develop technical skills.  Including: 

  • Assist with actuarial analyses supporting pricing initiatives.

  • Gather, validate, and analyze large data sets using actuarial and statistical techniques.

  • Support the development and maintenance of actuarial models, reports, and dashboards.

  • Prepare summaries, presentations, and recommendations based on analytical findings.

  • Assist in evaluating trends related to claims, premium, exposure, and profitability.

  • Participate in data quality reviews and process improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with underwriting, finance, claims, and other business partners to support strategic decision-making.

  • Conduct research on industry trends, market conditions, and emerging risks.

  • Complete special projects and ad hoc analyses as assigned.

Desired Qualifications 

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field.

  • At minimum must be sitting for Actuarial Exam; successful completion of one or more actuarial exams highly preferred 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with SQL, R, Python, Power BI, or other analytical tools is a plus.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to be onsite in office 4 days a week 

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

This is a paid internship.  Intern will be paid on an hourly basis at the rate of $25/hour.

jobs.title: Small Business Sales Senior Territory Manager (VA/MD)
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary:

The Sales Senior Territory Manager working under limited supervision, is responsible for implementing the Business territory strategy in their assigned distribution channel territory. The responsibilities include driving profitable business growth and sales, meeting annual growth targets, overseeing marketing and production of insurance products within their territory. The role serves as the representative of the Company in specified territory, actively engaging with agencies, networking, and participating in the local community to raise brand awareness. The role also manages agency relationships, leverages knowledge of the territory as a competitive advantage, gets involved in strategic territory planning, analyzing performance, gaining a deep understanding of the risks faced, staying updated on industry trends affecting the insurance business, and developing expertise in insurance products. This role collaborates closely with underwriting (UW) and product management teams to ensure profitability targets are met at both agency and territory levels, intervening to redirect agency behavior when required.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Executes the Business territory strategy in their designated territory and handles marketing, business development, and achieving annual growth targets for insurance products in the assigned territory.
  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets sales data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities, including examining sales reports, customer data, market research, and other relevant information to gain insights into sales performance.
  • Represents and promotes the company within the territory through agency visits, networking, and community involvement. Identifies specific opportunities within each agency and connects them with appropriate company resources.
  • Provides necessary support (e.g., underwriting, training, troubleshooting) to agencies to foster trust, comfort, and brand loyalty to the company. 
  • Collaborates with Distribution Management team in agency planning and customized compensation. Assists in identifying the need for new agencies in the territory and contributes to the agency selection process.
  • Uses their territory knowledge as a competitive advantage, focusing on territory planning, performance analysis, understanding risks, identifying industry trends, and building expertise in insurance products.
  • Gathers competitive and market intelligence through agency engagements and networking, sharing insights with Business Territory Leader and other stakeholders.
  • Stays up to date on industry topics, trends, competitors, and best practices through research, industry events, and networking, sharing knowledge within the business segment team.
  • Collaborates with corporate shared services functions to implement the competitive strategy and achieve desired results, while aligning with corporate governance and prioritizing the customer.
  • Develops and leverages strong partnerships to drive alignment and mutual benefits for business segments and the organization.
  • Prepares and presents regular sales reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate sales performance, trends, and analysis to relevant stakeholders. Summarizes findings and provides actionable recommendations.
  • For field roles, only: Expected to drive/travel at least 50% of working time to perform essential functions. This may involve traveling on short notice or other daily driving duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales, Distribution Management, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales or a related field and/or commensurate work experience. 
  • For field roles, only: Valid driver’s license and a driving record that conforms to company standards.

Licenses and Certifications: 

  • Certified Sales Professional (CSP) (Preferred)

Location: 

Maryland/Virgina Territory

Behavioral Competencies:

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Nimble Learning

Technical Skills:

  • Sales Support 
  • Sales Data Analysis
  • Compensation Policies and Processes
  • Field Sales
  • Market Development
  • Sales Account Management
  • Data Analysis and Reporting
  • Insurance Operations
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • Direct Sales

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Executive Underwriter, Cyber and E&O
jobs.description_html:
Underwriters are responsible for underwriting a complex book of business, employing the methods necessary to meet projected profitability, gross written premium, and expense goals, management and growth of the overall portfolio of business, implementing proper underwriting discipline/guidelines, marketing and servicing of existing and potential clients.  This position is located in New York, NY and will report directly into Cyber Liability Northeastern Regional Leader.    

 RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Growing and managing a portfolio of profitable business focused on providing Cyber Liability & Technology and Miscellaneous Errors & Omissions coverage.

  • Compliance with underwriting guidelines, systems, and procedures to align with all underwriting and administrative guidelines

  • General underwriting functions including underwriting submission review, pricing analysis, setting of terms and conditions, and quote/binder/invoice authorizations

  • Seek input from Actuarial Department to set process specific accounts when appropriate

  • Liaise with Claims Department on any specific claims activity and overall market claims concerns, which could potentially affect profitability

  • Marketing – attend client/broker meetings, lunches, dinners, and other social outings as applicable. Meet with key brokers regularly to discuss production, service and other topics relative to division operations

  • Stay current with respect to major industry issues and developments

  • Provide specific reports as needed by senior staff

CANDIDATE SKILLS, EXPERIENCE 

  • 4-year college degree required

  • Minimum 3 years underwriting experience; Cyber and E&O experience strongly preferred 

  • Solid Writing and Communication Skills

  • Excellent organizational skills, and ability to multi-task

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Willingness to travel

  • Must be able to think originally, be willing to challenge ideas and be receptive to constructive feedback

  • Ability to be onsite in office 4 days week, where applicable 

NYC Based Candidates Only: Salary range for this role is 150-175k

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern Program- Underwriting Intern, NYC
jobs.description_html:
The Westfield Specialty Intern Program is a paid, ten-week program that offers students the opportunity to obtain firsthand insight into the insurance business.  Every day you'll learn and develop your skills but you'll also have a clear and supportive path ahead of you. You'll gain the confidence to take on real projects, build your network and learn from senior leaders across our business.  The 2027 Summer Intern Program will run from June 7th to August 13th.  

Program Elements Include:

  • Classroom and On The Job Training 
  • Weekly Lunch and Learn Series with Senior Leaders
  • Formal Mentor Program 
  • Presentations from Major Brokerage Partners 
  • Teambuilding and Social Activities; including Community Service Event
  • Industry based Group Project 

Participants in the Westfield Specialty Summer Intern Program are immersed in the day-to-day operations of a fast-moving, growing insurance company. You will gain valuable, hands-on experience and insurance industry knowledge during the 10-week program. As a summer intern you will work side-by-side with industry leaders on dynamic projects that provide ample opportunity for challenges, learning and achievement.  At Westfield Specialty, we are proud to emphasize the education and development for the future leaders of the insurance industry. 

2027 Summer Intern Program Openings:

  • Alpharetta, GA: Underwriting
  • Berkeley Heights, NJ: Claims, IT, Operations 
  • Chicago, IL:, IT, Underwriting
  • New York, NY: Actuary, Marketing, Underwriting

For those who excel in the program, we would welcome the opportunity to discuss full-time employment opportunities at Westfield Specialty after graduation as part of our Trainee Program. 

As part of our internship program you will receive: 

  • Targeted business training designed to help you refine your professional skills and acumen critical to the success of Westfield professionals; 
  • Technical training to deepen your skill level within your chosen discipline; and an understanding of the broader insurance industry; 
  • Access to additional training to compliment your professional development. 
  • Opportunity to expand your professional network with talented insurance professionals 

Overview:

Underwriting Interns will support Westfield Specialty’s underwriting teams while gaining hands-on experience in the insurance industry and developing foundational technical and analytical skills. This role provides direct exposure to underwriting operations, products, and decision-making processes through meaningful project work and day-to-day team collaboration. Interns will be embedded within a specific underwriting team to gain a comprehensive understanding of the business and contribute to ongoing departmental initiatives.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting underwriting teams with research, data analysis, and risk assessment activities.
  • Assist underwriters in evaluating complex or non-standard insurance applications (e.g., Cyber, D&O, E&O, Property, Casualty, insurance, etc).
  • Research and analyze industry-specific risks, emerging trends, and exposures unique to specialty lines.
  • Help prepare underwriting files, including summaries of risk factors, coverage recommendations, and pricing justifications.
  • Organize supporting documentation such as loss runs, financial statements, and supplemental forms.
  • Conduct competitor analysis and benchmark coverage options or pricing.
  • Compile data to support the development of underwriting strategies and guidelines.
  • Attend underwriting meetings and shadow underwriters on client calls or risk reviews.
  • Participate in training sessions on specialty insurance products, underwriting systems, and risk modeling tools.
  • Stay updated on niche markets, policy forms, and regulatory requirements in specialty insurance.

Desired Qualifications 

  • Currently matriculated students enrolled at a 4 year college or university pursuing either a Bachelors or Masters degree (required)
  • Strong GPA preferred (Minimum GPA of 3.2 required) 
  • Strong oral and written communication skills 
  • Leadership experience through work or involvement in community service, athletics, clubs, or other activities preferred 
  • Technically adept/digitally savvy
  • Ability to be onsite in office 4 days a week 

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

This is a paid internship.  Intern will be paid on an hourly basis at the rate of $25/hour.

  • Assist in creating, editing, and scheduling content for social media channels.

  • Support development of blog posts, email campaigns, newsletters, and internal communications.

  • Help design basic visual assets using tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Support planning and execution of marketing campaigns, programs, and events.

Responsibilities 

An Operations Intern at Westfield Specialty works on a variety of projects to gain hands-on experience in the insurance industry and develop technical skills.  Including: 

  • Assist with day-to-day operational tasks, such as document processing, policy issuance, and record maintenance.
  • Help review and verify insurance applications and forms for completeness and accuracy.
  • Support processing of endorsements, renewals, and cancellations.
  • Help identify data inconsistencies and perform quality assurance checks.
  • Generate reports and summaries to support underwriting, claims, or compliance teams.
  • Collaborate with departments such as underwriting, claims, customer service, and compliance to resolve operational issues.
  • Assist in responding to internal inquiries related to policy status, documentation, or process flows.
  • Document and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) or process maps.
  • Attend training sessions to learn about insurance products, policy administration systems, and regulatory requirements.
  • Gain exposure to business operations and how they support the overall insurance value chain (underwriting, claims, billing, customer service).
  • Shadow professionals across different departments to understand cross-functional operations.
  • Help ensure policies and procedures follow company guidelines and regulatory standards.
  • Assist with preparation for internal or external audits by organizing and retrieving required documentation.

Desired Qualifications 

  • Currently matriculated student enrolled at a 4 year college or university pursuing either a Bachelors or Masters degree (required)

  • Strong GPA preferred (Minimum GPA of 3.2 required) 

  • Strong interpersonal skills, including strong oral and written communication skills 

  • Leadership experience through work or involvement in community service, athletics, clubs, or other activities preferred 

  • Technically adept/digitally savvy

  • Ability to be onsite in office 4 days a week

Responsibilities 

An Claims Intern at Westfield Specialty works on a variety of projects to gain hands-on experience in the insurance industry and develop technical skills.  Including: 

  • Assist with the intake and setup of new claims in internal systems.
  • Review loss notices and verify the completeness and accuracy of documentation.
  • Organize and maintain digital and physical claim files, ensuring all relevant documents (e.g., legal filings, policy forms, correspondence) are properly stored.
  • Assist with gathering and summarizing key claim information (e.g., timelines, policy terms, limits, and exclusions).
  • Review and summarize relevant contracts, policies, or legal documents under the guidance of a claims examiner.
  • Liaise with underwriters, legal counsel and internal stakeholders to request additional claim-related information.
  • Participate in claim review meetings or status calls with claims adjusters, legal teams, and risk managers.
  • Input claim details into claims management systems and update claim status as required.
  • Help identify and correct data inconsistencies or errors in claims files.
  • Track deadlines for litigation or investigation milestones (e.g., response dates, settlement discussions).
  • Learn the end-to-end claims lifecycle in specialty lines, including first notice of loss (FNOL), investigation, coverage determination, litigation, and resolution.
  • Observe claim strategies in unique or high-risk areas like cyberattacks, malpractice, or directors & officers liability.
  • Attend trainings on insurance law, policy interpretation, and regulatory compliance specific to specialty lines.
  • Attend training sessions to learn about insurance products, policy administration systems, and regulatory requirements.
  • Gain exposure to business operations and how they support the overall insurance value chain (underwriting, claims, billing, customer service).
  • Shadow professionals across different departments to understand cross-functional operations.

  • Strong GPA preferred (Minimum GPA of 3.2 required) 

  • Strong interpersonal skills, including strong oral and written communication skills 

  • Leadership experience through work or involvement in community service, athletics, clubs, or other activities preferred 

  • Technically adept/digitally savvy

  • Ability to be onsite in office 4 days a week

This is a paid internship.  Intern will be paid on an hourly basis at the rate of $25/hour.

jobs.title: Actuarial Consultant
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

The Actuarial Consultant utilizes advanced actuarial skills, work experience, and insurance products knowledge and serves as a technical expert and thought leader on Loss Reserving, Actuarial Reporting, and Research and Development, with a particular focus on optimizing reserving processes and conducting competitor and industry benchmarking. The role works with internal business partners in Claims, Financial Reporting, Investments, Finance Committee, etc. in support of the Company’s operations, objectives, and goals. The role leads discussion on the pricing of new and existing products, delivers management reporting, collaborates with analysts on complex analytical projects, provides support to Finance Reporting, and partners with the IT team to implement rating rule changes.

Job Responsibilities

  • Leads the preparation and analysis of loss and loss adjustment expense reserves across assigned lines of business, applying actuarial methods (e.g., loss development, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, frequency/severity) to estimate ultimate losses and reserve adequacy.
  • Performs quarterly and annual reserve reviews, documents key assumptions and judgments, and communicates reserve indications and drivers of change to management and Financial Reporting.
  • Identifies opportunities to streamline and automate the reserving process, improving turnaround time, consistency, and data quality across reserving cycles.
  • Develops and maintains reserving tools, models, and templates, partnering with IT and Data teams to enhance efficiency and reduce manual effort in reserve calculations and reporting.
  • Conducts competitor and industry benchmarking studies, comparing the Company’s reserve levels, loss development patterns, and reserving assumptions against peer and industry data to identify emerging trends and potential areas of exposure.
  • Monitors external actuarial research, regulatory developments, and industry reserve adequacy studies, incorporating relevant findings into internal reserving practices.
  • Analyzes emerging loss trends, claim frequency/severity shifts, and portfolio mix changes, assessing their impact on reserve estimates and flagging areas of concern.
  • Provides technical guidance and support to other members, mentors Actuarial Analysts, and less experienced Actuarial Consultants. Empowers team members and project groups to build reserving methodologies, pricing oversight, and related monitoring techniques consistent with best practice standards.
  • May supervise 1-2 employees, support employee selection, performance management, coaching, and development. Manages priorities and workload distribution and removes barriers that impede project progress.

Job Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in Actuarial or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics or related field and/or commensurate work experience.

Location 

Hybrid – defined as working three or more days per week in the office if the employee’s residence is within 50 miles of Westfield Center, OH; or Remote – if the employee resides more than 50 miles from Westfield Center, OH.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society – ACAS; required
  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society – FCAS; preferred
     

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Nimble Learning

Technical Skills

  • Statistical Modeling Software 

  • Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Competitor Benchmarking 

  • Corporate Reserving 
  • Reserving Process Optimization
  • Business Process Improvement
  • Financial Acumen
  • Insurance Industry Knowledge   

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Middle Market Underwriting and Sales Region Leader
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary:
The Middle Market Underwriting and Sales Region Leader is accountable for developing and executing the underwriting and sales strategy for an assigned region to achieve profitable growth and targeted financial results. The role leads regional business development, underwriting execution, and portfolio management while partnering with Distribution, Product Management, Marketing, and Underwriting Operations to achieve territory objectives.

The Region Leader provides leadership and direction to the regional team, using market insight, portfolio analytics, and sound underwriting judgment to identify opportunities, address performance issues, and make effective business decisions. The role builds strong agency and broker relationships, drives consistent sales and underwriting practices, and promotes collaboration across field and virtual teams. The Region Leader is also responsible for coaching and developing team members, strengthening underwriting and business development capabilities, and building a high-performing team positioned for sustained success.
 

Job Responsibilities:
·  Leads the Middle Market underwriting and sales organization for the region, establishing business priorities, monitoring performance, and ensuring execution of regional new business, renewal, pricing, and profitability objectives.

·  Leads underwriting managers and underwriting teams to achieve appropriate productivity, service, and portfolio results while maintaining sound underwriting discipline and effective partnership across Underwriting, Underwriting Practices, and Underwriting Operations.

·  Builds a strong culture of collaboration across field, home office, and virtual teams and models effective teamwork, communication, and shared accountability for results.

·  Ensures adherence to underwriting guidelines, authority, policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and quality assurance standards, including timely implementation of corrective actions and QA recommendations.

·  Leads and develops other leaders, establishing clear expectations for performance, coaching, and accountability while strengthening the team's underwriting expertise and ability to manage larger and more complex accounts.

·  Uses portfolio analytics, market intelligence, and business judgment to identify trends, prioritize opportunities, address performance gaps, allocate resources, and support effective underwriting and business decisions.

·  Establishes and maintains a disciplined, objective process for granting and managing underwriting authority based on demonstrated technical capability, experience, judgment, and performance.

·  Supports significant new business and renewal opportunities through agency and broker engagement, sales presentations, account strategy, and negotiation of coverage, pricing, financial terms, and service solutions.

·  Monitors performance against regional financial and operating objectives, identifies emerging issues and opportunities, and develops action plans to improve new business production, retention, pricing, profitability, and overall portfolio performance.

·  Owns talent management for the region, including hiring and selection, succession planning, performance and compensation management, employee development, career coaching, workload management, and resolution of employee issues that may affect team effectiveness.

·  Manages regional expenses within established plans, monitors spending throughout the year, and provides forecasts and variance explanations as required.

·  Maintains a strong understanding of commercial insurance market conditions, competitor activity, industry trends, and jurisdictional developments through agency engagement, industry participation, and other sources, and translates those insights into regional underwriting and sales strategies.

Job Qualifications:
•    8+ years of Commercial Underwriting experience and 5+ years of direct people management experience.
•    Bachelor's degree in related field and/or commensurate work experience.
•    Master's degree in a related field is preferred.

 

Location:
•   Remote territories AZ/CO/FL/GA/MN/IA/TN/KY or Headquarters.

 

Licenses and Certifications (Possesses one or more of the following): 
•    Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) (preferred)
•    Associate in Commercial Underwriting (AU) (preferred)
•    Certified Insurance Counselor
•    Certified Risk Manager

 

Behavioral Competencies:
•    Collaboration
•    Communicates Effectively
•    Customer Focus
•    Decision Quality 
•    Nimble Learning
•    Builds Effective Teams
•    Business Insight
•    Develops talent
•    Directs Work
•    Ensures Accountability
•    Manages Complexity
•    Drives Vision & Purpose
•    Strategic Mindset

Technical Skills:
•    Commercial Lines Underwriting 
•    Underwriting Strategy
•    Business Development and Sales Management 
•    Data Analysis & Reporting
•    Agency Management
•    Pricing Analytics
•    Contract Management
•    Predictive Modeling
•    Customer Relationship Management
•    Regulatory Compliance
•    Financial Management


This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

Job Summary

The Agribusines Trainee, working under direct supervision, is responsible to acquire knowledge, experience, skills, and business acumen in the assigned area. The role completes educational, work, and relationship building experiences and participates and engages in all assignments/experiences, soliciting feedback regarding performance, and closing gaps in his/her knowledge, skills, and business acumen. In addition, the role also establishes a strong foundation by building relationships and identifying resources that will help them in their career.

  • Assists leader, team, or business unit with work assigned to them.
  • This often includes, but is not limited to, project work and coverage of day-to-day activities.
  • Develops business acumen through interactions and shadowing with other professionals.
  • Attends business unit meetings, executes research, and creates and delivers presentations as assigned.
  • Prepares for and engages in one-on-one, on-line, and on-the-job learning/educational assignments/ experiences.

jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

The Middle Market Trainee, working under direct supervision, is responsible to acquire knowledge, experience, skills, and business acumen in the assigned area such as Claims, Surety, IT, etc. The role completes educational, work, and relationship building experiences and participates and engages in all assignments/experiences, soliciting feedback regarding performance, and closing gaps in his/her knowledge, skills, and business acumen. In addition, the role also establishes a strong foundation by building relationships and identifying resources that will help them in their career.

Job Responsibilities

  • Works to acquire the knowledge, experience, skills, and business acumen in the assigned area, which helps in the trainee's development towards the goal of becoming a professional in the respective department.
  • Assists leader, team, or business unit with work assigned to them.
  • This often includes, but is not limited to, project work and coverage of day-to-day activities.
  • Develops business acumen through interactions and shadowing with other professionals.
  • Attends business unit meetings, executes research, and creates and delivers presentations as assigned.
  • Prepares for and engages in one-on-one, on-line, and on-the-job learning/educational assignments/ experiences.
  • Develops operating knowledge of Company standardized hardware, software programs, third-party software, and processing procedures.
  • Works toward developing an understanding of key concepts and appropriate business skill application through learning programs, structured on the job experiences, and active participation and engagement in all team building, observation and practice activities.
  • Solicits reinforcing and constructive feedback from leader, peer coaches and others in the organization and incorporates feedback into development.
  • Identifies resources, best practices, and external networking opportunities to monitor pertinent industry activity and trends.
  • Maintains awareness, understanding, and compliance with internal policies and procedures, laws, and regulations appropriate for this position.

Job Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or General Education Diploma (GED) and/or commensurate experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, or Business preferred.

Location

  • Hybrid - defined as working three or more days per week in the office. Potential relocation after Trainee program is complete. 

Start Date

  • June 2027

Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Customer focus
  • Communicates effectively
  • Decision quality
  • Nimble learning

Technical Skills

  • Business Analysis
  • Data Management
  • Data Entry
  • Insurance Operations
  • Insurance Policies
  • Insurance Industry Knowledge
  • Information Systems
  • Data Analysis and Reporting

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: National Partner Manager
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

The National Partner Manager serves as Westfield's primary relationship leader for our largest and most strategically important national distribution partners, including agency networks, aggregators, financial institutions, and private equity-backed organizations with complex agency structures. This highly visible role is responsible for developing executive-level partnerships, aligning enterprise and partner strategies, and driving profitable growth across Westfield's Standard Lines business segments. 

Working closely with senior leaders across Distribution Management, Underwriting, Product, Operations, and other enabling functions, the National Partner Manager influences strategic direction, identifies emerging market opportunities, and provides leadership across some of Westfield's most significant distribution relationships. The role serves as the strategic owner of the partner lifecycle, providing executive engagement, growth planning, governance oversight, performance stewardship, and issue resolution across corporate, regional, and local stakeholder groups. 

Through business development, market intelligence, and cross-functional leadership, the National Partner Manager helps ensure alignment between Westfield's business strategies and partner objectives while creating long-term value for both organizations. This role plays a critical part in shaping how Westfield competes, grows, and strengthens relationships with some of the most influential organizations in the insurance distribution marketplace.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead and strengthen executive-level relationships with a portfolio of Westfield's most strategic national distribution partners, including agency networks, aggregators, financial institutions, and private equity-backed organizations.  
  • Develop and execute partner growth strategies that align partner objectives with Westfield's business priorities and profitable growth goals. 
  • Serve as the strategic owner of assigned partnerships, providing leadership across executive engagement, performance stewardship, governance, and relationship lifecycle management. 
  • Identify, influence, and capitalize on opportunities to expand business, increase market presence, and strengthen long-term partner value. 
  • Lead strategic business planning and performance reviews, utilizing data and market insights to drive results across business segments and optimize partner performance. 
  • Collaborate with leaders across Distribution Management, Underwriting, Product, Operations, and other business functions to ensure enterprise alignment and a coordinated partner experience. 
  • Provide market intelligence and strategic insights regarding distribution trends, agency consolidation, private equity activity, and emerging opportunities within the insurance marketplace. 
  • Facilitate governance and accountability processes that support effective partnership management, risk oversight, and compliance with company standards. 
  • Represent Westfield as a trusted advisor, influencing strategic decisions and strengthening relationships with senior leaders across partner organizations. 
  • Manage budgets and partnership investments responsibly while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • 10+ years of experience in Sales, Distribution Management, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, Sales or a related field and/or commensurate work experience.
  • Valid driver's license and a driving record that conforms to company standards.
  • Preferred experience in retail agency, retail broker or wholesale brokerage.

Location

  • Remote

Travel Requirements

  • Travel up to 50% of working time to support partner engagement, business development activities, and company initiatives. Travel may include overnight stays and occasional short-notice business travel. 

Behavioral Competencies

  • Influencing without authority 
  • Cross-functional leadership
  • Enterprise collaboration 
  • Collaborates
  • Manages complexity
  • Directs work
  • Business insight
  • Communicates effectively
  • Ensures accountability
  • Decision quality
  • Customer focus
  • Nimble learning

Technical Skills

  • KPI Tracking
  • Business Strategy
  • Growth Strategy 
  • People & Performance Management 
  • Agency Management System
  • Distribution Management 
  • Networking 
  • Sales Planning 
  • Agency Management 

  • Budget Management 

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

We are an equal opportunity employer/minority/female/disability/protected veteran.

jobs.title: Westfield Summer Intern
jobs.description_html:
Summer Internship Program

At Westfield, our interns are active contributors, not observers. Through meaningful projects, professional development opportunities, and collaboration with experienced professionals, you'll gain hands-on experience while making an impact across the business.

Our Summer Internship Program provides opportunities to explore careers in insurance, technology, analytics, finance, human resources, communications, and other business functions. Throughout the summer, interns build professional skills, grow their networks, and gain valuable insight into how a leading property & casualty insurance company serves its customers, agents, and communities.

What You'll Experience

As a Westfield Intern, you may:

  • Contribute to meaningful projects that support business goals and strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborate with professionals and leaders across the organization.
  • Develop technical, analytical, and professional skills through real-world work experiences.
  • Participate in networking events, learning sessions, and professional development opportunities.
  • Gain exposure to the insurance industry and the many career paths it offers.
  • Present your work and recommendations to business leaders and stakeholders.

Internship Opportunities

Actuarial
Actuarial Interns support key insurance functions including pricing, reserving, predictive modeling, and data analysis. Interns work alongside experienced actuaries to solve business problems, analyze trends, and help drive data-informed decisions that support Westfield's success.

Claims
Claims Interns gain exposure to the claims process and how Westfield delivers exceptional service to customers during important moments. Interns may assist with claim investigations, data analysis, process improvement initiatives, and projects that support operational excellence.

Communications
Communications Interns help tell Westfield's story through internal and external communications, content creation, employee engagement initiatives, and digital communication strategies. Interns gain experience supporting programs that strengthen relationships with employees, customers, agents, and communities.

Data Analytics & Reporting
Data Analytics & Reporting Interns work with data, reporting tools, and business stakeholders to deliver insights that support decision-making. Interns gain experience analyzing information, identifying trends, and helping transform data into meaningful business outcomes.

Data Science
Data Science Interns support the development of analytical and predictive solutions that address real-world business challenges. Interns work with large data sets, explore emerging analytical techniques, and help generate insights that influence strategic decision-making.

Finance & Accounting
Finance & Accounting Interns gain experience supporting financial operations, reporting, analysis, budgeting, and business planning activities. Interns develop a deeper understanding of how financial information supports organizational performance and strategic decision-making.

Government Relations
Government Relations Interns gain exposure to legislative, regulatory, and public policy issues impacting the insurance industry. Interns may research emerging topics, monitor industry developments, and support initiatives that help advance Westfield's business objectives.

Human Resources
Human Resources Interns support initiatives related to talent acquisition, employee experience, learning and development, compensation, benefits, and organizational effectiveness. Interns gain hands-on experience helping create a positive and engaging workplace culture.

Information Security
Information Security Interns assist with efforts to protect Westfield's systems, data, and digital assets. Interns gain exposure to cybersecurity practices, risk management, threat monitoring, and initiatives designed to strengthen the organization's security posture.

Information Technology
Information Technology Interns work with technology professionals to support systems, applications, infrastructure, and digital solutions that enable business success. Interns gain practical experience applying technology to solve business challenges and improve user experiences.

Internal Audit
Internal Audit Interns help evaluate business processes, internal controls, and risk management practices across the organization. Interns learn how organizations identify opportunities for improvement, strengthen controls, and support effective governance.

Risk Control
Risk Control Interns partner with professionals who help organizations identify, assess, and mitigate risk. Interns gain exposure to risk management strategies, safety practices, loss prevention activities, and customer-focused consulting services.

Customer Care Center 

Customer Care Center Interns will utilize strong analytical skills to assist the Leadership Team with consolidating and analyzing data across the contact center, billing,  and claims teams.  Interns will analyze trends, identify drivers of performance, and create reports for leaders leveraging tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and contact center management software.

 Hospitality

Our hospitality internship program offers students the opportunity to gain hands-on, real-world experience in a premier golf and conference center environment. Interns can explore a variety of career paths, including golf course turfgrass management, event operations, guest services, and other hospitality operations. From preparing championship-quality playing surfaces to helping execute weddings, corporate events, tournaments, and special occasions, every day brings a new experience. Our interns work alongside experienced professionals and are trusted with meaningful responsibilities that build valuable skills and confidence. The program provides an inside look at the many career opportunities available within the golf, hospitality, events, and club management industries. Interns will develop professional relationships, expand their resumes, and gain practical experience that translates directly to future careers. Whether you are passionate about golf, events, hospitality, or operations, our program provides an opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow. Join our team and experience what it takes to create exceptional experiences for our guests and members.

Personal Lines

Personal Lines Internship provides the opportunity to join a team for a hands-on internship experience that provides exposure to both Underwriting and Product Management operations. You'll contribute to meaningful projects, support daily business activities, and gain valuable insight into how insurance products are developed, managed, and underwritten. This internship offers the opportunity to build industry knowledge, develop professional skills, and work alongside experienced professionals focused on protecting customers and driving profitable growth.  

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Strong academic performance and a desire to learn.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to think critically, solve problems, and take initiative.
  • Interest in gaining real-world business experience through a challenging and rewarding internship.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.

Why Westfield

At Westfield, you'll do meaningful work, build valuable professional relationships, and gain experience that helps prepare you for future career opportunities. We're committed to creating a supportive environment where interns can learn, contribute, and grow.

Behavioral Competencies:

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Nimble Learning

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Specialty Underwriter
jobs.description_html:
Job Summary

The Senior Underwriter, Reinsurance, will be part of the Westfield A&H Underwriting team. You will be responsible for underwriting Stop-Loss, Excess Reinsurance and other specialty products.

  • Reporting to the Chief Underwriting Officer A&H, you will be a key contributor to the overall analysis and management of our new and renewal business.

  • You will work directly with brokers to successfully price and design quotes to acquire individual accounts and business produced through MGA/MGU’s.

  • You will manage the relationship and profitability of program business written through assigned Managing General Underwriters.

  • The senior underwriter will propose effective underwriting strategies across various product lines.

  • You will be part of and present new and renewal opportunities to our Peer Review team (UW, Actuarial, Claims).

  • Contribute to the development and execution of our underwriting strategies.

  • Developing strong relationships with our business partners is a key goal for the department (Brokers, TPAs, vendors, etc.) You will manage specific assigned relationships.

  • Engage with brokers and customers in-person when needed

  •       Participate in new product development as part of the A&H team.

The salary range for this position is $100,000.00 to $170,000.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree, plus 8-10 years of professional experience in the A&H business with demonstrated knowledge of Stop Loss and Excess Reinsurance
  • Strong current technical knowledge of Employer Stop Loss 
  • Established broker relationships 
  • Program management experience

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Claims Specialist, Financial Lines
jobs.description_html:
Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the oversight of financial lines claims, including Private D&O, EPL, handled by a Managing General Underwriter (MGU).

  • Manage and oversee Plastic Card Fraud and Theft claims.

  • Monitor claim activity to ensure timely handling, appropriate investigation, reserving, and resolution consistent with company guidelines and delegated authority requirements.

  • Review claim bordereaux to understand claim developments, coverage considerations, exposure evaluations, and resolution strategies.

  • Escalate significant claim developments, coverage concerns, and high-exposure matters to management as appropriate.

  • Communicate regularly with MGU claim handlers regarding claim status, significant developments, reserve changes, and settlement activity.

  • Maintain accurate claim documentation and prepare written summaries, reports, and updates for management and business partners as needed.

  • Provide responsive and professional service to internal and external customers, business partners, brokers, and insureds.

  • Monitor compliance with applicable statutes, regulations, company guidelines, and delegated authority requirements.

  • Support mediations, settlement discussions, and claim resolution efforts by coordinating information and facilitating communication among stakeholders.

  • Participate in meetings with underwriting, brokers, insureds, and MGU partners as needed to support business relationships and claim-related discussions.

  • Assist in the coordination and management of outside vendors, including payment of defense counsel and other service providers, to support effective claim resolution.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1 to 3 years of experience at either an insurance carrier and/or law firm.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Candidates will be required to obtain and maintain insurance adjuster licenses. 

  • Excellent written communication skills.

  • Excellent verbal and interpersonal communication skills, resulting in the ability to interact with all levels of management and employee population.

  • Strong analytic, investigative, listening and negotiation skills. 

  • Experience multi-tasking, prioritizing work and working effectively in a team environment, while maintaining attention to detail.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment, completing work with limited supervision.

  • Experience with Microsoft Windows, Outlook, and Excel or transferable software packages.

  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed.

The salary range for this position is $125,000.00 to $170,000.00.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description_html:
The Executive Assistant provides high‑level administrative and operational support to the WSP Chief Financial Officer and the Executive Vice President, Financial Lines. This role requires strong judgment, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, highly confidential environment. The Executive Assistant partners closely with senior leadership, internal teams, and external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of day‑to‑day activities and key initiatives.

The role operates with moderate supervision and mentorship and is fully accountable for individual results and deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple complex and dynamic calendars, resolving conflicts and anticipating scheduling needs
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including itineraries, logistics, and expense documentation
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external communications on behalf of senior leaders
  • Prepare presentations, briefing materials, and other executive‑level documents with accuracy and professionalism
  • Support financial and business unit meetings by coordinating agendas, logistics, materials, and follow‑up actions
  • Prepare, submit, and track expense reports in a timely and accurate manner
  • Track key initiatives, deadlines, and deliverables across teams, ensuring alignment and follow‑through
  • Proactively anticipate issues, assess risks, and recommend solutions to support leadership effectiveness
  • Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion, integrity, and sound judgment
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with leaders, team members, and external partners
  • Screen and respond to incoming calls, requests, and visitors, prioritizing appropriately
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years of executive administrative experience, preferably supporting senior‑level leaders
  • Demonstrated experience supporting finance, insurance, or related business leaders preferred
  • Exceptional organizational, time‑management, and prioritization skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a high level of professionalism
  • Proven ability to adapt and succeed in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • High attention to detail and strong follow‑through on commitments
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration tools (Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Excel, etc.)
  • Proactive problem‑solver with the ability to anticipate needs and take initiative

The salary range for this position is $80,000 to $130,0000.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.
